papers.title: Theory of Spin-splitter Magnetoresistance in Altermagnets
papers.abstract: We develop a theory of angle-dependent magnetoresistance (ADMR) in metallic altermagnets coupled to ferromagnetic insulators and establish criteria that distinguish them from conventional compensated magnets with spin-orbit coupling. We show that the spin-splitter magnetoresistance (SSMR) reported by H. Chen et al. [Adv. Mater. 37, 2507764 (2025)] constitutes a smoking-gun signature of collinear altermagnetism in metallic systems. In contrast to spin-Hall magnetoresistance (SMR), SSMR exhibits three key distinctions: it depends solely on the relative orientation between the ferromagnetic magnetization and the altermagnetic Néel vector, yields a longitudinal ADMR response of opposite sign, and features a direct proportionality between longitudinal and transverse ADMR signals, absent in SMR. These results provide a clear route to unambiguously identify altermagnets in transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a theory、establish criteria、show that。；研究对象：金属性交变磁体（altermagnets）与铁磁绝缘体耦合体系中的自旋劈裂磁电阻（SSMR）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋劈裂磁电阻（SSMR）是金属体系中共线交变磁性（collinear altermagnetism）的确凿特征，其与自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）存在三个关键区别：仅依赖于铁磁磁化与交变磁奈尔矢量的相对取向、产生符号相反的纵向ADMR响应、以及纵向与横向ADMR信号之间存在直接比例关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋劈裂磁电阻（SSMR）是金属体系中共线交变磁性（collinear altermagnetism）的确凿特征，其与自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）存在三个关键区别：仅依赖于铁磁磁化与交变磁奈尔矢量的相对取向、产生符号相反的纵向ADMR响应、以及纵向与横向ADMR信号之间存在直接比例关系。；创新点：首次从理论上证明SSMR可作为区分金属交变磁体与具有自旋轨道耦合的传统补偿磁体的“确凿证据”，并明确了SSMR区别于SMR的三大判据。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，具体建立了金属交变磁体中角度依赖磁电阻（ADMR）的理论框架，并对比分析了SSMR与SMR的输运特征。

papers.title: Lyapunov Exponents as Duality-Invariant Signatures of Critical States
papers.abstract: Critical eigenstates are usually identified through wave-function geometry in a chosen basis, such as participation ratios, multifractal spectra, or finite-size scaling. Here we formulate criticality instead as a dual-space Lyapunov property. We prove a Fourier exclusion principle: exponential localization in one representation is incompatible with exponential localization in its Fourier-dual representation. This turns the Liu--Xia condition, \(γ_x(E)=γ_m(E)=0\), from a phenomenological criterion into a rigorous length-scale statement: a critical state is characterized by the simultaneous absence of exponential confinement in real and momentum space. The criterion is invariant under bounded local gauge transformations of the transfer matrix and remains compatible with conventional single-space multifractal diagnostics. More importantly, it is exactly predictive. In analytically tractable quasiperiodic models, the same condition yields closed-form critical lines, an exact finite critical region with an additional critical branch, and a complex critical surface in a non-Hermitian non-self-dual spectrum. Thus the Liu--Xia condition provides not only a diagnostic of critical states, but an exact solvability principle for locating critical sets across distinct microscopic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“Lyapunov exponents”、“duality-invariant”、“rigorous length-scale statement”、“exactly predictive”、“closed-form critical lines”等，均为理论推导与数学分析。；研究对象：临界态（critical states）的识别与判定，具体针对准周期模型（quasiperiodic models）中的临界态，以及非厄米非自对偶谱中的临界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个基于对偶空间Lyapunov指数的临界态判定准则（Liu–Xia条件：γ_x(E)=γ_m(E)=0），该准则严格等价于实空间和动量空间同时不存在指数局域化，且具有对偶不变性，能精确预测临界线、临界区域和临界面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个基于对偶空间Lyapunov指数的临界态判定准则（Liu–Xia条件：γ_x(E)=γ_m(E)=0），该准则严格等价于实空间和动量空间同时不存在指数局域化，且具有对偶不变性，能精确预测临界线、临界区域和临界面。；创新点：将原本唯象的Liu–Xia条件提升为严格的长度尺度判据，并证明其具有对偶不变性和精确预测能力，能够解析地确定不同微观结构中的临界集。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括：傅里叶排除原理（Fourier exclusion principle）的证明、转移矩阵的局域规范变换不变性分析、以及准周期模型中解析求解临界条件的应用。

papers.title: Anomalous and diode Josephson effect in junctions with inhomogeneous ferromagnetic barrier and interfacial Rashba spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the anomalous and diode Josephson effects in planar two-dimensional Josephson junctions with arbitrarily oriented exchange fields in two ferromagnets within the barrier, and spin-orbit coupling at the superconductor/ferromagnet interfaces, where the superconducting electrodes can have $s$-wave or arbitrarily oriented $d$-wave order parameter lobes. We perform a systematic symmetry analysis of the junction Hamiltonian and identify the minimal conditions for breaking time-reversal and space-inversion symmetries, which are required for the emergence of anomalous and diode Josephson effects. We classify the junctions into three classes, with particular attention to those between $d_{x^2-y^2}$ and $d_{xy}$ oriented superconductors. Our symmetry analysis is supported by numerical calculations of the current-phase relation (CPR) obtained using a generalized Furusaki-Tsukada (F-T) approach. By tuning the directions of exchange fields in the ferromagnets, Rashba SOC at the interfaces and superconducting order parameter orientations, nonreciprocity can be enhanced by more than 40\%. We further analyze the phase-dependent Andreev bound states (ABS) spectrum and their contribution to charge transport, as well as their signatures in the nonreciprocal transport characteristics. By comparing the current carried by ABS with that obtained using the F-T technique, we find that the contribution from continuum states above the gap becomes pronounced in presence of zero energy crossings in the ABS spectrum, and in junctions with $d$-wave superconducting electrodes due to the narrower superconducting gap, which may become closed. In the nonreciprocal regime, the ABS spectra show an asymmetric profile with respect to phase inversion, indicating the presence of a finite current at zero phase difference and unequal critical currents in opposite directions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically investigate、symmetry analysis、numerical calculations、generalized Furusaki-Tsukada approach）；研究对象：具有非均匀铁磁势垒和界面Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的平面二维约瑟夫森结，其中超导电极可为s波或任意取向d波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统对称性分析，识别了打破时间反演和空间反演对称性的最小条件，并发现通过调节铁磁体交换场方向、界面Rashba SOC及超导序参量取向，非互易性可增强超过40%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统对称性分析，识别了打破时间反演和空间反演对称性的最小条件，并发现通过调节铁磁体交换场方向、界面Rashba SOC及超导序参量取向，非互易性可增强超过40%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于结哈密顿量）、广义Furusaki-Tsukada方法计算电流-相位关系、以及相位依赖的Andreev束缚态谱分析。

papers.title: Optical selection rules in hexagonal Ge polytypes and their lifting by symmetry perturbation
papers.abstract: Hexagonal germanium polytypes have emerged as promising direct-gap semiconductors for silicon-integrated optoelectronics, yet their optical properties remain largely unexplored beyond the well-studied 2H phase. We present a comprehensive theoretical study of optical properties of hexagonal 2H-, 4H-, and 6H-Ge polytypes through ab initio calculations of quasiparticle band structures, dipole transition matrix elements, and solution of the Bethe-Salpeter equation. While all three polytypes exhibit direct band gaps of increasing size from 2H to 6H, we reveal that the fundamental optical transition in 4H-Ge is parity-forbidden due to matching band parities at the valence and conduction band edges. This selection rule results in a radiative lifetime seven orders of magnitude longer than in 2H- and 6H-Ge, severely limiting light emission capabilities. To demonstrate that the selection rule can be lifted, we introduce controlled symmetry perturbations by substituting single Ge atoms with Si in each unit cell, breaking the crystal symmetry. This perturbation increases the optical matrix elements by up to two orders of magnitude and reduces radiative lifetimes for all perturbed polytypes. We also compute absorption coefficients and frequency-dependent dielectric tensors for both light polarizations, including excitonic effects up to 5 eV, providing complete optical characterization of ideal and symmetry-perturbed hexagonal Ge systems relevant for optoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：ab initio calculations、quasiparticle band structures、Bethe-Salpeter equation。；研究对象：六方锗（Ge）多型体（2H、4H、6H相）的光学性质，以及通过硅（Si）替代引入对称性扰动后的光学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 4H-Ge中基本光学跃迁因价带与导带边宇称匹配而呈宇称禁戒，导致其辐射寿命比2H-和6H-Ge长七个数量级；通过Si替代引入对称性扰动可打破该选择定则，将光学矩阵元提升两个数量级并显著缩短辐射寿命。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：4H-Ge中基本光学跃迁因价带与导带边宇称匹配而呈宇称禁戒，导致其辐射寿命比2H-和6H-Ge长七个数量级；通过Si替代引入对称性扰动可打破该选择定则，将光学矩阵元提升两个数量级并显著缩短辐射寿命。；创新点：首次系统对比了2H、4H、6H三种六方Ge多型体的光学性质，揭示了4H相中因宇称匹配导致的超长辐射寿命这一关键限制，并提出了通过Si替代打破对称性、恢复发光能力的可行策略。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算：准粒子能带结构计算、偶极跃迁矩阵元计算、求解Bethe-Salpeter方程（含激子效应），并计算吸收系数和频率依赖介电张量（含两种光偏振方向，能量范围至5 eV）。

papers.title: Freestanding GdBa2Cu3O7 Thin Films via Optimized Buffer Layer Design: Preserving Superconducting Properties
papers.abstract: Freestanding GdBa2Cu3O7 (GdBCO) superconducting thin films were fabricated using a water-soluble Sr3Al2O6 (SAO) sacrificial layer in combination with thermal release tape. An amorphous Al2O3 capping layer was introduced to suppress crack formation during the lift-off process. The influence of buffer-layer design inserted between the GdBCO and SAO layers was systematically investigated with respect to structural integrity and superconducting properties after lift-off. A LaAlO3/SrTiO3 bilayer buffer was found to be essential for maintaining epitaxial growth and a superconducting transition temperature (Tc) of approximately 92 K after lift-off, comparable to that of the as-grown films. In contrast, a reversed SrTiO3/LaAlO3 bilayer and single-layer buffer structures led to a suppression of Tc, highlighting the critical role of stacking sequence. These results demonstrate that optimization of the buffer-layer design is a key factor for realizing high-quality freestanding GdBCO films while maintaining their superconducting characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabricated、systematically investigated、demonstrate。；研究对象：GdBa2Cu3O7 (GdBCO) 高温超导薄膜，具体为通过水溶性牺牲层和缓冲层设计制备的自支撑薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用 LaAlO3/SrTiO3 双层缓冲层结构，可在剥离后保持 GdBCO 薄膜的外延生长和约 92 K 的超导转变温度（Tc），与生长态薄膜相当；而反转的 SrTiO3/LaAlO3 双层或单层缓冲层则导致 Tc 降低，表明缓冲层堆叠顺序对维持超导性能至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用 LaAlO3/SrTiO3 双层缓冲层结构，可在剥离后保持 GdBCO 薄膜的外延生长和约 92 K 的超导转变温度（Tc），与生长态薄膜相当；而反转的 SrTiO3/LaAlO3 双层或单层缓冲层则导致 Tc 降低，表明缓冲层堆叠顺序对维持超导性能至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用水溶性 Sr3Al2O6 (SAO) 牺牲层结合热释放胶带制备自支撑薄膜；引入非晶 Al2O3 覆盖层抑制剥离过程中的裂纹；系统比较不同缓冲层设计（LaAlO3/SrTiO3 双层、SrTiO3/LaAlO3 双层及单层缓冲层）对结构完整性和超导性能的影响。

papers.title: Transverse Magnetic Response from Orbitally Polarized Cooper Pairs in Elemental Superconductors
papers.abstract: We demonstrate how crystalline symmetry lowering, as for instance through strain, allows elemental superconductors such as vanadium and niobium to realize spin-singlet orbitally polarized Cooper pairs composed of electrons with identical orbital moments. Using superconducting density functional theory, we show that lowering of trigonal symmetry to $C_s$, thus keeping only a single mirror plane, activates interorbital pairing in bulk and (111) surfaces, with a pronounced surface enhancement. In a magnetic field, the resulting orbitally polarized superconducting state leads to a novel transverse magnetic response. For in--plane field orientations that break the remaining mirror symmetry, a sizable orbital magnetization emerges perpendicular to the applied field. We show that this effect is a direct consequence of equal--orbital-moment Cooper pairing, providing an experimentally accessible signature of this state. Our results establish strained elemental superconductors as a minimal material platform for superconducting orbitronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：superconducting density functional theory（超导密度泛函理论）、demonstrate（理论论证）、show（计算展示）。；研究对象：元素超导体（如钒、铌）在晶体对称性降低（如应变）条件下形成的轨道极化库珀对，以及由此产生的横向磁响应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过降低晶体对称性（如将三方对称性降至仅保留一个镜面的Cs对称性），元素超导体中可实现由相同轨道角动量的电子组成的自旋单态轨道极化库珀对；这种配对态在面内磁场打破剩余镜面对称性时，会产生垂直于外场的横向轨道磁化，可作为该超导态的实验可观测特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过降低晶体对称性（如将三方对称性降至仅保留一个镜面的Cs对称性），元素超导体中可实现由相同轨道角动量的电子组成的自旋单态轨道极化库珀对；这种配对态在面内磁场打破剩余镜面对称性时，会产生垂直于外场的横向轨道磁化，可作为该超导态的实验可观测特征。；创新点：首次在元素超导体这一最简材料平台中预言了轨道极化库珀对的存在，并揭示了其独特的横向磁响应作为实验探测手段，为超导轨道电子学（superconducting orbitronics）提供了最小化材料体系。
papers.method_zh: 超导密度泛函理论（superconducting DFT），用于计算体相和(111)表面的超导配对性质及磁场响应。

papers.title: Ginzburg--Landau Theory for Confined Thin-Film Superconductors
papers.abstract: We develop a Ginzburg--Landau theory for superconducting thin films under quantum confinement. Starting from the microscopic BCS free energy and the recently developed confinement theory of metallic thin films, explicit analytical expressions are derived for the Ginzburg--Landau coefficients, coherence length, penetration depth, electronic mean free path, and Ginzburg--Landau parameter in confined geometries. The central result is that quantum confinement directly renormalizes the intrinsic superconducting coherence length through confinement-induced modifications of the electronic density of states and Fermi energy. This effect is absent in conventional thin-film transport theories based solely on surface scattering. As a consequence, confinement simultaneously suppresses the coherence length and enhances the penetration depth, thereby driving superconductors toward progressively stronger type-II behavior with decreasing film thickness. The theory predicts a crossover regime in which confinement-induced renormalization of superconducting length scales and transport scattering become strongly intertwined. Comparison with recent penetration-depth measurements in Al thin films shows that the observed enhancement of the penetration depth originates from the interplay between confinement-induced renormalization of the coherence length and suppression of the effective mean free path by surface and disorder scattering. The results establish a direct connection between quantum confinement and superconducting electrodynamics in confined metallic films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a Ginzburg--Landau theory、derive explicit analytical expressions、starting from the microscopic BCS free energy。；研究对象：量子受限下的超导薄膜，具体为受限几何结构中的超导薄层，以及其电动力学性质（如相干长度、穿透深度、Ginzburg--Landau参数等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子禁闭通过修正电子态密度和费米能直接重整化超导体的内禀相干长度，同时抑制相干长度并增强穿透深度，使超导薄膜随厚度减小而趋向更强的第二类超导行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子禁闭通过修正电子态密度和费米能直接重整化超导体的内禀相干长度，同时抑制相干长度并增强穿透深度，使超导薄膜随厚度减小而趋向更强的第二类超导行为。；创新点：揭示了量子禁闭对超导长度尺度的直接重整化效应，这一效应在仅考虑表面散射的传统薄膜输运理论中未被包含；并指出禁闭诱导的长度尺度重整化与输运散射在特定厚度区间内强烈耦合。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观BCS自由能和金属薄膜的禁闭理论，推导出受限几何中Ginzburg-Landau系数的解析表达式，并与Al薄膜的穿透深度实验测量结果进行对比。

papers.title: Micro-environment of the Eu interstitial in $β$-SiAlON:Eu$^{2+}$ green phosphor
papers.abstract: The precise atomic-scale structure around Eu$^{2+}$ activators in the $β$-Si$_{6-z}$Al$_z$O$_z$N$_{8-z}$:Eu$^{2+}$ commercial green phosphor remains elusive. We use the first-principles $Δ$SCF excited-state method, embedding of the interatomic force constants for supercells up to 3501 atoms, and Huang-Rhys theory to clarify this issue. Monte Carlo exploration is used to identify representative low-energy structural models spanning different levels of Al/O concentration $z$. For the lowest-energy structure at low $z$, our computed photoluminescence spectrum reproduces the experimental vibronic peaks at 6~K with excellent agreement in peak positions and intensities, validating the Eu-N$_9$ coordination model with Al, O, and Eu confined to the same crystallographic plane. Analysis of the low-energy structures reveals that the electron-phonon coupling is weak ($S \approx 2.15$) with a robust characteristic phonon signature across different Al/O arrangements, explaining the surprising persistence of resolved phonon replicas with increasing $z$. We explain the experimentally observed red-shift of emission with increasing $z$ through systematic trends in zero-phonon line energies, modest increases in Huang-Rhys factors, and larger configurational diversity at higher compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles ΔSCF excited-state method、Monte Carlo exploration、Huang-Rhys theory）；研究对象：商用绿色荧光粉β-Si₆₋zAl_zO_zN₈₋z:Eu²⁺中Eu²⁺激活剂周围的微观原子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证实了Eu-N₉配位模型，其中Al、O和Eu共面；揭示了不同Al/O浓度下电子-声子耦合较弱（S≈2.15），并解释了随z增加发射光谱红移的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证实了Eu-N₉配位模型，其中Al、O和Eu共面；揭示了不同Al/O浓度下电子-声子耦合较弱（S≈2.15），并解释了随z增加发射光谱红移的机制。；创新点：首次通过第一性原理激发态计算精确再现了低温（6 K）下实验振动峰的位置和强度，从而明确了Eu²⁺在β-SiAlON中的局域配位环境。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理ΔSCF激发态方法、嵌入原子间力常数的超大胞（最多3501个原子）计算、Huang-Rhys理论、Monte Carlo结构搜索。

papers.title: Cavity-Induced Excitonic Insulation and Non-Fermi-Liquid Behavior in Dirac Materials
papers.abstract: We investigate two-dimensional Dirac fermions embedded in a deep-subwavelength cavity formed by high-impedance metasurfaces. We point out that, unlike conventional metallic boundaries, these metasurfaces support quasielectrostatic transverse-magnetic modes that mediate a long-range interaction between two-dimensional electrons. Combining static electronic screening with a Dyson-Schwinger analysis, we show that this engineered interaction can qualitatively alter the ground-state properties of Dirac materials. For a fermion flavor number $N_{f}$ below a critical value $N_{c}=16/π$, the interaction drives an excitonic insulating phase through an infinite-order quantum phase transition and spontaneously generates a mass gap. At $N_{f}>N_{c}$, the system remains gapless but enters a non-Fermi-liquid critical regime where the quasiparticle residue is singularly suppressed to zero, and the Dirac cone exhibits a nonanalytic dispersion relation. Furthermore, under a perpendicular magnetic field, the cavity fluctuations dynamically lift the zeroth Landau level degeneracy across all $N_{f}$. These results identify high-impedance metasurface cavities as promising platforms for engineering correlated Dirac matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“investigate”、“point out”、“show”、“analysis”，采用Dyson-Schwinger分析等理论框架，无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：嵌入高阻抗超表面形成的深亚波长腔中的二维狄拉克费米子，以及该体系中的激子绝缘相和非费米液体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过腔工程的长程相互作用，当费米子味数N_f低于临界值N_c=16/π时，系统会通过无穷级量子相变进入激子绝缘相并自发产生质量间隙；当N_f>N_c时，系统保持无能隙但进入非费米液体临界区，准粒子权重被奇异抑制为零，狄拉克锥呈现非解析色散关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过腔工程的长程相互作用，当费米子味数N_f低于临界值N_c=16/π时，系统会通过无穷级量子相变进入激子绝缘相并自发产生质量间隙；当N_f>N_c时，系统保持无能隙但进入非费米液体临界区，准粒子权重被奇异抑制为零，狄拉克锥呈现非解析色散关系。；创新点：指出高阻抗超表面腔（而非传统金属边界）支持的准静电横磁模式可介导二维电子间的长程相互作用，并证明这种工程化相互作用能定性改变狄拉克材料的基态性质。摘要未突出说明与已有腔量子电动力学或激子绝缘体研究的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 静态电子屏蔽结合Dyson-Schwinger方程分析。

papers.title: Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible Model with Mitigation on Scale-Free Networks
papers.abstract: We investigate infectious disease spreading on scale-free networks using a heterogeneous mean-field approach applied to the susceptible-infected-susceptible model, incorporating a mitigation factor. Individual heterogeneity is incorporated through a power-law distribution, while a mitigation factor accounts for behavioral responses and external effects that effectively reduce transmission from infected individuals. This mechanism, inspired by Malthus-Verhulst-type constraints, introduces a nonlinear saturation effect that encodes self-limiting dynamics in a tractable way. Analytical results are supported by stochastic simulations. We find that the mitigation factor induces a nontrivial behavior in the probability that a link points to an infected node, which develops a maximum at finite infection rates. In contrast, the overall prevalence remains a monotonically increasing function of the transmission rate. Additionally, the mitigation mechanism leads to an inversion in the dependence of epidemic observables on the degree exponent at sufficiently high transmission rates. While in the standard model smaller exponents yield higher endemic prevalence, in the modified model this trend reverses, with larger exponents producing higher prevalence and increased infection probability along network links.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：heterogeneous mean-field approach（异质平均场方法）、analytical results（解析结果）、stochastic simulations（随机模拟）。；研究对象：在无标度网络上使用易感-感染-易感（SIS）模型进行传染病传播，并引入缓解因子（mitigation factor）来模拟行为响应和外部效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缓解因子导致感染节点连接概率出现非单调行为（在有限感染率下出现最大值），而整体感染率仍随传播率单调增加；在高传播率下，缓解机制反转了流行病可观测值对度指数的依赖关系——标准模型中较小的度指数导致更高的地方病流行率，而修改模型中较大的度指数反而导致更高的流行率和更高的感染连接概率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缓解因子导致感染节点连接概率出现非单调行为（在有限感染率下出现最大值），而整体感染率仍随传播率单调增加；在高传播率下，缓解机制反转了流行病可观测值对度指数的依赖关系——标准模型中较小的度指数导致更高的地方病流行率，而修改模型中较大的度指数反而导致更高的流行率和更高的感染连接概率。；创新点：将缓解因子（行为响应与外部效应）以非线性饱和机制形式纳入SIS模型，揭示了该机制导致的感染概率非单调行为及度指数依赖关系的反转现象。
papers.method_zh: 异质平均场理论（heterogeneous mean-field approach），结合幂律分布描述个体异质性，引入类似马尔萨斯-维尔赫斯特约束的缓解因子实现非线性饱和效应，并通过随机模拟验证解析结果。

papers.title: Oxygen vacancies beyond the dilute limit in doped CaMnO3 perovskites and implications for screening materials in thermochemical applications
papers.abstract: Thermochemical energy storage (TCES) in oxide perovskites relies on reversible oxygen vacancy formation, and computational high-throughput screening of candidate materials has predominantly used the single oxygen vacancy formation energy (OVFE) as the key descriptor. We demonstrate that the OVFE is insufficient for screening cubic CaMnO3 perovskites, because the stoichiometric compound is not the minimum energy reference state; vacancies are inherently present at operating temperatures. Materials with negative single OVFEs are routinely excluded from screening datasets as unsuitable, but this reflects a mischoice of reference state rather than a genuine materials limitation, and risks discarding promising TCES candidates. We address this by computing OVFEs as a function of vacancy concentration using ab initio density functional theory, establishing the equilibrium vacancy concentration as the correct reference point. OVFE curves referenced to this minimum align with experimentally measured reduction enthalpies, providing a framework directly comparable to experiments. We further show that A-site and B-site doping modify the vacancy formation landscape through distinct mechanisms. A-site dopants act primarily through strain relaxation and symmetry breaking, while B-site dopants reshape the local redox environment and introduce strong configurational dependence. Finally, we develop a thermodynamic model incorporating configurational entropy that accurately predicts equilibrium oxygen stoichiometry as a function of temperature and oxygen partial pressure and reveals that selective reduction of Mn4+ versus B-site dopant ions can tune the onset temperature for vacancy formation. These results establish a screening framework for perovskite TCES materials and provide practical guidance for extending high-throughput workflows beyond the single-vacancy paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“ab initio density functional theory”（第一性原理密度泛函理论）进行计算，并开发了热力学模型。；研究对象：掺杂的立方CaMnO₃钙钛矿氧化物，具体研究其在高热化学储能（TCES）应用中的氧空位形成行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统的单氧空位形成能（OVFE）不足以作为筛选CaMnO₃基钙钛矿TCES材料的描述符，因为化学计量比化合物并非能量最低的参考态；在操作温度下，材料本身已存在本征氧空位。将平衡空位浓度作为参考点计算的OVFE曲线与实验测量的还原焓一致，为材料筛选提供了更准确的框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统的单氧空位形成能（OVFE）不足以作为筛选CaMnO₃基钙钛矿TCES材料的描述符，因为化学计量比化合物并非能量最低的参考态；在操作温度下，材料本身已存在本征氧空位。将平衡空位浓度作为参考点计算的OVFE曲线与实验测量的还原焓一致，为材料筛选提供了更准确的框架。；创新点：1. 指出并纠正了以往高通量筛选中因错误选择化学计量比作为参考态而将负OVFE材料（实为有潜力的候选者）错误排除的问题。2. 揭示了A位和B位掺杂通过不同机制（A位：应变弛豫和对称性破缺；B位：改变局域氧化还原环境并引入强构型依赖性）调控空位形成能。3. 建立了可直接与实验比较的、基于平衡空位浓度的筛选框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算不同空位浓度下的氧空位形成能；建立了包含构型熵的热力学模型，用于预测平衡氧化学计量比随温度和氧分压的变化。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and dynamics of non-compact prismatic dislocation loops simulated using a machine-learning model
papers.abstract: We explore how the thermodynamic properties and dynamics of a self-interstitial prismatic dislocation loop are affected by microscopic-scale variations in its geometric configuration, an aspect that rarely received attention in literature. First, we develop a machine-learning (ML) model to predict the formation energy of an arbitrary geometrically complex configuration of a self-interstitial atom dislocation loop. Trained on atomistic simulation data, the ML model achieves high predictive accuracy across a broad range of configurations, with a typical error in the 1% range. Second, from the ML model, we evaluate the density of configurational microstates as a function of loop's formation energy and derive analytical expressions valid in tractable limiting cases. Using statistical mechanics, we derive the configurational free energy, the average energy, and the thermodynamic entropy of a dislocation loop as a function of temperature. Third, we simulate the dynamics of self-climb of dislocation loops with various geometries and evaluate their diffusion coefficients and effective activation energies. Our analysis shows that there is a single universal parameter describing the morphological irregularity of loop configurations in its ground state. This parameter determines the thermodynamic properties of a loop as well as its dynamics, and simulations illustrate how the properties and mobility of a configurationally complex loop vary as functions of the irregularity parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：开发机器学习模型、基于原子模拟数据、统计力学推导、动力学模拟。；研究对象：非紧凑棱柱位错环（self-interstitial prismatic dislocation loop）的热力学性质与动力学行为，重点关注其几何构型微观变化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位错环基态构型的形态不规则性可由单一普适参数描述，该参数同时决定环的热力学性质（如构型自由能、熵）和动力学行为（如自攀移扩散系数、有效激活能）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位错环基态构型的形态不规则性可由单一普适参数描述，该参数同时决定环的热力学性质（如构型自由能、熵）和动力学行为（如自攀移扩散系数、有效激活能）。；创新点：首次系统研究位错环几何构型微观变化对其热力学与动力学性质的影响，并揭示单一不规则性参数可统一描述构型复杂环的多种性质。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习（ML）模型预测任意复杂几何构型的形成能；基于原子模拟数据训练；统计力学推导构型自由能、平均能量和热力学熵；动力学模拟自攀移过程并计算扩散系数与有效激活能。

papers.title: Exact Fixed-Point Constraints in Neural-ODEs with Provable Universality
papers.abstract: We introduce a technique that enables Neural-ODEs to approximate arbitrary velocity fields with a priori planted fixed-points. Specifically, a recipe is given to explicitly accommodate for a finite collection of points in the reference multi-dimensional space of the Neural-ODE where the velocity field is exactly equal to zero. In this way, the gradient-based training is rigorously constrained inside the prescribed hypothesis class while leaving the expressive power of the Neural-ODE unaltered. We rigorously prove the universality of the Neural-ODE under any local constraints in the velocity field and give a computationally convenient way of imposing the fixed points. Our method is then tested on two paradigmatic physical models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Neural-ODEs、universality、proof、constraints。；研究对象：论文研究的是神经常微分方程（Neural-ODEs）的数学结构，具体关注其速度场（velocity field）在预设固定点（fixed-points）约束下的逼近能力。物理模型仅作为测试案例，未明确指定具体材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种在Neural-ODE中精确植入有限个固定点（速度场为零的点）的技术，并严格证明了即使施加此类局部约束，Neural-ODE仍保持普适逼近能力（universality）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种在Neural-ODE中精确植入有限个固定点（速度场为零的点）的技术，并严格证明了即使施加此类局部约束，Neural-ODE仍保持普适逼近能力（universality）。；创新点：首次在Neural-ODE中实现了对速度场的精确固定点约束，同时严格证明了该约束不破坏模型的普适逼近能力，并给出了计算上便捷的实现方式。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值验证相结合。理论部分通过构造性证明给出在速度场中显式植入固定点的数学配方，并证明该约束下Neural-ODE的普适性；数值部分在两个典型物理模型上测试了该方法。

papers.title: Inherent Altermagnetism on regular hyperbolic lattices
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are a novel class of magnetic systems characterized by their momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization. In this work, we extend established Euclidean tight-binding models of altermagnets to regular hyperbolic lattices in two spatial dimensions defined on a discretized Poincaré disk. Using hyperbolic crystallography and hyperbolic band theory, we show that the inclusion of next-nearest neighbor hopping is sufficient to induce spin splitting in bipartite hyperbolic lattices. While certain families and special cases of hyperbolic lattices remain antiferromagnetic, we identify an entire family and a special case that show spin splitting in this framework. Hence, altermagnetism is inherent to certain hyperbolic lattices. Since hyperbolic band theory yields a momentum space that is at least four-dimensional, we classify the leading spin-splitting harmonics using four-dimensional atomic orbitals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“extend established Euclidean tight-binding models”、“show that”、“classify”等关键词，主要进行模型构建和理论分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：规则双曲晶格（regular hyperbolic lattices）中的交错磁性（Altermagnetism）。具体体系为定义在离散化庞加莱圆盘上的二维双曲晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双曲晶格中，仅需引入次近邻跳跃（next-nearest neighbor hopping）即可诱导出自旋劈裂，表明交错磁性是某些双曲晶格的内在属性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双曲晶格中，仅需引入次近邻跳跃（next-nearest neighbor hopping）即可诱导出自旋劈裂，表明交错磁性是某些双曲晶格的内在属性。；创新点：首次将交错磁性的概念从欧几里得晶格拓展到规则双曲晶格，并证明了在双曲晶格中，交错磁性可以作为一种内禀属性存在，而不需要额外的对称性破缺机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：双曲晶体学（hyperbolic crystallography）和双曲能带理论（hyperbolic band theory）。模型：将欧几里得空间中的交错磁紧束缚模型推广到双曲空间。分析手段：利用四维原子轨道对主导的自旋劈裂谐波进行分类。

papers.title: Ultra-Fast Quantum Control via Non-Adiabatic Resonance Windows: A 9x Speed-up on 127-Qubit IBM Processors
papers.abstract: Standard adiabatic protocols for superconducting qubits often face a trade-off between gate speed and decoherence. In this work, using IBM Quantum 127-qubit processors (ibm_fez and ibm_kingston), we report the discovery of a fundamental non-adiabatic resonance window at about 4.9. This window demonstrates the potential for a 9.2-fold reduction in gate duration relative to the conventional adiabatic limit, while maintaining state high fidelities within the identified resonance windows. Through synchronous cross-backend execution, we demonstrate a near-perfect correlation (R = 0.9998) in the resonance profile, confirming the universality of the non-adiabatic parameter across independent hardware architectures. However, our longitudinal analysis reveals that these high-Q windows are sensitive to sub-percent calibration drifts, which dynamically shift the system into a stochastic regime. These findings suggest that achieving next-tier quantum performance requires a transition from static gate protocols to dynamic resonance-tracking control tools. This study provides both the theoretical foundation and the experimental evidence for such ultra-fast, high-performance quantum architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：明确使用IBM Quantum 127-qubit处理器（ibm_fez和ibm_kingston）进行量子门操作实验，并报告了实验测量结果（如共振剖面、保真度、校准漂移影响）。；研究对象：超导量子比特上的量子门控制协议，具体研究非绝热共振窗口对门操作速度与保真度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约4.9的参数位置发现了一个基本的非绝热共振窗口，该窗口可将门持续时间相对于传统绝热极限缩短约9.2倍，同时保持高保真度；但该窗口对亚百分比级别的校准漂移敏感，会动态进入随机区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约4.9的参数位置发现了一个基本的非绝热共振窗口，该窗口可将门持续时间相对于传统绝热极限缩短约9.2倍，同时保持高保真度；但该窗口对亚百分比级别的校准漂移敏感，会动态进入随机区域。；创新点：发现了非绝热共振窗口这一基本物理现象，并实验证明了其可实现9倍以上的门加速；通过跨硬件架构的近乎完美相关性（R=0.9998）确认了该非绝热参数的普适性；提出了从静态门协议向动态共振跟踪控制工具转变的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 使用IBM Quantum 127量子比特处理器进行量子门操作实验；通过同步跨后端执行（synchronous cross-backend execution）验证共振剖面的普适性；采用纵向分析（longitudinal analysis）研究校准漂移对共振窗口稳定性的影响。

papers.title: The diffusion equation for non-Markovian Gaussian stochastic processes
papers.abstract: We derive the exact evolution equation for the probability density function of particle displacements generated by arbitrary Gaussian velocity processes, when neither Markovianity and nor stationarity are assumed. Starting from the characteristic function of the density of the position, we construct a systematic hierarchy of equations based on Wick's theorem, in which the dynamics is governed by sums of geometrically connected Wick contractions. This approach yields a closed non-Markovian diffusion equation that generalizes the Fokker-Planck description and preserves Gaussianity only in the infinite-order limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、evolution equation（演化方程）、Wick's theorem（Wick定理）、non-Markovian diffusion equation（非马尔可夫扩散方程）。；研究对象：非马尔可夫高斯随机过程（non-Markovian Gaussian stochastic processes）中粒子位移的概率密度函数演化。具体物理现象为一般性高斯速度过程驱动的扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了任意高斯速度过程（不假设马尔可夫性和平稳性）下粒子位移概率密度函数的精确演化方程，该方程是一个封闭的非马尔可夫扩散方程，推广了福克-普朗克描述，且仅在无穷阶极限下才保持高斯性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了任意高斯速度过程（不假设马尔可夫性和平稳性）下粒子位移概率密度函数的精确演化方程，该方程是一个封闭的非马尔可夫扩散方程，推广了福克-普朗克描述，且仅在无穷阶极限下才保持高斯性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。从位置密度的特征函数出发，基于Wick定理构建了由几何连通Wick收缩之和控制动力学的系统方程层级，最终得到封闭的非马尔可夫扩散方程。

papers.title: Data-driven body-centered cubic phase prediction in cobalt free high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) are known for superb combination of performance attributes, making them ideal for advanced applications, e.g., nuclear engineering. The concept of cobalt-free HEAs aims to mitigate concerns about cobalt's radioactivity, however, predicting their phase formation remains challenging due to their complex compositions. In this work, we integrate six semiempirical parameters, i.e., mixing entropy (ΔSmix), mixing enthalpy (ΔHmix), atomic size difference (δ), valence electron concentration (VEC), d-orbital energy level (Md), and the Ω parameter, along with machine learning (ML) to predict the body-centered cubic phase stability in Co free HEAs. To address the limitations of experimental data, generative adversarial networks were used to augment the dataset, thus improving the accuracy of the Gaussian process classification model used for phase prediction. After dimensionality reduction to five principal components, the model achieved an accuracy of 84%, with ΔHmix and δ identified as the key descriptors influencing phase formation. This approach highlights the synergy of ML and data augmentation in accelerating the design of HEAs for advanced applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning (ML)、Gaussian process classification model、data augmentation、generative adversarial networks。；研究对象：无钴高熵合金（Co-free high-entropy alloys）中体心立方（BCC）相的稳定性预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合六个半经验参数与机器学习，并利用生成对抗网络扩充数据集，实现了对无钴高熵合金BCC相稳定性的有效预测，准确率达到84%，其中混合焓（ΔHmix）和原子尺寸差（δ）被识别为影响相形成的关键描述符。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合六个半经验参数与机器学习，并利用生成对抗网络扩充数据集，实现了对无钴高熵合金BCC相稳定性的有效预测，准确率达到84%，其中混合焓（ΔHmix）和原子尺寸差（δ）被识别为影响相形成的关键描述符。；创新点：针对无钴高熵合金这一特定体系，利用数据增强（GAN）克服实验数据有限的瓶颈，并结合机器学习模型系统预测BCC相稳定性，明确了关键描述符。
papers.method_zh: 整合了六个半经验参数（混合熵ΔSmix、混合焓ΔHmix、原子尺寸差δ、价电子浓度VEC、d轨道能级Md、Ω参数），采用生成对抗网络（GAN）进行数据增强，并使用高斯过程分类模型进行相预测，最后通过主成分分析（PCA）将维度降至五个主成分。

papers.title: Structural transition and fragmentation of vortex lattices in rotating tilted dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: We investigate the vortex lattices of harmonically confined quasi-two-dimensional tilted rotational dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates. By employing an extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation for a rotating condensate, we reveal the structural transformation of vortices from square to triangular lattices as the tilt of dipolar bosons relative to the polarization axis approaches a critical angle. When the tilt of the magnetic dipoles surpasses the magic angle, the condensate elongates diagonally and becomes devoid of vortices. Moreover, we include the Lee-Huang-Yang correction, which enables the formation of vortices in the elongated condensate. Additionally, when dipoles are oriented perpendicular to the polarization axis, the Lee-Huang-Yang correction results in the fragmentation of condensates under strong rotation. The quench dynamics of the rotational frequency demonstrate the development of vortex lattices; however, with a strong rotational quench, the condensate remains free of vortices. Our numerical analysis highlights the beyond mean-field effects of the rotational properties of anisotropic dipolar bosons, which can be observed in current dipolar quantum gas experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：数值分析、扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程）；研究对象：旋转倾斜偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的涡旋晶格，具体为谐振势约束下的准二维倾斜旋转偶极BEC。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了偶极玻色子倾斜角接近临界角时，涡旋晶格从正方形到三角形的结构转变；当倾斜角超过“魔角”时，凝聚体沿对角线拉长且无涡旋。引入Lee-Huang-Yang修正后，可在拉长凝聚体中形成涡旋，并在强旋转下导致凝聚体碎裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了偶极玻色子倾斜角接近临界角时，涡旋晶格从正方形到三角形的结构转变；当倾斜角超过“魔角”时，凝聚体沿对角线拉长且无涡旋。引入Lee-Huang-Yang修正后，可在拉长凝聚体中形成涡旋，并在强旋转下导致凝聚体碎裂。；创新点：该工作系统地研究了偶极相互作用各向异性（通过倾斜角调控）对旋转BEC中涡旋晶格结构的影响，并特别强调了超越平均场效应（Lee-Huang-Yang修正）在强旋转和特定倾角下对涡旋形成和凝聚体碎裂的关键作用。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用描述旋转凝聚体的扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，并包含了超越平均场效应的Lee-Huang-Yang修正项。通过分析旋转频率的淬火动力学来研究涡旋晶格的形成。

papers.title: Collective Alignment in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: Disentangling Bias from Cooperation via Statistical Physics
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergent collective dynamics of LLM-based multi-agent systems on a 2D square lattice and present a model-agnostic statistical-physics method to disentangle social conformity from intrinsic bias, compute critical exponents, and probe the collective behavior and possible phase transitions of multi-agent systems. In our framework, each node of an $L\!\times\!L$ lattice hosts an identical LLM agent holding a binary state ($+1$/$-1$, mapped to yes/no) and updating it by querying the model conditioned on the four nearest-neighbor states. The sampler temperature $T$ serves as the sole control parameter. Across three open-weight models (llama3.1:8b, phi4-mini:3.8b, mistral:7b), we measure magnetization and susceptibility under a global-flip protocol designed to probe $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry. All models display temperature-driven order-disorder crossovers and susceptibility peaks; finite-size scaling on even-$L$ lattices yields effective exponents $γ/ν$ whose values are model-dependent, close to but incompatible with the 2D Ising universality class ($γ/ν=7/4$). Our method enables the extraction of effective $β$-weighted couplings $\tilde{J}(T)$ and fields $\tilde{h}(T)$, which serve as a measure of social conformity and intrinsic bias. In the models we analyzed, we found that collective alignment is dominated by an intrinsic bias ($\tilde{h}\gg\tilde{J}$) rather than by cooperative neighbor coupling, producing field-driven crossovers instead of genuine phase transitions. These effective parameters vary qualitatively across models, providing compact collective-behavior fingerprints for LLM agents and a quantitative diagnostic for the reliability of multi-agent consensus and collective alignment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出一种模型无关的统计物理方法”“计算临界指数”“有限尺寸标度”等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统在二维正方晶格上的集体对齐行为，具体研究社会从众性（social conformity）与内在偏见（intrinsic bias）的区分，以及系统可能存在的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LLM多智能体系统的集体对齐主要由内在偏见主导（\(\tilde{h}\gg\tilde{J}\)），而非邻居间的合作耦合，因此系统呈现场驱动的交叉行为而非真正的相变；有效临界指数与二维Ising普适类（\(\gamma/\nu=7/4\)）接近但不一致，且模型间存在定性差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LLM多智能体系统的集体对齐主要由内在偏见主导（\(\tilde{h}\gg\tilde{J}\)），而非邻居间的合作耦合，因此系统呈现场驱动的交叉行为而非真正的相变；有效临界指数与二维Ising普适类（\(\gamma/\nu=7/4\)）接近但不一致，且模型间存在定性差异。；创新点：提出一种模型无关的统计物理框架，能够从LLM多智能体系统的集体行为中定量分离社会从众性与内在偏见，并给出紧凑的集体行为指纹，为多智能体共识与对齐的可靠性提供定量诊断。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计物理方法，将每个晶格节点上的LLM智能体视为具有二元状态（+1/-1）的自旋，通过查询模型（基于四个最近邻状态）更新状态；以采样温度 \(T\) 为唯一控制参数，测量磁化强度和磁化率，并利用全局翻转协议探测 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 对称性；对偶数尺寸晶格进行有限尺寸标度，提取有效临界指数 \(\gamma/\nu\) 以及有效耦合 \(\tilde{J}(T)\) 和有效场 \(\tilde{h}(T)\)。

papers.title: Rare-Earth-Tuned Evolution from d- to f-Orbital Dominance and Giant Anomalous Hall Effect in Topological RGaGe (R = Ce, Pr, Nd) Semimetals
papers.abstract: The family of noncentrosymmetric rare-earth germanides RGaGe (R = Ce, Pr, Nd) provides a rich materials platform to explore the intertwined physics of strong magnetism, electronic correlations, and topological band structures. Through a combination of crystal growth, characterization, and first-principles calculations, we reveal that these compounds exhibit a pronounced uniaxial magnetic anisotropy, leading to distinct ground states: RGaGe orders ferromagnetically with moments along the crystallographic c-axis, and shows an antiferromagnetic-like structure in the ab-plane. A key finding is a significantly enhanced intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) compared to their well-known RAlGe counterparts, which even reaches as high as 948 Ω-1 cm-1 at 2 K in PrGaGe. Our theoretical analysis predicts that this AHC originates from a robust Weyl semimetallic state driven by inversion symmetry breaking, where Weyl points near the Fermi level couple strongly to the magnetic order. Importantly, this topological state persists above the magnetic ordering temperature, confirming its intrinsic electronic origin. Our calculation also reveals that, while the near-Fermi-level states in CeGaGe and PrGaGe are dominated by d-orbital contributions, NdGaGe exhibits significant f-orbital involvement, signaling a progressive evolution from d- to f-orbital dominated topology. These results establish the RGaGe system as a tunable platform for systematically extending the RAlGe-related family, showcasing a large anomalous Hall response and orbital evolution near the Fermi level, and advancing the understanding of the interplay between topology and magnetism in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“crystal growth, characterization, and first-principles calculations”，即晶体生长、表征和第一性原理计算。；研究对象：非中心对称稀土锗化物RGaGe（R = Ce, Pr, Nd）拓扑半金属，具体研究其磁性、电子关联、拓扑能带结构以及反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RGaGe体系表现出显著增强的本征反常霍尔电导率（AHC），在PrGaGe中于2 K时高达948 Ω⁻¹ cm⁻¹，且该效应源于由反演对称性破缺驱动的稳健Weyl半金属态；同时，从CeGaGe、PrGaGe到NdGaGe，费米面附近的轨道贡献从d轨道主导逐渐演变为f轨道主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RGaGe体系表现出显著增强的本征反常霍尔电导率（AHC），在PrGaGe中于2 K时高达948 Ω⁻¹ cm⁻¹，且该效应源于由反演对称性破缺驱动的稳健Weyl半金属态；同时，从CeGaGe、PrGaGe到NdGaGe，费米面附近的轨道贡献从d轨道主导逐渐演变为f轨道主导。；创新点：发现RGaGe体系相比已知的RAlGe同类化合物具有显著增强的反常霍尔电导率，并揭示了从d轨道到f轨道主导的拓扑态演化，为系统调控轨道贡献和拓扑磁性提供了可调平台。
papers.method_zh: 晶体生长、物性表征（具体手段摘要未明确说明）、第一性原理计算（具体方法如是否使用DFT+U等摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Laser-induced demagnetization in a MAX phase (Cr0.5Mn0.5)2GaC
papers.abstract: Magnetic MAX phases are nanolaminated metals that combine ceramic-like thermal and mechanical stability with peculiar magnetic ordering, making them attractive for thin-film optoelectronics and spintronics. However, their magnetization dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigate laser-induced ultrafast demagnetization in a 40-nm-thick epitaxial film of the magnetic MAX phase (Cr0.5Mn0.5)2GaC, which magnetically orders below ~250 K, using time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect spectroscopy. We reveal, that the demagnetization transients exhibit a two-step type-II demagnetization - a signature of two-dimensional magnetic systems. The fast demagnetization stage is small at low temperatures and fluences but becomes prominent with increasing excitation. The second stage dominates the process and has a characteristic time of approximately 100 ps. Applying the three-temperature model, we extract the electron-lattice, spin-lattice, and electron-spin coupling constants. The reconstructed spin heat capacity exhibits a weak temperature dependence, accounting for the absence of significant slowing down of demagnetization at elevated temperatures and fluences. Our results provide a starting point for experimental optical control of magnetism in MAX phases, bringing this broad class of materials into modern 2D spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect spectroscopy（时间分辨磁光克尔效应光谱）、epitaxial film（外延薄膜）、three-temperature model（三温度模型）。；研究对象：磁性MAX相材料(Cr0.5Mn0.5)2GaC的40纳米厚外延薄膜，具体研究其激光诱导的超快退磁动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料的退磁瞬态表现出二维磁系统特征的两步II型退磁过程：快速退磁阶段在低温和低激发通量下较弱，随激发增强而显著；主导过程的第二阶段特征时间约为100皮秒。通过三温度模型提取的耦合常数显示，自旋热容对温度依赖较弱，解释了高温和高通量下退磁未显著减慢的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料的退磁瞬态表现出二维磁系统特征的两步II型退磁过程：快速退磁阶段在低温和低激发通量下较弱，随激发增强而显著；主导过程的第二阶段特征时间约为100皮秒。通过三温度模型提取的耦合常数显示，自旋热容对温度依赖较弱，解释了高温和高通量下退磁未显著减慢的现象。；创新点：首次实验研究了磁性MAX相材料的超快磁化动力学，揭示了其二维磁系统特征的退磁行为，为通过光学手段控制MAX相磁性提供了起点，将该类材料引入现代二维自旋电子学领域。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨磁光克尔效应光谱（time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect spectroscopy），并结合三温度模型（three-temperature model）提取电子-晶格、自旋-晶格和电子-自旋耦合常数。

papers.title: Influence of pump size on pattern formation in exciton-polaritonic Bose-Einstein condensates in the non-Markovian regime
papers.abstract: Dynamics of exciton-polaritonic condensate under incoherent pumping is studied using the non-Markovian stochastic Gross-Pitaevskii equation with the pseudo-differential dispersion term. This term corresponds to the lower energy branch of polaritons. It is shown that an increasing of the pumping spot area leads to the appearance of various spatial structures whose properties depend on the duration of the dynamical memory. In the regime of short memory time, condensate can form an extended state that spans outside the pumping area. We conclude that onset of such extended states is related to the specific form of the dispersion term causing the ``traffic jam'' effect. The case of long memory time corresponds to enhanced condensate formation, when increasing of the pumping area leads to appearance of angular condensate structures which partially suppress emission of matter waves from the pumping area.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非马尔可夫随机Gross-Pitaevskii方程、数值模拟、理论分析。；研究对象：激子-极化激元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在非相干泵浦下的动力学行为，特别是泵浦光斑尺寸对空间结构形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增大泵浦光斑面积会导致出现多种空间结构，其性质取决于动力学记忆时间的长短。短记忆时间下可形成延伸至泵浦区域外的扩展态，该现象源于色散项导致的“交通堵塞”效应；长记忆时间下则出现角向凝聚体结构，部分抑制物质波从泵浦区域的发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增大泵浦光斑面积会导致出现多种空间结构，其性质取决于动力学记忆时间的长短。短记忆时间下可形成延伸至泵浦区域外的扩展态，该现象源于色散项导致的“交通堵塞”效应；长记忆时间下则出现角向凝聚体结构，部分抑制物质波从泵浦区域的发射。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用带有伪微分色散项的非马尔可夫随机Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，该色散项对应极化子的低能分支。

papers.title: Renormalization of Quantum Operations: Parity-Time Transition and Chaotic Flows
papers.abstract: The renormalization group (RG) in statistical physics focuses on ground-state properties of equilibrium systems. However, it is unclear how it should be generalized to nonunitary quantum dynamics caused by dissipation and measurement backaction, in which the notion of conserved energy is absent. Here, we extend the RG to cover nonunitary quantum dynamics governed by quantum operations. By performing coarse-graining in real time, we find that the competition between decoherence and coherent dynamics plays a decisive role in the behavior of the RG flow. In particular, we find that chaotic behavior without fixed points emerges in the RG flow when coherent dynamics is dominant, with the parity-time transition serving as a prototypical example. The measurement-induced parity-time transition belongs to the universality class of the one-dimensional Yang-Lee edge singularity, which serves as a guide for experimentally realizing imaginary fields in lattice spin systems with a quantum system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization group (RG)、nonunitary quantum dynamics、quantum operations、coarse-graining。；研究对象：非幺正量子动力学（由耗散和测量反作用引起）中的重整化群行为，具体包括宇称-时间（parity-time）转变和混沌流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子操作驱动的非幺正动力学中，退相干与相干动力学的竞争决定了重整化群流的性质：当相干动力学占主导时，重整化群流出现无不动点的混沌行为；测量诱导的宇称-时间转变属于一维杨-李边缘奇点的普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子操作驱动的非幺正动力学中，退相干与相干动力学的竞争决定了重整化群流的性质：当相干动力学占主导时，重整化群流出现无不动点的混沌行为；测量诱导的宇称-时间转变属于一维杨-李边缘奇点的普适类。；创新点：首次将重整化群方法系统性地扩展到非幺正量子动力学（如耗散和测量反作用），并揭示了其中宇称-时间转变与杨-李边缘奇点普适类的联系，为在晶格自旋系统中实验实现虚数场提供了理论指导。
papers.method_zh: 采用实时粗粒化方法，将重整化群推广到由量子操作描述的非幺正量子动力学中。

papers.title: Effective dynamic constants for nonequilibrium third-principles simulations
papers.abstract: Computational studies of the thermodynamic properties of materials at the mesoscopic and macroscopic scales -- involving lengths and times of at least $μ$m and $μ$s, respectively -- rely on a coarse-graining approximation such that only a few relevant collective variables are treated explicitly. Those variables typically take the form of fields defined everywhere in space or macroscopic quantities when spatial inhomogeneities can be treated implicitly. The free energy is usually expressed as a Landau-like potential whose temperature-dependent minima track stable states, characteristic equilibrium fluctuations being implicitly accounted for. Further, the response of the system to external perturbations, and its relaxation toward thermal equilibrium, are described in terms of simple equations of motion governed by effective inertial and viscous-damping constants. There is considerable literature on the problem of deriving Landau free energy potentials, from either experiment or predictive atomistic simulations, including recent efforts to develop systematic machine-learning approaches that we denote ``third principles''. Much less attention has received the calculation of the effective constants controlling the nonequilibrium macroscopic or mesoscopic dynamics. Here we tackle that problem, describing a protocol that allows us to compute the temperature-dependent inertial and damping coefficients associated to the electric polarization in representative soft-mode ferroelectric PbTiO$_{3}$. Our scheme lends itself to a widespread application, although the non-trivial behaviors found in PbTiO$_{3}$ suggest that more case studies will be needed to finetune a general and robust calculation protocol. Our results also allow us to comment on common assumptions in the literature of effective dynamic treatments of ferroelectrics and related materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：computational studies、coarse-graining、third-principles simulations、protocol。；研究对象：非平衡态下铁电材料（以软模铁电体PbTiO₃为例）的宏观/介观动力学有效常数（惯性系数和阻尼系数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种从原子尺度模拟计算温度依赖的有效惯性系数和阻尼系数的方案，并应用于PbTiO₃的电极化动力学，发现其非平凡行为表明需要更多案例研究来完善通用计算协议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种从原子尺度模拟计算温度依赖的有效惯性系数和阻尼系数的方案，并应用于PbTiO₃的电极化动力学，发现其非平凡行为表明需要更多案例研究来完善通用计算协议。；创新点：已有研究多集中于推导Landau自由能势（平衡态性质），而本文系统性地关注了非平衡动力学中有效常数（惯性系数和阻尼系数）的计算，并提出了可推广的计算协议。
papers.method_zh: 基于“第三原理”（third-principles）的粗粒化模拟框架，结合机器学习方法构建自由能势，并进一步推导出控制非平衡宏观/介观动力学的有效惯性常数和粘滞阻尼常数。具体针对PbTiO₃的电极化动力学进行计算。

papers.title: Bose-Fermi Mapping in Hubbard Models at Imaginary Chemical Potential and Phase-Induced Fermionization
papers.abstract: We find a mapping between the attractive Fermi-Hubbard model and the repulsive Bose-Hubbard model at finite temperature and at imaginary chemical potential $μ=iθ$. We show, by using a large $N$-expansion, that the partition functions of the two models are related by a simple shift $θ\to θ+ π$. This condition maps the BCS--BEC crossover of attractive fermions to a Bose--Fermi crossover (fermion-like occupation) of repulsive bosons. Central feature of this correspondence plays the thermal kernel $g(βE,φ),$ whose analytic continuation $g_B(βE,φ) = g_F(βE,φ+π)$ governs the bosonic and fermionic sectors. Interestingly, we are able to find that the special angles $φ= 2π/3,4π/3$ for fermions correspond to $φ= π/3,5π/3$ for bosons, marking the boundaries of a universal thermal window. We further argue that the present mechanism shows that fermionization can occur at finite interaction strength through a thermodynamic effect induced by the imaginary chemical potential. This suggests that it is a new way of fermionization (not a change in statistics but a fermion-like behaviour) unlike the Tonks--Girardeau limit, where fermionization arises from an infinite repulsive interaction and anyonic or Floquet-engineered systems where transmutation emerges from modified statistics or dynamics. Essentially, the phase $φ$ is a statistical parameter; by twisting the thermal phase, it generates fermion-like behaviour without hard-core constraints or infinite repulsion but only by using thermodynamics. We derive the gap equation and number equation for the bosonic model, highlighting the role of the imaginary chemical potential as a statistical regulator. Our results provide a unified framework for understanding crossovers in interacting lattice systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“large N-expansion”“推导了间隙方程和数方程”等理论方法，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：吸引型费米-哈伯德模型与排斥型玻色-哈伯德模型在虚化学势下的映射关系，以及由此诱导的“费米子化”现象（即玻色子表现出类似费米子的占据行为）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限温度和虚化学势μ=iθ下，吸引型费米-哈伯德模型与排斥型玻色-哈伯德模型的配分函数通过θ→θ+π的简单平移相联系，从而将费米子的BCS-BEC渡越映射为玻色子的“玻色-费米渡越”（费米子化行为）。这种费米子化并非源于无限排斥（如Tonks-Girardeau极限）或统计修饰，而是由虚化学势诱导的热力学效应产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限温度和虚化学势μ=iθ下，吸引型费米-哈伯德模型与排斥型玻色-哈伯德模型的配分函数通过θ→θ+π的简单平移相联系，从而将费米子的BCS-BEC渡越映射为玻色子的“玻色-费米渡越”（费米子化行为）。这种费米子化并非源于无限排斥（如Tonks-Girardeau极限）或统计修饰，而是由虚化学势诱导的热力学效应产生。；创新点：提出了一种新的费米子化机制：通过虚化学势的相位θ（即统计参数φ）的热力学扭曲，在有限相互作用强度下使排斥型玻色子表现出费米子般的占据行为，无需硬核约束或无限排斥，也不同于任意子或Floquet工程系统。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用大N展开方法分析配分函数的对称性；引入热核g(βE,φ)及其解析延拓关系g_B(βE,φ)=g_F(βE,φ+π)来统一描述玻色和费米子行为；推导了玻色模型的间隙方程和数方程，并利用虚化学势作为统计调节器。

papers.title: Pulse, polarization and topology shaping of polariton fuids
papers.abstract: Here we present different approaches to ultrafast pulse and polarization shaping, based on a ``quantum fluid'' platform of polaritons. Indeed we exploit the normal modes of two dimensional polariton fluids made of strong coupled quantum well excitons and microcavity photons, by rooting different polarization and topological states into their sub-picosecond Rabi oscillations. Coherent control of two resonant excitation pulses allows us to prepare the desired state of the polariton, taking benefit from its four-component features given by the combination of the two normal modes with the two degrees of polarization. An ultrafast imaging based on the digital off-axis holography technique is implemented to study the polariton complex wavefunction with time and space resolution. We show in order coherent control of the polariton state on the Bloch sphere, an ultrafast polarization sweeping of the Poincaré sphere, and the dynamical twist of full Poincaré states such as the skyrmion on the sphere itself. Finally, we realize a new kind of ultrafast swirling vortices by adding the angular momentum degree of freedom to the two-pulse scheme. These oscillating topology states are characterized by one or more inner phase singularities tubes which spirals around the axis of propagation. The mechanism is devised in the splitting of the vortex into the upper and lower polaritons, resulting in an oscillatory exchange of energy and angular momentum and in the emitted time and space structured photonic packets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultrafast imaging、digital off-axis holography、coherent control。；研究对象：基于强耦合量子阱激子与微腔光子形成的二维极化激元（polariton）量子流体，研究其脉冲、偏振及拓扑态的超快调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双共振激发脉冲的相干控制，利用极化激元的四分量特征（两个本征模式与两个偏振自由度），实现了对极化激元态在布洛赫球上的相干控制、庞加莱球上的超快偏振扫描、以及全庞加莱态（如斯格明子）的动态扭转；进一步引入角动量自由度，实现了新型超快旋转涡旋，其内部具有沿传播轴螺旋的相位奇点管。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双共振激发脉冲的相干控制，利用极化激元的四分量特征（两个本征模式与两个偏振自由度），实现了对极化激元态在布洛赫球上的相干控制、庞加莱球上的超快偏振扫描、以及全庞加莱态（如斯格明子）的动态扭转；进一步引入角动量自由度，实现了新型超快旋转涡旋，其内部具有沿传播轴螺旋的相位奇点管。；创新点：首次在极化激元流体中实现了对全庞加莱态（如斯格明子）的动态扭转，并利用双脉冲方案引入角动量自由度，生成了具有螺旋相位奇点管的新型超快旋转涡旋。
papers.method_zh: 采用数字离轴全息术实现超快成像，以时空分辨率研究极化激元复波函数；利用两个共振激发脉冲进行相干控制，结合亚皮秒拉比振荡制备不同偏振与拓扑态。

papers.title: Layer-antisymmetric pair-phase resonance at the bonding-antibonding splitting in the AA-stacked bilayer attractive Hubbard model
papers.abstract: The relative phase between the two pair condensates of a bilayer s-wave superconductor is a collective degree of freedom distinct from the usual in-phase Anderson-Bogoliubov mode. Working at the Gaussian fluctuation level for the AA-stacked attractive-Hubbard honeycomb bilayer, we show analytically that the layer-antisymmetric pair-phase channel hosts an in-gap collective pole at twice the single-particle interlayer hopping, $2t_h$, precisely the bonding-antibonding band splitting. The mechanism is algebraic: at this frequency, the antisymmetric phase bubble reduces pointwise in momentum space to the static symmetric phase bubble that enforces the in-phase Goldstone pole. The resulting resonance scale is therefore fixed by the single-particle hybridization, rather than by the interaction-driven Josephson coupling that controls the canonical Leggett mode. The identity is verified numerically by direct Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations. The diagonal antisymmetric phase-channel kernel zero is exact within Gaussian theory at any chemical potential; the full coupled amplitude-phase pole coincides with it at half filling and tracks it closely away from half filling. The excitation is Raman-forbidden by inversion, which motivates layer-odd probes. We find that a layer-imbalance drive has finite Gaussian-level overlap with the pair-phase sector, suggesting a possible cold-atom layer-bias response feature near the sub-kilohertz scale for typical optical-lattice parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值验证）。判断依据：关键词“Gaussian fluctuation level”“show analytically”“Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations”。；研究对象：AA堆叠双层蜂窝晶格中的吸引型哈伯德模型（AA-stacked attractive-Hubbard honeycomb bilayer），具体研究双层s波超导体中与层间反相对相位相关的集体激发模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AA堆叠双层吸引型哈伯德模型中，层反对称的配对相位通道在频率等于单粒子层间跃迁能量2t_h（即成键-反键带分裂）处存在一个带隙内的集体共振极点。该共振尺度由单粒子杂化决定，而非由相互作用驱动的约瑟夫森耦合（即Leggett模）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AA堆叠双层吸引型哈伯德模型中，层反对称的配对相位通道在频率等于单粒子层间跃迁能量2t_h（即成键-反键带分裂）处存在一个带隙内的集体共振极点。该共振尺度由单粒子杂化决定，而非由相互作用驱动的约瑟夫森耦合（即Leggett模）决定。；创新点：揭示了层反对称配对相位共振的代数机制：在该频率下，反对称相位气泡在动量空间逐点退化为静态对称相位气泡（后者负责同相Goldstone极点）。该共振与经典的Leggett模不同，其能量尺度由单粒子杂化而非约瑟夫森耦合决定。此外，该激发因反演对称性而拉曼禁戒，但层不平衡驱动可与之耦合，为冷原子层偏压响应实验提供了亚千赫兹尺度的可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯涨落理论进行解析分析，并通过Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）数值计算直接验证。在任意化学势下，高斯理论中反对称相位通道的核零点精确成立；全耦合振幅-相位极点在半满时与之重合，偏离半满时也紧密跟随。

papers.title: Strain-Enhanced Coherence in Curved hBN Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) hosts robust room-temperature single-photon emitters, yet their coherence is typically limited by phonon induced dephasing and spectral broadening. Here, we show that thermally induced curvature in bulk like hBN flakes provides a strain enabled route to suppress defect phonon coupling under ambient conditions. Nanoscale bubbles formed by thermal processing generate strong through thickness strain gradients, which we directly probe by infrared nano spectroscopy. These measurements reveal strain induced splitting of in-plane phonon modes, evidencing a substantial local modification of the phonon density of states. Quantum emitters localized within these curved regions exhibit markedly enhanced room temperature spectral purity, with Debye Waller factors of 0.91 and narrower line widths than emitters in flat regions. Photon correlation measurements confirm high-purity single photon emission at room temperature. Supported by first-principles calculations, we attribute this behavior to strain driven phonon redistribution, which depletes phonons in tensile regions and accumulates them in compressive regions, thereby creating locally phonon suppressed environments for defect emitters. These results establish strain engineering as an effective route for phonon control in hBN and open a pathway toward high coherence, room-temperature quantum light sources for integrated nano photonic platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measurements、nano spectroscopy、photon correlation measurements、first-principles calculations 辅助支持）；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的弯曲区域（纳米气泡）及其对缺陷单光子发射体相干性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过热诱导弯曲产生的应变梯度可抑制缺陷-声子耦合，在室温下实现高纯度单光子发射，德拜-沃勒因子达0.91，线宽显著窄于平坦区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过热诱导弯曲产生的应变梯度可抑制缺陷-声子耦合，在室温下实现高纯度单光子发射，德拜-沃勒因子达0.91，线宽显著窄于平坦区域。；创新点：首次利用热诱导曲率产生的应变梯度在环境条件下调控hBN中的声子环境，从而提升量子发射体的室温相干性，为应变工程控制声子提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 红外纳米光谱（直接探测应变诱导的面内声子模分裂）、光子关联测量（验证单光子发射纯度）、第一性原理计算（解释应变驱动的声子再分布机制）。

papers.title: Statistical mechanics of the $N$-queens problem
papers.abstract: We investigate the $N$-queens problem as a lattice gas -- a model in which $N$ queens are placed on an $N \times N$ chessboard with pairwise repulsive interactions along shared rows, columns, and diagonals -- from the perspective of statistical mechanics. The ground states are exactly the $Q(N)$ solutions of the classical $N$-queens problem, with entropy per queen $s_0 \approx \ln N - γ$ ($γ\approx 1.944$). This entropy reflects a characteristic constraint hierarchy: each successive geometric constraint -- columns, then diagonals -- reduces the entropy from the free-placement value $\ln N$ by a definite constant. We derive the exact high-temperature energy $E/N \to 5/3$ as $N \to \infty$. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations with $10^8$ sweeps per temperature point for $N = 8$--$1024$ reveal that the specific heat per queen $C_v/N$ converges to a universal function of $T$ as $N \to \infty$. The converged curve features a non-divergent peak $C_v^{\max}/N \approx 1.63$ at $T^* \approx 0.235\,J$, establishing the absence of a thermodynamic phase transition. Combined with the trivially exact high-temperature entropy $S(\infty)/N = (1/N) \ln \binom{N^2}{N}$, the convergence of $C_v/N$ enables a thermodynamic integration of $C_v/T$ from $T = \infty$ to $T = 0$ that recovers the ground-state entropy -- and hence the Simkin constant $γ$ -- purely from Monte Carlo data. This provides an independent thermodynamic route to a fundamental combinatorial constant. Thermodynamic integration yields $γ_{\rm MC} = 1.946 \pm 0.003$ at $N = 1024$, within $0.1\%$ of the precise combinatorial value $γ= 1.94400(1)$. We further present a transfer-matrix-based tensor network formulation that encodes the non-attacking constraints into a rank-9 site tensor with 17 nonzero elements, providing a complementary exact-enumeration route.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：统计力学分析、Monte Carlo模拟、张量网络表述。；研究对象：N皇后问题作为晶格气体模型，即N个皇后在N×N棋盘上沿行、列、对角线具有排斥相互作用的统计力学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 比热每皇后C_v/N在N→∞时收敛到温度的普适函数，在T*≈0.235J处出现非发散峰值C_v^max/N≈1.63，证明不存在热力学相变；通过热力学积分从Monte Carlo数据恢复出基态熵，从而独立得到组合常数Simkin常数γ。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：比热每皇后C_v/N在N→∞时收敛到温度的普适函数，在T*≈0.235J处出现非发散峰值C_v^max/N≈1.63，证明不存在热力学相变；通过热力学积分从Monte Carlo数据恢复出基态熵，从而独立得到组合常数Simkin常数γ。；创新点：将经典组合问题N皇后问题转化为统计力学晶格气体模型，通过热力学积分从Monte Carlo数据独立提取组合常数γ，并证明比热收敛到普适函数且无相变。
papers.method_zh: 统计力学分析（推导高温极限能量）、大规模Monte Carlo模拟（N=8–1024，每温度点10^8次扫描）、热力学积分（从T=∞到T=0积分C_v/T）、基于转移矩阵的张量网络表述（构造秩9位点张量，含17个非零元）。

papers.title: Beyond Topological Invariants: Order Parameters from Dominant Fock-state Patterns
papers.abstract: We introduce a general scheme for constructing order parameters (OPs) by extracting generic patterns from the dominant Fock states of many-body ground states. While topological phases are traditionally characterized by non-local invariants, we demonstrate that our real-space OPs provide a more refined classification. In the extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, we show that the standard winding number is insufficient to fully distinguish all phases; our OPs reveal a hidden sub-structure where each topological sector splits into two distinct phases. Beyond identifying the phase boundaries, these OPs quantify the depth of a phase, and remain robust in characterizing transitions in disordered systems. Furthermore, our approach provides a practical finite-size diagnostic for the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition in the interacting spin-1/2 XXZ model. The presented framework offers a broadly applicable tool for uncovering the phase diagrams of diverse interacting and non-interacting quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入一般方案”“构建序参量”“展示”“揭示”等理论推导与分析方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：多体量子系统的基态相图，具体包括扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型（非相互作用拓扑模型）和相互作用的自旋1/2 XXZ模型（Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless相变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过从多体基态的主导Fock态中提取模式，可以构造实空间序参量，这些序参量能揭示传统拓扑不变量（如缠绕数）无法区分的隐藏子结构，并可用于表征无序系统中的相变以及有限尺寸下的BKT相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过从多体基态的主导Fock态中提取模式，可以构造实空间序参量，这些序参量能揭示传统拓扑不变量（如缠绕数）无法区分的隐藏子结构，并可用于表征无序系统中的相变以及有限尺寸下的BKT相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统序参量构造方法的具体对比，但明确指出该方法超越了拓扑不变量，能揭示拓扑相内部的子结构，并适用于无序和相互作用系统。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种基于主导Fock态模式提取序参量的一般理论框架，应用于扩展SSH模型和XXZ模型，通过分析基态波函数的Fock空间结构来定义实空间序参量。

papers.title: Partial annealing and pattern decorrelation in associative neural networks
papers.abstract: Using the Hopfield model as a benchmark case, the present work focuses on the investigation of partially annealed associative neural networks, wherein neural dynamics is coupled to slowly evolving patterns within the two-temperature-two-timescale framework. This setting inherently introduces a real parameter n, reminiscent of the number of replicas in the celebrated replica trick, that tunes the separation of timescales and the effective interaction between fast (i.e. the neurons) and slow (i.e. the synapses) degrees of freedom. By adapting Guerra's interpolation to the case, we derive the free energy without relying on analytical continuation. The obtained results demonstrate that negative values of n induce a progressive decorrelation of the stored patterns, thereby effectively reducing interference, promoting orthogonal configurations and ultimately conferring to the network the maximal storage alphac=1. Numerical simulations based on a mean field Monte Carlo dynamics have been employed to confirm this scenario and prove that partial annealing restores retrieval in challenging regimes, such as in the presence of biased patterns, outperforming standard decorrelation methods. These findings underscore the notion of partial annealing as an adaptive mechanism for enhancing memory organisation and retrieval in complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“free energy”“Guerra's interpolation”“mean field Monte Carlo dynamics”。；研究对象：部分退火联想神经网络，以Hopfield模型为基准，研究神经动力学与缓慢演化模式（突触）耦合下的记忆组织与检索行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 部分退火引入的参数n（类似复制数）取负值时，会导致存储模式逐步去相关，从而减少干扰、促进模式正交化，使网络达到最大存储容量αc=1；部分退火能在有偏模式等困难条件下恢复检索能力，优于标准去相关方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：部分退火引入的参数n（类似复制数）取负值时，会导致存储模式逐步去相关，从而减少干扰、促进模式正交化，使网络达到最大存储容量αc=1；部分退火能在有偏模式等困难条件下恢复检索能力，优于标准去相关方法。；创新点：将部分退火机制（两温度-两时间尺度框架）引入联想神经网络，通过参数n连续调节快（神经元）与慢（突触）自由度之间的有效相互作用，并利用Guerra插值严格推导自由能，无需依赖复制技巧的解析延拓。
papers.method_zh: 采用Guerra插值方法推导自由能（无需解析延拓），并结合基于平均场的蒙特卡洛动力学进行数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Floquet-tuned superfluid-checkerboard competition in dipolar bosons
papers.abstract: We study hard-core dipolar bosons on a square lattice subject to a unidirectional periodic drive that Floquet-engineers anisotropic hopping. Driving along one lattice direction provides a controlled way to suppress transverse tunneling, yielding a kinetically quasi-one-dimensional regime with strongly anisotropic transport within the leading-order high-frequency Floquet effective description. In this limit, the system does not reduce to decoupled chains, due to the long-range in-plane dipolar interaction remains isotropic and couples different chains. Focusing on dipoles polarized perpendicular to the plane, for which the interaction is purely repulsive and isotropic, we use sign-problem-free worm-algorithm quantum Monte Carlo simulations to map the half-filling phase diagram versus kinetic anisotropy and dipolar coupling. We find that increasing kinetic anisotropy systematically lowers the interaction strength required to stabilize checkerboard order, demonstrating that Floquet-induced suppression of transverse motion enhances density ordering. Near the superfluid--checkerboard boundary, finite-size results reveal a narrow transition region where the stiffness drops rapidly while checkerboard correlations rise sharply; Its pronounced sharpening with system size is consistent with a weakly first-order transition rounded by finite-size effects. Away from half filling, on the doped sides of the checkerboard plateau, we identify a narrow checkerboard-supersolid regime with simultaneously finite checkerboard correlations and superfluid stiffness, where the superfluid stiffness is anisotropic but the density pattern is isotropic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：sign-problem-free worm-algorithm quantum Monte Carlo simulations、Floquet-engineers、有效描述。；研究对象：受单向周期驱动（Floquet工程）的方形晶格上硬核偶极玻色子体系，重点研究超流态与棋盘序之间的竞争，以及远离半填充时的超固态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Floquet驱动的动力学各向异性会系统性地降低稳定棋盘序所需的相互作用强度，从而增强密度有序；在超流-棋盘边界附近存在一个窄的弱一级相变区域，而在棋盘相掺杂侧则存在一个窄的各向异性超流但各向同性密度模式的棋盘超固态区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Floquet驱动的动力学各向异性会系统性地降低稳定棋盘序所需的相互作用强度，从而增强密度有序；在超流-棋盘边界附近存在一个窄的弱一级相变区域，而在棋盘相掺杂侧则存在一个窄的各向异性超流但各向同性密度模式的棋盘超固态区域。；创新点：通过Floquet驱动沿一个方向抑制横向隧穿，实现了准一维动力学区域，同时保持长程偶极相互作用的各向同性，从而揭示了动力学各向异性对密度有序（棋盘相）稳定性的调控作用，并发现了各向异性超流-各向同性密度模式的棋盘超固态。
papers.method_zh: 采用高频Floquet有效描述来工程化各向异性隧穿；使用无符号问题的蠕虫算法量子蒙特卡洛（worm-algorithm QMC）模拟，在半填充下绘制相图，并分析有限尺寸效应。

papers.title: Saddle-node bifurcation in interfacial morphology selects battery degradation phase
papers.abstract: We propose a minimal nonlinear closure ODE for the dynamic active-area factor of a battery interface and show that it exhibits a saddle-node bifurcation when the smoothing rate saturates with surface roughness. The closure is the simplest physically motivated extension of a recently introduced single-fixed-point closure [C. Bae, in preparation (2026)]: u = K - u/(1 + alphau^2), where u = xi - 1 is the dimensionless excess active area, K the dimensionless drive, and alpha a single saturation parameter. The bifurcation occurs at K_c = 1/(2sqrt(alpha)), separating a smooth passivating phase from a morphologically unstable phase. Mapping four canonical anode configurations -- graphite, silicon composite, lithium metal, and anode-free Li/Cu -- onto the closure via end-of-cycling steady-state xi extracted from publicly available long-cycle data populates the stable branch with monotonically increasing K/K_c ratios: graphite (~0.01), silicon composite (~0.24), lithium metal (~0.73), and anode-free (~0.95). The anode-free configuration sits within 5% of the saddle-node threshold, predicting a vanishingly small operational stability window in current density, temperature, and electrolyte composition. We test three falsifiable predictions of the framework -- a critical current density, a critical temperature shift, and a mean-field critical-slowing-down exponent -- and find them broadly consistent with publicly available data. We argue that this near-critical position is universal to nucleation-controlled deposition on non-passivating substrates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出非线性闭包ODE模型、分岔分析、理论预测与数据对比。；研究对象：电池界面形貌演化中的鞍结分岔现象，以及由此导致的电池退化相变。具体涉及石墨、硅复合材料、锂金属、无负极Li/Cu四种阳极构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电池界面活性面积因子动力学方程存在鞍结分岔，当平滑速率随表面粗糙度饱和时发生；无负极Li/Cu构型处于距分岔阈值5%以内的近临界状态，导致其工作稳定性窗口极小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电池界面活性面积因子动力学方程存在鞍结分岔，当平滑速率随表面粗糙度饱和时发生；无负极Li/Cu构型处于距分岔阈值5%以内的近临界状态，导致其工作稳定性窗口极小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出一个最小非线性闭包常微分方程（ODE），用于描述电池界面动态活性面积因子；通过公开长循环数据提取稳态活性面积因子，将四种阳极构型映射到模型参数空间；检验了临界电流密度、临界温度偏移和平均场临界慢化指数三个可证伪预测。

papers.title: Local supersolid in moiré modulated Bose-Hubbard model using density-matrix renormalization group method
papers.abstract: The search and characterization of supersolid phases remain a central topic in condensed matter physics. Inspired by the experimental discovery of local superfluid and insulating phases in two-dimensional moiré optical lattices [Meng et al., Nature 615, 231 (2023)], we systematically explore the emergence of a local supersolid ($l$SS) phase in a one-dimensional Bose-Hubbard model subjected to a moiré potential, using the density-matrix renormalization group method. We impose a maximum site occupation $n_{\rm max}=2$ to realize the soft-core boson constraint. In the absence of nearest-neighbor repulsion, we identify the conventional superfluid, local superfluid, Mott insulator, and moiré-induced insulator phases. When the nearest-neighbor repulsion is turned on, the $l$SS phase emerges in the strong-moiré regime. This phase is uniquely characterized by three key signatures: (i) coexisting local staggered density order and local off-diagonal coherence within isolated moiré supercells; (ii) exponentially decaying global off-diagonal correlations; and (iii) a vanishing global structure factor in the thermodynamic limit, while the local structure factor remains finite. These features clearly distinguish the $l$SS from the conventional global supersolid (SS) phase, which exhibits algebraic correlations and a finite global structure factor. Our results provide a complete microscopic picture of local quantum phases in moiré lattices and offer clear experimental observables for detecting $l$SS states with ultracold atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group method（DMRG）、数值模拟。；研究对象：一维莫尔势调制下的Bose-Hubbard模型中的局域超固态（local supersolid, lSS）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在最近邻排斥相互作用且处于强莫尔势区域时，系统会出现一种全新的局域超固态（lSS）相，该相具有局域交错密度序与局域非对角长程序共存、全局非对角关联指数衰减、以及全局结构因子在热力学极限下为零而局域结构因子有限等特征，与传统的全局超固态（SS）相截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在最近邻排斥相互作用且处于强莫尔势区域时，系统会出现一种全新的局域超固态（lSS）相，该相具有局域交错密度序与局域非对角长程序共存、全局非对角关联指数衰减、以及全局结构因子在热力学极限下为零而局域结构因子有限等特征，与传统的全局超固态（SS）相截然不同。；创新点：首次在莫尔势调制的Bose-Hubbard模型中系统性地识别并刻画了局域超固态（lSS）相，给出了其区别于传统全局超固态（SS）相的三个关键判据，为实验上利用超冷原子探测该新物态提供了清晰的观测量。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法对一维莫尔势调制下的Bose-Hubbard模型进行数值模拟，并设置最大格点占据数n_max=2以实现软核玻色子约束。

papers.title: Apparent double-$T_c$ from a single BKT transition in anisotropic phase-only models
papers.abstract: Transport experiments on two-dimensional superconductors often yield direction-dependent transition temperatures, raising the question of whether such a ``double-$T_c$'' reflects a true thermodynamic splitting or a transport artifact. To establish a baseline, we study a minimal anisotropic phase-only Josephson-junction array in equilibrium and under resistively shunted junction dynamics with fluctuating twist boundary conditions. The equilibrium model exhibits a single Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition. Out of equilibrium, anisotropic Josephson couplings and anisotropic dissipation reshape the linear $R$--$T$ curves in a finite-size, finite-current crossover regime, so that curve-shape criteria such as Halperin--Nelson fits and fixed-resistance thresholds yield an apparent double-$T_c$. In contrast, critical-scaling criteria -- the universal exponent $α=3$ and dynamic finite-size scaling -- remain consistent with the single $T_{\mathrm{BKT}}$. A robust splitting that persists in the nonlinear critical scaling, such as that recently reported at KTaO$_3$ interfaces, therefore points to physics beyond this clean anisotropic baseline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：phase-only models、equilibrium、resistively shunted junction dynamics、critical-scaling criteria）；研究对象：各向异性二维超导体中的输运现象，特别是方向依赖的转变温度（“双Tc”）是否源于单一BKT相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅具有单一BKT相变的各向异性模型中，由于有限尺寸和有限电流的交叉效应，各向异性约瑟夫森耦合和耗散会导致输运测量中出现表观的双Tc，但临界标度分析仍支持单一转变温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅具有单一BKT相变的各向异性模型中，由于有限尺寸和有限电流的交叉效应，各向异性约瑟夫森耦合和耗散会导致输运测量中出现表观的双Tc，但临界标度分析仍支持单一转变温度。；创新点：通过建立各向异性基线的理论模型，明确指出输运测量中表观双Tc可能仅是有限尺寸和耗散导致的伪影，而非热力学相变分裂，从而为区分真实物理效应（如KTaO₃界面报道的鲁棒分裂）提供了判断标准。
papers.method_zh: 平衡态下研究各向异性相位-only约瑟夫森结阵列模型；非平衡态下采用电阻分路结动力学（RSJ dynamics）结合涨落扭曲边界条件，通过线性R-T曲线形状分析（Halperin-Nelson拟合、固定电阻阈值）和临界标度（universal exponent α=3、动态有限尺寸标度）进行对比。

papers.title: Parabolic-growth universality and its nucleation-driven breakdown across lithium-battery anode chemistries
papers.abstract: Solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) growth is widely modeled cell-by-cell with chemistry-specific closures, yet its underlying kinetic scaling is rarely tested across chemistries. By compiling cycle-resolved data from public long-cycle datasets covering four anode configurations -- graphite, silicon composite, lithium metal, and anode-free -- we show that the cumulative interphase-loss index Lambda_int obeys the parabolic law Lambda_int = A_chem * sqrt(1 - Theta_Li) in three of the four chemistries, with an exponent indistinguishable from alpha = 1/2 within experimental uncertainty. The chemistry-specific prefactor A_chem spans an order of magnitude, but the diffusion-limited parabolic kinetics is preserved. The fourth chemistry, anode-free configurations, deviates with a super-parabolic exponent alpha approx 0.77, consistent with a nucleation-controlled growth regime. We rationalize the result using the Tammann-Deal-Grove parabolic-growth framework adapted to interphase formation and identify the conditions under which universality is recovered. The observed regularity reduces SEI modeling complexity to a single rate constant per chemistry and provides a sharp falsifiable test for next-generation cell formats.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：compiling cycle-resolved data from public long-cycle datasets、实验数据统计分析）；研究对象：锂离子电池中固体电解质界面相（SEI）的生长动力学，涵盖石墨、硅复合材料、锂金属和无负极四种阳极构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨、硅复合材料和锂金属三种阳极中，SEI累积损耗指数Λ_int遵循抛物线规律（指数α=1/2），表明扩散限制的动力学普适性；而无负极构型则偏离抛物线，呈现超抛物线指数α≈0.77，对应成核控制的生长机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨、硅复合材料和锂金属三种阳极中，SEI累积损耗指数Λ_int遵循抛物线规律（指数α=1/2），表明扩散限制的动力学普适性；而无负极构型则偏离抛物线，呈现超抛物线指数α≈0.77，对应成核控制的生长机制。；创新点：首次跨多种阳极化学体系系统检验SEI生长的动力学标度行为，发现除无负极构型外均遵循抛物线普适规律，从而将SEI建模复杂度简化为每种化学体系仅需一个速率常数，并提供了可证伪的检验标准。
papers.method_zh: 基于公开长循环数据集，对四种阳极构型的循环分辨数据进行编译和统计分析，提取累积界面损耗指数Λ_int，并拟合其与锂化程度（1-Θ_Li）的幂律关系；采用Tammann-Deal-Grove抛物线生长框架进行理论解释。

papers.title: One-dimensional relativistic hydrogen-like atom in Dirac materials: Energy spectra and supercritical states
papers.abstract: We consider a model of 1D relativistic hydrogen-like atom, formed by a Coulomb impurity in graphene nanoribbon. Describing the electron motion in terms of the one-dimensional Dirac equation for Coulomb potential taking into account the finite-size of the atomic nucleus, we compute the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the atomic electron. The cases of unconfined atom and atomin-box system are considered. Special focus is given calculation of supercritical energy levels and the critical charge. The latter is the value of the atomic nucleus charge, when the electronic state reaches the border of the Dirac sea. It is found that for confined atom the value of the critical charge is larger than that of free atom. Experimentally measurable characteristics, local density of states is also plotted for both cases. Existence of strong localization for atom-in-box system is shown.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“consider a model”、“compute the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions”、“calculation of supercritical energy levels”。；研究对象：一维相对论性类氢原子，具体由石墨烯纳米带中的库仑杂质形成，并考虑原子核有限尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于受限（原子在盒子中）的类氢原子，其临界电荷（电子态到达狄拉克海边界的原子核电荷值）大于自由原子的临界电荷；并且受限体系表现出强局域化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于受限（原子在盒子中）的类氢原子，其临界电荷（电子态到达狄拉克海边界的原子核电荷值）大于自由原子的临界电荷；并且受限体系表现出强局域化现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用一维狄拉克方程描述电子在库仑势中的运动，并考虑原子核的有限尺寸。通过求解本征值和本征函数，分别计算了自由原子和原子在盒子中两种情形下的能谱、超临界能级、临界电荷以及局域态密度。

papers.title: Computing eigenpairs of quantum many-body systems with Polfed.jl
papers.abstract: We present Polfed.jl, an open-source Julia package implementing the Polynomially Filtered Exact Diagonalization (POLFED) algorithm for computing mid-spectrum eigenvalues and eigenvectors (shortly, eigenpairs) of quantum many-body Hamiltonians. Access to such eigenpairs is essential for studying non-equilibrium many-body physics, but is hindered by the exponential growth of Hilbert-space dimension. POLFED addresses this challenge through a polynomial spectral transformation evaluated on the fly within a Lanczos iteration, preserving Hamiltonian sparsity and substantially reducing memory costs compared to other diagonalization methods. The package supports flexible energy targeting, automatic optimization of the spectral mapping for structured Hamiltonians, and GPU acceleration, which is particularly effective since the dominant computational cost reduces to repeated sparse matrix-vector multiplications. Benchmarks on disordered spin-chain and fermionic models demonstrate access to larger system sizes than alternative approaches, and CPU--GPU comparisons confirm significant speedups. In particular, we also provide code for constructing the quantum sun model Hamiltonian, a toy model of a many-body ergodicity-breaking transition. While our focus is on many-body Hamiltonians, Polfed.jl may be applied to any large sparse matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“open-source Julia package”、“algorithm”、“benchmarks”、“CPU–GPU comparisons”。；研究对象：量子多体哈密顿量的本征对（特征值与特征向量），特别是用于研究非平衡多体物理的中间谱本征对，以及作为示例的量子太阳模型（quantum sun model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Polfed.jl 软件包通过多项式滤波精确对角化（POLFED）算法，能够高效计算量子多体哈密顿量的中间谱本征对，在无序自旋链和费米子模型上实现了比现有方法更大的系统尺寸，并借助GPU加速获得显著性能提升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Polfed.jl 软件包通过多项式滤波精确对角化（POLFED）算法，能够高效计算量子多体哈密顿量的中间谱本征对，在无序自旋链和费米子模型上实现了比现有方法更大的系统尺寸，并借助GPU加速获得显著性能提升。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 多项式滤波精确对角化（POLFED）算法，该算法在Lanczos迭代过程中实时计算多项式谱变换，保持哈密顿量的稀疏性，并支持GPU加速（主要计算成本为重复的稀疏矩阵-向量乘法）。
