papers.title: Non-homogeneous structure of complex concentrated alloys: Effect of intrinsic strain
papers.abstract: Even if the atoms of a multicomponent alloy occupy a common lattice, their distribution is not homogeneous, and regions with different compositions can be detected. Three representative examples will be discussed: a Cantor-type system containing transition-metal elements (Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, and Co), a refractory high-entropy alloy (Ti, Zr, Nb, Ta, and Mo), and a multicomponent system combining transition and refractory metals (Cu, Ni, Ti, Zr, and Hf). Using a combination of theoretical analysis and experimental observations, we demonstrate that the formation of locally segregated regions can lead to a reduction in the overall energy of the system. This stabilization arises from the compensation of tensile and compressive strain fields associated with atoms of different sizes, highlighting the key role of local chemical and structural heterogeneity in determining the thermodynamic stability of multicomponent alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验观察）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“结合理论分析与实验观察”（combination of theoretical analysis and experimental observations）。；研究对象：复杂浓缩合金（complex concentrated alloys）的非均匀结构，具体包括三种代表性体系：含过渡金属的Cantor型合金（Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Co）、难熔高熵合金（Ti, Zr, Nb, Ta, Mo）、以及过渡与难熔金属混合体系（Cu, Ni, Ti, Zr, Hf）。核心物理现象是合金中原子分布的非均匀性及其对热力学稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部成分偏析（locally segregated regions）的形成可降低体系总能量，这种稳定化源于不同尺寸原子产生的拉伸与压缩应变场的相互补偿，揭示了局域化学与结构异质性在多组分合金热力学稳定性中的关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部成分偏析（locally segregated regions）的形成可降低体系总能量，这种稳定化源于不同尺寸原子产生的拉伸与压缩应变场的相互补偿，揭示了局域化学与结构异质性在多组分合金热力学稳定性中的关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（具体框架摘要未明确说明）与实验观测（具体实验手段如X射线衍射、电子显微镜等摘要未明确说明）相结合。

papers.title: Ytterbium charge state and stabilization in the Ba(Ca)F$_2$ host by electron paramagnetic resonance and infrared photoluminescence
papers.abstract: Lanthanide-doped fluorides are promising materials for advanced photonic and quantum applications due to their wide bandgap, low phonon energy, and chemical stability. In this work, we present a systematic comparative study of ytterbium incorporation at low doping levels (0.05--0.2 mol\%) in BaF$_2$ and CaF$_2$ single crystals, focusing on the interplay between host lattice properties, charge-state stabilization, and defect formation mechanisms. Using a combination of X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), transmittance, and infrared photoluminescence (IR PL), we explore how host lattice properties affect the stabilization of Yb$^{3+}$ and Yb$^{2+}$ ions. XRD confirmed cubic phase purity and lattice parameter stability in both hosts, while XPS revealed surface chemical composition variations associated with charge-compensating defects and trace impurities. EPR spectra indicated that BaF$_2$ favored perturbed Yb$^{3+}$ environments with increasing dopant levels, while CaF$_2$ maintained predominantly unperturbed sites, suggesting a more favorable ionic match for Yb$^{2+}$. Photothermal deflection spectroscopy (PDS) and IR PL results showed host-specific optical responses, with CaF$_2$ exhibiting crystal-field splitting and broader local field effects. These results reveal a clear decoupling between long-range structural stability and local lattice perturbations, and demonstrate that host cation identity governs the balance between Yb$^{2+}$ and Yb$^{3+}$ stabilization as well as defect-driven optical behavior. This offers valuable insights for optimizing rare-earth-doped fluoride crystals in laser, scintillator, and quantum device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了XRD、XPS、EPR、红外光致发光等多种实验手段进行系统比较研究。；研究对象：Yb掺杂的BaF₂和CaF₂单晶，具体研究Yb³⁺和Yb²⁺电荷态在两种氟化物基质中的稳定化机制及缺陷形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BaF₂基质倾向于形成受扰动的Yb³⁺环境，而CaF₂基质主要维持未受扰动的Yb³⁺位点，表明CaF₂对Yb²⁺具有更有利的离子匹配；宿主阳离子身份决定了Yb²⁺与Yb³⁺稳定化之间的平衡以及缺陷驱动的光学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BaF₂基质倾向于形成受扰动的Yb³⁺环境，而CaF₂基质主要维持未受扰动的Yb³⁺位点，表明CaF₂对Yb²⁺具有更有利的离子匹配；宿主阳离子身份决定了Yb²⁺与Yb³⁺稳定化之间的平衡以及缺陷驱动的光学行为。；创新点：揭示了长程结构稳定性与局域晶格扰动之间的清晰解耦，并系统阐明了宿主阳离子身份如何调控Yb²⁺/Yb³⁺电荷态稳定化及缺陷相关的光学响应。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射（XRD）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）、电子顺磁共振（EPR）、透射光谱、红外光致发光（IR PL）、光热偏转光谱（PDS）。

papers.title: Cascade of fractional quantum Hall states in 2D system
papers.abstract: The observation of the fractional quantum Hall (FQH) effect in 2D electron gases ushered in investigations of topological phases driven by strong electron correlations. Their remarkable features include fractionalized elementary excitations, gapless boundary states, and non-trivial quantum entanglement patterns. Thanks to persistent efforts in the building of new platforms and making higher-quality samples, a diverse plethora of FQH states have been unveiled in experiments. We report a systematic study of ultrahigh-quality GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells with mobility up to 3.7*10^7 cm^2/V/s using quantum transport measurements in nuclear adiabatic demagnetization and dilution refrigerators down to 1 mK. In addition to many FQH states that have already been identified in previous work, new longitudinal resistance dips are observed at filling factors 17/33 and 15/31. The application of an in-plane magnetic field causes disparate variations of the FQH states. The theoretical foundation of these states is discussed in the framework of composite fermion theory. While most fractions can be explained as non-interacting composite fermions forming integer quantum Hall states, a few states correspond to FQH states of composite fermions that arise from residual interaction between them. We summarize the observed fractions in the range of 0 < ν < 2 and propose a pattern to account for their experimental appearance that provides an intuitive picture about the relative strengths of different FQH states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：quantum transport measurements、nuclear adiabatic demagnetization、dilution refrigerators、observed、reported）；研究对象：超高质量GaAs/AlGaAs量子阱二维电子气中的分数量子霍尔态（FQH states），具体关注填充因子0 < ν < 2范围内的级联分数量子霍尔态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在迁移率高达3.7×10^7 cm²/V/s的GaAs/AlGaAs量子阱中，观测到填充因子17/33和15/31处新的纵向电阻谷；不同分数量子霍尔态对平面内磁场的响应存在显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在迁移率高达3.7×10^7 cm²/V/s的GaAs/AlGaAs量子阱中，观测到填充因子17/33和15/31处新的纵向电阻谷；不同分数量子霍尔态对平面内磁场的响应存在显著差异。；创新点：首次在实验上观测到填充因子17/33和15/31处的分数量子霍尔态，并系统总结了0 < ν < 2范围内所有观测到的分数，提出了一个描述不同分数量子霍尔态相对强度的直观模式。摘要未明确说明该模式的具体形式。
papers.method_zh: 采用核绝热去磁制冷机和稀释制冷机在低至1 mK的温度下进行量子输运测量；利用复合费米子理论框架对观测态进行理论解释。

papers.title: Superconductivity Mediated Long Range Magnetic Coupling
papers.abstract: We study a Rashba superconductor thin film with ferromagnetic insulators (FIs) placed on top of it. We show that the ferromagnetic insulators generate circular super-currents, enabling long-range magnetic interactions (LRMI), decaying in power laws. In the static case, the long-range magnetic interaction can be ferromagnetic, in contrast to previous studies showing that superconductor mediates anti-ferromagnetic interactions decaying exponentially. Surprisingly, we find that in the dynamic case, the LRMI has a different distance dependence. Our results have potential applications in superconducting spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We study”“We show”“We find”等理论推导和模型分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：Rashba超导薄膜上放置铁磁绝缘体（FIs）的异质结构，研究其诱导的长程磁耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁磁绝缘体可在Rashba超导薄膜中产生环形超流，从而引发幂律衰减的长程磁相互作用；静态下该相互作用可为铁磁性，与以往认为超导仅介导指数衰减的反铁磁耦合不同；动态下长程磁相互作用的距离依赖关系发生变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁磁绝缘体可在Rashba超导薄膜中产生环形超流，从而引发幂律衰减的长程磁相互作用；静态下该相互作用可为铁磁性，与以往认为超导仅介导指数衰减的反铁磁耦合不同；动态下长程磁相互作用的距离依赖关系发生变化。；创新点：首次发现超导可介导长程铁磁耦合（而非传统预期的指数衰减反铁磁耦合），并揭示静态与动态下距离依赖关系的差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于Rashba超导薄膜与铁磁绝缘体耦合的模型，推导静态与动态条件下的磁相互作用形式。

papers.title: Chiral Porphyrin Monolayers on Ferromagnetic Thin Films: Ultrafast Spectroscopy of Hybrid Interfaces
papers.abstract: Hybrid ferromagnetic metal/organic interfaces (spinterfaces) exhibit unique properties, including spin filtering. In parallel, chiral organic molecules can themselves induce efficient spin filtering, leading to unexpectedly high spin polarizations. Here, we investigate how the proximity of gold-capped Co/Ni ferromagnetic multilayers influences the spectroscopic properties and photoinduced electron dynamics of chiral oligopeptides bearing a porphyrin chromophore. The molecules are covalently attached to the gold cap via a chiral linker, forming a self-assembled monolayer. The porphyrin macrocycles adopt an orientation parallel to the surface, resulting in the formation of J-like aggregates. Photoinduced dynamics are probed using femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption spectroscopy. Despite excitation of only a single molecular layer, a clear transient absorption signal of the porphyrin singlet excited state is observed. Adsorption on the metal surface leads to a pronounced reduction of the excited-state lifetime. However, no signatures of long-lived photoinduced charge-transfer products are detected. Furthermore, no dependence of the excited-state dynamics on either the magnetization direction of the ferromagnetic layer or the molecular chirality is observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption spectroscopy（飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收光谱）、self-assembled monolayer（自组装单层）。；研究对象：金覆盖的Co/Ni铁磁多层膜上，通过手性连接基共价连接卟啉发色团的手性寡肽自组装单层，形成的杂化铁磁金属/有机界面（spinterface）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管仅激发单分子层，仍可观察到卟啉单重激发态的清晰瞬态吸收信号；吸附在金属表面导致激发态寿命显著缩短，但未检测到长寿命光致电荷转移产物，且激发态动力学对铁磁层的磁化方向或分子手性均无依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管仅激发单分子层，仍可观察到卟啉单重激发态的清晰瞬态吸收信号；吸附在金属表面导致激发态寿命显著缩短，但未检测到长寿命光致电荷转移产物，且激发态动力学对铁磁层的磁化方向或分子手性均无依赖。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收光谱（femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption spectroscopy）。

papers.title: B-H hysteresis in itinerant Feromagnetism from Chern-Simons Gauge theory
papers.abstract: The log H term is derived in the free energy of many-electron system from Chern-Simons gauge theory. Owing to the singularity at $H=0$, this leads the first order transition and B-H hysteresis to many-electron systems of symmetric and single domain. This has the origin in quantum mechanics and is irrelevant to non-invertible motions of domains. This transition appears in single and symmetric domain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Chern-Simons gauge theory（陈-西蒙斯规范理论）、derived（推导出）、free energy（自由能）。；研究对象：巡游铁磁体（itinerant ferromagnetism）中的B-H磁滞现象，具体为对称单畴（symmetric and single domain）的多电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从陈-西蒙斯规范理论推导出多电子系统自由能中存在对数项（log H term），该对数项在H=0处的奇异性导致了对称单畴多电子系统中的一级相变和B-H磁滞回线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从陈-西蒙斯规范理论推导出多电子系统自由能中存在对数项（log H term），该对数项在H=0处的奇异性导致了对称单畴多电子系统中的一级相变和B-H磁滞回线。；创新点：该工作将B-H磁滞的起源归因于量子力学效应（quantum mechanics），并明确指出其与畴壁的非可逆运动（non-invertible motions of domains）无关，为理解巡游铁磁体中的磁滞现象提供了新的微观理论视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用陈-西蒙斯规范理论（Chern-Simons gauge theory）作为理论框架，通过分析多电子系统自由能中的对数项来研究磁滞现象。

papers.title: Correlation-Driven Orbital-Selective Fermiology and Superconductivity in the Bilayer Nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: Recent angle-resolved photoemission measurements on La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ have challenged the density-functional-theory-based picture of three Fermi surfaces by revealing that the $d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band can reside below the Fermi level. Motivated by this discrepancy, we investigate a realistic bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model using time-dependent variational principle (TDVP)-based cluster perturbation theory (CPT), alongside large-scale density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations. Our TDVP-CPT calculations, performed on clusters of up to 16 physical sites, reveal that electronic correlations drive a pronounced orbital-selective reconstruction of the low-energy spectrum: the $d_{z^2}$ spectral weight is progressively depleted, the $γ$ band sinks below the Fermi level, and pseudogaps open on the remaining $α$ and $β$ bands, leaving Fermi arcs dominated by the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital at strong coupling. Furthermore, large-scale DMRG calculations demonstrate that the leading superconducting correlations evolve consistently with this Fermi surface reconstruction, transitioning from $d_{z^2}$-dominated to $d_{x^2-y^2}$-dominated interlayer spin-singlet pairing while retaining an $s_{\pm}$ structure. Consequently, our results indicate that the disappearance of the $γ$ pocket is not detrimental to superconductivity; rather, it signals a correlation-driven shift of the pairing channel mediated by interlayer antiferromagnetism, Hund's coupling, and inter-orbital hybridization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：time-dependent variational principle (TDVP)-based cluster perturbation theory (CPT)、density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的电子关联效应、轨道选择性费米面重构以及超导配对机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联驱动了轨道选择性的低能谱重构：d_{z²} 谱权重被耗尽，γ 能带沉入费米能级以下，α 和 β 能带打开赝能隙，最终在强耦合下形成由 d_{x²-y²} 轨道主导的费米弧。超导配对从 d_{z²} 主导转变为 d_{x²-y²} 主导的层间自旋单态配对，但保持 s± 结构，表明 γ 费米口袋的消失并非不利于超导，而是关联驱动的配对通道转移信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联驱动了轨道选择性的低能谱重构：d_{z²} 谱权重被耗尽，γ 能带沉入费米能级以下，α 和 β 能带打开赝能隙，最终在强耦合下形成由 d_{x²-y²} 轨道主导的费米弧。超导配对从 d_{z²} 主导转变为 d_{x²-y²} 主导的层间自旋单态配对，但保持 s± 结构，表明 γ 费米口袋的消失并非不利于超导，而是关联驱动的配对通道转移信号。；创新点：通过超越密度泛函理论（DFT）的强关联计算方法，解释了近期角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验中观测到的 γ 能带下沉现象，并揭示了该现象与超导配对机制转变的内在关联，指出 γ 口袋消失是关联效应而非超导的抑制因素。
papers.method_zh: 基于时间依赖变分原理的团簇微扰理论（TDVP-CPT，最多16个物理格点）和大尺度密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算。

papers.title: A molecular perspective on coordination, screening, and emergent length scales in lithium electrolytes
papers.abstract: Lithium electrolytes are commonly described using separate conceptual frameworks for local coordination chemistry, electrostatic screening, and ionic transport. This separation is effective in dilute conditions but breaks down at higher concentration, where coordination, ion pairing, clustering, and collective dynamics become intrinsically coupled. In this Perspective, we develop a unified multiscale framework that links local coordination motifs, mesoscopic ionic organization, and macroscopic transport within a single physical picture. Through representative examples spanning carbonate liquids, polymer electrolytes, concentrated systems, and confinement, we show that increasing concentration drives a systematic evolution from solvent-dominated Li$^+$ coordination to ion pairing, clustering, and correlated domains. In this regime, screening and transport are not independent phenomena but arise from the same underlying correlated structures. This perspective implies that rational electrolyte design must simultaneously control short-range coordination, mesoscale organization, and collective electrostatic response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（Perspective/综述性理论框架）。判断依据：关键词“unified multiscale framework”、“physical picture”、“implies”。；研究对象：锂电解质中的配位化学、静电屏蔽与离子输运，涵盖碳酸酯液体、聚合物电解质、浓缩体系及受限体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着浓度升高，锂电解质从溶剂主导的Li⁺配位逐步演化为离子对、团簇及关联畴区，在此高浓度下屏蔽与输运并非独立现象，而是源于相同的关联结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着浓度升高，锂电解质从溶剂主导的Li⁺配位逐步演化为离子对、团簇及关联畴区，在此高浓度下屏蔽与输运并非独立现象，而是源于相同的关联结构。；创新点：提出在高浓度下配位、屏蔽与输运内在耦合的物理图像，强调理性电解质设计必须同时控制短程配位、介观组织与集体静电响应，突破了传统将局域配位化学、静电屏蔽与离子输运分离描述的局限。
papers.method_zh: 构建统一的多尺度理论框架，将局域配位构型、介观离子组织与宏观输运联系起来，并通过代表性实例（碳酸酯液体、聚合物电解质、浓缩体系、受限体系）进行阐释。

papers.title: Orbital and Spin Nernst Effects in Monolayers of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: In recent years, orbitronic effects have attracted growing attention as complementary counterparts to the well-established spintronic phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate that monolayers of transition metal dichalcogenides provide an excellent platform for the observation of the orbital Nernst effect, a relatively less explored phenomenon describing the generation of a transverse orbital current in response to an applied temperature gradient. We show that, similar to its electrical counterpart, viz., the orbital Hall effect, the orbital Nernst effect does not require the presence of spin-orbit coupling. Analytical results based on a low-energy valley model offer key insights into the underlying mechanisms, highlighting in particular the crucial role of electronic states at the Fermi energy for the emergence of this effect. The inclusion of spin-orbit coupling further gives rise to a spin Nernst effect, which scales with the strength of spin-orbit coupling and vanishes in its absence. We substantiate our analytical findings with full Brillouin-zone tight-binding results for two representative systems, monolayer 2H MoS$_2$ and 2H NbS$_2$. Our results show that while both orbital and spin Nernst conductivities in MoS$_2$ require electron or hole doping, both effects are intrinsically present in metallic NbS$_2$. Our work reveals the central role of orbital and spin Berry curvatures, identifies doping as an effective route for tuning orbital and spin Nernst responses, and proposes a possible experimental setup for detecting these effects in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算验证）。判断依据：关键词“demonstrate”“show”“analytical results”“tight-binding results”。；研究对象：单层过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDs）中的轨道能斯特效应与自旋能斯特效应，具体以单层2H MoS₂和2H NbS₂为代表体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层TMDs是观测轨道能斯特效应的优良平台，该效应无需自旋-轨道耦合即可存在；自旋能斯特效应则依赖于自旋-轨道耦合，其强度随耦合强度增大而增大。在MoS₂中两种效应均需电子或空穴掺杂，而在金属性NbS₂中两者均为本征存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层TMDs是观测轨道能斯特效应的优良平台，该效应无需自旋-轨道耦合即可存在；自旋能斯特效应则依赖于自旋-轨道耦合，其强度随耦合强度增大而增大。在MoS₂中两种效应均需电子或空穴掺杂，而在金属性NbS₂中两者均为本征存在。；创新点：首次系统揭示单层TMDs中轨道能斯特效应的存在及其与自旋能斯特效应的区别，明确指出轨道能斯特效应不依赖自旋-轨道耦合，并强调费米能级处电子态的关键作用；提出通过掺杂调控轨道/自旋能斯特响应的有效途径，并给出可能的实验探测方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于低能谷模型进行解析分析，并结合全布里渊区紧束缚模型计算，对两种代表性体系（单层2H MoS₂和2H NbS₂）进行数值验证。

papers.title: Families of planar lattices with arbitrarily high $T_{\rm c}$ for the ferromagnetic Ising model
papers.abstract: We construct families of periodic tessellations of the plane with arbitrarily high critical temperature, $T_{\rm c}$, for the classical ferromagnetic Ising model. Our approach is motivated by recently found exact bounds, which imply that large values of $T_{\rm c}$ require large values of the maximal coordination number of the lattice, $q_{\rm max}$. We create such lattices through iterative triangulation and derive explicit expressions for their $T_{\rm c}$. Furthermore, we show that $T_{\rm c}$ for these families scales asymptotically as $T_{\rm c}/J\sim A \ln q_{\rm max}$ with a universal prefactor $A=2/\ln 2$. We introduce a function $T_{\rm c}^*(q_{\rm max})$ that we conjecture to be optimal for all periodic tessellations of the plane. We show that the family of so-called Apollonian lattices, which are derived from the Triangular lattice through iterative triangulation, saturates this bound. The lattices discussed in this work are relevant for theoretical questions of optimality in network systems and may be realized experimentally in Coherent Ising Machines or topoelectric circuits in the future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct families、derive explicit expressions、conjecture、bounds。；研究对象：经典铁磁伊辛模型在平面周期镶嵌晶格上的临界温度 \(T_{\rm c}\)，特别是通过迭代三角剖分构造的晶格家族（如阿波罗晶格）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了具有任意高临界温度 \(T_{\rm c}\) 的平面周期晶格家族，并证明其 \(T_{\rm c}\) 随最大配位数 \(q_{\rm max}\) 渐近标度为 \(T_{\rm c}/J\sim A \ln q_{\rm max}\)，其中普适前因子 \(A=2/\ln 2\)；同时提出一个被认为对所有平面周期镶嵌晶格最优的 \(T_{\rm c}^*(q_{\rm max})\) 函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了具有任意高临界温度 \(T_{\rm c}\) 的平面周期晶格家族，并证明其 \(T_{\rm c}\) 随最大配位数 \(q_{\rm max}\) 渐近标度为 \(T_{\rm c}/J\sim A \ln q_{\rm max}\)，其中普适前因子 \(A=2/\ln 2\)；同时提出一个被认为对所有平面周期镶嵌晶格最优的 \(T_{\rm c}^*(q_{\rm max})\) 函数。；创新点：首次系统构造了平面周期晶格中 \(T_{\rm c}\) 可任意高的家族，并给出了其渐近标律和最优性猜想。摘要未突出说明与已有晶格（如三角晶格）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过迭代三角剖分构造晶格，推导出 \(T_{\rm c}\) 的显式表达式，并利用近期发现的精确边界进行理论分析。

papers.title: Valley-contrasting Spin Textures in Janus Metal Phosphochalcogenides
papers.abstract: Momentum-resolved spin textures and potential valley-contrasting physical properties in the momentum space are two intriguing characteristics of noncentrosymmetric materials, and they have broad applications in spintronics and valleytronics. The realization of diverse spin textures within a single material, along with their further coupling to the valley degree of freedom, is highly desirable. Via first-principles calculations, we investigate electronic properties of Janus MP$_2$S$_3$Se$_3$ monolayers, which exhibits distinct spin textures at different valleys. While Ising-type spin textures are located at $K_\pm$ valleys, the symmetry breaking from the Janus structure brings about a coexistence of Weyl-type and Rashba-type spin textures at $Γ$ valley. In addition to valley-contrasting spin textures, valley dependence also occurs in Berry-curvature-driven anomalous Hall currents and optical selectivity. Besides, energy differences between $Γ$ and $K_\pm$, as well as band gaps, are highly tunable by applied strain. These findings present an intriguing coupling between diverse spin textures and multiple valleys, and pave the way for designing advanced electronic devices that leverage spin and valley degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Janus MP₂S₃Se₃ 单层材料（一种非中心对称的金属磷硫族化合物单层）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在不同谷（K±谷和Γ谷）展现出截然不同的自旋织构（Ising型、Weyl型与Rashba型共存），并实现了自旋织构多样性与谷自由度的耦合，同时表现出谷依赖的贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔电流和光学选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在不同谷（K±谷和Γ谷）展现出截然不同的自旋织构（Ising型、Weyl型与Rashba型共存），并实现了自旋织构多样性与谷自由度的耦合，同时表现出谷依赖的贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔电流和光学选择性。；创新点：在单一材料中同时实现了Ising型、Weyl型和Rashba型自旋织构的共存，并揭示了它们与不同谷（K±和Γ）的耦合关系，以及由此产生的谷对比物理性质（如反常霍尔电流和光学选择性）。摘要未突出说明与已有Janus材料或谷电子学工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），用于研究电子性质、自旋织构、贝里曲率及应变调控。

papers.title: Localization phase diagram of the Hexagonal Lattice with irrational magnetic flux
papers.abstract: We study the Hofstadter model on a hexagonal lattice with irrational magnetic flux in this work. The Hofstadter model of the square lattice with irrational flux has been solved mathematically by Avila in his Fields medal work. However, this theory is usually not applicable to lattices with internal degrees of freedom, such as spin or sub-lattices. In this work, we show that for the hexagonal lattice with only nearest neighbor hopping, the system can still be characterized by a 2*2 transfer matrix and solved exactly by Avila$'$s global theory of Avila although this lattice has two sub-lattices. We obtained the exact localization phase diagram of the hexagonal lattice with irrational flux by this theory, which reveals three pure phases, that is, the extended, localized and critical states but no mobility edge due to the chiral symmetry. We used the renormalization group (RG) theory to verify these results, which can determine part of the phase diagram. We then computed the fractal dimension of the remaining part numerically. The results from both the RG theory and numerical analysis confirmed the phase diagram we get from Avila$'$s global theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“solved exactly by Avila's global theory”、“renormalization group (RG) theory”以及“numerical analysis”，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：六角晶格（hexagonal lattice）上的Hofstadter模型，在无理数磁通（irrational magnetic flux）条件下的局域化相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六角晶格在无理数磁通下存在三种纯相：扩展态、局域态和临界态；由于手征对称性（chiral symmetry），系统中不存在迁移率边（mobility edge）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六角晶格在无理数磁通下存在三种纯相：扩展态、局域态和临界态；由于手征对称性（chiral symmetry），系统中不存在迁移率边（mobility edge）。；创新点：将Avila在方晶格无理数磁通问题上的数学理论推广到具有两个子晶格（sub-lattices）的六角晶格，并证明该体系仍可用2×2转移矩阵精确求解，从而首次得到六角晶格无理数磁通下的精确局域化相图。
papers.method_zh: Avila全局理论（Avila's global theory）精确求解2×2转移矩阵；重整化群（RG）理论验证部分相图；数值计算分形维数（fractal dimension）验证剩余部分。

papers.title: Antisymmetric linear transverse magnetization and ferroaxial moments induced by geometry-driven electric field gradients
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the transverse magnetization and ferroaxial moments induced by electric field gradients arising from the geometry of finite systems. Based on the Kubo formalism and real-time numerical simulations for a finite trapezoidal model, we demonstrate that both quantities are generated under the electric field gradient and are enhanced by tuning the leg inclination, which controls the gradient strength. We further show that the induced transverse magnetization is antisymmetric and linear in the magnetic field; such a response is prohibited by Onsager reciprocity in the absence of an electric field gradient. In addition, we find that the total transverse magnetization scales linearly with the electric field, in contrast to the longitudinal one, which exhibits a quadratic dependence, providing an advantage for experimental observation. Our results establish geometry-induced electric field gradients as a versatile mechanism for realizing and controlling unconventional transverse responses in mesoscopic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically investigate、Kubo formalism、real-time numerical simulations）；研究对象：有限几何结构（梯形模型）中由电场梯度诱导的横向磁化与铁轴矩。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限体系的几何形状产生的电场梯度下，可诱导出反对称且与磁场呈线性关系的横向磁化，且该响应在无电场梯度时被昂萨格倒易关系禁止；总横向磁化与电场呈线性标度关系，而纵向磁化呈二次依赖，有利于实验观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限体系的几何形状产生的电场梯度下，可诱导出反对称且与磁场呈线性关系的横向磁化，且该响应在无电场梯度时被昂萨格倒易关系禁止；总横向磁化与电场呈线性标度关系，而纵向磁化呈二次依赖，有利于实验观测。；创新点：提出几何诱导的电场梯度作为实现和调控介观体系中非常规横向响应的通用机制，并揭示了横向磁化在电场梯度下的反对称线性行为及其与昂萨格倒易关系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于久保形式（Kubo formalism）的理论推导，并结合有限梯形模型的实时数值模拟。

papers.title: Attenuation of long-wavelength sound in quenched disordered media
papers.abstract: We derive analytically, and validate numerically, the dispersion renormalization and attenuation of acoustic waves propagating through quenched disordered media in the long-wavelength limit. We consider weak spatial fluctuations in elastic moduli and/or mass density and compute the disorder-induced self-energies within the leading (Born) approximation. For sufficiently weak disorder, the results depend only on the variances of the fluctuations and are therefore insensitive to the detailed form of the underlying random distribution. For spatially uncorrelated elasticity disorder we obtain Rayleigh-type attenuation, $Γ(q)\propto q^{d+1}$ , together with a reduction of the sound speed. In contrast, density disorder produces Rayleigh-type attenuation but does not renormalize the acoustic dispersion to leading order. Molecular dynamics simulations and normal-mode analyses of disordered one- and two-dimensional lattices quantitatively confirm the theoretical predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值验证）。判断依据：关键词“derive analytically”、“compute...within the leading (Born) approximation”、“validate numerically”。；研究对象：声波在淬火无序介质（quenched disordered media）中的传播，具体关注长波长极限下的色散重整化与衰减行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱无序条件下，弹性模量涨落导致声速降低和瑞利型衰减（Γ(q)∝q^{d+1}），而密度涨落仅产生瑞利型衰减，不改变声速（至领头阶）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱无序条件下，弹性模量涨落导致声速降低和瑞利型衰减（Γ(q)∝q^{d+1}），而密度涨落仅产生瑞利型衰减，不改变声速（至领头阶）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：采用领头阶（Born近似）计算无序诱导的自能；数值验证：对一维和二维无序晶格进行分子动力学模拟和简正模式分析。

papers.title: Spin Seebeck effect in magnetic junctions with a compensated ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: Compensated ferrimagnets enable ferromagnet-like spin transport without net magnetization. We study the spin Seebeck effect in a compensated ferrimagnet/normal-metal junction using a four-sublattice model in which sublattice inequivalence arises from differences in exchange couplings, in contrast to the previously studied anisotropy-based mechanism. Within the nonequilibrium Green's function framework, we show that isotropic magnon splitting generates a robust spin current with a magnitude comparable to that in standard ferromagnetic junctions. We also demonstrate that the spin Seebeck effect vanishes in altermagnet junctions under identical conditions, thereby establishing compensated ferrimagnets as uniquely suited for thermal spin-current generation among magnetically compensated systems. These results provide a theoretical basis for the applications of compensated ferrimagnets with exchange-coupling asymmetry as stray-field-free spin-current sources in spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：nonequilibrium Green's function framework（非平衡格林函数框架）、four-sublattice model（四子格模型）。；研究对象：补偿铁磁体/正常金属结（compensated ferrimagnet/normal-metal junction）中的自旋塞贝克效应（spin Seebeck effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在补偿铁磁体中，各向同性的磁振子劈裂（isotropic magnon splitting）能够产生与标准铁磁结相当的自旋流；而在相同条件下，交变磁体（altermagnet）结中自旋塞贝克效应消失，因此补偿铁磁体是磁性补偿体系中唯一适合热自旋流产生的材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在补偿铁磁体中，各向同性的磁振子劈裂（isotropic magnon splitting）能够产生与标准铁磁结相当的自旋流；而在相同条件下，交变磁体（altermagnet）结中自旋塞贝克效应消失，因此补偿铁磁体是磁性补偿体系中唯一适合热自旋流产生的材料。；创新点：首次在补偿铁磁体中通过交换耦合不对称（而非磁各向异性）实现子格不等价，并证明该机制可产生与标准铁磁结相当的自旋塞贝克效应；同时明确区分了补偿铁磁体与交变磁体在热自旋流产生能力上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用四子格模型（four-sublattice model），通过子格间交换耦合差异（而非此前研究的各向异性机制）引入子格不等价性，并基于非平衡格林函数（nonequilibrium Green's function）框架进行计算。

papers.title: Equilibrium and non-equilibrium properties of active matter systems
papers.abstract: Active matter systems encompass both natural and artificially created systems consisting of numerous active particles. These particles actively consume energy to propel themselves or exert mechanical forces, leading to intricate behaviors and a diverse range of collective motions from flocking transition to motility-induced phase separation. The flocking transition refers to the spontaneous alignment and coordination of individuals in a group, resembling the cohesive motion observed in flocks of birds or schools of fish. On the other hand, motility-induced phase separation refers to the segregation of active particles into distinct regions based on their differing motility levels. In this presentation, I will talk about active matter systems, specifically focusing on the collective behavior and dynamics, including the influence of volume exclusion features, the impact of disorder in the media, and the behavior of self-propelled particles in off-lattice domains by introducing spin anisotropy. The objective is to understand how the collective behavior of self-propelled particles is affected by various system parameters, including thermal noise, self-propulsion velocity, external field strength, etc. I will furthermore show the phenomena such as jamming, kinetic arrest, motility-induced phase separation, coexisting phases, microphase separation, and phase transitions within the context of active matter models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入自旋各向异性”、“研究系统参数影响”等，属于理论建模和数值模拟的典型范畴。；研究对象：活性物质系统，具体包括：自驱动粒子（self-propelled particles）的集体行为，如 flocking 转变（群体对齐运动）和运动性诱导相分离（motility-induced phase separation, MIPS），以及体积排斥效应、无序介质影响、离格点（off-lattice）模型中的自旋各向异性等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一核心结论，但指出研究目标是理解自驱动粒子的集体行为如何受热噪声、自推进速度、外场强度等系统参数影响，并展示活性物质模型中的堵塞、动力学停滞、运动性诱导相分离、共存相、微相分离及相变等现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一核心结论，但指出研究目标是理解自驱动粒子的集体行为如何受热噪声、自推进速度、外场强度等系统参数影响，并展示活性物质模型中的堵塞、动力学停滞、运动性诱导相分离、共存相、微相分离及相变等现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：引入自旋各向异性（spin anisotropy）来研究离格点（off-lattice）域中自驱动粒子的行为；通过改变系统参数（热噪声、自推进速度、外场强度等）进行参数扫描分析。

papers.title: Magnetic structure in the two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnet Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$
papers.abstract: High-quality single crystals of the two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnet Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ (FGaT) were successfully grown using the chemical vapour transport method, which effectively reduced surface impurities compared with conventional self-flux growth. Structural and magnetic characterizations were performed using single-crystal X-ray and neutron diffraction. The results confirm that FGaT crystallizes in the hexagonal $P6_3/mmc$ structure, with Fe occupying two inequivalent sites (Fe$^{i}$ and Fe$^{ii}$), where the magnetic moment of Fe$^{i}$ [1.9(2) $μ_B$] is larger than that of Fe$^{ii}$ [1.4(6) $μ_B$]. The magnetic easy axis is oriented along the $c$ axis and the Curie temperature ($T_C$) is approximately 355-360 K. Compared with Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ (FGT), FGaT exhibits a slightly expanded $a$ axis and a contracted $c$ axis, resulting in a reduction in the Fe$^{i}$-Fe$^{ii}$ interatomic distance along the $c$ axis. This pronounced contraction could strengthen the Fe$-$Fe exchange interaction, which is believed to be the key factor responsible for the significantly higher $T_C$ in FGaT relative to FGT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“单晶生长”、“X射线衍射”、“中子衍射”、“结构表征”、“磁性表征”。；研究对象：二维范德瓦尔斯铁磁体Fe₃GaTe₂（FGaT）的晶体结构与磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe₃GaTe₂具有六方P6₃/mmc结构，Fe占据两个不等价位点，磁矩大小不同；其易磁化轴沿c轴方向，居里温度约为355-360 K，显著高于同族材料Fe₃GeTe₂，主要归因于c轴方向Fe¹-Fe²原子间距的收缩增强了Fe-Fe交换相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe₃GaTe₂具有六方P6₃/mmc结构，Fe占据两个不等价位点，磁矩大小不同；其易磁化轴沿c轴方向，居里温度约为355-360 K，显著高于同族材料Fe₃GeTe₂，主要归因于c轴方向Fe¹-Fe²原子间距的收缩增强了Fe-Fe交换相互作用。；创新点：通过化学气相输运法有效减少了表面杂质，并首次通过中子衍射确定了Fe₃GaTe₂中两个不等价Fe位点的磁矩大小，揭示了c轴收缩导致居里温度升高的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学气相输运法生长高质量单晶；使用单晶X射线衍射和中子衍射进行结构与磁性表征。

papers.title: Non-magnetic insulating phase induced by Jahn-Teller effect in RNiO$_3$
papers.abstract: We propose a three-dimensional multi-orbital tight-binding model for rare-earth nickelates RNiO$_3$ that treats charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom on equal footing. All model parameters, including the on-site interactions $U$ and $J$ and the electron-phonon (el-ph) coupling to the breathing mode, are extracted from hybrid-functional DFT calculations for the small-bandwidth nickelate LuNiO$_3$. The model describes three competing insulating phases governed by the interplay of $U{-}3J$ and el-ph coupling to the breathing and Jahn--Teller (JT) modes. For large $U{-}3J$, the insulating state is stabilized by local JT distortions on high-spin Ni$^{3+}$ sites. For smaller $U{-}3J$, the system undergoes charge disproportionation, $2\mathrm{Ni}^{3+}\rightarrow\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}+\mathrm{Ni}^{4+}$, resulting in the spin-polarized charge-ordered state observed experimentally below the Néel temperature in small-bandwidth RNiO$_3$. When the JT energy on the Ni$^{2+}$ site exceeds Hund's exchange $3J$, a distinct charge- and orbital-ordered insulating phase emerges in which the two $e_g$-electrons occupy the same orbital with opposite spin. The stability of this phase is further confirmed by self-consistent calculations within the full three-dimensional tight-binding model. This newly predicted metastable state, characterized by JT distortions in a nonmagnetic charge-ordered RNiO$_3$ phase, shows that the onset of magnetic order is not required for the metal-insulator transition in RNiO$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tight-binding model、hybrid-functional DFT calculations、self-consistent calculations。；研究对象：稀土镍酸盐 RNiO₃（以 LuNiO₃ 为代表）中由 Jahn-Teller 效应诱导的非磁性绝缘相，涉及电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格自由度的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 RNiO₃ 中，当 Ni²⁺ 位上的 Jahn-Teller 能量超过 Hund 耦合 3J 时，会出现一种新的非磁性电荷-轨道有序绝缘相，该相中两个 e_g 电子占据同一轨道且自旋相反。这一发现表明，RNiO₃ 的金属-绝缘体转变并不必然伴随磁有序的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 RNiO₃ 中，当 Ni²⁺ 位上的 Jahn-Teller 能量超过 Hund 耦合 3J 时，会出现一种新的非磁性电荷-轨道有序绝缘相，该相中两个 e_g 电子占据同一轨道且自旋相反。这一发现表明，RNiO₃ 的金属-绝缘体转变并不必然伴随磁有序的出现。；创新点：首次预测了 RNiO₃ 中一种由 Jahn-Teller 畸变驱动的非磁性电荷有序绝缘亚稳态，打破了以往认为该体系中金属-绝缘体转变必须伴随磁有序的传统认识。
papers.method_zh: 构建了三维多轨道紧束缚模型，模型参数（包括在位相互作用 U 和 J、电子-声子耦合）均从针对小带宽镍酸盐 LuNiO₃ 的杂化泛函 DFT 计算中提取。通过分析 U-3J 与呼吸模和 Jahn-Teller 模电子-声子耦合的竞争，描述三种绝缘相，并用全三维紧束缚模型的自洽计算验证新相的稳定性。

papers.title: Spin-charge separation in two-leg t-J ladders
papers.abstract: Spin-charge separation is a hallmark of one-dimensional fermionic systems, yet its realization in higher dimensions remains an open question. To address this issue, we investigate a two-leg t-J ladder using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) method and its time-dependent extension. By analyzing ground-state correlations and single-particle removal spectra, we systematically examine the effects of plaquette diagonal hopping, spin exchange, and hole doping. Within appropriate parameter regimes, these factors drive the system from the well-known Luther Emery phase, with gapped spin and gapless charge modes, into a Luttinger liquid phase characterized by gapless spin and charge excitations, where signatures of spin-charge separation emerge. In combination with previous studies using exact diagonalization, our results provide evidence that spin-charge separation may persist in wider ladder systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）及其含时扩展方法进行数值计算。；研究对象：两腿t-J梯子模型中的自旋-电荷分离现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节plaquette对角跳跃、自旋交换和空穴掺杂等参数，系统可从具有自旋能隙和电荷无能隙的Luther Emery相转变为自旋和电荷均无能隙的Luttinger液体相，并在该相中观察到自旋-电荷分离的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节plaquette对角跳跃、自旋交换和空穴掺杂等参数，系统可从具有自旋能隙和电荷无能隙的Luther Emery相转变为自旋和电荷均无能隙的Luttinger液体相，并在该相中观察到自旋-电荷分离的特征。；创新点：结合先前精确对角化研究，提供了自旋-电荷分离可能存在于更宽梯子系统中的证据。摘要未明确说明与已有工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法及其含时扩展，分析基态关联函数和单粒子移除谱。

papers.title: Hole-Doping Suppresses Competing Magnetism in High-DOS C136 Carbon Schwarzite: A Computational Route Toward Superconductivity in Negative-Curvature Carbon Networks
papers.abstract: Carbon schwarzites are negative-curvature carbon networks with electronic structures distinct from graphene, fullerenes, and conventional carbon allotropes. Here we report a spin-polarized first-principles screening study of D-type C136 carbon schwarzite focused on the competition between magnetism, doping, and high-DOS metallic behavior. Neutral C136 has a robust competing magnetic branch, with total magnetization of about 11.01-11.03 Bohr magnetons per 136-atom cell. Charged-cell calculations reveal a clear electron-hole asymmetry: adding two electrons per cell increases the total magnetization to 12.11 Bohr magnetons per cell, while removing two electrons reduces it to 9.61. Further hole doping suppresses the magnetic branch monotonically, giving 8.02, 6.34, and 4.76 Bohr magnetons per cell for removal of 4, 6, and 8 electrons, respectively. The most strongly hole-doped point, h8, was examined with spin-polarized NSCF and density-of-states calculations on a 4x4x4 k-point mesh. The NSCF Fermi energy, -0.7414 eV, agrees with the SCF value, -0.7413 eV. The DOS remains high near the Fermi level: at E = -0.740 eV, the total DOS is about 44.69 states/eV/cell, with DOS_up = 33.11 and DOS_down = 11.58 states/eV/cell. Thus h8 combines substantial suppression of the competing magnetic branch with preservation of a high-DOS metallic state. We do not claim superconductivity in C136. Instead, these calculations identify hole doping as a route for suppressing a competing magnetic instability while preserving electronic conditions relevant for further superconductivity screening. Lattice stability, electron-phonon coupling, and transition-temperature estimates remain open problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles screening study、spin-polarized、DFT（密度泛函理论）计算。；研究对象：D型C136碳施瓦茨石（carbon schwarzite），一种具有负曲率的碳网络结构，重点研究其磁性、掺杂与高态密度金属行为之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空穴掺杂可以单调抑制C136碳施瓦茨石中竞争性的磁性分支，同时保持费米能级附近的高态密度金属态，为在该体系中进一步筛选超导电性提供了可行路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空穴掺杂可以单调抑制C136碳施瓦茨石中竞争性的磁性分支，同时保持费米能级附近的高态密度金属态，为在该体系中进一步筛选超导电性提供了可行路径。；创新点：首次系统揭示了C136碳施瓦茨石中电子-空穴掺杂的不对称性对磁性的调控作用，并明确指出空穴掺杂是抑制竞争磁性、保留高DOS金属态的有效手段，为负曲率碳网络中的超导探索提供了计算依据。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化第一性原理计算（spin-polarized first-principles screening study），包括自洽场（SCF）计算、非自洽场（NSCF）计算、态密度（DOS）分析，采用4×4×4 k点网格。

papers.title: Giant Rashba Splitting and Enhanced Nonlinear Berry-Phase Responses in Sliding-Tunable vdW MXene Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Chalcogen-terminated van der Waals MXenes (M2CX2; M = Nb, Ta; X = S, Se) provide a robust platform for exploring strong spin-orbit coupling and proximity engineering. To probe their tunability and guide optimization of emergent properties, we systematically examine sister compounds and propose M2CS2/CrBr3 heterostructures that break time-reversal symmetry via proximity exchange coupling, enabling combined intrinsic magnetic and mechanical control. First-principles calculations reveal Rashba splitting up to 2.53 eV A and valley-contrasting spin polarization in monolayers. These features drive strong second-order nonlinear responses, with pristine bilayer Ta2CS2 reaching a shift current of |sigma|_max approx 5 A mA/V^2 and Nb2CS2/CrBr3 attaining |D|_max approx 18.44 A. In M2CS2/CrBr3 heterostructures, the ferromagnetic substrate induces a magnetization-reversible proximity exchange field with valley-selective conduction-band renormalization (Delta_val approx 50 meV). Crucially, interfacial geometry, controlled by stacking inversion and lateral sliding, acts as a mechanical knob that continuously tunes the exchange-SOC interplay and bandgap, driving an emergent quantum anomalous Hall phase in the bilayer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：硫族元素封端的范德华MXene材料（M₂CX₂；M = Nb, Ta；X = S, Se）及其与CrBr₃构成的异质结，具体研究其Rashba自旋劈裂、非线性Berry相响应以及通过堆叠和滑移实现的机械可调性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层MXene中实现了高达2.53 eV·Å的Rashba劈裂和谷对比自旋极化，并在M₂CS₂/CrBr₃异质结中通过铁磁衬底诱导出可逆的近邻交换场（谷选择性导带重整化约50 meV），同时界面滑移可连续调控交换-自旋轨道耦合相互作用，驱动双层体系进入量子反常霍尔相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层MXene中实现了高达2.53 eV·Å的Rashba劈裂和谷对比自旋极化，并在M₂CS₂/CrBr₃异质结中通过铁磁衬底诱导出可逆的近邻交换场（谷选择性导带重整化约50 meV），同时界面滑移可连续调控交换-自旋轨道耦合相互作用，驱动双层体系进入量子反常霍尔相。；创新点：提出了通过界面几何（堆叠反转和横向滑移）作为机械旋钮，连续调控MXene/CrBr₃异质结中交换作用与自旋轨道耦合的竞争，从而诱导出量子反常霍尔相，并实现了巨大的Rashba劈裂和增强的非线性Berry相响应。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations），具体用于计算电子结构、Rashba劈裂、非线性响应（如位移电流）以及异质结的能带和拓扑性质。

papers.title: Purcell enhancement in layered InSe on the Mie-resonant silicon nitride waveguide
papers.abstract: Hybrid integration of layered van der Waals (vdW) semiconductors with dielectric resonant structures provides an effective approach for controlling excitonic emission dynamics. Here, we demonstrate Purcell-enhanced spontaneous emission from a thin InSe flake integrated with a Mie-resonant Si$_3$N$_4$ waveguide. The structure is designed to spectrally overlap with the InSe photoluminescence band and enhance coupling of excitonic emission to the guided mode. Time-resolved photoluminescence shows a reduction of the excitonic decay time by up to a factor of three relative to planar InSe. The extracted Purcell factors are approximately 3 for out-of-plane excitons and 2.1 for in-plane excitons. These results demonstrate resonator-induced control of excitonic recombination in layered InSe and highlight vdW-dielectric interfaces as a platform for integrated excitonic and quantum photonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、Time-resolved photoluminescence、extracted Purcell factors。；研究对象：层状InSe薄片与Mie共振氮化硅（Si₃N₄）波导的混合集成体系，具体研究其激子发射动力学及Purcell增强效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将薄层InSe集成到Mie共振Si₃N₄波导上，实现了自发辐射的Purcell增强，激子衰减时间相比平面InSe缩短了最多三倍，面外和面内激子的Purcell因子分别约为3和2.1。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将薄层InSe集成到Mie共振Si₃N₄波导上，实现了自发辐射的Purcell增强，激子衰减时间相比平面InSe缩短了最多三倍，面外和面内激子的Purcell因子分别约为3和2.1。；创新点：首次在层状InSe中实现了由谐振器诱导的激子复合控制，展示了范德华-介电界面作为集成激子与量子光子器件平台的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上设计了与InSe光致发光谱带光谱重叠的波导结构，采用时间分辨光致发光（TRPL）测量激子衰减时间，并提取Purcell因子。

papers.title: Effective sextic field theory for tricritical-critical crossover
papers.abstract: Effective field theories provide a suitable framework for both particle physics and statistical physics. We delve deeper into the study of the effective three-dimensional scalar field theory for its application to statistical physics, especially considering the role of the sextic coupling in the tricritical-to-critical crossover. The three-loop renormalization of the mass and the two coupling constants that we perform allows us to obtain, for the first time, the complete renormalization group flow of the couplings in that order. We analyze what universality means in this problem and how we can recover non-universal terms from the renormalization group beta functions. The crossover is realized by the convergence of the renormalization group flow towards the line connecting the tricritical and critical fixed points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“effective field theories”、“renormalization”、“renormalization group flow”、“fixed points”。；研究对象：三维标量场理论中的三临界-临界交叉（tricritical-to-critical crossover）现象，具体研究六次耦合（sextic coupling）在该交叉过程中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在三圈重整化阶获得了质量与两个耦合常数的完整重整化群流，并揭示了该交叉通过重整化群流向连接三临界与临界不动点的线收敛而实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在三圈重整化阶获得了质量与两个耦合常数的完整重整化群流，并揭示了该交叉通过重整化群流向连接三临界与临界不动点的线收敛而实现。；创新点：首次在三圈水平上完成了耦合常数的完整重整化群流计算，并分析了如何从β函数中恢复非普适项以及该问题中普适性的含义。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效三维标量场理论框架，进行三圈重整化计算（包括质量与两个耦合常数的重整化），并分析重整化群β函数。

papers.title: Molecular Nitrogen Formation in Nitrogen-Implanted (100) $β-Ga_2O_3$ Revealed by Temperature-Dependent $N$ $K$-edge XANES
papers.abstract: The realization of $p$-type doping in wide-band-gap oxide semiconductors remains a major challenge, particularly in $β-Ga_2O_3$ where nitrogen has long been considered a potential acceptor dopant but has consistently failed to produce hole conductivity. Here we investigate the microscopic configuration of implanted nitrogen in (100) $β-Ga_2O_3$ using temperature-dependent $N$ $K$-edge x-ray absorption spectroscopy. The spectra reveal a pronounced $π^*$ resonance characteristic of molecular nitrogen, which becomes increasingly dominant upon thermal annealing. First-principles calculations and multiple-scattering simulations reveal a pronounced tendency for nitrogen atoms to form $N-N$ bonded configurations in the $Ga_2O_3$ matrix, particularly in defect-rich environments created by ion implantation, reproducing the characteristic spectral features observed in the $N$ $K$-edge XANES spectra. Structural analysis further indicates that implantation induces a defect-rich near-surface layer with local $β$-to-$γ$-like structural motifs, highlighting the strongly nonequilibrium structural environment in which nitrogen incorporation occurs. Reported results show that implanted nitrogen preferentially forms molecular $N_2$-like configurations rather than substitutional acceptors. Our results provide a microscopic explanation for the long-standing failure of nitrogen acceptor doping in $β-Ga_2O_3$ and reveal dopant molecularization as a previously overlooked pathway for impurity incorporation under strongly nonequilibrium implantation conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：温度依赖N K边X射线吸收谱（XANES）、第一性原理计算、多重散射模拟。；研究对象：氮离子注入的(100) β-Ga₂O₃中氮的微观构型，特别是氮掺杂失败的原因。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 注入的氮原子在β-Ga₂O₃中优先形成分子N₂-like构型，而非替代式受主，这解释了长期以来氮掺杂无法实现p型导电的失败原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：注入的氮原子在β-Ga₂O₃中优先形成分子N₂-like构型，而非替代式受主，这解释了长期以来氮掺杂无法实现p型导电的失败原因。；创新点：揭示了在强非平衡注入条件下，杂质分子化（dopant molecularization）是此前被忽视的杂质掺入路径，为氮掺杂β-Ga₂O₃长期失败提供了微观解释。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：温度依赖的N K边X射线吸收近边结构谱（XANES）；计算方法：第一性原理计算、多重散射模拟；结构分析：通过XANES谱特征推断注入诱导的缺陷富集近表面层及局部β→γ结构转变。

papers.title: On the thermal properties of knotted block copolymer rings
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermal and structural properties of knotted diblock copolymer rings using a coarse-grained lattice model in an implicit solvent. The system is studied by means of the Wang--Landau Monte Carlo algorithm, allowing us to analyze thermodynamic and conformational responses over a wide temperature range. Different knot topologies, including the unknot, trefoil, figure-eight, and pentafoil knots, are considered for both symmetric and asymmetric monomer compositions. In the AB model employed here, A-type monomers are self-repulsive, B-type monomers are self-attractive, and A-B interactions are neutral, such that the solvent is effectively good for A-type monomers and poor for B-type monomers at low temperatures. We analyze several key observables, including the heat capacity, the radius of gyration, and its temperature derivative for both the entire copolymer ring and the individual blocks, and the probability that a monomer belongs to the knotted region. Our results show that the interplay between knot topology, monomer composition, and temperature strongly influences polymer conformations. Small variations in the B-block length induce nonmonotonic, reentrant-like conformational behavior as a function of temperature, including transitions between knot localization and delocalization at low temperatures. These effects arise from the competition between energetic and entropic contributions imposed by topological constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Wang-Landau Monte Carlo算法、粗粒化晶格模型、隐式溶剂。；研究对象：嵌段共聚物环（diblock copolymer rings）的热学与结构性质，具体研究不同纽结拓扑（unknot、trefoil、figure-eight、pentafoil）以及对称/非对称单体组成对体系的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纽结拓扑、单体组成与温度之间的相互作用强烈影响聚合物构象；B嵌段长度的微小变化会导致随温度变化的非单调、类似回滞的构象行为，包括低温下纽结的局域化与去局域化之间的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纽结拓扑、单体组成与温度之间的相互作用强烈影响聚合物构象；B嵌段长度的微小变化会导致随温度变化的非单调、类似回滞的构象行为，包括低温下纽结的局域化与去局域化之间的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用隐式溶剂中的粗粒化晶格模型，通过Wang-Landau蒙特卡洛算法在宽温度范围内分析热力学与构象响应。模型中A型单体自排斥、B型单体自吸引、A-B相互作用中性，从而在低温下溶剂对A型单体为良溶剂、对B型单体为不良溶剂。

papers.title: Interparticle Interactions in Nonlocal Media: Attraction and Repulsion from Charge-Polarization Coupling
papers.abstract: Recent measurements of microsphere interactions in diverse media suggest that the standard dielectric-continuum models of solution-phase interactions are fundamentally incomplete. Experiments indicate that the interactions of charged particles in liquids can be dominated by solvent structuring at interfaces, thereby motivating the concept of electrosolvation. While interfacial spectroscopy and molecular simulations have established that solvent molecules can exhibit net orientation at interfaces, conventional theoretical frameworks treat the fluid as a structureless medium described by a constant dielectric permittivity. This view does not envisage a contribution of interfacial polarization to interactions at longer range. Here, we employ nonlocal dielectric theory accounting for spatial correlations in polarization to describe interactions in solution. This model permits both charge and polarization to govern interactions, leading to dramatic departures from classical expectations. Specifically, the balance between charge and polarization generates a framework of symmetric (repulsive) and antisymmetric (attractive) interactions, wherein: (i) like-charged surfaces can attract at long range, (ii) oppositely charged objects can repel, and (iii) neutral matter can acquire effective electrical mobility and display long-range forces-potentially explaining long-range hydrophobic attraction. Further, like-charged biomolecules can attract in aqueous electrolytes even for modest polarization correlation lengths ($ξ=2$ Å). Our results also suggest that electrosolvation effects may underpin flocculation in suspended matter, which has traditionally been attributed to attractive dispersion forces. These findings indicate how solvent structuring and correlations may play a dominant, complex role in fluid-phase physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“非局域介电理论”、“理论框架”、“模型”。；研究对象：带电粒子在液体（溶液）中的相互作用，特别是由界面溶剂结构化和极化关联引起的长程力，包括同号电荷吸引、异号电荷排斥以及中性物质的电迁移现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入非局域介电理论，发现电荷与极化之间的耦合可以产生对称（排斥）和反对称（吸引）相互作用，导致同号电荷表面可长程吸引、异号电荷物体可排斥、中性物质可具有有效电迁移率并显示长程力，从而可能解释长程疏水吸引和悬浮物絮凝现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入非局域介电理论，发现电荷与极化之间的耦合可以产生对称（排斥）和反对称（吸引）相互作用，导致同号电荷表面可长程吸引、异号电荷物体可排斥、中性物质可具有有效电迁移率并显示长程力，从而可能解释长程疏水吸引和悬浮物絮凝现象。；创新点：将溶剂界面极化的空间关联效应纳入相互作用理论，揭示了电荷-极化耦合可导致与经典介电连续模型截然相反的相互作用行为（如同号吸引、异号排斥），并指出电溶剂化效应可能主导传统上归因于色散力的絮凝过程。
papers.method_zh: 采用非局域介电理论（nonlocal dielectric theory），该理论考虑了极化在空间中的关联（即极化关联长度），从而超越传统恒定介电常数的连续介质模型。

papers.title: Stacking-dependent thermoelectric transport in layered Sc_2Si_2Te_6 from first principles
papers.abstract: Stacking polymorphism is a common characteristic of van der Waals layered materials and can substantially modify their physical properties. Here, based on first-principles calculations combined with electron and phonon transport theories, we systematically investigate the thermodynamic stability, electronic structure, lattice dynamics, and thermoelectric performance of Sc_2Si_2Te_6 with three high-symmetry stacking sequences, namely, AA, AB, and ABC. We find that the AA- and AB-stacked structures are nearly degenerate in energy with the experimentally reported ABC phase, and that the maximum sliding barrier among these stacking sequences is only about 10~meV/atom, thereby accounting for the stacking faults observed experimentally. These three stacking sequences exhibit distinct electronic structures, with the conduction-band minimum being highly sensitive to the stacking sequence. As a consequence, the conduction-band degeneracies are 12, 2, and 8 for the ABC, AA, and AB stackings, respectively, leading to markedly different electronic transport properties near the band edge. The lattice thermal conductivity is governed primarily by three-phonon scattering, whereas four-phonon scattering provides an additional reduction, particularly in the ABC stacking. Among the three structures, the AB stacking exhibits the lowest lattice thermal conductivity owing to its stronger three-phonon scattering and lower phonon group velocity. As a result, the maximum thermoelectric figure of merit, ZT, is achieved in the ABC structure, followed closely by the AB structure, whereas the AA structure shows a substantially reduced value. These results demonstrate that the stacking sequence exerts a non-negligible influence on the thermoelectric performance of Sc_2Si_2Te_6 and suggest that suppressing the formation of the AA stacking is important for achieving high thermoelectric performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”、“electron and phonon transport theories”。；研究对象：层状材料 Sc₂Si₂Te₆ 中不同堆叠序列（AA、AB、ABC）的热电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 堆叠序列显著影响 Sc₂Si₂Te₆ 的热电性能，其中 ABC 堆叠结构具有最高的热电优值（ZT），而 AA 堆叠结构性能明显较差，抑制 AA 堆叠的形成对实现高热电性能至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：堆叠序列显著影响 Sc₂Si₂Te₆ 的热电性能，其中 ABC 堆叠结构具有最高的热电优值（ZT），而 AA 堆叠结构性能明显较差，抑制 AA 堆叠的形成对实现高热电性能至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算，结合电子输运理论和声子输运理论（包括三声子和四声子散射）。

papers.title: Boundary-dependent topological degeneracy in an Ising chain
papers.abstract: The topological degeneracy is a characteristic of quantum phase diagram in an Ising chain with transverse field. We revisit the phase diagram at nonzero temperature of an Ising chain with two types of open boundary conditions. In this work, we focus on an alternative boundary condition that not only removes the coupling between the two end sites but also eliminates the transverse field on them. We show that such a system can be exactly mapped onto two independent Kitaev chains, where spinless fermions correspond to domain-wall excitations. This results in a switch in the existence of the topological Kramers-like degeneracy in the phase diagram. The underlying mechanism is analyzed within the Majorana representation, which indicates that such a switch arises from the gauge dependence of the winding number in an SSH chain. The manifestation of bulk-boundary correspondence at nonzero temperature is demonstrated by numerical simulations on finite-size systems. This finding provides insight into the quantum spin chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly mapped、Majorana representation、numerical simulations。；研究对象：具有两种开边界条件的横场伊辛链（Ising chain with transverse field），特别是去除了两端耦合和横向场的替代边界条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将系统精确映射到两条独立的Kitaev链，发现拓扑Kramers-like简并在相图中的存在性发生了切换，这种切换源于SSH链中缠绕数的规范依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将系统精确映射到两条独立的Kitaev链，发现拓扑Kramers-like简并在相图中的存在性发生了切换，这种切换源于SSH链中缠绕数的规范依赖性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 精确映射（exactly mapped）到Kitaev链模型，利用马约拉纳表示（Majorana representation）分析机制，并通过有限尺寸系统的数值模拟（numerical simulations）展示非零温度下的体-边对应关系。

papers.title: Orienting-Field Effects on Instability and Mode Selection in Active Nematics
papers.abstract: We examine the instabilities of a confined active nematic subjected to an orienting field using a low Reynolds number Ericksen-Leslie framework with active stresses and field-induced torques. Linear analysis reveals two distinct modes, with odd and even director symmetry, the instabilities of which depend on the interplay between activity and field strength. We derive exact and approximate analytic forms of the stability boundaries and show that an orienting field that aligns the director perpendicular to the substrate anchoring direction cooperatively lowers activity thresholds and enables a field-driven even symmetry mode instability, while an orienting field that aligns the director parallel to the substrate anchoring tends to stabilise the system. Numerical solutions of the full nonlinear equations show that the linear stability analysis correctly identifies the symmetries of long-time states. These results demonstrate how orienting fields can promote an instability below the classical critical activity and can be used to both tune the instability onset and control the mode selection in confined active nematics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Ericksen-Leslie framework、linear analysis、numerical solutions of full nonlinear equations）；研究对象：受限于基底的活性向列相液晶在取向场作用下的不稳定性与模式选择。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 取向场可以降低活性向列相失稳的临界活性阈值，并调控失稳模式的选择：垂直于基底锚定方向的取向场协同降低阈值并驱动偶对称模式失稳，而平行于锚定方向的取向场则倾向于稳定系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：取向场可以降低活性向列相失稳的临界活性阈值，并调控失稳模式的选择：垂直于基底锚定方向的取向场协同降低阈值并驱动偶对称模式失稳，而平行于锚定方向的取向场则倾向于稳定系统。；创新点：揭示了取向场能够使系统在低于经典临界活性时发生失稳，并提供了通过取向场同时调控失稳起始点和模式选择的方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于低雷诺数Ericksen-Leslie流体力学框架，引入活性应力和场致扭矩，进行线性稳定性分析（推导精确与近似解析边界）以及全非线性方程的数值求解。

papers.title: Spin Quadrupolar orders in $d$-wave Unconventional Magnetism
papers.abstract: Unconventional magnetism represents a class of metallic states whose Fermi surfaces exhibit spin-dependent splittings under the non-trivial representations of the rotation group. The $d$-wave $α$-phase unconventional magnetic state, commonly known as altermagnet, recently, has attracted significant attention. While these systems exhibit distinct anisotropic $d$-wave characteristics in momentum space, how this microscopic topology translates into the spin distributions in real space remains a question. In this work, we bridge the intrinsic spin quadrupolar ordering in momentum space to the real-space staggered magnetic distribution. By introducing a weak, non-magnetic periodic crystal potential into a $d$-wave unconventional magnetic state, the spin-charge cross susceptibility is calculated by using the linear response theory. We reveal that the interplay between the crystal potential and the intrinsic $d$-wave spin-splitting naturally induces a spatial spin quadrupole distribution without enlarging the unit cell. Our study thus provides a physical connection between momentum-space multipoles in the even partial wave channel and real-space spin multipole orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：线性响应理论、自旋-电荷交叉响应函数、动量空间多极子与实空间多极子关联。；研究对象：d波非常规磁性态（即d波α相，俗称交变磁体）中自旋四极矩序的实空间分布及其与动量空间拓扑的对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入弱非磁性周期晶格势，d波非常规磁性态中固有的动量空间自旋四极矩会自然诱导出实空间交错自旋四极分布，且不扩大原胞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入弱非磁性周期晶格势，d波非常规磁性态中固有的动量空间自旋四极矩会自然诱导出实空间交错自旋四极分布，且不扩大原胞。；创新点：建立了动量空间偶宇称分波通道中的多极子与实空间自旋多极序之间的物理联系，揭示了d波非常规磁性态中微观拓扑如何转化为实空间自旋分布。
papers.method_zh: 采用线性响应理论计算自旋-电荷交叉响应函数，分析弱非磁性周期晶格势与d波自旋劈裂的耦合效应。

papers.title: Coherence, long-range transport and nuclear polarization in a driven-dissipative dark exciton condensate
papers.abstract: We report direct evidence for macroscopic coherence in a condensate of dark dipolar excitons in coupled quantum wells and show that its formation follows a non-equilibrium, driven-dissipative mechanism. The condensation transition is governed by gain-loss competition, in which the exceptionally long lifetime of dark excitons enables their dominance in mode selection. Condensate formation is revealed by photoluminescence darkening, changes in radiative recombination channels, and the emergence of long-range hydrodynamic transport manifested by propagation of density (sound) modes over millimeter-scale distances. The buildup of dark exciton density induces dynamic nuclear polarization, which closes the dark-bright exciton gap, Δ, via the Overhauser field. This leads to nuclear spin polarization across the entire mesa, far beyond the optically excited region, and produces pronounced hysteresis behavior. At Δ~ 0 the gap is locked and the condensate loss are minimal, resulting in a second threshold manifested as a photoluminescence blueshift. Coherence is revealed through interference between incident and boundary-reflected exciton currents, producing spatial modulation of the photoluminescence from the radiative reservoir and enabling extraction of the condensate coherence length. These results establish dark excitons as a platform for coherent quantum fluids in a driven-dissipative, strongly interacting regime with electrical tunability, bridging the physics of polariton condensates and matter-like excitonic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report direct evidence”、“photoluminescence darkening”、“measurements”、“extraction of the condensate coherence length”等表明为实验研究。；研究对象：耦合量子阱中的暗偶极激子凝聚体，具体研究其非平衡驱动-耗散机制下的宏观相干性、长程输运及核自旋极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 暗激子凝聚体的形成遵循非平衡驱动-耗散机制，其宏观相干性通过入射与边界反射激子流的干涉得以揭示，并伴随长程流体动力学输运和动态核极化导致的能隙锁定行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：暗激子凝聚体的形成遵循非平衡驱动-耗散机制，其宏观相干性通过入射与边界反射激子流的干涉得以揭示，并伴随长程流体动力学输运和动态核极化导致的能隙锁定行为。；创新点：首次直接证明暗激子凝聚体中的宏观相干性，并揭示其形成由增益-损耗竞争主导，同时发现动态核极化通过Overhauser场锁定暗-亮激子能隙，产生跨整个台面的核自旋极化和迟滞行为，将驱动-耗散极化激元凝聚体与类物质激子系统的物理联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光（photoluminescence）光谱测量，包括发光暗化、辐射复合通道变化、密度（声）模式传播的空间调制分析，以及通过干涉提取相干长度。

papers.title: Emergent critical phases of the Ashkin-Teller model on the Union-Jack Lattice
papers.abstract: The Ashkin-Teller (AT) model is a classic spin model in statistical mechanics. For traditional homogeneous lattices like triangular and kagome lattices, even when frustration exists, the model only has one ferromagnetic-paramagnetic critical line in the $J>0$ and $K<0$ region. However, in this paper, for the Union Jack lattice, where the lattice coordination numbers are 4, 8, and 8 and which also contains a large number of small triangular units, using Metropolis Monte Carlo method, we find that, the critical line of the AT model splits into two Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless(BKT) boundaries, and a critical phase emerges in the intermediate region. This phenomenon is the combined result of frustration, lattice inhomogeneity and the two coupled spin degrees of freedom inherent to the AT model. In detail, the novel critical phase characterized by a power-law decay of magnetization with system size, where the correlation length ratio $ξ/L$ remains finite even in the thermodynamic limit. We also introduce the susceptibility $\widetildeχ = \text{d}\langle m \rangle /\text{d}J$ as a key probe, and through this probe, pseudo-critical points $J_c(L)$ are observed to scale proportionally to $(\ln L)^{-2}$, a behavior consistent with BKT criticality. Since superfluids, superconductors, and supersolids all possess quasi-long-range order and fall into the category of critical phases, our results could also inspire the exploration of such quantum phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（理论计算）。判断依据：使用 Metropolis Monte Carlo 方法进行数值模拟。；研究对象：Union-Jack 晶格上的 Ashkin-Teller (AT) 模型，该晶格配位数分别为 4、8、8，并包含大量小三角形单元，存在阻挫、晶格不均匀性以及两个耦合自旋自由度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Union-Jack 晶格上，AT 模型的临界线分裂为两条 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 边界，并在中间区域出现一个临界相。该临界相的特征是磁化强度随系统尺寸呈幂律衰减，且关联长度比 ξ/L 在热力学极限下保持有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Union-Jack 晶格上，AT 模型的临界线分裂为两条 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 边界，并在中间区域出现一个临界相。该临界相的特征是磁化强度随系统尺寸呈幂律衰减，且关联长度比 ξ/L 在热力学极限下保持有限。；创新点：首次在 Union-Jack 晶格上的 AT 模型中发现了由阻挫、晶格不均匀性和耦合自旋自由度共同作用导致的临界相，该临界相位于两条 BKT 边界之间，不同于传统均匀晶格（如三角、kagome 晶格）上仅有一条铁磁-顺磁临界线的行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Metropolis Monte Carlo 方法进行数值模拟，并引入磁化率 $\widetildeχ = \text{d}\langle m \rangle /\text{d}J$ 作为关键探针，通过该探针观测到赝临界点 $J_c(L)$ 按 $(\ln L)^{-2}$ 标度，符合 BKT 临界行为。

papers.title: Microscopic origin of Boson peak in amorphous solids
papers.abstract: We proposed a non-analytic model to explain the microscopic origin of the anomalous vibrational density of states (DOS), the Boson peak (BP), in amorphous solids based on the scalar dynamical matrix of a network with springs and nodes. We argue that disorder can be classified into two factors: fluctuation of spring strength and fluctuation of coordination numbers (the number of springs connected to a node). The results suggest that BP originates solely from fluctuation of coordination numbers, while the fluctuation of spring strength only contributes to the effect of damping and has very limited effect on low frequency DOS. This work converts complexity into simplicity and provides a direct answer to the puzzle of the microscopic origin of BP in amorphous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“proposed a non-analytic model”、“based on the scalar dynamical matrix”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：非晶固体中的玻色峰（Boson peak, BP）现象，即振动态密度（DOS）在低频区的反常增强。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻色峰的微观起源完全来自配位数（节点连接的弹簧数）的涨落，而弹簧强度的涨落仅贡献阻尼效应，对低频态密度影响极小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻色峰的微观起源完全来自配位数（节点连接的弹簧数）的涨落，而弹簧强度的涨落仅贡献阻尼效应，对低频态密度影响极小。；创新点：将复杂无序分解为两类独立因素，首次明确指出玻色峰仅由配位数涨落引起，为玻色峰的微观起源提供了直接且简洁的答案。
papers.method_zh: 基于标量动力学矩阵（scalar dynamical matrix）构建弹簧-节点网络模型，将无序分为弹簧强度涨落和配位数涨落两类，分别分析其对振动态密度的影响。

papers.title: Power spectral density of trajectories of active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles
papers.abstract: The power spectral density (PSD) is a central frequency-domain descriptor of stochastic processes. While PSDs have been studied for Brownian motion and a few anomalous diffusion processes, the spectral densities of active nonequilibrium processes remain almost unexplored. Here, we present an exact theory for the PSDs of active diffusion using the model of active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles (AOUPs). We investigate the spectral densities of AOUPs in free space and under harmonic confinement. In free space, active motion does not alter the Brownian $f^{-2}$ spectrum, but only modifies its amplitude and introduces a crossover at the persistence frequency. Under confinement, the spectrum exhibits a rich variety of features depending on the persistence, trap relaxation, and activity strength, including two characteristic signatures that are absent in both thermal systems and free AOUPs. These are a two-plateau structure from a double-trapping mechanism due to two noise sources, and the new $f^{-4}$ spectral scaling associated with transient ballistic motion. We also investigate the finite time effects through the finite-time PSD, and find that the low-frequency plateau and high frequency oscillation exhibit distinct dependences on the observation time $T$ in free and confined systems. Finally, we discuss our results in connection with previously reported experimental studies of active systems. Our results provide an analytically tractable framework for interpreting such systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact theory、analytically tractable framework。；研究对象：活性奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子（AOUPs）的功率谱密度（PSD），包括自由空间和谐波束缚下的活性扩散过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自由空间中，活性运动不改变布朗运动的 \( f^{-2} \) 谱形，仅改变振幅并引入一个与持续频率相关的交叉；在束缚下，谱出现双平台结构（源于双噪声源的双俘获机制）和 \( f^{-4} \) 谱标度（源于瞬态弹道运动），这些特征在热平衡系统或自由AOUPs中均不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自由空间中，活性运动不改变布朗运动的 \( f^{-2} \) 谱形，仅改变振幅并引入一个与持续频率相关的交叉；在束缚下，谱出现双平台结构（源于双噪声源的双俘获机制）和 \( f^{-4} \) 谱标度（源于瞬态弹道运动），这些特征在热平衡系统或自由AOUPs中均不存在。；创新点：首次对活性非平衡过程的功率谱密度（PSD）进行精确解析研究，揭示了束缚下活性系统特有的双平台结构和 \( f^{-4} \) 谱标度，并讨论了与已有实验观测的联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于活性奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克粒子（AOUPs）模型，对功率谱密度（PSD）进行精确解析理论推导，并分析了有限时间效应下的有限时间PSD。

papers.title: Characterizing Dislocation Substructures in Creep-Deformed Olivine Using Electron Channeling Contrast Imaging
papers.abstract: Olivine is the dominant mineral in Earth's upper mantle and therefore controls mantle rheology and the mechanics of plate tectonics. The constitutive laws for dislocation-mediated deformation of olivine depend on the nature, density, and arrangements of dislocations within crystals. Hence, imaging and characterizing these defects is important, albeit challenging. Traditional imaging approaches involve (1) transmission electron microscopy (TEM), which samples small areas and requires extensive preparation and (2) oxidation decoration methods that have low spatial resolution and cannot distinguish dislocations of opposite Burgers vectors. Here, we apply electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) to unlock insight into the deformation structures within olivine, and combined with electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) and weighted Burgers vector (WBV) mapping as an informative route to characterize dislocation substructures in bulk materials. Specifically, we have used an ECCI workflow based on selected-area electron channeling patterns (SA-ECPs) and we apply this workflow to a single crystal of San Carlos olivine that was deformed by creep at high temperature. ECCI micrographs reveal subgrain boundaries, surface threading dislocations, and dislocation loops across representative areas. The observations demonstrate that this workflow can reliably reveal the complexity of subgrain boundaries in olivine, which can host multiple dislocation types and exhibit non-planar geometries. Despite the limited number of slip systems in olivine, subgrain boundaries can form complex, mixed assemblies. Overall, such observations can provide a variety of constraints on dislocation types, morphologies, and distributions, which are required to parameterize and calibrate models of transient and steady-state dislocation creep in olivine and other materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI)、electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD)、micrographs。；研究对象：橄榄石（olivine）在高温蠕变变形后形成的位错亚结构（dislocation substructures），包括亚晶界、表面穿透位错和位错环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）结合电子背散射衍射（EBSD）和加权伯氏矢量（WBV）映射，可以可靠地揭示橄榄石中复杂的亚晶界结构，包括多种位错类型和非平面几何形态，为位错蠕变模型提供约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）结合电子背散射衍射（EBSD）和加权伯氏矢量（WBV）映射，可以可靠地揭示橄榄石中复杂的亚晶界结构，包括多种位错类型和非平面几何形态，为位错蠕变模型提供约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用基于选区电子通道花样（SA-ECPs）的ECCI工作流程，并结合EBSD和WBV映射，对高温蠕变变形的San Carlos橄榄石单晶进行表征。

papers.title: First-Principles Study of the Temperature Dependence of Structural, Electronic, and Hyperfine Properties of the Cu(100) Surface
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the temperature-dependent behavior of the pure (undoped) Cu(100) surface using first-principles calculations within the Density Functional Theory framework. One of the main objectives is to determine whether the linear dependence of the predicted electric-field gradient (EFG) tensor on the outermost Cu atom on the Cu(100) surface arises from the same generation of the surface or from the reconstruction of the surface. To this end, we perform here a comprehensive $\it{ab}$ $\it{initio}$ study of the Cu(100) surface reconstruction and its associated structural, electronic, and hyperfine properties as a function of temperature, not only at the outermost atomic layer (i.e., the topmost Cu atom) but also as a function of atomic depth relative to the reconstructed surface. To study the temperature dependence of the EFG, we use experimentally determined temperature-dependent lattice parameters for bulk copper in our calculations. The anisotropic relaxation that arises when bulk symmetry is broken helps unravel the potential sources of EFG temperature dependence at the surface. Studying the electron density of conduction electrons $ρ$($\bf{r}$) at the atomic scale near the Cu nucleus and the atom-resolved partial density of states at the topmost Cu atom allows us to correlate the surface effect on the EFG with the bulk value. Finally, we correlate the temperature dependence of the EFG on the undoped Cu(100) surface with the linear behavior of the ''ionic'' contribution to the EFG.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”、“Density Functional Theory”、“ab initio study”。；研究对象：纯Cu(100)表面的温度依赖性行为，具体包括其结构、电子性质以及超精细性质（特别是电场梯度张量）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，Cu(100)表面最外层Cu原子电场梯度（EFG）的温度线性依赖性并非源于表面重构，而是与EFG中“离子”贡献的线性行为相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，Cu(100)表面最外层Cu原子电场梯度（EFG）的温度线性依赖性并非源于表面重构，而是与EFG中“离子”贡献的线性行为相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。计算中使用了实验测定的铜体材料随温度变化的晶格参数，并分析了原子尺度上靠近Cu核的传导电子密度以及最外层Cu原子的原子分辨部分态密度。

papers.title: Dynamical geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates
papers.abstract: When subjected to specific prestresses, continuum elastic shells can exhibit geometric zero modes: complex motions that require vanishing elastic energy to excite, enabling them to be driven by weak and generic energy inputs. Despite recent interest in these modes, we understand very little about their dynamical properties. Non-Euclidean plates modeled on minimal surfaces are one example in which prestresses and geometry combine to produce a continuum of ground states that the plate can explore through a geometric zero mode. We demonstrate that a non-Euclidean plate with metric corresponding to Enneper's minimal surface exhibits the predicted continuous stability, but this degeneracy is ultimately lifted by aging. Despite developing a preferred configuration, the zero mode remains the softest mode. Using a combination of analytical theory and experiments, we show that the elastodynamics of this soft mode is captured by the dynamics of a damped pendulum. A periodic driving uncovers resonance phenomena in this pendulum mode, such as small oscillations and steady rotations, but mixes with an additional flapping mode at high frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验验证）。关键词：analytical theory, experiments。；研究对象：非欧几里得平板（non-Euclidean plates），具体为基于Enneper极小曲面（Enneper's minimal surface）度规的弹性板，以及其中存在的动力学几何零模（dynamical geometric modes）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非欧几里得平板中的几何零模在老化效应下会失去简并性，但仍保持为最软模式；该软模式的弹性动力学行为可由阻尼摆（damped pendulum）的动力学精确描述，并在周期性驱动下表现出共振现象（小振荡与稳态旋转）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非欧几里得平板中的几何零模在老化效应下会失去简并性，但仍保持为最软模式；该软模式的弹性动力学行为可由阻尼摆（damped pendulum）的动力学精确描述，并在周期性驱动下表现出共振现象（小振荡与稳态旋转）。；创新点：首次系统研究了非欧几里得平板中几何零模的动力学性质（而非仅关注其静态存在），揭示了其与阻尼摆动力学的等价性，并实验观测到老化效应如何打破简并但保留软模特性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（弹性动力学建模，将软模动力学映射为阻尼摆方程）与实验（对具有Enneper曲面度规的平板进行力学测试与驱动观测）相结合。

papers.title: Microscopic resonant-shell mechanism for slow Liouvillian sectors in an open correlated lattice
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic theory for how slow Liouvillian sectors are selected in an open correlated lattice. The starting point is not a postulated non-Hermitian band, but a local interacting resonance between an on-site doublon and a branch-resolved nearest-neighbor bond. This resonance defines a composite shell orbital whose doublon weight controls reservoir visibility and whose mixed doublon-bond character controls shell mobility. Projecting the microscopic hopping onto the selected shell yields a branch-selective dimerized channel. In the dilute regime, a boundary doublon-loss channel yields an exponentially slow edge-memory pole through a Zeno-type return. At the shell-critical point, the edge pole is replaced by a near-zero standing-wave doublet with an algebraic coherent spacing. At finite shell filling, the same local shell becomes density dressed. A number-conserving phase-locking jump removes a bright mismatch sector, leaving defects as the asymptotic slow variables and producing a diffusive finite-size gap. We derive the local shell, the projected branch topology, the edge-memory law, the shell-critical doublet, the density-dressed shell Hamiltonian, and the defect generator within one Schur-projection framework. The resulting mechanism identifies the reservoir-engineered fast block as the selector of the observable slow sector, while the microscopic parent shell remains fixed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a microscopic theory、Schur-projection framework、理论推导。；研究对象：开放关联晶格（open correlated lattice）中慢速Liouvillian扇区的选择机制，具体涉及局域双占据（doublon）与键（bond）之间的相互作用共振。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种微观共振壳层机制：局域双占据与分支分辨的最近邻键之间的相互作用共振定义了复合壳层轨道，该壳层通过投影微观跃迁产生分支选择性的二聚化通道，并导致边缘记忆极点和壳层临界双峰等慢速动力学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种微观共振壳层机制：局域双占据与分支分辨的最近邻键之间的相互作用共振定义了复合壳层轨道，该壳层通过投影微观跃迁产生分支选择性的二聚化通道，并导致边缘记忆极点和壳层临界双峰等慢速动力学行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但核心新意在于：不预设非厄米能带，而是从局域相互作用共振出发，通过壳层投影机制解释慢速Liouvillian扇区的选择，并统一描述了边缘记忆、壳层临界双峰和有限填充下的扩散能隙等行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用Schur投影框架（Schur-projection framework），从微观相互作用共振出发，推导出复合壳层轨道、投影分支拓扑、边缘记忆律、壳层临界双峰、密度修饰壳层哈密顿量以及缺陷生成算符。

papers.title: Universal 3:1 Scaling of Quantum-Confined Stark Spectra Revealed by a Three-Dimensional Profile
papers.abstract: We report that the quantum-confined Stark effect spectrum exhibits a nearly rigid redshift while preserving its characteristic peak spacing patterns when increasing the electric field strength F. Using InGaN as a model system, we uncover two electric-field-independent scaling laws for the spectral peaks in both the sub-bandgap and above-bandgap regions and the coefficient ratio is near 3:1. With a novel three-dimensional (3D) visualization, we reveal that the sub-bandgap peak spacings scale as $\frac{12π\hbar^2}{L^2\sqrt{m_em_h}}$ while the above-bandgap peak spacings scale as $\frac{4π\hbar^2}{L^2\sqrt{m_em_h}}$, explaining the origin of the 3:1 ratio. This scaling behavior, validated in both InGaN and GaAs systems and at electroluminescence working conditions, shows that increasing F only expands the energy range and increases the number of peaks without altering the spacing. Beyond these laws, the 3D profile offers new insights into the Tauc background, Franz-Keldysh oscillations and coherence length, providing a powerful tool for the design and diagnostics of electro-optic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report, uncover, validated in both InGaN and GaAs systems, electroluminescence working conditions）；研究对象：量子限域斯塔克效应（QCSE）光谱，以InGaN为模型体系，并验证于GaAs体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电场强度F增加时，量子限域斯塔克效应光谱呈现近乎刚性的红移，且保持特征峰间距模式不变；亚带隙与上带隙区域的峰间距分别遵循两种与电场无关的标度律，其系数比接近3:1。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电场强度F增加时，量子限域斯塔克效应光谱呈现近乎刚性的红移，且保持特征峰间距模式不变；亚带隙与上带隙区域的峰间距分别遵循两种与电场无关的标度律，其系数比接近3:1。；创新点：首次发现并定量解释了量子限域斯塔克效应光谱中峰间距的普适3:1标度律，并利用三维可视化方法揭示了其物理起源（亚带隙峰间距标度为12πℏ²/(L²√(m_e m_h))，上带隙峰间距标度为4πℏ²/(L²√(m_e m_h))）。
papers.method_zh: 通过三维（3D）可视化技术分析光谱数据，揭示峰间距的标度行为；实验验证在InGaN和GaAs体系以及电致发光工作条件下进行。

papers.title: Bound-State Spectra of a Lifshitz-Type Dirac Equation in (2+1) Dimensions
papers.abstract: We investigate a Dirac-type equation in (2+1) dimensions modified by Lifshitz spatial derivatives with dynamical exponent $z=2$, focusing on the spectral properties of bound states under radial confinement. Analytical solutions are obtained for constant backgrounds, hard-wall confinement, and harmonic potentials, while logarithmic confinement is treated numerically via the Numerov method and complemented by a semiclassical WKB analysis. The resulting spectra exhibit characteristic scaling laws governed by the Lifshitz parameter $b$, including $E - M \propto b/R_0^2$ for hard-wall confinement, $E - M \propto \sqrt{2b}\,ω$ for harmonic trapping, and $E - M \sim α\ln\sqrt{b}$ in the semiclassical regime of logarithmic confinement. These results provide a consistent characterization of how higher-order spatial derivatives modify bound-state spectra in two-dimensional Dirac systems and may be relevant for effective descriptions of materials with quadratic low-energy dispersion, such as bilayer graphene and related anisotropic 2D systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Dirac-type equation、analytical solutions、Numerov method、WKB analysis。；研究对象：(2+1)维Lifshitz型Dirac方程（动力学指数z=2）在径向约束下的束缚态谱，可能关联具有二次低能色散的材料（如双层石墨烯及相关各向异性二维系统）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硬壁约束、谐振子势和对数势三种约束下，束缚态能谱均呈现由Lifshitz参数b主导的特征标度律，例如硬壁约束下E-M ∝ b/R₀²，谐振子势下E-M ∝ √(2b) ω，对数势半经典区域E-M ∼ α ln√b。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硬壁约束、谐振子势和对数势三种约束下，束缚态能谱均呈现由Lifshitz参数b主导的特征标度律，例如硬壁约束下E-M ∝ b/R₀²，谐振子势下E-M ∝ √(2b) ω，对数势半经典区域E-M ∼ α ln√b。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解（常数背景、硬壁约束、谐振子势）与数值方法（对数势下使用Numerov方法）结合，辅以半经典WKB分析。

papers.title: Benchmarking a restricted Boltzmann machine on the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Bose-Hubbard chain in the adiabatic hard-core regime
papers.abstract: We study the ground state of the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Bose-Hubbard chain in the adiabatic hard-core limit at half filling using variational Monte Carlo with a shallow restricted Boltzmann machine as the variational ansatz.
