In this context, the neural quantum state is compared with the established adiabatic description of the model. The variational results reproduce the overall structure of the phase diagram obtained from magnetization observables, distinguish the polarized and Néel-ordered regions, and capture representative spin patterns and site occupations for the staggered insulating configurations selected by a weak symmetry-breaking field. Taken together, these results show that a shallow restricted Boltzmann machine reproduces the main adiabatic phase structure of the one-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Bose-Hubbard chain and captures the selected symmetry-broken insulating configurations at half filling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：variational Monte Carlo（变分蒙特卡洛）、variational ansatz（变分拟设）、neural quantum state（神经量子态）。；研究对象：半满填充下绝热硬核极限中的一维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 玻色-哈伯德链（$\mathbb{Z}_2$ Bose-Hubbard chain）的基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个浅层受限玻尔兹曼机（restricted Boltzmann machine）能够再现该模型的主要绝热相图结构，包括极化区和奈尔有序区，并能捕捉由弱对称性破缺场选定的交错绝缘构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个浅层受限玻尔兹曼机（restricted Boltzmann machine）能够再现该模型的主要绝热相图结构，包括极化区和奈尔有序区，并能捕捉由弱对称性破缺场选定的交错绝缘构型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用浅层受限玻尔兹曼机作为变分拟设，结合变分蒙特卡洛方法（variational Monte Carlo）计算基态，并与该模型的已知绝热描述进行对比。

papers.title: Spin Elasticity:A New Paradigm for Spintronics
papers.abstract: Elasticity shapes our world. For centuries, it has been regarded as a property exclusive to ordinary matter. Here we uncover its hidden existence in the spin degree of freedom. We introduce spin elasticity-a framework linking spin torque to spin morpgology. This reveals a topological Hooke's law, uncovers spontaneous oscillations and resonance, and predicts a new class of collective excitations:spin stress waves. By establishing a unfied tau-D theory bridging classical elasticity and topological spin physics, this work completes the elastic picture and opens a new frontier for spintronics-spinelastronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“framework”（理论框架）、“topological Hooke's law”（拓扑胡克定律）、“predicts”（预测）等关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：自旋自由度中的弹性现象，具体为自旋应力波、自旋振荡与共振等集体激发，以及自旋电子学中的新分支“自旋弹性电子学”（spinelastronics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了自旋自由度中隐藏的弹性行为，建立了连接经典弹性理论与拓扑自旋物理的统一理论（tau-D理论），并预测了自旋应力波这一新型集体激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了自旋自由度中隐藏的弹性行为，建立了连接经典弹性理论与拓扑自旋物理的统一理论（tau-D理论），并预测了自旋应力波这一新型集体激发。；创新点：首次提出“自旋弹性”（spin elasticity）概念，将传统上仅属于普通物质的弹性属性拓展至自旋自由度，开创了自旋电子学的新范式——自旋弹性电子学。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：通过将自旋扭矩与自旋形态（spin morphology）关联，推导出拓扑胡克定律，并建立tau-D理论统一描述自旋弹性。

papers.title: Magnetization alignment in spin-transfer-torque magnetic random-access memory
papers.abstract: Reliable operation of perpendicular spin-transfer-torque magnetic random-access memory (p-STT-MRAM) requires control of magnetic alignment within the synthetic antiferromagnet (SAF) reference layer. At nanopillar dimensions, however, devices can exhibit magnetic states that are absent in extended thin films. We present a systematic micromagnetic study of 30 nm-diameter three-layer p-STT-MRAM nanopillars using experimentally motivated material parameters, and map equilibrium states as functions of bilinear and biquadratic interlayer exchange coupling. Phase diagrams show that introducing asymmetry between the SAF layers in saturation magnetization, anisotropy, and thickness reduces the coupling strength required to stabilize antiparallel SAF states and suppress competing configurations. Minimum-energy path calculations show that, for noncollinear antiparallel SAF states, increasing SAF asymmetry can raise SAF reversal barriers while lowering the free-layer barrier; this trade-off is absent for collinear antiparallel SAF states. Stray fields also significantly modify both SAF and free-layer energy barriers. To support the design of p-STT-MRAM devices with either collinear or noncollinear antiparallel SAF reference states, we publicly release the simulation dataset covering 4374 distinct device configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“micromagnetic study”（微磁学研究）、“phase diagrams”（相图）、“minimum-energy path calculations”（最小能量路径计算），以及公开模拟数据集。；研究对象：垂直自旋转移矩磁随机存储器（p-STT-MRAM）中的磁化对齐行为，具体聚焦于合成反铁磁（SAF）参考层在纳米柱（30 nm直径）中的磁态及其稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SAF层之间引入饱和磁化强度、各向异性和厚度不对称性，可降低稳定反平行SAF态所需的层间交换耦合强度，并抑制竞争磁态；但非共线反平行SAF态中，不对称性增加会同时提高SAF翻转势垒和降低自由层势垒，形成权衡关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SAF层之间引入饱和磁化强度、各向异性和厚度不对称性，可降低稳定反平行SAF态所需的层间交换耦合强度，并抑制竞争磁态；但非共线反平行SAF态中，不对称性增加会同时提高SAF翻转势垒和降低自由层势垒，形成权衡关系。；创新点：系统揭示了SAF层间不对称性对磁态稳定性及能量势垒的定量影响，特别是发现了非共线反平行态中SAF与自由层势垒之间的权衡关系，并公开了涵盖4374种器件构型的模拟数据集以支持器件设计。
papers.method_zh: 采用微磁学模拟方法，基于实验驱动的材料参数，系统研究30 nm直径三层p-STT-MRAM纳米柱；通过构建相图分析双线性与双二次层间交换耦合的作用，并利用最小能量路径计算评估能量势垒。

papers.title: Embedded Direct Ink Writing of Thermoset and Elastomeric Polymers via Frontal Polymerization
papers.abstract: Direct ink writing (DIW) using frontal ring-opening metathesis polymerization (FROMP) offers a compelling route to the rapid and energy-efficient fabrication of thermoset and elastomeric polymer architectures, leveraging a self-propagating exothermic curing reaction. While FP-DIW excels at freestanding path printing due to the rapid solidification, it is constrained by stringent rheological requirements, a lower bound on achievable feature size due to quenching, and the need for the reaction front to closely follow the nozzle during printing. Here, we overcome these constraints by leveraging embedded 3D printing to implement FP-DIW with delayed solidification, thereby decoupling shape retention and solidification from ink chemistry and rheology. The use of a yield-stress support medium enables extrusion of low-viscosity inks by suppressing gravitational and capillary instabilities, mitigating front quenching at small diameters, and allowing time-delayed solidification to fuse complex, overlapping, and mechanically interlinked features after deposition. Two complementary thermal initiation strategies are introduced:\ volumetric dielectric heating via microwaves and surface heating at the boundary of the support bath. Formulations based on dicyclopentadiene (DCPD), cyclooctadiene (COD), and mixtures thereof, result in tunable final mechanical properties with glass transition temperatures spanning $-50$ to $160 $$^\text{o}$C. The versatility of this approach is demonstrated through the fabrication of lattices, springs, mechanically interlocked, and multimaterial architectures. Compared to printing in air, this embedded approach introduces a substantially broader range of possible formulations, material properties, feature sizes, and architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验方法（嵌入式3D打印、微波加热、表面加热）和材料制备（DCPD、COD等配方），并展示了实物制造（晶格、弹簧等）。；研究对象：基于前沿开环易位聚合（FROMP）的嵌入式直写打印（Embedded DIW）技术，用于制造热固性和弹性体聚合物结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入屈服应力支撑介质实现嵌入式3D打印，成功解耦了形状保持与固化过程，克服了传统FP-DIW在流变要求、特征尺寸下限和反应前沿跟随性方面的限制，实现了低粘度油墨的打印和复杂互锁结构的制造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入屈服应力支撑介质实现嵌入式3D打印，成功解耦了形状保持与固化过程，克服了传统FP-DIW在流变要求、特征尺寸下限和反应前沿跟随性方面的限制，实现了低粘度油墨的打印和复杂互锁结构的制造。；创新点：首次将嵌入式3D打印与前沿聚合（FP-DIW）结合，利用屈服应力支撑介质实现延迟固化，从而允许打印低粘度油墨、克服小直径淬灭问题，并实现复杂重叠和机械互锁结构的融合制造。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：嵌入式直写打印（Embedded DIW），结合两种热引发策略——微波体积介电加热和支撑浴边界表面加热；材料体系：双环戊二烯（DCPD）、环辛二烯（COD）及其混合物；性能表征：玻璃化转变温度（-50至160°C）测量。

papers.title: Lubrication-Induced Newtonianization Enables Passive Transport of Non-Newtonian materials
papers.abstract: Non Newtonian flows are typically governed by intrinsic bulk rheology, which imposes strong constraints on transport through confined geometries. Here, we show that stable boundary lubrication can fundamentally alter this behavior by localizing shear within a thin, low-viscosity interfacial layer. As a result, the nonlinear rheological response of a broad class of complex materials, including yield-stress, shear-dependent, and thixotropic materials, is strongly suppressed during flow. Using analytical solutions of Stokes flow and numerical simulations, we demonstrate that lubrication-induced shear localization leads to an apparent Newtonianization of transport, in which the macroscopic flow response becomes primarily controlled by the lubricating layer and geometric confinement rather than the intrinsic material properties. In this regime, materials that would otherwise require large pressure gradients can be transported at substantially lower driving forces. Notably, this boundary-dominated transport enables gravity-driven passive flow with orders-of-magnitude enhancement in throughput compared to rigid-wall conduits. These results establish lubrication as a powerful mechanism for tuning and simplifying complex fluid transport, with implications for biological systems, soft and jammed materials, and energy-efficient fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“analytical solutions of Stokes flow and numerical simulations”。；研究对象：非牛顿流体（包括屈服应力流体、剪切依赖性流体、触变性流体）在受限几何结构中的被动输运现象，以及边界润滑对其流动行为的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳定的边界润滑通过将剪切局域在薄的低粘度界面层中，能够显著抑制非牛顿流体的非线性流变响应，实现“牛顿化”输运，使宏观流动主要由润滑层和几何约束控制，而非材料本征性质，从而大幅降低驱动压力并提升重力驱动被动输运的通量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳定的边界润滑通过将剪切局域在薄的低粘度界面层中，能够显著抑制非牛顿流体的非线性流变响应，实现“牛顿化”输运，使宏观流动主要由润滑层和几何约束控制，而非材料本征性质，从而大幅降低驱动压力并提升重力驱动被动输运的通量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用斯托克斯流解析解与数值模拟相结合的方法，分析润滑诱导的剪切局域化对非牛顿流体宏观输运行为的影响。

papers.title: Sensitivity Analysis in the Face of Rare Events
papers.abstract: Molecular motors and other complex nonequilibrium systems are controlled by large sets of design parameters, and optimizing those parameters requires computing sensitivities -- derivatives of dynamical observables with respect to the parameters. When the system's dynamics involves rare events, both the observable and its sensitivity are difficult to estimate from direct simulation. We present a practical computational pipeline that addresses both challenges by combining importance sampling with a Markov state model (MSM). The MSM separately captures the slow, rare-event dynamics and the fast, local dynamics, and the chain rule connects those two pieces to yield an efficient sensitivity estimator. An iterative reweighting procedure based on the RiteWeight algorithm substantially reduces approximation errors from the MSM coarse-graining. We validate the approach on diffusion in the Müller-Brown potential, where the sensitivity of a transition rate to landscape parameters can be computed exactly. We then use sensitivies to optimize the directional bias of a particle-based model of a catalysis-driven molecular motor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：computational pipeline、importance sampling、Markov state model、chain rule、iterative reweighting。；研究对象：复杂非平衡系统（如分子马达）中涉及稀有事件的动力学过程，具体包括Müller-Brown势能面上的扩散以及基于粒子的催化驱动分子马达模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种结合重要性采样与马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）的计算流程，能够有效估计稀有事件动力学中可观测量对设计参数的敏感性（导数），并通过迭代重加权方法减少MSM粗粒化带来的近似误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种结合重要性采样与马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）的计算流程，能够有效估计稀有事件动力学中可观测量对设计参数的敏感性（导数），并通过迭代重加权方法减少MSM粗粒化带来的近似误差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用重要性采样与马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）相结合的计算框架。MSM分别捕捉慢速稀有事件动力学和快速局域动力学，通过链式法则连接两者以构建高效的敏感性估计器；同时使用基于RiteWeight算法的迭代重加权程序来降低粗粒化误差。

papers.title: Theory and Experiment of Chirality-induced Magnetic Nonreciprocity Manifested by Coupling Phase
papers.abstract: Magnetic interactions have long served as the most robust and widely used approach for realizing nonreciprocity, with an externally applied magnetic field breaking time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and chiral photon-magnon interactions introducing spatial asymmetry. In this work, we investigate the chirality mechanisms essential for magnetic nonreciprocity from a unified experimental and theoretical perspective. We begin by examining conventional chiral interactions that generate chiral electromagnetic fields through specially designed structures, and then place particular emphasis on synthetic chirality enabled by nontrivial phase accumulation in traveling-wave-mediated coupling systems. We establish a microscopic theoretical framework that maps field polarization onto the phase of a complex coupling strength and validate it with systematic experiments, thereby providing a consistent formalism that describes both conventional and synthetic chirality. Notably, we highlight the symmetry properties and the unique features of synthetic chirality that distinguish it from conventional nonreciprocal mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“从统一的实验和理论视角研究”、“建立微观理论框架”并“通过系统实验验证”。；研究对象：手性诱导的磁非互易性，具体包括传统手性相互作用（通过特殊结构产生手性电磁场）和合成手性（通过行波耦合系统中的非平凡相位积累实现）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了将场极化映射为复耦合强度相位的微观理论框架，并通过实验验证，从而提供了一个统一描述传统手性与合成手性的形式体系，并揭示了合成手性区别于传统非互易机制的对称性特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了将场极化映射为复耦合强度相位的微观理论框架，并通过实验验证，从而提供了一个统一描述传统手性与合成手性的形式体系，并揭示了合成手性区别于传统非互易机制的对称性特征。；创新点：首次从统一的理论与实验视角，将传统手性相互作用与合成手性（基于行波耦合系统中的相位积累）纳入同一形式体系，并特别强调了合成手性的对称性及其区别于传统非互易机制的独特特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将场极化映射为复耦合强度的相位；实验手段：摘要未明确说明具体实验技术（如材料、测量装置等），仅提及“系统实验验证”。

papers.title: Band alignment of grafted diamond/GaN p-n heterojunctions interfaced with ALD Al2O3 and SiNx/Al2O3
papers.abstract: Diamond and gallium nitride are complementary semiconductors for forming p-n junctions because of their respective doping limitations. Understanding the band alignment of grafted diamond/GaN heterojunctions is therefore essential for optimizing diode performance. In this study, the band alignment of diamond/Al2O3/GaN and diamond/Al2O3/SiNx/GaN heterostructures was determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Both structures exhibit type-II band alignment, but with different band offsets. The band offsets of the diamond/Al2O3/SiNx/GaN heterojunction are larger by 0.42 eV than those of diamond/Al2O3/GaN. This difference is attributed to a modification of the interfacial electrostatic potential, which may arise from a reduced density of positive fixed charges in the interfacial dielectric near the diamond/Al2O3 interface after insertion of the SiNx layer. These results demonstrate that interfacial-layer engineering provides an effective strategy for tailoring the band alignment of grafted diamond/GaN heterojunctions, offering guidance for the design of p-n diodes with tunable rectifying characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“通过X射线光电子能谱（X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy）确定能带排列”。；研究对象：金刚石/氮化镓（diamond/GaN）p-n异质结，具体研究其与ALD Al₂O₃和SiNₓ/Al₂O₃界面层形成的异质结构（diamond/Al₂O₃/GaN 和 diamond/Al₂O₃/SiNₓ/GaN）的能带排列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种异质结构均呈现II型能带排列，但插入SiNₓ层后，能带偏移比无SiNₓ层时增大0.42 eV，表明界面层工程可有效调控嫁接金刚石/GaN异质结的能带排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种异质结构均呈现II型能带排列，但插入SiNₓ层后，能带偏移比无SiNₓ层时增大0.42 eV，表明界面层工程可有效调控嫁接金刚石/GaN异质结的能带排列。；创新点：揭示了通过插入SiNₓ界面层改变界面静电势（降低金刚石/Al₂O₃界面附近正固定电荷密度）来调控能带排列的机制，为设计具有可调整流特性的p-n二极管提供了实验指导。
papers.method_zh: X射线光电子能谱（XPS）用于测定能带偏移；原子层沉积（ALD）制备Al₂O₃和SiNₓ/Al₂O₃界面层；通过分析界面静电势变化解释能带偏移差异。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Theory for Molecular Machine Design
papers.abstract: Modeling the dynamical flows on networks of biomolecular machines often entails computing node populations and edge fluxes with Master Equations and correlating machine performance with entropy production. But this alone is not sufficient for design, optimization and evolution because it doesn't treat cost-benefit tradeoffs, or small-system misflows (backsteps, futile cycles, ineffective actions), or differential properties for flow design. Here we develop CFT Design, based on the recently developed Caliber Force Theory (CFT). We apply it to: designing faster molecular motors through ``traffic control''; optimizing speed, energy, and accuracy in kinetic proofreaders; and designing better enzyme inhibitors. CFT Design provides a general framework for optimizing nonequilibrium flow networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop CFT Design”（发展CFT设计理论）、“provides a general framework”（提供一个通用框架），核心是理论框架的构建与应用。；研究对象：生物分子机器网络中的非平衡流动网络。具体包括：分子马达（molecular motors）、动力学校对器（kinetic proofreaders）以及酶抑制剂（enzyme inhibitors）等非平衡系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Caliber Force Theory (CFT) 发展出的CFT Design理论框架，能够系统地优化非平衡流动网络，通过“交通管制”策略设计更快的分子马达，并同时优化动力学校对器的速度、能量和精度，以及设计更好的酶抑制剂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Caliber Force Theory (CFT) 发展出的CFT Design理论框架，能够系统地优化非平衡流动网络，通过“交通管制”策略设计更快的分子马达，并同时优化动力学校对器的速度、能量和精度，以及设计更好的酶抑制剂。；创新点：该工作超越了传统仅用主方程计算和熵产生关联性能的方法，首次将成本-收益权衡（cost-benefit tradeoffs）、小系统误流（如回步、无效循环、无效动作）等关键设计因素纳入统一的非平衡理论框架，为分子机器的设计、优化和演化提供了系统性的理论工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Caliber Force Theory (CFT)。具体应用包括：通过主方程（Master Equations）对节点布居和边通量进行建模，并利用CFT Design框架进行优化设计。

papers.title: Effect of spin-dependent tunneling and intervalley scattering in magnetic-semiconductor van der Waals heterostructures on exciton and trion polarization
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical analysis of valley pseudospin control in the transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayer by utilizing the magnetic proximity effect of 2D magnetic layer and, propose self-consistent analysis of photoluminescence (PL) polarization peculiarities in TMD/magnetic material van der Waals heterostructures. We attribute observed peculiarities to the interplay between spin-dependent interlayer charge transfer and intervalley scattering of excitons and trions. The ratio between the electron tunneling timescale and the exciton and trion intervalley scattering lifetimes and radiative lifetimes determine the PL dynamics. A possibility to switch PL polarization sign due to the quasi-particles dynamics under circularly polarized laser excitations is revealed. We also discuss generalization of the proposed model due to the careful analysis of both intervalley and intravalley scattering processes between bright and dark excitons. Obtained results allow a long-distance manipulation of exciton and trion behaviors and open the possibilities for the effective control under spin and valley pseudospin in multilayer magnetic-semiconductor van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretical analysis”、“propose self-consistent analysis”、“discuss generalization of the proposed model”。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）单层与二维磁性材料构成的范德华异质结中的激子和三子极化现象，具体涉及谷赝自旋控制、自旋依赖的层间电荷转移以及谷间散射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了自旋依赖的层间电荷转移与激子/三子的谷间散射之间的相互作用是决定光致发光（PL）极化特性的关键；并发现通过准粒子动力学，可在圆偏振激光激发下实现PL极化符号的翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了自旋依赖的层间电荷转移与激子/三子的谷间散射之间的相互作用是决定光致发光（PL）极化特性的关键；并发现通过准粒子动力学，可在圆偏振激光激发下实现PL极化符号的翻转。；创新点：提出了一个自洽模型来解释TMD/磁性材料异质结中光致发光极化的特殊现象，并揭示了通过准粒子动力学调控极化符号的可能性，为多层磁性-半导体范德华异质结中自旋和谷赝自旋的长程操控提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析模型，包括对电子隧穿时间尺度、激子和三子的谷间散射寿命以及辐射寿命之间比值的自洽分析，并讨论了亮激子与暗激子之间的谷间和谷内散射过程。

papers.title: Manipulation of magnetic skyrmions by non-uniform electric fields
papers.abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are topologically protected spin textures in ferromagnetic materials that hold great promise for both classical information storage and processing, as well as for fault-tolerant quantum computing. Realizing practical skyrmion-based devices demands an energy-efficient and precise method for their flexible manipulation. In this paper, we theoretically propose such a tool, leveraging the magnetoelectric effect induced by a localized electric field generated by one or several charged tips. Combining complementary numerical simulations and analytical approaches, we develop a consistent theory describing the stability and dynamics of Néel-type skyrmions under the influence of the electric field from a charged tip. Specifically, we demonstrate that the electric field can create, drive, and annihilate skyrmions of both chiralities, as well as more complex textures such as skyrmioniums and target skyrmions. We identify several distinct dynamical regimes of skyrmion motion near the tip and map them onto a phase diagram. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of a practical device capable of controlled skyrmion manipulation based on this principle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically propose、numerical simulations、analytical approaches）；研究对象：磁性斯格明子（magnetic skyrmions），具体为Néel型斯格明子，以及skyrmioniums和target skyrmions等复杂自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过带电针尖产生的局域非均匀电场，利用磁电效应可以实现对磁性斯格明子的可控创建、驱动和湮灭，并识别出斯格明子运动的多个不同动力学区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过带电针尖产生的局域非均匀电场，利用磁电效应可以实现对磁性斯格明子的可控创建、驱动和湮灭，并识别出斯格明子运动的多个不同动力学区域。；创新点：提出利用局域非均匀电场（而非均匀电场或电流）作为能量高效且精确的工具，实现对不同手性斯格明子及更复杂自旋纹理的灵活操控，并绘制了相应的动力学相图。
papers.method_zh: 结合互补的数值模拟与解析方法，建立描述Néel型斯格明子在带电针尖电场下稳定性与动力学的自洽理论。

papers.title: Angle-Resolved Cryogenic Brillouin-Mandelstam Spectroscopy of Surface and Bulk Acoustic Phonons in Diamond
papers.abstract: We used angle-resolved Brillouin-Mandelstam light-scattering spectroscopy to monitor surface and bulk acoustic phonons in diamond along the <100> and <110> crystallographic directions across a temperature range from 10 K to 300 K. The frequencies and phase velocities were measured for three types of surface acoustic phonons: Rayleigh waves, shear horizontal waves, and high-frequency pseudo-longitudinal waves. All surface acoustic phonons exhibit weak temperature dependence, with the largest observed change of 1.6% across the examined temperature range. The frequencies of all three types of surface acoustic phonons agree with the theoretical values within the experimental uncertainty. Cryogenic surface-acoustic-phonon data are important for diamond-based quantum sensors, surface acoustic wave devices, and other electronic technologies. Knowledge of surface acoustic phonons can also be used for developing accurate models for thermal transport between interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“used angle-resolved Brillouin-Mandelstam light-scattering spectroscopy”进行测量，并给出了温度范围（10 K至300 K）和具体测量对象（表面与体声学声子）。；研究对象：金刚石（diamond）中沿<100>和<110>晶向的表面与体声学声子，具体包括瑞利波、剪切水平波和高频准纵波三种表面声学声子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有表面声学声子的频率和相速度在10 K至300 K范围内表现出微弱的温度依赖性，最大变化仅为1.6%；实验测得的三种表面声学声子频率与理论值在实验不确定度内一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有表面声学声子的频率和相速度在10 K至300 K范围内表现出微弱的温度依赖性，最大变化仅为1.6%；实验测得的三种表面声学声子频率与理论值在实验不确定度内一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：首次在宽低温范围（10 K至300 K）内对金刚石表面声学声子进行角度分辨的布里渊散射测量，并系统比较了三种表面声学模式与理论值的吻合程度，为金刚石基量子传感器和声表面波器件提供了关键的低温声子数据。
papers.method_zh: 角度分辨布里渊-曼德尔斯坦光散射光谱学（angle-resolved Brillouin-Mandelstam light-scattering spectroscopy），在10 K至300 K的低温范围内进行测量。

papers.title: Condensation Transition in Entropy-Constrained Probability Spaces
papers.abstract: The organization of high-dimensional probability spaces is a fundamental problem at the intersection of statistical physics and information theory. Here, we analyze the distributions populating level surfaces of the probability simplex $Δ_{K-1}$ defined by a fixed Shannon entropy. We introduce a discretization strategy that assigns equal statistical weight to distinct microstate distributions and enables a combinatorial analysis of the simplex. A condensation phase transition is shown to take place below a critical entropy that scales as $H_c \simeq \log K - 1 + γ$ in the thermodynamic limit. For entropy values $H_0 < H_c$, the overwhelming majority of distributions are found in a condensed state, in which a single component captures a macroscopic fraction of the total probability mass while the remaining components form a homogeneous fluid background. These results provide a framework for understanding phenomena such as overconfident predictions in machine learning and the emergence of dominant species in ecology, and suggest that sparsity can arise naturally from entropic constraints in high-dimensional manifolds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：combinatorial analysis、phase transition、thermodynamic limit。；研究对象：高维概率空间（概率单纯形）中由固定香农熵约束的分布组织方式，具体为熵约束下的凝聚相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，当香农熵低于临界值 \(H_c \simeq \log K - 1 + \gamma\) 时，概率单纯形中绝大多数分布会进入凝聚态：单个分量占据总概率质量的宏观部分，其余分量形成均匀的流体背景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，当香农熵低于临界值 \(H_c \simeq \log K - 1 + \gamma\) 时，概率单纯形中绝大多数分布会进入凝聚态：单个分量占据总概率质量的宏观部分，其余分量形成均匀的流体背景。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种离散化策略，赋予不同微观态分布相等的统计权重，从而对概率单纯形进行组合分析，并推导出临界熵标度。

papers.title: CrystalREPA: Transferring Physical Priors from Universal MLIPs to Crystal Generative Models
papers.abstract: Crystal generative models mainly learn what stable crystals look like, with little explicit supervision for what makes them stable. We reveal a substantial representation gap between state-of-the-art crystal generative models and pretrained universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) via energy probing, and show this gap can be closed by a simple training-time alignment. We propose Crystal REPresentation Alignment (CrystalREPA), a plug-and-play framework that aligns the atom-wise hidden states of generative encoders with frozen MLIP representations through an element-aware contrastive objective, transferring stability-aware atomistic priors with marginal training overhead and no additional inference cost. Across three generative frameworks, ten MLIP teachers, and two benchmark datasets, CrystalREPA consistently improves the thermodynamic stability, structural validity, and structural fidelity of generated crystals. Equally important, we find that an MLIP's transfer effectiveness is poorly predicted by its accuracy on standard leaderboards (e.g., Matbench Discovery) but strongly predicted by the distinguishability of its atom-wise representation space, yielding a practical, accuracy-independent criterion for selecting MLIP teachers for generative transfer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：generative models、machine learning interatomic potentials、representation alignment、contrastive objective。；研究对象：晶体生成模型（crystal generative models）与预训练通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）之间的表征差异，以及如何将MLIPs的物理先验知识迁移至晶体生成模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过能量探测实验发现，现有最先进的晶体生成模型与预训练通用MLIPs之间存在显著的表征差距；提出CrystalREPA框架，通过训练时的表征对齐可有效弥合这一差距，显著提升生成晶体的热力学稳定性、结构有效性和结构保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过能量探测实验发现，现有最先进的晶体生成模型与预训练通用MLIPs之间存在显著的表征差距；提出CrystalREPA框架，通过训练时的表征对齐可有效弥合这一差距，显著提升生成晶体的热力学稳定性、结构有效性和结构保真度。；创新点：首次揭示晶体生成模型与预训练MLIPs之间的表征差距，并提出一种轻量级训练时对齐方法（CrystalREPA），在不增加推理成本的前提下将稳定性感知的原子先验知识迁移至生成模型。此外，发现MLIP的迁移有效性并非由其标准排行榜（如Matbench Discovery）上的精度决定，而是由其原子级表征空间的可区分性（distinguishability）强烈预测，这为选择MLIP教师模型提供了新的实用标准。
papers.method_zh: 提出CrystalREPA（Crystal Representation Alignment）框架，这是一种即插即用的方法，通过元素感知的对比学习目标（element-aware contrastive objective），将生成编码器的原子级隐状态与冻结的MLIP表征进行对齐。在三种生成框架、十种MLIP教师模型和两个基准数据集上进行了验证。

papers.title: Bond strengths in solids computed from a Wannier-type construction of local vibrational modes
papers.abstract: We introduce a Wannier-type formulation of periodic local vibrational mode theory that yields real-space-localized vibrational modes associated with individual internal coordinates in crystalline solids. These modes are constructed as locally coherent superpositions of wavevector-resolved local modes, yielding a smooth and gauge-consistent real-space representation without the need for additional phase-fixing procedures. The resulting Wannier-type local modes provide well-defined force constants and frequencies that enable robust, chemically interpretable measures of bond and interaction strengths in periodic systems. Moreover, our framework demonstrates that phonon dispersion behavior makes important contributions to the bond and interaction strengths calculated via local vibrational mode theory. We demonstrate the method for representative ionic and covalent systems, including MgO, tetrahedrally-coordinated C, Si, SiC, and two polymorphs of CaCO3. Our framework establishes a direct analog of molecular local modes for fully periodic systems and opens new avenues for quantitative bonding analysis in crystalline materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Wannier-type formulation、local vibrational mode theory、computational demonstration。；研究对象：晶体固体中与内坐标相关的局域振动模式，以及键合强度与相互作用强度的计算。具体体系包括MgO、四面体配位C、Si、SiC以及两种CaCO₃多晶型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于Wannier型构造的周期性局域振动模式理论，能够从实空间局域振动模式中提取明确定义的力常数和频率，从而获得化学上可解释的键合强度与相互作用强度度量，并揭示了声子色散行为对这些强度的重要贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于Wannier型构造的周期性局域振动模式理论，能够从实空间局域振动模式中提取明确定义的力常数和频率，从而获得化学上可解释的键合强度与相互作用强度度量，并揭示了声子色散行为对这些强度的重要贡献。；创新点：建立了全周期体系中局域振动模式的直接类比于分子局域模式的理论框架，为晶体材料的定量键合分析开辟了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有局域振动模式方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: Wannier-type formulation of periodic local vibrational mode theory，通过波矢分辨局域模式的局域相干叠加构造实空间局域振动模式，无需额外相位固定步骤。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Approach for Deciphering Magneto-Structural Phase Transitions: Proof of Concept in Heusler Alloys
papers.abstract: Ferromagnetic solids acquire nontrivial magnetic and caloric properties when the temperature of the structural phase transition approaches the Curie point. Deciphering magneto-structural transitions, i.e. determining their characteristic temperatures and elucidating the related properties, remains challenging. In the present paper, three types of transformational behaviour of Ni50Mn25-xCuxGa25 (x = 6.25, 6.5, 6.75, 7) and Ni50.5Mn18.5Cu6.5Ga24.5 alloys have been identified, arising from small variations in chemical composition: (i) structural martensitic transformation (MT) in the ferromagnetic phase; (ii) magneto-structural phase transition from paramagnetic austenite to ferromagnetic martensite; (iii) MT in paramagnetic phase. The temperature-dependent values of magnetization, M(T), and of magnetic susceptibility, $χ(T)$, were measured for each alloy. A novel thermodynamic analysis was used to determine the Curie points and MT temperatures. The novelty lies in considering the interplay between structural and magnetic characteristics of the alloys through the impact of the structural transition on the spin-exchange parameter. The theoretical analysis of experimental data revealed that this impact results in a large difference ($\geq$ 50 K) between the Curie temperatures computed for the austenitic and martensitic states of each alloy. The characteristic temperatures, corresponding to the extrema of the dM(T)/dT and $χ(T)$ functions, were calculated. The correlation of these temperatures with the Curie temperatures and the MT temperatures is not straightforward and depends strongly on the type of transformational behaviour (i) - (iii). The proposed approach provides a robust framework for extracting unmeasurable characteristic temperatures from standard magnetization data, applicable to ferromagnetic Heusler systems and other multiferroic ferromagnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measured、experimental data、standard magnetization data）；研究对象：Ni50Mn25-xCuxGa25 (x = 6.25, 6.5, 6.75, 7) 和 Ni50.5Mn18.5Cu6.5Ga24.5 合金中的磁-结构相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过小范围化学成分变化，识别出三种不同类型的相变行为，并提出一种新的热力学分析方法，能够从标准磁化数据中提取无法直接测量的特征温度（如奥氏体和马氏体态的居里温度），两者差异可达50 K以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过小范围化学成分变化，识别出三种不同类型的相变行为，并提出一种新的热力学分析方法，能够从标准磁化数据中提取无法直接测量的特征温度（如奥氏体和马氏体态的居里温度），两者差异可达50 K以上。；创新点：提出了一种通过结构转变对自旋交换参数的影响来关联结构相变与磁特性的热力学分析框架，从而能够从标准磁化数据中提取奥氏体和马氏体态的居里温度，并系统区分三种不同类型的相变行为。
papers.method_zh: 测量了各合金的磁化强度 M(T) 和磁化率 χ(T) 随温度的变化；采用一种新的热力学分析，通过考虑结构相变对自旋交换参数的影响，来解耦结构转变与磁特性之间的相互作用。

papers.title: A Closer Look on the Influence of Constraints Upon the Optimization of the Nonadditive Entropic Functional $S_{q}$
papers.abstract: The thermal-equilibrium canonical distribution is currently obtained by maximizing the Boltzmann-Gibbs-von Neumann-Shannon entropy $S_{BG}(p)=k\sum^{W}_{i=1}p_{i}\ln 1/p_{i}$ constrained to $\sum^{W}_{i=1}p_{i}=1$ and $\sum^{W}_{i=1}p_{i}\,e_{i}=U$, $e_{1}\leq\ldots\leq e_{W}$ being the energies of the $W$ possible states and $U\in[e_{1},e_{W}]$ their mean value. We revisit a generalized version of this optimization problem grounded in the nonadditive entropy $S_{q}(p)=k\,(\sum^{W}_{i=1}p_{i}^{q}-1)/(1-q)$ (frequently, though not necessarily, $q\in(0,1)$; $S_1=S_{BG}$), and the constraint $\sum^{W}_{i=1} p_{i}^{q^{\prime}}e_{i} / \sum^{W}_{i=1}p_{i}^{q^{\prime}}=U$, $q^{\prime}>0$. Sufficient conditions for existence, strict positivity, and uniqueness of solutions are derived, along with a theorem that enables their closed-form calculation. We apply these results to deepen the understanding of the two standard cases in the literature ($q^{\prime}=1$ and $q^{\prime}=q$), as well as of a new one ($q^{\prime}=2-q$). We prove that these standard cases are the only ones yielding optimizing probability distributions of $q$-exponential form. Furthermore, we define an effective temperature $T_{q,q^{\prime}}$ through a Clausius-like relation $1/T_{q,q^{\prime}}=\partial S_{q} / \partial U$ and derive a Helmholtz-like energy $F_{q,q^{\prime}}=U-T_{q,q^{\prime}}S_{q}$, with the former grounding the validity of the $0^{th}$ Principle of Thermodynamics within this generalized statistical mechanics. Finally, we show that the case with a linear constraint (i.e., $q^{\prime}=1$) with $q\in(0,1)$ (i) preserves the Third Law of Thermodynamics; (ii) can be used to model classical many-body Hamiltonian systems with arbitrarily-ranged interactions; and (iii) resembles features of low-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems at the edge of chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：maximizing entropy、optimization problem、theorem、derivation。；研究对象：非加性熵 \(S_q\) 在约束条件下的优化问题，具体涉及广义统计力学中概率分布的存在性、唯一性及闭式求解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了文献中两种标准约束（\(q'=1\) 和 \(q'=q\)）是唯一能产生 \(q\)-指数形式优化概率分布的情况；定义了有效温度 \(T_{q,q'}\) 和类亥姆霍兹自由能 \(F_{q,q'}\)，并验证了线性约束（\(q'=1\)）情形下热力学第三定律的保持及其在经典多体系统和低维非线性动力系统中的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了文献中两种标准约束（\(q'=1\) 和 \(q'=q\)）是唯一能产生 \(q\)-指数形式优化概率分布的情况；定义了有效温度 \(T_{q,q'}\) 和类亥姆霍兹自由能 \(F_{q,q'}\)，并验证了线性约束（\(q'=1\)）情形下热力学第三定律的保持及其在经典多体系统和低维非线性动力系统中的应用。；创新点：系统分析了不同约束形式（\(q'\) 取值）对非加性熵优化结果的影响，首次提出并研究了 \(q'=2-q\) 情形，并严格证明了只有 \(q'=1\) 和 \(q'=q\) 两种约束能导出 \(q\)-指数分布。此外，通过克劳修斯关系定义了有效温度，为广义统计力学中热力学第零定律的成立提供了基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分法优化非加性熵泛函 \(S_q\)，结合约束条件 \(\sum p_i^{q'} e_i / \sum p_i^{q'} = U\)，推导解的存在性、正定性及唯一性的充分条件，并给出闭式求解定理。通过比较 \(q'=1\)、\(q'=q\) 和 \(q'=2-q\) 三种情形，分析概率分布形式及热力学量（如有效温度、自由能）的构造。

papers.title: An ab initio approach to energy alignment and charge-state prediction of adsorbates on ultrathin insulators
papers.abstract: The rapid progress of electron spin resonance scanning tunneling microscopy experiments has enabled the manipulation of individual adsorbate spin states physisorbed on ultrathin oxide layers supported on metal substrates. Electron resonance requires unpaired spin density on the adsorbate, which can be achieved, for instance, through charge transfer from the supporting substrate. This requires the correct energy-level alignment between the energy levels of the adsorbate and the Fermi energy of the substrate. Experiments on molecules and single atoms adsorbed on metal-insulator systems have revealed complex phenomena, including electronic bandgap narrowing, charge transfer, Fermi-level pinning, and the re-ordering of adsorbate orbitals after charge transfer. Despite these advances, a predictive first-principles approach based on accurate methods such as quasiparticle GW, capable of capturing these effects without the prohibitive cost of full adsorbate/oxide/metal simulations, remains an open challenge. In this work, we present a theoretical approach to determine the energy-level alignment of adsorbates on oxide/metal substrates. Our method transparently exposes all physical processes and strikes a balance between computational cost and accuracy. Ionization potentials and electron affinities of the isolated adsorbates are obtained using GW calculations, electronic bandgap polarization is quantified through the quasiparticle renormalization caused by the substrate, Fermi-level pinning is evaluated within the integer charge transfer model, and work function shifts arising from Pauli pushback or from the adsorbate-metal dipole are determined from the local variations of the electrostatic potential. This computationally efficient framework paves the way for highthroughput screening of molecular qubits and organic electronic interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“first-principles approach”、“GW calculations”、“theoretical approach”、“computationally efficient framework”。；研究对象：吸附在金属基底上超薄氧化物绝缘层上的单个分子或原子（吸附物）的能级对齐与电荷态预测。具体涉及电子自旋共振扫描隧道显微镜（ESR-STM）实验中的自旋态调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于第一性原理的理论方法，能够在不进行完整吸附物/氧化物/金属全体系模拟的高成本下，准确预测吸附物在氧化物/金属基底上的能级对齐、电荷转移、费米能级钉扎及功函数变化等复杂现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于第一性原理的理论方法，能够在不进行完整吸附物/氧化物/金属全体系模拟的高成本下，准确预测吸附物在氧化物/金属基底上的能级对齐、电荷转移、费米能级钉扎及功函数变化等复杂现象。；创新点：该方法在计算成本与精度之间取得了平衡，透明地揭示了所有物理过程，为高通量筛选分子量子比特和有机电子界面铺平了道路。摘要未突出说明与已有GW方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用准粒子GW计算获取孤立吸附物的电离能和电子亲和能；通过基底引起的准粒子重整化量化电子带隙极化；利用整数电荷转移模型评估费米能级钉扎；通过静电势的局域变化确定由Pauli排斥或吸附物-金属偶极引起的功函数偏移。

papers.title: Concentration-Dependent Membrane Destabilization in DPPC Bilayers: Distinct Insertion Mechanisms and Stress Redistribution by Chloroform and Alkanols
papers.abstract: How do solute concentration and molecular chemistry govern the transition from membrane saturation to destabilization? We address this using microsecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations of dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (DPPC) bilayers with chloroform (CHCl$_3$) and a homologous series of alkanols (methanol, ethanol, octanol) over $0-50\%$ concentrations. Although complete membrane melting is not observed within $1000\, ns$, all systems exhibit clear precursors of destabilization, including enhanced thickness fluctuations, reduced lipid order, and mechanical softening. Chloroform induces pronounced thinning and large fluctuations, consistent with deep, transient insertion. Methanol perturbs primarily the headgroup region, while ethanol shows intermediate behavior with partial insertion. Octanol preserves bilayer thickness at high concentrations due to lipid-like insertion but significantly increases fluctuations and interdigitation. Across all systems, increasing concentration decreases the area compressibility modulus and deuterium order parameter, accompanied by smoothing of lateral pressure profiles, indicating stress redistribution. Free energy analysis reveals increased membrane partitioning and reduced translocation barriers with concentration, strongest for octanol and weakest for methanol. These results demonstrate that membrane destabilization is governed by the interplay of insertion depth, interfacial crowding, and lipid packing disruption.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：DPPC（二棕榈酰磷脂酰胆碱）双层膜在氯仿（CHCl₃）及一系列醇类（甲醇、乙醇、辛醇）溶质作用下的浓度依赖性膜失稳行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 膜失稳由溶质插入深度、界面拥挤和脂质堆积破坏三者共同决定：氯仿通过深层瞬时插入导致显著变薄和波动；醇类因链长不同表现出从头部区域扰动（甲醇）到类脂插入（辛醇）的差异化机制；所有溶质均随浓度增加引起膜力学软化、应力重新分布及跨膜能垒降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：膜失稳由溶质插入深度、界面拥挤和脂质堆积破坏三者共同决定：氯仿通过深层瞬时插入导致显著变薄和波动；醇类因链长不同表现出从头部区域扰动（甲醇）到类脂插入（辛醇）的差异化机制；所有溶质均随浓度增加引起膜力学软化、应力重新分布及跨膜能垒降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 微秒级分子动力学模拟（microsecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations），覆盖0-50%溶质浓度范围；结合面积压缩模量、氘序参数、横向压力分布及自由能分析（膜分配与跨膜能垒计算）。

papers.title: Multi-Fidelity Computational Screening of High-Entropy MBenes for CO$_2$ Electroreduction
papers.abstract: High-entropy MBenes (HE-MBenes) represent a promising, unexplored class of 2D materials for electrocatalysis. In this work, we present a systematic computational screening of 56 equiatomic quinary HE-MBene compositions from the {Ti, V, Cr, Mo, Nb, Ta, Zr, Hf} pool for CO$_2$ adsorption and electroreduction. Using the Monte Carlo Special Quasirandom Structure (MCSQS) algorithm, we generated disordered M$_1B_1$-type supercells and assessed structural stability via DFT (PBE+D3) in VASP. Of the 56 candidates, 55 passed relaxation, with 45 exhibiting negative formation energies, confirming thermodynamic stability. To efficiently screen CO$_2$ adsorption across disordered surfaces, we developed a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) using the MACE architecture. Fine-tuned on our DFT dataset, the model achieved energy RMSEs of 3.49 and 3.0 meV/atom for adsorbed and pristine sets, respectively. Active sites were identified via PDOS analysis, matching metal d-orbital signatures with CO$_2$ molecular orbitals. The rate-determining step of the CO$_2$-to-CO pathway was evaluated using the computational hydrogen electrode (CHE) model. Short-time structural integrity was assessed via AIMD at 500 K over 2.5 ps; phonon-based stability remains a priority for future work. Our results establish an integrated DFT-MLIP-AIMD framework for the rational design of high-entropy 2D materials tailored for CO$_2$ conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational screening、DFT、machine-learning interatomic potential、AIMD。；研究对象：高熵MBenes（HE-MBenes），具体为56种等原子五元HE-MBene组分（元素池为{Ti, V, Cr, Mo, Nb, Ta, Zr, Hf}），用于CO₂电还原。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在56种候选组分中，55种通过结构弛豫，45种具有负形成能（热力学稳定）；通过集成DFT-MLIP-AIMD框架，筛选出可用于CO₂吸附与电还原的活性位点，并评估了CO₂-to-CO路径的速率决定步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在56种候选组分中，55种通过结构弛豫，45种具有负形成能（热力学稳定）；通过集成DFT-MLIP-AIMD框架，筛选出可用于CO₂吸附与电还原的活性位点，并评估了CO₂-to-CO路径的速率决定步骤。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 使用蒙特卡罗特殊准随机结构（MCSQS）算法生成无序M₁B₁型超胞；2. 采用VASP中的DFT（PBE+D3）评估结构稳定性；3. 基于MACE架构开发机器学习原子间势（MLIP），在DFT数据集上微调（能量RMSE分别为3.49和3.0 meV/atom）；4. 通过投影态密度（PDOS）分析识别活性位点；5. 使用计算氢电极（CHE）模型评估CO₂-to-CO路径的速率决定步骤；6. 在500 K下进行2.5 ps的AIMD模拟评估短时结构完整性。

papers.title: Emergent Quantum-Geometric Equivalence of Injection and Shift Currents
papers.abstract: Injection and shift currents are generally regarded as distinct nonlinear optical responses with separate microscopic origins. Here, we uncover a general hidden connection between them through interband Berry-curvature and quantum-metric dipoles. In systems with approximately linear electronic dispersion near the Fermi level and at low photon energies, this relation sharpens into an emergent equivalence, with injection and shift currents governed by the same interband quantum-geometric dipole. This regime is naturally realized in Dirac and Weyl semimetals, as well as in strained graphene, where measurements of injection and shift currents probe a unified geometric property of the electronic wavefunctions rather than distinct dynamical processes. Our results establish a new framework for interpreting nonlinear optical experiments and suggest that quantum geometry may provide a broader organizing principle linking seemingly distinct nonlinear optical responses in solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：uncover、relation、framework、organizing principle。；研究对象：非线性光学响应中的注入电流（injection current）和位移电流（shift current），以及它们与量子几何（Berry曲率、量子度量）的关系。具体材料体系包括狄拉克半金属、外尔半金属和应变石墨烯。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了注入电流和位移电流之间通过带间Berry曲率和量子度量偶极子存在的隐藏联系；在费米面附近具有近似线性电子色散且光子能量较低时，两者由相同的带间量子几何偶极子支配，从而出现一种涌现的等价性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了注入电流和位移电流之间通过带间Berry曲率和量子度量偶极子存在的隐藏联系；在费米面附近具有近似线性电子色散且光子能量较低时，两者由相同的带间量子几何偶极子支配，从而出现一种涌现的等价性。；创新点：发现注入电流和位移电流并非具有完全独立的微观起源，而是通过量子几何偶极子存在深层等价关系，提出量子几何可能作为统一不同非线性光学响应的组织原则。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析，基于量子几何（Berry曲率、量子度量）的框架，对具有线性色散的系统（如狄拉克/外尔半金属、应变石墨烯）进行低能近似分析。

papers.title: The superite phase and phase transition inducing multiscale solidification microstructures and segregations in steels
papers.abstract: Based on classical concept, solidification of alloys is a direct transition from liquid phase to solid phase, by which dendrites and dendritic segregation are produced. Through in-situ and real time morphology observation and XRD test during solidification of three steels, a new superite phase featured as statistically oriented tiny structures was identified, and a general liquid-superite-solid phase transformation process is revealed. In the early solidification stage, the liquid alloys transit to dendrites composed of superite phase. Initiated from the boundaries of dendritic arms or dendrite grains, the superite phase transits to austenite grains within an initial dendritic arm, and expels solute elements to the residual superite phase. Mixed multi-phase microstructures are subsequently produced from the residual enriched superite phase. Here, although three steels exhibit different phase proportion and phase constitution in the superite-solid transition, they all follow above general transition mode. Multiscale microstructures and segregations are produced in the transition from superite to solid. These new findings change the basic understanding about the solidification of alloys, rediscover the formation mechanism on segregations and multiscale solidification microstructures, including dendrite pattern, solid dendritic arm, dendritic segregation, the mixed multi-phase microstructures, eutectic, inclusions and precipitate. These new findings are also crucial to the control of solidification microstructures and segregation in metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in-situ and real time morphology observation、XRD test、solidification of three steels。；研究对象：钢的凝固过程，具体研究凝固过程中出现的“超相”（superite phase）及其引发的多尺度凝固微观结构和偏析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的“超相”（superite phase），并揭示了从液相到超相再到固相的一般相变过程，该过程是钢中多尺度微观结构和偏析形成的根本机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的“超相”（superite phase），并揭示了从液相到超相再到固相的一般相变过程，该过程是钢中多尺度微观结构和偏析形成的根本机制。；创新点：提出了一个全新的“液相-超相-固相”相变过程，挑战了经典的“液相直接转变为固相”的凝固概念，并重新解释了枝晶、枝晶偏析、共晶、夹杂物等多尺度微观结构的形成机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用原位实时形貌观察和X射线衍射（XRD）测试，对三种钢的凝固过程进行直接观测。

papers.title: Quasiparticle Quality Factors in Superconducting Resonators: Effects of Bath Temperature and Readout Power
papers.abstract: The performance of superconducting resonators underpins a wide range of modern quantum technologies, yet their quality factor often deviates at low temperatures from standard Mattis-Bardeen predictions. This discrepancy is often attributed to nonthermal quasiparticles generated by microwave readout power, which limits the sensitivity of superconducting devices. We present a macroscopic model based on modified Rothwarf-Taylor equations that incorporates a power-dependent phonon generation term, providing an explicit relationship between quality factor, bath temperature and readout power. The model shows excellent agreement with temperature sweep measurements of NbN microstrip resonators with \b{eta}-Ta terminations over a wide dynamic range of readout power levels, accurately capturing the transition between thermally-dominated and microwave-induced loss regimes. This framework provides a predictive tool for optimizing superconducting resonators and advancing the design of high-Q devices for quantum sensing and quantum information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。关键词：macroscopic model, modified Rothwarf-Taylor equations, agreement with measurements。；研究对象：超导谐振器中的准粒子品质因子，具体研究体系为NbN微带谐振器（带β-Ta终端），物理现象为品质因子随浴温度和读出功率的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入功率依赖的声子产生项，修正的Rothwarf-Taylor方程能精确描述从热主导损耗到微波诱导损耗的转变，从而解释低温下品质因子偏离标准Mattis-Bardeen理论的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入功率依赖的声子产生项，修正的Rothwarf-Taylor方程能精确描述从热主导损耗到微波诱导损耗的转变，从而解释低温下品质因子偏离标准Mattis-Bardeen理论的现象。；创新点：建立了品质因子、浴温度和读出功率之间的显式解析关系，首次将功率依赖的声子产生项纳入Rothwarf-Taylor框架，实现了对热与微波损耗交叉区域的定量描述。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于修正的Rothwarf-Taylor方程的宏观模型，包含功率依赖的声子产生项。实验验证：对NbN微带谐振器（β-Ta终端）进行温度扫描测量，覆盖宽动态范围的读出功率水平。

papers.title: Fokker--Planck framework for stochastic octupole moment dynamics in chiral antiferromagnet Mn3Sn
papers.abstract: We develop a reduced stochastic framework for thermally assisted octupole moment dynamics in Mn3Sn by combining the reduced Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) equation with the Fokker--Planck formalism. The reduced model is benchmarked against the complete three-sublattice octupole dynamics and is shown to capture the essential switching behavior with good accuracy. We then derive the corresponding Fokker--Planck equation, which is implemented and solved via a CUDA-accelerated solver. The analysis shows that the octupole dynamics are highly sensitive to the out-of-plane grid resolution because ultrafast rotation of the octupole is controlled by its very small deviations from the basal plane. The solver is validated against Monte Carlo simulations through equilibrium distributions, relaxation trajectories, and switching times. Finally, we apply the method to thermally assisted field-driven switching and demonstrate efficient access to ultra-low error probabilities beyond the practical reach of direct Monte Carlo simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Fokker-Planck formalism、reduced Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation、Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：手性反铁磁体Mn₃Sn中的随机八极矩动力学，具体为热辅助下的八极矩翻转行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过约化模型与Fokker-Planck框架，发现八极矩动力学对面外网格分辨率高度敏感，因为八极矩的超快旋转由其相对于基面的极小偏差控制；该方法能够高效计算超低错误概率，远超直接蒙特卡洛模拟的实际能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过约化模型与Fokker-Planck框架，发现八极矩动力学对面外网格分辨率高度敏感，因为八极矩的超快旋转由其相对于基面的极小偏差控制；该方法能够高效计算超低错误概率，远超直接蒙特卡洛模拟的实际能力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合约化Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG)方程与Fokker-Planck形式论，建立随机动力学框架；通过CUDA加速求解器实现Fokker-Planck方程的数值求解；与完整三子格八极矩动力学进行基准对比，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟（平衡分布、弛豫轨迹、翻转时间）进行验证。

papers.title: Antiferro-Chiral Phonons in $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$-Symmetric Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Chiral phonons provide a route to couple lattice motion to magnetic order, but conventional chiral phonons carry a net angular momentum and thus couple naturally to net magnetization rather than to compensated Néel order. Here we show that $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$-symmetric antiferromagnets can host \emph{antiferro-chiral phonons} (AFCPs): phonon modes with vanishing total angular momentum but finite sublattice-staggered angular momentum. Symmetry enforces this distinction because $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$ forbids a net phonon angular momentum while allowing counter-rotating local motion on inversion-related sublattices. AFCPs arise from a Néel-vector-locked coupling between Raman and infrared-active phonons. The coupling is odd under both $\mathcal{P}$ and $\mathcal{T}$ while preserving their product. Through this hybridization, the normal modes acquire both Raman and infrared character and carry a sublattice-staggered phonon angular momentum that acts as a conjugate field to the Néel vector. This coupling is microscopically generated by the molecular Berry curvature, which is demonstrated in a prototype lattice model. Reversing the Néel vector reverses the staggered phonon chirality. These results indicate AFCPs as probes of antiferromagnetic order and suggest coherent phonon excitation as a route to its dynamical control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“show that”“symmetry enforces”“demonstrated in a prototype lattice model”等表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算细节。；研究对象：$\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$对称反铁磁体中的手性声子模式，具体为一种新型的“反铁手性声子”（antiferro-chiral phonons, AFCPs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在$\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$对称反铁磁体中，存在总角动量为零但子晶格交错角动量非零的声子模式（反铁手性声子），其手性与奈尔矢量耦合，可通过分子贝里曲率产生，并有望用于探测和动态控制反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在$\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$对称反铁磁体中，存在总角动量为零但子晶格交错角动量非零的声子模式（反铁手性声子），其手性与奈尔矢量耦合，可通过分子贝里曲率产生，并有望用于探测和动态控制反铁磁序。；创新点：首次提出并定义了“反铁手性声子”这一概念，揭示了在$\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$对称反铁磁体中，声子可以携带子晶格交错的角动量而非净角动量，从而直接与补偿型奈尔序耦合，而非传统手性声子与净磁化耦合。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于$\mathcal{P}$、$\mathcal{T}$及$\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$对称性约束）、原型晶格模型（prototype lattice model）中的微观机制推导（分子贝里曲率），以及拉曼-红外声子杂化耦合的理论描述。

papers.title: Multiscale modeling of materials and neural operators
papers.abstract: Multiscale modeling is essential for understanding the complex behavior of materials. However, accurately transferring all relevant information from one scale to another has remained an outstanding challenge. Neural operators, discretization-independent generalizations of neural networks, is proving to be a powerful tool in addressing this challenge. This article provides an introduction to neural operators, and illustrates their use in multiscale modeling of materials through three selected examples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural operators（神经算子）、multiscale modeling（多尺度建模）、discretization-independent generalizations（离散化无关的推广）。；研究对象：材料的多尺度建模方法，具体材料体系或物理现象摘要未明确说明，仅提及通过三个示例展示神经算子在材料多尺度建模中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经算子作为离散化无关的神经网络推广，能够有效解决多尺度建模中跨尺度信息准确传递这一长期挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经算子作为离散化无关的神经网络推广，能够有效解决多尺度建模中跨尺度信息准确传递这一长期挑战。；创新点：将神经算子引入材料多尺度建模领域，通过三个示例展示其解决跨尺度信息传递难题的潜力。摘要未突出说明与传统多尺度方法的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经算子（neural operators）这一机器学习框架，其核心特点是离散化无关性（discretization-independent），可处理不同尺度间的信息映射。具体实现细节摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Mirror transitions in diffusion with stochastic resetting confined on a ring
papers.abstract: Diffusion with an incorporated resetting mechanism provides a reference framework for modeling a wide range of natural phenomena. Within this framework, the optimal resetting rate is a key quantity that arises from the optimization of the mean first-passage time. While substantial work has focused on the study of the optimal resetting rate in unbounded one dimensional domains, little is still known about the optimization of the mean first-passage time in bounded systems, in particular when multiple resetting sites are available. In this work, we consider a particle diffusing along a circular circumference and under resetting, with an absorbing target site at a fixed location. Using the appropriate free propagator for this system, we compute the Laplace transform of the survival probability when resetting occurs to multiple sites drawn from an arbitrary probability density function. We also calculate the mean first-passage time at the target site, and study the dependence of the optimal resetting rate in terms of the relevant parameters of the system in a two-resetting site configuration. Depending on the arc length between one of the resetting sites and the absorbing target site, and the weight of the remaining resetting site, the optimal resetting rate can exhibit abrupt ("first order'') and continuous ("second order'') transitions. Moreover, the behavior of the mean first-passage time is rich enough to allow both critical and tri-critical points to exist in the parameter space. All the transitions have "mirror symmetry'' around the selected target site and its corresponding diametrically opposite site.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“计算”“研究”“分析”等理论推导和数学建模词汇，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：在环形（一维圆周）上受限扩散并带有随机重置（stochastic resetting）的粒子系统，具体研究粒子在存在吸收靶点（absorbing target site）时的首次通过时间（mean first-passage time）优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双重置点配置下，最优重置率可随系统参数（如重置点与靶点间的弧长、另一重置点的权重）发生突变（“一级”相变）和连续（“二级”相变）转变；参数空间中存在临界点和三临界点，且所有转变关于靶点及其对径点具有“镜像对称性”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双重置点配置下，最优重置率可随系统参数（如重置点与靶点间的弧长、另一重置点的权重）发生突变（“一级”相变）和连续（“二级”相变）转变；参数空间中存在临界点和三临界点，且所有转变关于靶点及其对径点具有“镜像对称性”。；创新点：首次在有限边界（环形）且存在多个重置点的系统中，系统研究平均首次通过时间的优化问题，发现了重置率相变及其镜像对称性，并揭示了临界点与三临界点的存在。
papers.method_zh: 利用环形系统上的自由传播子（free propagator）计算生存概率的拉普拉斯变换，进而推导平均首次通过时间，并分析最优重置率对系统参数的依赖关系。重置点位置服从任意概率密度函数。

papers.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Domain Wall on a Racetrack: Impact of Line-Edge Roughness
papers.abstract: We investigate the impact of line-edge roughness on current-driven domain wall dynamics in ferromagnetic racetracks. Modeling the edge disorder as a spatially correlated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we demonstrate that even minimal experimentally relevant roughness induces pronounced stochastic pinning of domain walls. Notably, this stochasticity of the current-driven motion arises purely from spatial disorder, even in the absence of thermal fluctuations. The probability of a domain wall to reach a given position exhibits a robust sigmoidal dependence on the applied current, reflecting an effective distribution of depinning thresholds. At the same time, the underlying dynamics is highly nontrivial: the mean velocity exhibits a nonlinear dependence on both time and current, while the mean-square displacement exhibits a ballistic regime at short times followed by saturation due to trapping at pinning sites. These results demonstrate that line-edge roughness provides a controllable source of stochasticity and enables p-bit-like functionality in racetrack systems, offering a pathway toward hardware implementations of probabilistic and neuromorphic computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：建模（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程）、数值分析（概率、平均速度、均方位移）。；研究对象：铁磁赛道中电流驱动的畴壁动力学，重点研究赛道边缘粗糙度（line-edge roughness）对畴壁运动的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使是最小实验相关程度的边缘粗糙度，也会导致畴壁出现显著的随机钉扎，且这种随机性完全源于空间无序，无需热涨落。畴壁到达给定位置的概率随电流呈稳健的S形依赖关系，反映了去钉扎阈值的有效分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使是最小实验相关程度的边缘粗糙度，也会导致畴壁出现显著的随机钉扎，且这种随机性完全源于空间无序，无需热涨落。畴壁到达给定位置的概率随电流呈稳健的S形依赖关系，反映了去钉扎阈值的有效分布。；创新点：揭示了边缘粗糙度可作为可控随机性来源，在无热涨落条件下实现类似p-bit的功能，为概率计算和神经形态计算的硬件实现提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 将边缘无序建模为空间相关的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，通过分析畴壁运动的概率分布、平均速度的时间/电流依赖关系以及均方位移的时域行为（弹道区与饱和区）来研究其随机动力学。

papers.title: Photovoltaic Possibility of Cu2SiSe3 and Cu2SnS3 Ternary Chalcogenides- Single Junction to Tandem Architecture
papers.abstract: Cu based ternary chalcogenides are gathering attention for sustainable energy applications due to their reduced complexity compared to quaternary alternatives. We used drift diffusion modeling to evaluate the feasibility of photovoltaics employing ternary chalcogenide absorbers based on Cu2SiSe3 and Cu2SnS3. The device metrics are evaluated by analyzing absorber layer thickness intrinsic carrier concentration defect density and energy band alignment at interfacial junctions. The optimized single junction Cu2SiSe3 based device configuration achieves a power conversion efficiency of 18.13 percent exhibiting a short circuit current density of 38 mA cm^-2 and an open circuit voltage of 0.64 V. The Cu2SnS3 based device achieves an efficiency of 15.59 percent with a short circuit current density of 48.8 mA cm^-2 and an open circuit voltage of 0.42 V. We examined the impact of the buffer layer on device parameters uncovering further avenues for performance improvement. Additionally we simulated a two terminal tandem solar cell using Cu2SiSe3 Eg 1.44 eV in the upper cell to capture photons from the visible spectrum and Cu2SnS3 Eg 0.91 eV in the lower cell to absorb from the infrared spectrum. The simulated tandem architecture, featuring a VOC of 1.24 V a JSC of 24.6 mA cm^-2 a fill factor (FF) of 79.2 percent and an efficiency of 24.1 percent markedly surpassed conventional single junction devices demonstrating the viability of Cu2SiSe3-Cu2SnS3 absorber-based tandem solar cells for next generation high-efficiency solar technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：drift diffusion modeling、simulated、device metrics evaluated by analyzing）；研究对象：基于三元硫族化合物Cu₂SiSe₃和Cu₂SnS₃的单结及叠层太阳能电池。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过漂移扩散模拟优化，Cu₂SiSe₃单结器件效率达18.13%，Cu₂SnS₃单结器件效率达15.59%；而由两者组成的双端叠层太阳能电池效率显著提升至24.1%，验证了该类材料在下一代高效光伏技术中的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过漂移扩散模拟优化，Cu₂SiSe₃单结器件效率达18.13%，Cu₂SnS₃单结器件效率达15.59%；而由两者组成的双端叠层太阳能电池效率显著提升至24.1%，验证了该类材料在下一代高效光伏技术中的可行性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用漂移扩散模型（drift diffusion modeling）进行器件模拟，系统分析了吸收层厚度、本征载流子浓度、缺陷密度以及界面结处的能带对齐对器件性能的影响。

papers.title: SLayerGen: a Crystal Generative Model for all Space and Layer Groups
papers.abstract: Crystal generative models have shown rapid progress for accelerating the discovery of bulk, periodic materials. However, many material systems such as 2D superconductors, thin film semiconductors, and catalytic surfaces are diperiodic, i.e., aperiodic along one of the lattice directions. These systems are invariant under the layer groups, which are known to influence materials properties yet not considered by existing models. In this paper, we propose SLayerGen, a generative model that produces crystals constrained to be invariant to any space or layer group. SLayerGen consists of coarse-to-fine discrete autoregressive lattice generation; transformer-based autoregressive sampling of Wyckoff positions, elements, and numbers of symmetrically unique atoms; and space or layer group equivariant diffusion of atomic coordinates. For the diffusion component, we corrected an inconsistency in the loss from prior work arising from hexagonal groups being non-orthogonal in fractional coordinates. To facilitate progress in generative modeling of diperiodic materials, we assembled and filtered datasets of monolayers and bilayers, propose relevant evaluation metrics, and developed novel representations for layer group symmetries. For de novo generation of diperiodic materials, SLayerGen achieves consistent performance gains over bulk crystal generative models and is competitive when training jointly on bulk and diperiodic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：generative model, autoregressive sampling, diffusion, 机器学习方法）；研究对象：二维（diperiodic）材料体系，包括单层、双层材料，以及体相（bulk）周期性材料。具体涉及受空间群或层群对称性约束的晶体生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出SLayerGen生成模型，能够生成受任意空间群或层群对称性约束的晶体，在二维材料生成任务上优于现有体相晶体生成模型，并在体相与二维材料联合训练时具有竞争力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出SLayerGen生成模型，能够生成受任意空间群或层群对称性约束的晶体，在二维材料生成任务上优于现有体相晶体生成模型，并在体相与二维材料联合训练时具有竞争力。；创新点：首次将层群（layer group）对称性引入晶体生成模型，解决了现有模型无法处理二维周期性（diperiodic）材料对称性的问题；修正了六方晶系在扩散损失中的非正交坐标不一致性；构建了适用于二维材料生成评估的数据集和指标。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗到细的离散自回归晶格生成、基于Transformer的自回归采样（Wyckoff位置、元素种类、对称不等价原子数目）、以及空间群/层群等变扩散模型对原子坐标进行生成。特别修正了先前工作中因六方晶系分数坐标非正交性导致的损失函数不一致问题。同时构建并筛选了单层和双层数据集，提出了新的层群对称性表示和评估指标。

papers.title: Two-dimensional Clay Channels for Tunable Nanofluidic Memristor
papers.abstract: Dynamic reconfiguration of charge carriers in confined ion-channels under electrical stimulation produces memory effects, where the internal resistance depends on history of the electric field. Vermiculite nanofluidic devices harness this effect to store and process information within a single component. We report switching between distinct memory loops by tuning ion transport pathways, governed by asymmetrical device architecture and intrinsic surface-charge. Polarity-dependent memory switching between crossing-1 and crossing-2 loops is achieved solely by altering electrode configurations, without modifying electrolyte, channel surface chemistry or device structure: providing mechanistic insights into ionic memristors through a straightforward, experimentally validated strategy. The memristive characteristics are demonstrated in both in-plane and out-of-plane channel configurations with channel lengths spanning from centimeters to micrometers length scales using re-stacked vermiculite membranes and further investigated for miniaturization with devices having nanometer scale channel lengths, fabricated via ultramicrotomy method. Furthermore, we demonstrate neuromorphic functionalities, including synaptic potentiation-depression and programmable memory retention, highlighting potential for bio-inspired computing systems. Cost-effective and scalable fabrication solution processed vermiculite membrane memristors pave the way for practical integration of nanofluidic memristors for neuromorphic computing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：We report、demonstrate、fabricated、experimentally validated。；研究对象：基于蛭石（vermiculite）的二维纳米流体通道器件，具体研究其作为可调谐纳米流体忆阻器（nanofluidic memristor）的离子输运和记忆效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变电极配置（而非改变电解质、通道表面化学或器件结构），实现了对交叉-1和交叉-2两种不同记忆回路的极性依赖切换。该器件在从厘米到纳米尺度的通道长度下均表现出忆阻特性，并展示了突触可塑性和可编程记忆保留等神经形态功能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变电极配置（而非改变电解质、通道表面化学或器件结构），实现了对交叉-1和交叉-2两种不同记忆回路的极性依赖切换。该器件在从厘米到纳米尺度的通道长度下均表现出忆阻特性，并展示了突触可塑性和可编程记忆保留等神经形态功能。；创新点：提出了一种简单、实验上可验证的策略，仅通过改变电极配置来调控离子输运路径，从而实现对不同记忆回路的切换，为理解离子忆阻器的机制提供了新见解。同时，展示了从宏观到纳米尺度的可扩展性以及低成本、可溶液加工的制备方法。
papers.method_zh: 使用溶液处理的蛭石膜（re-stacked vermiculite membranes）构建面内和面外通道构型；利用超薄切片法（ultramicrotomy）制备具有纳米尺度通道长度的微型化器件。通过测量不同电极配置下的电流-电压特性来表征忆阻开关行为。

papers.title: Dynamically Characterizing the Structures of Dirac Points via Wave Packets
papers.abstract: Topological non-trivial band structures are the core problem in the field of topological materials. In this paper, we investigate the topological band structure in a system with controllable Dirac points from the perspective of wave packet dynamics. By adding a third-nearest-neighboring coupling to the graphene model, additional pairs of Dirac points emerge. The emergence and annihilation of Dirac points result in hybrid and parabolic points, and we show that these band structures can be revealed by the dynamical behaviors of wave packets. Particularly, for the gapped hybrid point, the motion of the wave packet shows a one-dimensional \emph{Zitterbewegung} motion. Furthermore, we also show that the winding number associated with the Dirac point and parabolic point can be determined via the center-of-mass and spin texture of wave packets, respectively. The results of this work could motivate new experimental methods to characterize the system's topological signatures through wave packet dynamics, which may also find application in systems of other exotic topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“从波包动力学角度研究”、“展示”、“确定”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有可控狄拉克点的拓扑能带结构，具体以引入第三近邻耦合的石墨烯模型为体系，研究狄拉克点、混合点、抛物线点等能带结构及其波包动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过波包动力学行为可以揭示狄拉克点的产生与湮灭导致的混合点和抛物线点等能带结构；有能隙的混合点处波包呈现一维Zitterbewegung运动；波包的质心和自旋纹理可分别用于确定狄拉克点和抛物线点对应的绕数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过波包动力学行为可以揭示狄拉克点的产生与湮灭导致的混合点和抛物线点等能带结构；有能隙的混合点处波包呈现一维Zitterbewegung运动；波包的质心和自旋纹理可分别用于确定狄拉克点和抛物线点对应的绕数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于石墨烯模型引入第三近邻耦合调控狄拉克点，通过波包动力学（包括质心运动、自旋纹理）研究能带拓扑特征。

papers.title: Rashba engineering at van der Waals interfaces
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) interfaces offer a versatile platform for studying emergent quantum phenomena and enabling novel device functionalities. When distinct TMD monolayers are stacked vertically or laterally stitched, their interfaces can exhibit unique electronic band alignments, giving rise to long-lived interlayer excitons, charge transfer effects, and moiré superlattices with correlated states. Here, we demonstrate that the interface between a large variety of two different epitaxially grown TMD monolayers controls the intensity and sign of the Rashba spin splitting, which is probed using THz spintronic emission. Optimized TMD heterobilayers, such as HfSe$_2$/PtSe$_2$, show enhanced THz emission that surpass the spin-to-charge conversion efficiency of bulk TMDs, confirming the presence of Rashba states with large spin splitting at the interface. By combining spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with density functional theory, we reveal that the electronic hybridization between the two different TMD monolayers gives rise to extended in-gap states with strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling. The choice of TMD layers enables to engineer the sign and strength of spin-to-charge conversion in van der Waals heterobilayers opening up perspectives to build efficient and tunable THz spintronic emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“probed using THz spintronic emission”、“spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy”、“density functional theory”。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯异质界面（具体为两种不同过渡金属硫族化物单层垂直堆叠形成的界面）中的Rashba自旋劈裂现象及其对太赫兹自旋发射的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择不同的过渡金属硫族化物单层组合（如HfSe₂/PtSe₂），可以工程化调控界面Rashba自旋劈裂的强度和符号，从而显著增强自旋-电荷转换效率，实现高效可调谐的太赫兹自旋电子发射器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择不同的过渡金属硫族化物单层组合（如HfSe₂/PtSe₂），可以工程化调控界面Rashba自旋劈裂的强度和符号，从而显著增强自旋-电荷转换效率，实现高效可调谐的太赫兹自旋电子发射器。；创新点：首次在实验上证明，通过外延生长不同过渡金属硫族化物单层形成的范德瓦尔斯界面，可以主动调控Rashba自旋劈裂的强度与符号，并实现超越体材料转换效率的自旋-电荷转换。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹自旋电子发射谱（THz spintronic emission）、自旋和角分辨光电子能谱（spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Construction and Analysis of the Effective Model for the Bulk Steady State under Current in Boundary-Driven Open Systems
papers.abstract: Current-induced phenomena are often obscured by Joule heating, and their steady states are difficult to analyze in large open systems. We introduce a translationally invariant asymmetric-hopping model as an effective bulk description of boundary-driven systems under current. In a minimal case, it corresponds to an open-system Hatano--Nelson model. We find that the effective temperature rises linearly with current density, as observed experimentally. The model provides a useful tool for separating intrinsic current-induced effects from heating.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“introduce a translationally invariant asymmetric-hopping model as an effective bulk description”，并进行了“construction and analysis”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：边界驱动开放系统中存在电流时的体稳态（bulk steady state），具体以非对称跳跃模型（asymmetric-hopping model）和开放系统Hatano-Nelson模型为最小实例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有效温度随电流密度线性上升，这与实验观测一致；该模型可用于将本征电流诱导效应与焦耳热效应分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有效温度随电流密度线性上升，这与实验观测一致；该模型可用于将本征电流诱导效应与焦耳热效应分离。；创新点：提出了一个平移不变的有效体模型来分离电流诱导效应与焦耳热效应，从而避免焦耳热对电流诱导现象的掩盖，并揭示了有效温度与电流密度的线性关系。
papers.method_zh: 构建平移不变的非对称跳跃模型作为边界驱动系统的有效体描述，在最小情形下对应开放系统的Hatano-Nelson模型，通过理论分析研究稳态性质。

papers.title: Nonlinear Coherent Transport in 2D Thermal Metamaterials: From Solitons and Topological Defects to Quantum Computing
papers.abstract: Understanding heat transport in low-dimensional and nano-architectured materials remains a central challenge in nonequilibrium statistical physics due to persistent deviations from Fourier's law. These deviations are driven by anharmonicity, reduced dimensionality, and the emergence of long-lived coherent excitations. In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework for two-dimensional thermal metamaterials that combines nonlinear lattice dynamics, soliton-based effective field theories, and geometrically organized defect networks as guiding structures for energy flow. We introduce minimal discrete and continuum-inspired models suitable for controlled benchmarking of thermal transport in patterned two-dimensional architectures and identify a two-channel transport mechanism in which coherent nonlinear excitations coexist with incoherent hydrodynamic modes. The interplay between these channels is shown to be highly sensitive to geometry, nonlinearity, and temperature, offering new avenues for thermal management. We establish rigorous connections between microscopic nonlinearity, geometry-driven channeling of heat in two dimensions, and quantum-enabled exploration of both high-occupation classical regimes and genuinely quantum regimes beyond the reach of standard simulation strategies. The theoretical predictions are corroborated by recent experimental and computational results in Stone-Wales-defected PdSSe monolayers and silicon phononic crystal nanostructures, which exhibit ultra-low thermal conductivity coexisting with high carrier mobility and strong anisotropy -- direct manifestations of the two-channel mechanism. This synthesis provides actionable guidance for the design of engineered heat-spreading architectures and positions quantum simulation as a transformative tool for advancing the theory of nonlinear heat transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a unified theoretical framework, nonlinear lattice dynamics, soliton-based effective field theories, theoretical predictions）；研究对象：二维热超构材料中的非线性相干热输运，具体涉及Stone-Wales缺陷PdSSe单层和硅声子晶体纳米结构中的热传导现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维热超构材料中，存在一种双通道输运机制：相干非线性激发（如孤子）与非相干流体动力学模式共存，两者对几何结构、非线性和温度高度敏感，导致超低热导率与高载流子迁移率及强各向异性共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维热超构材料中，存在一种双通道输运机制：相干非线性激发（如孤子）与非相干流体动力学模式共存，两者对几何结构、非线性和温度高度敏感，导致超低热导率与高载流子迁移率及强各向异性共存。；创新点：建立了微观非线性、几何驱动的二维热通道化与量子模拟之间的严格联系，将量子模拟定位为推进非线性热输运理论的变革性工具。摘要未突出说明与已有理论框架的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 结合非线性晶格动力学、基于孤子的有效场论、几何组织的缺陷网络作为能量流导向结构，建立最小离散和连续模型进行受控基准测试，并利用量子模拟探索经典和量子区域。

papers.title: Heat Transfer in Phase Change Materials with Multiple Fin Insertion
papers.abstract: We leverage 3D numerical simulations to study phase change materials (PCMs) cells under the effect of buoyancy forces. The solid PCM is heated from a source boundary, triggering melting. The source features multiple solid fins that protrude into the PCM cell; the impact of the fins and their number is investigated by designing and testing equivalent (in terms of heating power) finless and single fin simulations. For each configuration, the performance is quantified via the total molten substance in time. The designs were also tested for different values of the non-dimensional numbers encoding relevant properties. We confirm that fins increase the melting performance and find that single fin configurations are sub-optimal since a layout with multiple fins takes advantage of interstitial spaces, melting the substance more efficiently. The results also indicate that fins should be properly spaced, as closeness can result in overlapping, thus interfering, molten areas.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：3D numerical simulations（三维数值模拟）。；研究对象：相变材料（PCMs）在浮力作用下的熔化过程，以及插入多个固体翅片对传热性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多翅片布局比单翅片更优，因为能利用间隙空间更高效地熔化材料；但翅片间距过近会导致熔化区域重叠并相互干扰，从而降低性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多翅片布局比单翅片更优，因为能利用间隙空间更高效地熔化材料；但翅片间距过近会导致熔化区域重叠并相互干扰，从而降低性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维数值模拟，通过设计并测试等效加热功率的无翅片、单翅片及多翅片配置，量化不同时间下的总熔化量，并改变无量纲数（如浮力相关参数）进行对比。

papers.title: Criticality in optical properties of the Drude and Drude-Sommerfeld metals around the plasma frequencies for high carrier concentrations
papers.abstract: We have analytically determined the attenuation constant of the Drude metal for the entire range of frequency ($0<ω<\infty$) of an electromagnetic (plane) wave incident on it within a single framework of classical electrodynamics. Here, by the Drude metal, we mean an electrical conductor that obeys the Drude model for the conduction electrons. We further consider the conductor to have linear dielectric and magnetic properties (i.e. permittivity $ε>ε_0$ and permeability $μ>μ_0$) due to the bound charges and bound currents in the background. Interestingly, for such a conductor with a high carrier concentration ($ω_pτ\gg1$), we have obtained a simple form of the attenuation constant $k_-\simeq+\sqrt{\frac{με}{2}}\sqrt{ω_p^2-ω^2+|ω_p^2-ω^2|}$ for a wide range of high frequencies below and above plasma frequency $ω_p$. Such a result gives rise to criticality in the conductor's optical properties, such as -- the attenuation constant, group velocity, and complex dielectric constant near around $ω=ω_p$. We have obtained the critical exponents for these quantities. We also have obtained a quantum correction to the optical properties within the Drude-Sommerfeld model with the Thomas-Fermi screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically determined、classical electrodynamics、Drude-Sommerfeld model、quantum correction。；研究对象：Drude金属和Drude-Sommerfeld金属在等离子体频率附近的光学性质，特别是高载流子浓度下的衰减常数、群速度和复介电常数的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高载流子浓度（ω_pτ≫1）条件下，Drude金属的衰减常数在等离子体频率ω_p附近呈现简单形式，导致光学性质（衰减常数、群速度、复介电常数）出现临界性，并获得了相应的临界指数。此外，在Thomas-Fermi屏蔽框架下，Drude-Sommerfeld模型给出了光学性质的量子修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高载流子浓度（ω_pτ≫1）条件下，Drude金属的衰减常数在等离子体频率ω_p附近呈现简单形式，导致光学性质（衰减常数、群速度、复介电常数）出现临界性，并获得了相应的临界指数。此外，在Thomas-Fermi屏蔽框架下，Drude-Sommerfeld模型给出了光学性质的量子修正。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典电动力学框架，解析求解Drude模型下电磁平面波入射导体的衰减常数；进一步引入Drude-Sommerfeld模型和Thomas-Fermi屏蔽进行量子修正分析。

papers.title: A passive self-correcting quantum memory in three dimensions
papers.abstract: We construct a 3D Pauli stabilizer Hamiltonian whose ground state space can encode a qubit for exponential time when coupled to a bath at non-zero temperature. Our construction recursively applies a sequence of transformations to a seed Hamiltonian that increases the memory lifetime of the encoded qubit while maintaining geometric locality in $\mathbb{R}^3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、Hamiltonian（哈密顿量）、recursively applies a sequence of transformations（递归应用一系列变换）。；研究对象：三维空间中的被动自纠正量子存储器（passive self-correcting quantum memory），具体为一种三维泡利稳定子哈密顿量（3D Pauli stabilizer Hamiltonian）及其基态空间编码的量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该三维哈密顿量在非零温度下与热库耦合时，其基态空间编码的量子比特可以保持指数级长的记忆寿命。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该三维哈密顿量在非零温度下与热库耦合时，其基态空间编码的量子比特可以保持指数级长的记忆寿命。；创新点：首次在三维空间中构造出具有几何局域性的被动自纠正量子存储器，能够在非零温度下实现指数级长的量子记忆寿命。摘要未突出说明与已有三维量子纠错码或自纠正模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用递归构造方法，对种子哈密顿量（seed Hamiltonian）反复应用一系列变换，在保持几何局域性（geometric locality in ℝ³）的同时逐步提升编码量子比特的记忆寿命。

papers.title: Crystallographic Symmetry Generates Phononic Holonomic Gates with Biased-Erasure Channels
papers.abstract: Solid-state processors require control layers whose errors are legible to quantum-error-correction decoders. We show that crystallographic symmetry can provide such a layer in strain-active Lambda manifolds. When the projected strain tensor and Lambda-transition operators share a multiplicity-one two-dimensional irreducible representation, symmetry fixes the linear strain interaction to a scalar dot product. Two phase-locked mechanical modes synthesize a circular strain field, enabling complex phononic Lambda-leg control without local microwave near fields. On this manifold we construct a superadiabatic echo-lune holonomic gate using Lambda-leg control and a resonant double-quantum counterdiabatic tone. Rotating-frame simulations of a nitrogen-vacancy center give 99.88% conditional average fidelity in 1.833 microseconds, or 99.40% when leakage is counted as error. A resonant gigahertz high-overtone bulk acoustic resonator analysis translates the Hamiltonian into Rabi-rate, linewidth, and envelope-tracking requirements. The bright-state structure organizes noise: A2-sector perturbations are parity-filtered into an optically distinguishable auxiliary state, whereas transverse E-sector faults are echo suppressed and retained as a decoder stress axis. The extracted channel has 0.47% erasure probability and 0.168% residual Z error. In XZZX code-capacity simulations, this biased-erasure model yields a nominal 64% fit-extrapolated data-qubit reduction relative to an unstructured Rabi baseline. Repeated-round detector-model diagnostics preserve the nominal distance-9 proxy and identify missed erasures, transverse floors, leakage/flag timing, and strong crosstalk as validation limits. Extensions to orbital Lambda systems and bright-projector phonon-bus diagnostics identify crystallographic symmetry as a principle for co-designing phononic actuation, leakage, noise bias, and quantum decoding.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：构建理论模型、旋转框架模拟、哈密顿量分析、码容量模拟。；研究对象：固态量子处理器中的应变活性Lambda能级系统，具体以氮空位（NV）中心为例，研究如何利用晶体对称性实现声子全息门控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶体对称性可以迫使应变相互作用成为标量点积，从而在Lambda能级上实现无需局部微波近场的复杂声子控制。通过构建超绝热回波全息门，在NV中心模拟中实现了99.88%的条件平均保真度，并提取了一个具有0.47%擦除概率和0.168%残余Z误差的偏置擦除信道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶体对称性可以迫使应变相互作用成为标量点积，从而在Lambda能级上实现无需局部微波近场的复杂声子控制。通过构建超绝热回波全息门，在NV中心模拟中实现了99.88%的条件平均保真度，并提取了一个具有0.47%擦除概率和0.168%残余Z误差的偏置擦除信道。；创新点：提出晶体对称性可作为协同设计声子驱动、泄漏、噪声偏置和量子解码的统一原理，从而生成具有偏置擦除信道的声子全息门。摘要未突出说明与具体实验实现的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 1. 利用群论分析晶体对称性，将投影应变张量与Lambda跃迁算符约束到单一二维不可约表示。2. 构建超绝热回波全息门，结合Lambda支路控制和共振双量子反绝热驱动。3. 对NV中心进行旋转框架模拟。4. 使用千兆赫兹高次泛音体声谐振器分析，将哈密顿量转化为拉比速率、线宽和包络跟踪要求。5. 在XZZX码容量模拟中评估偏置擦除模型。

papers.title: Parafermionizing the Monster
papers.abstract: We study the parafermionization of the Monster CFT with respect to its $\mathbb{Z}_{pA}$ subgroups, with $p$ an odd prime. Under certain assumptions, we show that the parafermionization is equal to a non-invertible gauging of $\mathcal{P}(p) \times \mathcal{P}(p)^\vee$, where $\mathcal{P}(p)$ is the theory of $\mathbb{Z}_p$-parafermions and $\mathcal{P}(p)^\vee$ is an appropriate dual theory, with global symmetry characterized by the centralizer of $\mathbb{Z}_{pA}$. By tracking the symmetries of $\mathcal{P}(p) \times \mathcal{P}(p)^\vee$ through the non-invertible gauging, we argue that the diagonal Monster CFT has $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathfrak{so}(3)_p) \boxtimes \mathrm{Rep}(\mathfrak{so}(3)_p)^\mathrm{op}$ symmetry, and hence that the holomorphic Monster theory has symmetry $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathfrak{so}(3)_p)$. We then compute the defect McKay-Thompson series associated to these symmetries, and prove that their invariance subgroups are $Γ_1(p+2)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：parafermionization（parafermion化）、non-invertible gauging（非可逆规范）、对称性分析。；研究对象：Monster CFT（魔群共形场论）及其相对于 $\mathbb{Z}_{pA}$ 子群（$p$ 为奇素数）的parafermion化过程，以及由此产生的对称性结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定假设下，Monster CFT的parafermion化等价于对 $\mathcal{P}(p) \times \mathcal{P}(p)^\vee$ 理论进行非可逆规范，并由此论证了全纯Monster理论具有 $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathfrak{so}(3)_p)$ 对称性，且其缺陷McKay-Thompson级数的不变子群为 $\Gamma_1(p+2)$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定假设下，Monster CFT的parafermion化等价于对 $\mathcal{P}(p) \times \mathcal{P}(p)^\vee$ 理论进行非可逆规范，并由此论证了全纯Monster理论具有 $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathfrak{so}(3)_p)$ 对称性，且其缺陷McKay-Thompson级数的不变子群为 $\Gamma_1(p+2)$。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用parafermion化（parafermionization）方法，结合非可逆规范（non-invertible gauging）技术，通过追踪对称性结构（特别是中心化子）以及计算缺陷McKay-Thompson级数（defect McKay-Thompson series）来推导结论。
