papers.title: Emergence of synthetic twist defects in the surface code under local perturbation
papers.abstract: Topologically-ordered quantum states with Abelian excitations can host defects that obey effective non-Abelian statistics, in principle allowing for quantum information processing via defect braiding. These extrinsic defects (or twists) are typically studied as static features of the lattice. However, an alternative proposal considers how an underlying topologically ordered quantum substrate can be locally perturbed to create and manipulate synthetic defects \cite{you_synthetic_2013}. Unfortunately, while largely referenced, elements of this proposal were never systematically studied. Understanding the energy spectrum is particularly important in finite size and finitely perturbed systems, which are crucial for experimental realizations. In this work we announce a significant step in this direction by explicitly constructing, simplifying, and numerically studying the spectral properties of synthetic defects in a model system. First, we introduce two alternative representations of this problem in both spin and Majorana languages. In the former we describe emergent virtual symmetries which constrain and simplify the problem and in the latter we show a direct connection to Kitaev's well-known Majorana chain. We utilize these simplifications to perform numerical calculations to indicate the location of the quantum phase transition driving the emergence of the synthetic defects. We conclude by discussing key steps for future work to more clearly and completely study this phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：理论框架、数值计算、模型系统）；研究对象：表面码（surface code）中在局域微扰下涌现的合成扭结缺陷（synthetic twist defects），以及这些缺陷的非阿贝尔统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过局域微扰可在具有阿贝尔激发的拓扑有序量子态中创建合成缺陷，并驱动量子相变使缺陷涌现；数值计算揭示了该相变的位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过局域微扰可在具有阿贝尔激发的拓扑有序量子态中创建合成缺陷，并驱动量子相变使缺陷涌现；数值计算揭示了该相变的位置。；创新点：首次系统性地构造、简化并数值研究了合成缺陷的谱性质，填补了此前仅被引用但未被系统研究的空白。
papers.method_zh: 自旋表示与马约拉纳表示两种替代理论框架；利用涌现的虚拟对称性简化问题；将问题映射至Kitaev马约拉纳链；进行数值计算研究能谱与量子相变。

papers.title: The Canted Cosine Theta HTS Sextupole Demonstrator for FCC-ee
papers.abstract: A single-aperture, two-layer Canted-Cosine-Theta (CCT) sextupole magnet using high-temperature superconducting (HTS) ReBCO tape has been developed for the short straight sections (SSS) of FCC through the FCCee-HTS4 project. The magnet was designed, manufactured and tested under cryogenic conditions. Two HTS tapes from two manufacturers have been qualified for this specific application. Design and manufacturing details and cryogenic temperature measurements are presented. This demonstrator represents the first HTS CCT magnet ever constructed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：developed, designed, manufactured, tested, cryogenic temperature measurements。；研究对象：用于FCC-ee短直线节（SSS）的高温超导（HTS）Canted-Cosine-Theta（CCT）六极磁铁，具体材料为ReBCO超导带材。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功研制并测试了首个采用HTS ReBCO带材的CCT六极磁铁演示样机，验证了该设计在低温条件下的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功研制并测试了首个采用HTS ReBCO带材的CCT六极磁铁演示样机，验证了该设计在低温条件下的可行性。；创新点：这是世界上首次建造并测试的HTS CCT磁铁，为FCC-ee短直线节提供了新型超导磁铁方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用CCT线圈结构设计，使用两种不同厂商的HTS ReBCO带材进行绕制，在低温条件下进行性能测试，并给出设计与制造细节及低温测量结果。

papers.title: Factual recall in linear associative memories: sharp asymptotics and mechanistic insights
papers.abstract: Large language models demonstrate remarkable ability in factual recall, yet the fundamental limits of storing and retrieving input--output associations with neural networks remain unclear. We study these limits in a minimal setting: a linear associative memory that maps $p$ input embeddings in $\mathbb{R}^d$ to their corresponding~$d$-dimensional targets via a single layer, requiring each mapped input to be well separated from all other targets. Unlike in supervised classification, this strict separation induces~$p$ constraints per association and produces strong correlations between constraints that make a direct characterisation of the storage capacity difficult. Here, we provide a precise characterisation of this capacity in the following way. We first introduce a decoupled model in which each input has its own independent set of competing outputs, and provide numerical and analytical evidence that this decoupled model is equivalent to the original model in terms of storage capacity, spectra of the learnt weights, and storage mechanism. Using tools from statistical physics, we show that the decoupled model can store up to $p_c \log p_c / d^2 = 1 / 2$ associations, and generalise the computation of $p_c$ to linear two-layer architectures. Our analysis also gives mechanistic insight into how the optimal solution improves over a naïve Hebbian learning rule: rather than boosting input-output alignments with broad fluctuations, the optimal solution raises the correct scores just above the extreme-value threshold set by the competing outputs. These findings give a sharp statistical-physics characterisation of factual storage in linear networks and provide a baseline for understanding the memory capacity of more realistic neural architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：sharp asymptotics, mechanistic insights, statistical physics, analytical evidence。；研究对象：线性联想记忆（linear associative memory）中事实性存储（factual recall）的存储容量极限，具体为单层线性神经网络将输入嵌入映射到目标输出的能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在严格分离约束下，线性联想记忆的存储容量满足 \( p_c \log p_c / d^2 = 1/2 \)；最优解通过将正确得分提升至竞争输出的极值阈值之上来工作，而非简单增强输入-输出对齐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在严格分离约束下，线性联想记忆的存储容量满足 \( p_c \log p_c / d^2 = 1/2 \)；最优解通过将正确得分提升至竞争输出的极值阈值之上来工作，而非简单增强输入-输出对齐。；创新点：首次对线性联想记忆中事实性存储的容量给出精确的统计物理刻画，并揭示了最优解相对于朴素Hebbian学习规则的机制性改进（将正确得分提升至极值阈值之上）。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计物理工具（sharp asymptotics）分析解耦模型（decoupled model），并通过数值与解析证据证明该模型与原模型在存储容量、权重谱和存储机制上等价；同时推广至线性两层架构。

papers.title: No measurement induced phase transition in the entanglement dynamics of monitored non-interacting one-dimensional fermions in a disordered or quasiperiodic potential
papers.abstract: We show that the entanglement entropy (EE) of one-dimensional (1d) non-interacting fermions with $U(1)$ symmetry in the presence of a quasi-periodic or disordered potential in which the occupation number is being monitored by homodyne or quantum jump protocols is always in an area-law phase so no measurement induced phase transition (MIPT) occurs. The reason for the previously claimed MIPT in these systems was a finite size effect related to the fact that the maximum lattice size $L \sim 500$ was of the order of the correlation length. By increasing the system size up to $L \leq 18000$, employing Graphics Processing Unit (GPU), and performing a careful finite size scaling analysis, we find that the critical monitoring strength is consistent with zero so no MIPT occurs. For the disordered case, these numerical results are fully supported by an analytical calculation based on mapping the problem onto a nonlinear sigma model (NLSM) with an additional mass-like term that confirms the absence of the MIPT for any monitoring or disorder strength. Another salient feature of the disordered case, in part related to a different symmetry in the NLSM, is that the correlation length in the weak disorder limit is longer than in the clean limit and increases with the disordered strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：numerical results（数值计算）、analytical calculation（解析计算）、GPU（图形处理器）、finite size scaling analysis（有限尺寸标度分析）、nonlinear sigma model（非线性sigma模型）。；研究对象：一维无相互作用费米子系统，在准周期势或无序势中，通过零差测量或量子跳跃协议监测占据数时的纠缠熵动力学，以及是否存在测量诱导相变（MIPT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序或准周期势下，一维无相互作用费米子的纠缠熵始终处于面积律相，不存在测量诱导相变；此前声称的相变是有限尺寸效应（最大晶格尺寸~500与关联长度相当），通过增大系统尺寸至L≤18000并进行仔细的有限尺寸标度分析，发现临界监测强度为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序或准周期势下，一维无相互作用费米子的纠缠熵始终处于面积律相，不存在测量诱导相变；此前声称的相变是有限尺寸效应（最大晶格尺寸~500与关联长度相当），通过增大系统尺寸至L≤18000并进行仔细的有限尺寸标度分析，发现临界监测强度为零。；创新点：通过大幅增加系统尺寸（从~500到18000）和精细的有限尺寸标度分析，纠正了此前关于该体系中存在测量诱导相变的错误结论；对无序情况，解析计算完全支持数值结果，并发现弱无序极限下关联长度比干净极限更长且随无序强度增加而增大（摘要未突出说明此点是否为全新发现，但该行为与NLSM中不同对称性相关）。
papers.method_zh: 采用GPU进行大规模数值模拟（系统尺寸L≤18000），结合有限尺寸标度分析；对无序情况，还通过将问题映射到带额外质量项的非线性sigma模型进行解析计算。

papers.title: Vacuum and thermal fluctuations of a scalar field with point interactions
papers.abstract: We investigate the vacuum and thermal fluctuations of a neutral massless scalar field living in Minkowski spacetime and interacting with a finite number of point-like obstacles, modelled by zero-range potentials. The system is described rigorously in terms of self-adjoint realizations of the Laplacian, under assumptions ensuring the absence of instabilities. Using the relative zeta-function technique, we determine the renormalized connected partition function and derive explicit expressions for the thermodynamic observables, characterizing both their low- and high-temperature behaviours. Furthermore, we derive of a convergent Born series expansion for the Casimir energy, which identifies multiple-scattering processes as the mechanism underlying vacuum forces. The latter decompose into pairwise contributions directed along the lines joining the obstacles, with intensities depending non-locally on the full configuration. We also present some numerical results for identical obstacles, indicating that the Casimir forces are always attractive in this context.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate, model, derive, theoretical framework。；研究对象：在闵可夫斯基时空中，与有限个点状障碍物（由零程势建模）相互作用的无质量中性标量场的真空涨落和热涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用相对zeta函数技术，确定了重整化的连通配分函数，并推导出热力学量的显式表达式。Casimir能量可以分解为沿障碍物连线的两两贡献，且对于相同障碍物，Casimir力始终是吸引力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用相对zeta函数技术，确定了重整化的连通配分函数，并推导出热力学量的显式表达式。Casimir能量可以分解为沿障碍物连线的两两贡献，且对于相同障碍物，Casimir力始终是吸引力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自伴拉普拉斯算符对系统进行严格描述，并利用相对zeta函数技术计算重整化连通配分函数。推导了Casimir能量的收敛Born级数展开，以识别多散射过程作为真空力的微观机制。

papers.title: Local topological order, Haag duality, and reflection positivity
papers.abstract: In our previous article [arXiv:2307.12552], we introduced local topological order (LTO) axioms for abstract quantum spin systems which allow one to access topological order via a boundary algebra construction. Using the LTO axioms, we produced a canonical pure state on the quasi-local algebra, which gives a net of von Neumann algebras associated to a poset of cones in $\mathbb{R}^n$. In this article, motivated by [arXiv:2509.23734], we introduce an axiom for LTOs which ensures Haag duality for cone-like regions using Tomita-Takesaki theory. We prove this axiom is satisfied for all known topologically ordered commuting projector models. We thus get an independent proof of Haag duality for the Levin-Wen string net models originally proved in [arXiv:2509.23734]. We also give a reflection positivity axiom for LTOs, connecting to the recent article [arXiv:2510.20662]. We again prove this axiom is satisfied for all known topologically ordered commuting projector models about some $\mathbb{Z}/2$-reflection symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：axiom（公理）、Tomita-Takesaki theory（Tomita-Takesaki理论）、proof（证明）。；研究对象：抽象量子自旋系统中的拓扑序，特别是通过边界代数构造和von Neumann代数网络描述的拓扑有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作为局部拓扑序（LTO）引入了两个新公理：一个确保锥形区域满足Haag对偶性（利用Tomita-Takesaki理论），另一个确保反射正性。这些公理对所有已知的拓扑有序交换投影模型（包括Levin-Wen弦网模型）均成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作为局部拓扑序（LTO）引入了两个新公理：一个确保锥形区域满足Haag对偶性（利用Tomita-Takesaki理论），另一个确保反射正性。这些公理对所有已知的拓扑有序交换投影模型（包括Levin-Wen弦网模型）均成立。；创新点：1. 为LTO体系增加了Haag对偶性公理，并独立证明了Levin-Wen弦网模型中的Haag对偶性（此前已在[arXiv:2509.23734]中证明）。2. 引入反射正性公理，将LTO与近期工作[arXiv:2510.20662]联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于局部拓扑序（LTO）公理体系，结合Tomita-Takesaki理论证明Haag对偶性，并引入反射正性公理。具体模型验证：对所有已知的拓扑有序交换投影模型进行公理满足性检验。

papers.title: A Random-Matrix Criterion for Initializing Gated Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Proper weight initialization prior to training has historically been one of the key factors that helped kick off the deep learning revolution. Initialization is even more crucial in "reservoir computing", where the weights of a readout layer are learned linearly while the reservoir weights are fixed and largely determine the richness, stability and memory of the resulting dynamics. In the infinite-width limit it has been shown that meaningful initializations are those sitting at an effective critical point of the randomly initialized model. The phase transition is controlled by the weight variance $g^2$ and separates an ordered phase from a chaotic one where information progressively degrades. Here we derive a simple criterion to estimate the critical $g_c$ for a broad class of recurrent architectures and we show that it closely tracks the gain at which a gated-RNN reservoir achieves peak performance on a chaotic forecasting task. Finally, we argue that our criterion can serve as a design principle for future initialization schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：推导随机矩阵判据、分析相变临界点、使用混沌预测任务进行性能评估。；研究对象：门控循环神经网络（gated recurrent neural networks）的权重初始化问题，具体关注其在“储层计算”（reservoir computing）框架下的动力学相变（有序相与混沌相）及临界初始化条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个简单的随机矩阵判据，用于估计门控循环神经网络权重初始化的临界方差 \( g_c \)，该判据能准确预测储层在混沌预测任务中达到最佳性能时的增益值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个简单的随机矩阵判据，用于估计门控循环神经网络权重初始化的临界方差 \( g_c \)，该判据能准确预测储层在混沌预测任务中达到最佳性能时的增益值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于随机矩阵理论分析无限宽极限下的相变临界点），并结合数值实验（在混沌预测任务中测试门控循环神经网络的性能）。

papers.title: Composing diffusion priors with explicit physical context via generative Gibbs sampling
papers.abstract: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful learned priors, but in scientific sampling the target distribution often depends on physical context that is not fully represented by one generative model. We introduce Generative Gibbs for Physics-Aware Sampling (GG-PA), a training-free framework that formulates the composition of learned partial priors and explicit physical context as inference over a joint target distribution in an augmented state space. We derive a Gibbs sampler for this joint target, show that it is asymptotically exact as the diffusion time approaches zero, and prove that in settings with quadratic interactions it remains exact at finite diffusion times. We further introduce replica exchange over diffusion time to accelerate mixing. Experiments on a double-well system, a $φ^4$ lattice model, and atomistic peptide systems show that GG-PA recovers context-induced distribution shifts and emergent collective behavior in interacting systems using partial priors without retraining. These results demonstrate GG-PA as a practical approach for combining pretrained generative priors with explicit physical context.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出了一种新的计算框架（Generative Gibbs for Physics-Aware Sampling, GG-PA），并基于扩散模型和吉布斯采样进行理论推导与数值实验（双阱系统、φ⁴晶格模型、肽系统）。；研究对象：物理科学中的采样问题，具体包括：双阱系统、φ⁴晶格模型、原子级肽系统。这些体系涉及物理上下文（如相互作用、约束）对目标分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GG-PA框架能够在不重新训练扩散模型的前提下，将预训练的生成先验与显式物理上下文（如相互作用势、约束条件）组合，从而恢复由上下文引起的分布偏移和相互作用系统中的涌现集体行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GG-PA框架能够在不重新训练扩散模型的前提下，将预训练的生成先验与显式物理上下文（如相互作用势、约束条件）组合，从而恢复由上下文引起的分布偏移和相互作用系统中的涌现集体行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可归纳为：首次将扩散先验与显式物理上下文通过吉布斯采样进行组合，并证明了在特定条件下的精确性，同时无需重新训练模型。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种无需训练的框架GG-PA，核心方法包括：在增广状态空间上定义联合目标分布，推导针对该联合目标的吉布斯采样器；证明在扩散时间趋于零时采样渐近精确，且在二次相互作用情形下有限扩散时间仍保持精确；引入扩散时间上的副本交换（replica exchange）以加速混合。

papers.title: Mathematical analysis and numerical methods for the computation of transport coefficients in molecular dynamics
papers.abstract: We review various numerical approaches to compute transport coefficients in molecular dynamics. These approaches can be broadly classified into three groups: (i) nonequilibrium methods based on applying an external driving field to the system, measuring the average response in the system, and evaluating the related linear response coefficient; (ii) approaches reformulating the transport coefficient of interest through a time correlation function for the equilibrium dynamics (the most popular instances being Green--Kubo and Einstein formulas); (iii) transient techniques, where the transport coefficient can be computed by monitoring the return to the steady state of a dynamics perturbed off its stationary distribution. For all three classes of methods, we provide elements of numerical analysis, allowing to estimate or at least quantify the level of numerical errors in the estimator of the transport coefficient; and also briefly present recent attempts to more efficiently compute transport coefficients with variance reduction approaches such as control variates, importance sampling and coupling methods. The computation of transport coefficients remains nonetheless challenging and will continue requiring research efforts in the foreseeable future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical approaches、numerical analysis、variance reduction approaches。；研究对象：分子动力学中输运系数的计算方法。具体涉及线性响应系数、时间关联函数（Green-Kubo和Einstein公式）以及瞬态技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要对三类数值方法进行了综述，并指出输运系数的计算仍具挑战性，未来需继续研究。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要对三类数值方法进行了综述，并指出输运系数的计算仍具挑战性，未来需继续研究。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，主要贡献在于对三类方法的数值分析进行了系统梳理，并讨论了近期方差缩减方法在提高计算效率方面的尝试。
papers.method_zh: 综述了三种数值方法：(i) 非平衡方法（施加外部驱动场并测量平均响应）；(ii) 基于平衡动力学时间关联函数的方法（如Green-Kubo公式和Einstein公式）；(iii) 瞬态技术（监测扰动后系统回归稳态的过程）。同时介绍了方差缩减技术（控制变量、重要性抽样、耦合方法）。

papers.title: Perspective on tailoring quantum coherence with electron beams
papers.abstract: Examining and controlling the interaction between semiconductor quantum qubits and their environment can boost semiconductor quantum technologies, which have many applications in table-top quantum computing hardware. Electron beams in electron microscopes have opened up a new avenue for the quantum-coherent probing of semiconductor excitations and strong-coupling effects. Here, I provide a brief overview of recent advancements in electron-beam probes for investigating quantum coherence in semiconductors and two-dimensional materials, complemented by my perspective on using electron beams to manipulate the entanglement and correlations between quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：关键词为“perspective”（观点）、“brief overview”（简要概述）、“complemented by my perspective”（辅以个人观点），表明本文是对已有进展的总结和未来方向的展望，而非原创实验或计算工作。；研究对象：半导体量子比特（quantum qubits）及其与环境的相互作用，具体涉及半导体量子技术、半导体激发态、二维材料中的量子相干性，以及电子束在量子系统纠缠和关联调控中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子显微镜中的电子束为半导体激发态的量子相干探测和强耦合效应研究提供了新途径，并有望用于操控量子系统之间的纠缠和关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子显微镜中的电子束为半导体激发态的量子相干探测和强耦合效应研究提供了新途径，并有望用于操控量子系统之间的纠缠和关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明本文相对于已有研究的具体创新点，但指出作者提供了个人视角（perspective），探讨利用电子束操控量子系统之间的纠缠和关联，这可能是对现有电子束探测技术应用范围的拓展性思考。
papers.method_zh: 电子束探针（electron-beam probes），具体指在电子显微镜中利用电子束对半导体和二维材料进行量子相干探测。

papers.title: Quantum and classical processing with photonic quantum machine learning
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence and machine learning have been widely adopted both in the industry and in everyday life, but at the cost of high compute demands. Recent studies show that implementing machine learning in physical systems in the deep quantum regime could not only lead to faster information processing, but also to perform tasks that are out of reach for classical systems. Here, we report a quantum reservoir processing device capable of performing both quantum and classical machine learning tasks. The implementation is realized with a programmable silicon chip excited with single photons, a highly scalable and adaptable photonics technology. We successfully implement a variety of quantum tasks, including quantum state tomography and measurement of entanglement via negativity. Moreover, we implement a method of mitigation of experimental imperfections which results in a significant improvement in accuracy in comparison to the same system operating in the classical regime. Our results demonstrate a method to overcome a crucial bottleneck of quantum technologies by providing a practical way of probing quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report、implementation、realized with a programmable silicon chip、experimental imperfections。；研究对象：基于单光子激发可编程硅芯片的光子量子储层处理装置，用于执行量子与经典机器学习任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该量子储层处理装置能够同时执行量子与经典机器学习任务，并通过实验误差缓解方法显著提升精度，克服了量子技术的关键瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该量子储层处理装置能够同时执行量子与经典机器学习任务，并通过实验误差缓解方法显著提升精度，克服了量子技术的关键瓶颈。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用可编程硅芯片，以单光子激发实现量子储层处理；具体任务包括量子态层析成像和通过负性测量纠缠度，并实施了实验不完美性的缓解方法。

papers.title: QT-Net: Rethinking Evaluation of AI Models in Atomic Chemical Space
papers.abstract: Atomic properties such as partial charges or multipoles encode chemically meaningful information that can inform downstream molecular property prediction, but their evaluation as machine learning targets has been complicated by the absence of a principled out-of-distribution evaluation protocol at the atomic level. In this work, we propose a held-out evaluation protocol that clusters atomic environments by SOAP descriptors and computes metrics accounting only for cluster labels unseen during training. Following this procedure, we use 5$\times$5 cross-validation and Tukey's HSD to run a statistically rigorous comparison of E(3)-equivariant against non-equivariant, rotationally augmented models for predicting electron populations and multipoles of H, C, N, and O atoms. Building on our results, we introduce the Quantum Topological Neural Network (QT-Net), a rotationally augmented, non-equivariant graph neural network. We show that QT-Net can be used to infer properties of atoms in molecules from QM9 outside our training set, and that these inferred properties can yield improvement when used as input features for downstream molecular property prediction. To further validate the framework, molecular dipole moments computed from QT-Net's per-atom outputs recover the ground-truth values reported in QM9. We release all code and data, including a JAX implementation of QT-Net, to support the broader use of learned QTA properties as inductive biases for atomic-scale molecular machine learning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning targets、graph neural network、JAX implementation。；研究对象：原子化学空间中的原子性质预测，具体为H、C、N、O原子的电子布居数和多极矩，以及基于这些原子性质的下游分子性质预测（如QM9数据集中的分子偶极矩）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于SOAP描述符的原子级留出评估协议，并构建了旋转增强的非等变图神经网络QT-Net，该网络能够从训练集外的QM9分子中推断原子性质，且这些推断性质可作为输入特征改善下游分子性质预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于SOAP描述符的原子级留出评估协议，并构建了旋转增强的非等变图神经网络QT-Net，该网络能够从训练集外的QM9分子中推断原子性质，且这些推断性质可作为输入特征改善下游分子性质预测。；创新点：提出了一个原则性的原子级分布外评估协议（基于SOAP聚类），并引入QT-Net——一种旋转增强的非等变图神经网络，能够从QM9分子中学习并迁移原子QTA（量子拓扑原子）性质，作为分子机器学习的归纳偏置。
papers.method_zh: 采用SOAP描述符对原子环境进行聚类，设计基于未见过的聚类标签的留出评估协议；使用5×5交叉验证和Tukey HSD进行统计严格的模型比较；构建了旋转增强的非等变图神经网络QT-Net（基于JAX实现），用于预测原子电子布居数和多极矩，并验证其在下游分子性质预测中的有效性。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium scaling across first-order transitions with relativistic scalar fields
papers.abstract: We investigate the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of a relativistic $Z_2$-symmetric scalar field theory with Langevin dynamics in two and three spatial dimensions under linear driving across magnetic first-order phase transitions, close to and far below the critical temperature $T_c$. Using classical-statistical lattice simulations, we find that if the driving timescale is sufficiently fast, the system exhibits finite-time scaling behavior independent of temperature and dimensionality, identical to that observed in mean-field simulations. In slow quenches near $T_c$ this mean-field behavior crosses over to critical Kibble-Zurek scaling behavior, while for temperatures $T \ll T_c$ nucleation and growth dominate the transition dynamics, resulting in corrections to scaling. Near the transition point where the order parameter changes sign, the crossover between mean-field and critical out-of-equilibrium dynamics is found to be well described by the leading algebraic correction to Kibble-Zurek scaling. We find that universal non-equilibrium scaling behavior can be observed for $T \lesssim T_c$, provided the driving is fast enough to avoid nucleation but slow enough for correlations to form, and compute the associated universal scaling functions for the order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Langevin dynamics、classical-statistical lattice simulations、mean-field simulations、Kibble-Zurek scaling）；研究对象：相对论性Z₂对称标量场理论在磁场驱动下的一级相变非平衡动力学，涉及二维和三维空间维度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够快的驱动下，系统表现出与温度和维度无关的有限时间标度行为，与平均场模拟结果一致；慢淬火时则交叉到临界Kibble-Zurek标度行为，而在远低于临界温度时成核与生长主导动力学并导致标度修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够快的驱动下，系统表现出与温度和维度无关的有限时间标度行为，与平均场模拟结果一致；慢淬火时则交叉到临界Kibble-Zurek标度行为，而在远低于临界温度时成核与生长主导动力学并导致标度修正。；创新点：揭示了在T ≲ Tc条件下，通过适当快的驱动（避免成核但允许关联形成）可观测到普适的非平衡标度行为，并计算了序参量的普适标度函数；同时给出了平均场与临界非平衡动力学之间交叉的代数修正描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典统计格点模拟（classical-statistical lattice simulations）结合Langevin动力学，对线性驱动下的磁一级相变进行数值研究，并与平均场模拟结果对比。

papers.title: Bulk-Edge Correspondence via Higher Gauge Theory
papers.abstract: More profound than bulk topological order of quantum materials is only its unwinding via gapless excitations along boundaries of the sample. We recast this bulk-edge correspondence -- for the experimentally relevant case of fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems -- in terms of effective relative higher gauge theory, controlled by choices of classifying fibrations. For FQH systems, we identify the complex Hopf fibration as classifying the bulk/boundary topological effects, and find that it yields a non-Lagrangian reconstruction of Floreanini-Jackiw/Wess-Zumino-Witten chiral edge currents. Remarkably, the resulting effective FQH higher gauge theory turns out to be "geometrically engineered" on M2/M5-branes probing A-type orbi-singularities in 11D supergravity, globally completed by flux-quantization in twisted equivariant differential (TED) Cohomotopy: Here the M-string ends of M2-branes on M5-branes engineer the FQH liquid's boundary. This geometric engineering on M-branes might naturally elucidate the curious combination of $W_\infty$-symmetry and of super-symmetry that is known to govern the collective excitations of FQH liquids at long wavelengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：higher gauge theory, classifying fibrations, geometric engineering, flux-quantization。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔（FQH）系统，特别是其体-边对应关系（bulk-edge correspondence）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将分数量子霍尔系统的体-边对应关系重新表述为有效的相对高规范理论，发现该理论可由M2/M5膜在11维超引力中探测A型轨道奇点来“几何工程化”，并最终由扭曲等变微分上同伦（TED Cohomotopy）中的通量量子化来全局完成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将分数量子霍尔系统的体-边对应关系重新表述为有效的相对高规范理论，发现该理论可由M2/M5膜在11维超引力中探测A型轨道奇点来“几何工程化”，并最终由扭曲等变微分上同伦（TED Cohomotopy）中的通量量子化来全局完成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用了高规范理论（higher gauge theory）框架，通过选择分类纤维化（classifying fibrations）来控制理论。具体识别了复Hopf纤维化作为体/边界拓扑效应的分类器，并利用M2/M5膜在11维超引力中的几何工程化，结合通量量子化（twisted equivariant differential Cohomotopy）进行理论构建。

papers.title: Generating Symmetric Materials using Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Tackling the task of materials generation, we aim to enhance the previously proposed All-atom Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) by introducing SymADiT, a symmetry-aware variant. To do so, we use a representation of materials based on Wyckoff positions. We follow ADiT and perform generative modelling in latent space, adapted to our symmetry-aware representation. By forcing the output of the generative model to adhere to the symmetry restrictions imposed by the generated crystal's space group and each atom's Wyckoff-position, the generated materials exhibit more realistic symmetry properties. We benchmark our method against both symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic models for materials generation and show competitive performance, generating stable, symmetric materials with a simple Transformer architecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：generative modelling、Transformer architecture、latent space、benchmark。；研究对象：晶体材料，特别是具有对称性约束的晶体结构生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入基于Wyckoff位置的对称性感知表示，并强制生成模型输出符合空间群和Wyckoff位置的对称性限制，所生成的晶体材料展现出更真实的对称性，且性能与对称性感知及对称性无关的模型相比具有竞争力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入基于Wyckoff位置的对称性感知表示，并强制生成模型输出符合空间群和Wyckoff位置的对称性限制，所生成的晶体材料展现出更真实的对称性，且性能与对称性感知及对称性无关的模型相比具有竞争力。；创新点：在All-atom Diffusion Transformer（ADiT）基础上引入对称性感知变体SymADiT，通过显式施加对称性约束来生成更真实的对称材料。
papers.method_zh: 采用潜在流匹配（Latent Flow Matching）生成模型，基于Wyckoff位置表示材料，在潜在空间中进行生成建模，并强制输出满足晶体空间群和原子Wyckoff位置的对称性约束。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Non-Hermitian Jarzynski Equality in an SU(2)-Rotated Family of Hybrid $\mathcal{PT}$--$\mathcal{APT}$ Systems
papers.abstract: The Jarzynski equality is a cornerstone of nonequilibrium thermodynamics, linking work statistics to equilibrium free-energy differences. Although it has been extensively verified in classical and quantum Hermitian settings, its status in non-Hermitian dynamics remains under debate. Here we show that, in a postselected no-quantum-jump framework, a conditional non-Hermitian Jarzynski equality holds when the transition probabilities obey a parity-exchange symmetry. We study a constructed family of two-level hybrid Hamiltonians formed as linear combinations of parity-time ($\mathcal{PT}$) and anti-parity-time ($\mathcal{APT}$) symmetric terms, and demonstrate using complementary geometric and algebraic arguments that the parity-exchange symmetry persists throughout the corresponding $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-rotated orbit. Relative to previous $\mathcal{PT}$-focused conditional Jarzynski equality results, the advance here is an extension of the symmetry criterion from the isolated $\mathcal{PT}$ endpoint to a broader $\mathcal{PT}$--$\mathcal{APT}$ hybrid family. Experimentally, we implement three representative points, $θ_k = 0, π/4, π/2$, in a single trapped $^{171}\mathrm{Yb}^+$ ion and measure the resulting work distributions under cyclic protocols with $ΔF = 0$, confirming the predicted symmetry criterion at those points. Our results establish a symmetry-based extension of the conditional non-Hermitian Jarzynski relation within this restricted two-level setting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。关键词：postselected no-quantum-jump framework、geometric and algebraic arguments、single trapped ion experiment。；研究对象：非厄米动力学中的Jarzynski等式，具体研究一类由PT对称和APT对称项线性组合构成的二能级混合哈密顿量族，并在单个囚禁171Yb+离子中实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足宇称交换对称性的条件下，后选择无量子跃迁框架中的条件性非厄米Jarzynski等式成立；该宇称交换对称性在SU(2)旋转轨道上保持，从而将对称性判据从纯PT端点扩展到PT-APT混合族。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足宇称交换对称性的条件下，后选择无量子跃迁框架中的条件性非厄米Jarzynski等式成立；该宇称交换对称性在SU(2)旋转轨道上保持，从而将对称性判据从纯PT端点扩展到PT-APT混合族。；创新点：将条件性非厄米Jarzynski等式的对称性判据从先前仅适用于纯PT对称端点，扩展至更广泛的PT-APT混合哈密顿量族。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：利用几何与代数论证分析SU(2)旋转轨道上的宇称交换对称性；实验方面：在单个囚禁171Yb+离子中实现三个代表性参数点（θ_k = 0, π/4, π/2），测量循环协议下的功分布（ΔF = 0），验证对称性判据。

papers.title: A Single-Molecule Spin-Photon Interface
papers.abstract: Optical interfaces that connect long-lived spin qubits to photons are a central requirement for quantum networking and distributed quantum information processing. Currently, solid-state atomic defects are leading candidates due to their inherent spin and optical coherence. Building on these advancements, synthetically tailored molecular systems represent a fundamental change in the field, utilizing precise atomic control and consistent bottom-up assembly. However, the lack of a robust spin-photon interface combining bright fluorescence, high spectral stability, and the persistent spin lifetimes inherent to ground-state systems has prohibited the detection of individual molecular qubits. Here we show that a triplet ground state carbene molecule, embedded within a structurally matched host crystal, functions as a robust spin-photon interface with single-molecule addressability. The system exhibits narrow zero-phonon lines, spectral stability over more than an hour, spin-selective optical transitions and single-molecule optically detected magnetic resonance. Coherent control yields millisecond-scale dynamical-decoupling coherence and tens-of-milliseconds spin relaxation at a temperature of 4.5 K. These results establish molecular qubits as a viable platform for single-emitter quantum optics while preserving the advantages of bottom-up chemical design and processable materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：single-molecule addressability、optically detected magnetic resonance、coherent control。；研究对象：一种三重态基态卡宾分子（triplet ground state carbene molecule），嵌入在结构匹配的主体晶体中，作为单分子自旋-光子界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该分子体系实现了窄零声子线、超过一小时的频谱稳定性、自旋选择性光学跃迁以及单分子光探测磁共振，在4.5 K下展现出毫秒量级的动态退耦相干时间和数十毫秒的自旋弛豫时间，证明了分子量子比特可作为单发射体量子光学的可行平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该分子体系实现了窄零声子线、超过一小时的频谱稳定性、自旋选择性光学跃迁以及单分子光探测磁共振，在4.5 K下展现出毫秒量级的动态退耦相干时间和数十毫秒的自旋弛豫时间，证明了分子量子比特可作为单发射体量子光学的可行平台。；创新点：首次在单分子层面实现了兼具明亮荧光、高光谱稳定性和基态系统固有持久自旋寿命的稳健自旋-光子界面，将自下而上的化学设计与可加工材料优势引入单发射体量子光学领域。
papers.method_zh: 单分子荧光光谱、光探测磁共振（ODMR）、动态退耦相干控制。

papers.title: Diamond membranes: platform for photonic and opto-mechanical applications
papers.abstract: Diamond 1 - 10 micrometers thick membranes are platform for photonic, quantum and opto-mechanic devices with applications across UV-IR spectral ranges. IR characterization of diamond gratings in reflection and transmission showed a change of the IR absorbance dichroism between positive and negative when the grating period was 1-2 wavelengths (free space) including inside the region of the intrinsic diamond absorbance. Femtosecond laser cutting of micrometers-wide and mm-long structures are demonstrated by steps of carbonization > 0.4 J/cm2/pulse (1030 nm/200 fs) and oxidation of diamond membranes. Light intensity distribution inside form-birefringent diamond structure was modeled for a scaled-down structure and wavelength to reveal characteristic interference patterns for different polarizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：IR characterization、Femtosecond laser cutting、modeled）；研究对象：厚度1-10微米的金刚石薄膜及其制备的光栅结构，用于光子、量子及光机电器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当光栅周期为自由空间波长的1-2倍时，红外吸收二向色性发生正负转变，该转变可发生在金刚石本征吸收区域内；飞秒激光切割可实现微米宽、毫米长的结构加工。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当光栅周期为自由空间波长的1-2倍时，红外吸收二向色性发生正负转变，该转变可发生在金刚石本征吸收区域内；飞秒激光切割可实现微米宽、毫米长的结构加工。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 红外反射/透射光谱表征（测量光栅的IR吸收二向色性）、飞秒激光切割（1030 nm/200 fs，碳化阈值>0.4 J/cm²/脉冲）、有限元建模（模拟缩比双折射结构中的光强分布及偏振相关干涉图案）。

papers.title: Clifford Ergotropy
papers.abstract: We discuss the interplay between thermodynamics and magic resources in closed quantum dynamics by introducing Clifford ergotropy, the amount of extractable energy under the restriction to Clifford operations. We provide universal upper bounds on Clifford ergotropy, which decrease with increasing magic as quantified by the infinite-order filtered stabilizer Rényi entropy. We demonstrate the utility of this bound for one- and two-qubit systems, with the latter exhibiting a notable transition in the control landscape of Clifford ergotropy. Finally, we show that our analysis has nontrivial consequences even for many-body systems, including a form of the second law of thermodynamics under Clifford operations for typical quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论的是封闭量子动力学中热力学与魔法资源（magic resources）的相互作用，并引入理论概念（Clifford ergotropy）和数学上界（universal upper bounds），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子系统中的可提取能量（ergotropy）与量子魔法资源（magic resources）之间的关系，具体研究在Clifford操作限制下的能量提取过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Clifford ergotropy（在Clifford操作下可提取的能量）存在普适上界，该上界随系统魔法资源（由无限阶滤波稳定子Rényi熵量化）的增加而降低；对于典型量子态，Clifford操作下存在类似热力学第二定律的约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Clifford ergotropy（在Clifford操作下可提取的能量）存在普适上界，该上界随系统魔法资源（由无限阶滤波稳定子Rényi熵量化）的增加而降低；对于典型量子态，Clifford操作下存在类似热力学第二定律的约束。；创新点：首次将热力学中的可提取能量（ergotropy）概念与量子计算中的魔法资源（magic）联系起来，揭示了在Clifford操作限制下能量提取与量子非稳定化资源之间的定量约束关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过引入Clifford ergotropy概念，利用无限阶滤波稳定子Rényi熵量化魔法资源，推导出Clifford ergotropy的普适上界；对一比特和两比特系统进行具体分析，并推广到多体系统。

papers.title: Rare transitions between collective states in an active fluid via a weakly nonlinear reduction
papers.abstract: We study a model for a dilute suspension of rod-like particles swimming at constant velocity in a Stokes flow. As the translational diffusivity of the particles decreases, a two-dimensional uniform concentration of randomly aligned particles undergoes either a codimension-2 pitchfork bifurcation or a codimension-4 Hopf bifurcation, depending on the particles' swimming speed. We use a weakly nonlinear expansion to reduce the system to a low-dimensional one for the amplitudes of the bifurcating eigenmodes. The originality of our calculations lies in incorporating spatio-temporal white noise forcing. The stochastic forcing terms in the amplitude equations are derived analytically from the noise acting on the original system. Past the onset of the bifurcations, the particles deterministically self-organize into steady or oscillating states of collective motion. For the Hopf bifurcation scenario, two stable periodic orbits are found to coexist, each corresponding to a distinct collective dynamics. The stochastic forcing induces rare transitions between them. Owing to the low dimensionality of amplitude equations, steady and dynamical statistics can be computed directly from the Fokker-Planck equation, or via the Adaptive Multilevel Splitting (AMS) rare-event algorithm. In particular, extremely long mean transition times and associated out-of-equilibrium paths between the periodic orbits are obtained. These paths can be understood in light of the invariant manifolds of the low-dimensional system, which brings insights into the mechanism behind the transitions. We also performed fully nonlinear stochastic simulations and used the AMS algorithm directly on the full system. The statistics are in good quantitative agreement with those computed on the reduced systems, the latter being obtained at a considerably lower numerical cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：weakly nonlinear expansion、stochastic forcing、Fokker-Planck equation、Adaptive Multilevel Splitting (AMS) algorithm、fully nonlinear stochastic simulations。；研究对象：活性流体中杆状颗粒的集体运动，具体为在斯托克斯流中恒速游动的稀悬浮液，以及其从均匀随机取向态到集体运动态的相变和罕见跃迁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hopf分岔场景下，系统存在两个共存的稳定周期轨道，对应不同的集体动力学；随机噪声可诱导这两个周期轨道之间的罕见跃迁，且通过低维约化系统可高效计算极长的平均跃迁时间和跃迁路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hopf分岔场景下，系统存在两个共存的稳定周期轨道，对应不同的集体动力学；随机噪声可诱导这两个周期轨道之间的罕见跃迁，且通过低维约化系统可高效计算极长的平均跃迁时间和跃迁路径。；创新点：在弱非线性约化中系统性地纳入了时空白噪声，并解析推导了振幅方程中的随机项；利用低维约化系统的高效性，首次实现了对活性流体中两个共存周期轨道之间罕见跃迁的定量统计（包括极长平均跃迁时间和路径），并通过不变流形揭示了跃迁机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用弱非线性展开将原系统约化为低维振幅方程，并解析地引入时空白噪声；通过Fokker-Planck方程和自适应多层分裂（AMS）算法计算稳态和动力学统计量；同时在全系统上进行完全非线性随机模拟并与约化系统结果对比验证。

papers.title: Polarizable Embedding QM/MM for Periodic Systems
papers.abstract: A general polarizable embedded (PE) quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics scheme for periodic systems is presented, describing mutual polarization of the two subsystems. The QM system, described with density functional theory (DFT), is coupled to a single center multipole expansion (SCME) model, characterising H$_2$O molecules in the MM region. In SCME the H$_2$O molecules are ascribed anisotropic dipole and quadrupole polarizabilities and permanent multipoles up to and including the hexadecapole. Our embedding scheme illustrates a smooth and efficient convergence pattern of the periodic interaction potential by introducing a single and clustered multipole expansion points in the far-field. By choosing the near- and far-field expansion of the potential carefully the PE-QM/MM calculation matches the level of accuracy of a the QM calculation. In the short range, the electrostatic interaction between the QM and MM subsystems is damped with a real-space and pair-wise isotropic damping functions - resulting in a screened interaction and preventing over-polarization. In molecular dynamics simulations the two subsystems are separated with the elastic scattering assisted flexible inner region [Kirchhoff et. al. JCTC, 2021, 17, 9, 5863] - ensuring a smooth transition in the radial distribution at the boundary between the two subsystems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“presented”、“scheme”、“described with density functional theory (DFT)”、“molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：周期性体系中的极化嵌入量子力学/分子力学（PE-QM/MM）方案，具体以水分子（H₂O）作为MM区域的表征对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种适用于周期性体系的通用极化嵌入QM/MM方案，通过引入单中心多极展开模型和精心设计的近场/远场势展开，使PE-QM/MM计算的精度与纯QM计算相匹配，并有效防止了过极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种适用于周期性体系的通用极化嵌入QM/MM方案，通过引入单中心多极展开模型和精心设计的近场/远场势展开，使PE-QM/MM计算的精度与纯QM计算相匹配，并有效防止了过极化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）描述QM子系统，耦合单中心多极展开（SCME）模型描述MM区域的水分子；在远场引入单点和簇状多极展开点以实现周期相互作用势的平滑高效收敛；在短程使用实空间各向同性阻尼函数屏蔽QM与MM间的静电相互作用；分子动力学模拟中采用弹性散射辅助柔性内区方法分离两个子系统。

papers.title: Supersensitive rotation sensor from superintegrability
papers.abstract: Detection based on quantum principles such as entanglement has the capacity to achieve finessed levels of sensitivity, bringing transformative impacts to applications. In this study, we propose a rotation sensor using ultra-cold dipolar atoms trapped in a four-well configuration. The design, based on a simple population imbalance measurement to quantify rotation, profits from the property of superintegrability. The implementation of the measurement protocol achieves rotation-detection sensitivity beyond the Heisenberg limit. Our results spotlight superintegrability opportunities for advancing the field of quantum sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、design（设计）、measurement protocol（测量协议）。；研究对象：基于超冷偶极原子囚禁在四阱构型中的旋转传感器（rotation sensor）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用超可积性（superintegrability）设计的旋转传感器，通过简单的布居数不平衡测量即可实现超越海森堡极限的旋转探测灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用超可积性（superintegrability）设计的旋转传感器，通过简单的布居数不平衡测量即可实现超越海森堡极限的旋转探测灵敏度。；创新点：首次将超可积性（superintegrability）应用于量子传感领域，实现了超越海森堡极限的旋转探测灵敏度。摘要未突出说明与现有旋转传感器在具体实现路径上的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于超可积性（superintegrability）的量子传感方案，采用超冷偶极原子在四阱构型中的布居数不平衡测量来量化旋转。

papers.title: Emerging 2D Materials for Beyond von Neumann Computing: A Perspective
papers.abstract: The end of conventional Dennard scaling and the widening gap between memory bandwidth and arithmetic throughput have made the von Neumann partition a structural bottleneck rather than a transient one. Two-dimensional (2D) materials, with atomically thin geometries, electrically tunable carrier densities, and large optical responses, offer a unified platform on which to build devices that compute where they store, process events rather than clock cycles, and shift workload into the optical domain. This perspective surveys progress along three converging thrusts, graphene and graphene nanoribbon transistors as scalable channel materials, oxide and 2D-integrated memristors for in-memory analog compute, and silicon-compatible 2D photonic and thermal-emitter structures for optical computing primitives. Our central argument is that the 2D-materials community has spent a decade producing record devices, and the next decade will be decided by who first integrates three of them on a single semiconductor wafer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：观点/综述文章（Perspective）。判断依据：关键词“perspective surveys progress”、“central argument”。；研究对象：基于二维材料（2D materials）的超越冯·诺依曼计算架构，具体包括：石墨烯/石墨烯纳米带晶体管、氧化物与二维材料集成的忆阻器、硅兼容的二维光子与热发射器结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维材料凭借其原子级厚度、电可调载流子密度和大光学响应，为构建存算一体、事件驱动及光学计算器件提供了统一平台；未来十年的关键挑战在于能否将三种器件首次集成在同一半导体晶圆上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维材料凭借其原子级厚度、电可调载流子密度和大光学响应，为构建存算一体、事件驱动及光学计算器件提供了统一平台；未来十年的关键挑战在于能否将三种器件首次集成在同一半导体晶圆上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但核心论点在于强调二维材料领域应从“制造创纪录的单个器件”转向“将多种功能器件集成于同一晶圆”，以解决冯·诺依曼瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算方法，属于对三类器件（晶体管、忆阻器、光子结构）研究进展的综述性展望。

papers.title: Classification of Chimera States via Fourier Analysis and Unsupervised Learning
papers.abstract: Chimera states are among the most intriguing phenomena in nonlinear dynamics, characterized by the coexistence of coherent and incoherent behavior in systems of coupled identical oscillators. Many methods have been proposed to detect chimera states and to distinguish their different types. However, such methods often suffer from important limitations that prevent sufficiently precise classification. In this work, we overcome the issue by considering a method based on Fourier analysis to determine key signal characteristics such as amplitude, phase, and frequency, jointly with an unsupervised clustering step acting on normalized total variations, measures of local spatial changes of the above-mentioned dynamical features. The proposed method allows us to identify regions in parameter space returning chimera states, but also to further distinguish between the different types. The method is applied to a network of Rayleigh oscillators, which has been shown to exhibit a rich variety of dynamical patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Fourier analysis, unsupervised clustering, 数值方法应用于网络模型。；研究对象：耦合相同振子系统中的奇美拉态（Chimera states），具体应用于Rayleigh振子网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于傅里叶分析与无监督聚类的方法，能够更精确地识别参数空间中的奇美拉态区域，并进一步区分不同类型的奇美拉态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于傅里叶分析与无监督聚类的方法，能够更精确地识别参数空间中的奇美拉态区域，并进一步区分不同类型的奇美拉态。；创新点：克服了已有奇美拉态检测方法在分类精度上的局限性，通过联合傅里叶分析与无监督学习实现了对奇美拉态类型更精细的区分。
papers.method_zh: 采用傅里叶分析提取信号的振幅、相位和频率等关键特征，结合归一化总变差（测量上述动力学特征的局部空间变化）进行无监督聚类。

papers.title: Systematic Fine-Tuning of MACE Interatomic Potentials for Catalysis
papers.abstract: Once trained, machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) provide a fast and accurate way to study catalytic reaction pathways, but their performance strongly depends on the training set. Here, we compare nine MLIPs trained with different data sets and strategies, including from-scratch (FS) training and fine-tuning (FT) of large foundation models. The models are evaluated on reaction energies, $E_{r}$, and reaction energy barriers, $E_{a}$, for 141 reactions, including CO$_2$ reduction to C$_2$ and C$_3$ products, propane dehydrogenation, hydrogen intercalation on Pd, and out-of-distribution oxygen evolution reaction (OER) on metal oxides. FS models trained with 5%--10% perturbed high-energy configurations from molecular dynamics or contour exploration reduce the error by more than twofold compared with models trained only on relaxation trajectories. In contrast, FT MLIPs are less sensitive to sampling and transfer well to out-of-distribution reactions. An MLIP fine-tuned on metallic catalysts achieves a 0.30 eV MAE for OER on iridium oxide polymorphs, outperforming out-of-the-box MACE-MH-1 by 0.08 eV and the best FS model by 0.14 eV. A model fine-tuned to O and OH adsorption on metal oxides gives a 0.19 eV reaction-barrier MAE for out-of-distribution CO$_2$RR on Cu, comparable to an FS model trained on in-distribution C--C bond-breaking reactions. Finally, a large MLIP fine-tuned on 49,860 configurations gives the best overall performance across metallic and metal-oxide catalysts and was used to screen a large left-out set of bimetallic alloys, achieving a 0.15 eV MAE for $E_{r}$, even for adsorbates on unseen Miller-index surfaces such as (532). This work identifies the training configurations needed for accurate FS and FT MLIPs for catalytic reaction modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“training”、“fine-tuning”、“reaction energies”、“reaction energy barriers”。；研究对象：催化反应体系，包括CO₂还原为C₂和C₃产物、丙烷脱氢、Pd上的氢插层，以及金属氧化物上的析氧反应（OER）等催化反应路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微调（fine-tuning）的大规模机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在催化反应能量和能垒预测上优于从头训练（from-scratch）模型，尤其对分布外（out-of-distribution）反应具有更好的迁移能力；而从头训练模型需引入5%-10%的高能扰动构型才能显著降低误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微调（fine-tuning）的大规模机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在催化反应能量和能垒预测上优于从头训练（from-scratch）模型，尤其对分布外（out-of-distribution）反应具有更好的迁移能力；而从头训练模型需引入5%-10%的高能扰动构型才能显著降低误差。；创新点：系统比较了不同训练策略（从头训练 vs. 微调）和不同数据采样方法对催化反应建模精度的影响，并展示了微调模型在分布外反应（如金属氧化物上的OER、Cu上的CO₂RR）以及未见过的Miller指数表面（如(532)）上的优异泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 使用MACE系列机器学习原子间势（MLIP），对比了从头训练（FS）和微调（FT）两种训练策略。训练数据包括分子动力学或构象探索产生的高能扰动构型，以及大规模构型集（49,860个构型）。评估指标为反应能量（E_r）和反应能垒（E_a）的平均绝对误差（MAE）。

papers.title: Truncating loopy tensor networks by zero-mode gauge fixing: the $Z_2$ lattice gauge theory at finite temperature
papers.abstract: Loopy tensor networks exhibit internal correlations that often render their compression inefficient. We show that even local bond optimization can more effectively exploit locally available information about relevant loop correlations. By cutting a bond, we define a set of states whose linear dependence can be identified through a zero mode of the states' metric tensor and used to truncate the bond dimension. In the absence of an exact zero mode, a linear combination of a small number of the lowest modes can instead be optimized to provide the optimal approximation to a zero mode. The truncation does not require prior gauge fixing. The method is applied to the two-dimensional finite-temperature $Z_2$ lattice gauge theory, whose thermal-state purification is represented by an infinite projected entangled-pair state (iPEPS).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及张量网络压缩方法、零模式分析、iPEPS（无限投影纠缠对态）等理论计算框架，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维有限温度Z₂格点规范理论的热态纯化，具体由无限投影纠缠对态（iPEPS）表示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过零模式规范固定，可以在不预先进行规范固定的情况下，利用局域键截断有效压缩存在内部环状关联的圈张量网络，并应用于有限温度Z₂格点规范理论的热态表示。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过零模式规范固定，可以在不预先进行规范固定的情况下，利用局域键截断有效压缩存在内部环状关联的圈张量网络，并应用于有限温度Z₂格点规范理论的热态表示。；创新点：提出了一种无需预先规范固定的局域键截断方法，通过零模式分析更有效地利用环状关联的局域信息来压缩圈张量网络。
papers.method_zh: 采用张量网络方法，具体为：通过切断键定义一组态，利用态度量张量的零模式识别线性相关并截断键维数；若无精确零模式，则优化少量最低本征模式的线性组合以近似零模式。应用对象为二维有限温度Z₂格点规范理论的iPEPS热态纯化。

papers.title: Dual Fear Mechanisms Shaping Stochastic Population Dynamics under the Allee Effect
papers.abstract: Traditional population models that include predator-prey interactions attribute demographic changes directly to predation-related effects. However, predator-induced fear in prey has increasingly been recognised as an important factor shaping population dynamics. In this study, we propose a cubic population model in which fear acts through two distinct functional channels for a single-species population exhibiting the Allee effect. In this model, fear reduces the intrinsic growth rate through a multiplicative suppression mechanism while also playing an integrated role in modulating the growth and interaction dynamics by rescaling the saturation structure of the Holling type III interaction term. The stochastic extension of the model is described by a Langevin formalism containing correlated additive and multiplicative Gaussian noise, and the steady state probability distribution (SSPD) is analytically obtained using the corresponding Fokker-Planck equation. The analytical solution is validated by numerical simulations. The SSPD reveals both noise-induced transitions and fear-controlled regime changes between low- and high-density states, with the two-channel effect of fear producing structural competition and non-monotonic changes in the distribution. These are analysed through phenomenological bifurcation (P-bifurcation) diagrams and three-dimensional distribution surfaces. Additionally, statistical properties, parameter sensitivity, and escape dynamics are investigated through normalised moments, Fisher information, and mean first-passage time (MFPT) calculations. Notably, our model treats fear as an independent control parameter and provides a natural explanation for several conflicting empirical findings in the literature on fear-mediated population dynamics, while also offering an analytical basis for conservation biology and ecosystem management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提出模型、解析求解、数值模拟、Fokker-Planck方程、P-bifurcation。；研究对象：具有Allee效应的单物种种群在捕食者诱导恐惧下的随机种群动力学。具体物理现象为恐惧通过两个功能通道（抑制内禀增长率、调节Holling III型功能反应的饱和结构）对种群密度状态分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 恐惧作为独立控制参数，通过双通道效应产生结构竞争和非单调分布变化，导致噪声诱导的相变和低/高密度态之间的恐惧控制态切换，并能为文献中关于恐惧介导种群动力学的矛盾实证结果提供自然解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：恐惧作为独立控制参数，通过双通道效应产生结构竞争和非单调分布变化，导致噪声诱导的相变和低/高密度态之间的恐惧控制态切换，并能为文献中关于恐惧介导种群动力学的矛盾实证结果提供自然解释。；创新点：将恐惧处理为独立控制参数，并首次在同一模型中同时考虑恐惧对增长率的直接抑制和对相互作用项饱和结构的调节（双通道效应），从而解释文献中看似矛盾的实证结果。
papers.method_zh: 提出包含Allee效应的三次方种群模型，其中恐惧通过乘法抑制机制降低内禀增长率，并通过重新缩放Holling III型相互作用项的饱和结构来调节增长与相互作用动力学。随机扩展采用Langevin形式（含相关加性和乘性高斯噪声），通过对应的Fokker-Planck方程解析得到稳态概率分布（SSPD），并用数值模拟验证。分析手段包括P-bifurcation图、三维分布曲面、归一化矩、Fisher信息以及平均首通时间（MFPT）计算。

papers.title: An exact spacetime polymer gas for finite-temperature $\mathbb Z_N$ homological quantum code
papers.abstract: We study finite-temperature $P$-form $\mathbb Z_N$ homological codes via an exact finite-Trotter quantum-to-classical map to a $(d+1)$-dimensional spacetime model with electric and magnetic topological background charges. The resulting background-resolved partition functions admit an exact reformulation in terms of closed magnetic and electric defect polymers, with opposite-species interactions governed by linking phases. By bounding this complex polymer gas by positive same-species hard-core majorant gases, we obtain an explicit low-activity criterion under which all background-dependent partition functions are uniformly controlled and homologically nontrivial polymers are exponentially suppressed on the scale of the spacetime systole. We also derive an exact higher-form Kramers-Wannier duality exchanging electric and magnetic backgrounds, Wilson and 't Hooft operators, and $P$-form and $(d-P)$-form theories. Finally, for prime $N$, we identify an exact source-free gauge-theory specialization coupled to the plaquette random-cluster model, which imports sharp phase-transition results on special geometries into the spacetime framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum-to-classical map、exact reformulation、duality、gauge-theory specialization。；研究对象：有限温度下的 $P$-形式 $\mathbb Z_N$ 同调量子码（homological quantum code），即一种拓扑量子纠错码的有限温度统计物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确的量子-经典映射，将有限温度同调码转化为带有电、磁拓扑背景荷的时空聚合物气体模型，并证明在低活性条件下，同调非平凡的聚合物被指数压制，从而实现对背景依赖配分函数的统一控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确的量子-经典映射，将有限温度同调码转化为带有电、磁拓扑背景荷的时空聚合物气体模型，并证明在低活性条件下，同调非平凡的聚合物被指数压制，从而实现对背景依赖配分函数的统一控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限Trotter步长的精确量子-经典映射，将量子模型映射为 $(d+1)$ 维时空模型；利用闭合磁缺陷和电缺陷聚合物（polymer）的精确表述，并通过正同种硬核主导气体（positive same-species hard-core majorant gases）进行界估计；推导了高阶Kramers-Wannier对偶性；对于素数 $N$，将无源规范理论特化与plaquette随机团簇模型（plaquette random-cluster model）耦合。

papers.title: Beyond the Black Box: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Electronic Structure Microdescriptors and Structure-Performance Relationships in Fe-based Catalytic Systems
papers.abstract: The current catalyst discovery and development pipeline for energy-intensive applications like methane conversion remains bottlenecked by expensive trial-and-error experimentation, irreproducible chemical intuition, and a lack of frameworks linking complex catalytic design spaces to performance. This work presents an interpretable machine learning framework that integrates SHAP-based feature importance analysis (Explainable AI) with tree-based ensembles (Random Forest and Bayesian-optimized CatBoost) to characterize Fe-zeolite and oxide-supported catalysts for the partial oxidation of methane (POM). Despite limited data, the framework decodes complex structure-performance relationships by identifying and ranking thermodynamic, structural, and geometric microdescriptors that influence the electronic band gap and govern macroscale performance metrics such as selectivity, activity, and stability. This work explicitly demonstrates that thermodynamic lattice stability and geometric factors are the primary drivers of electronic band gap (a critical proxy for redox reactivity) rather than bulk stoichiometry. Non-linear models achieve an R2 of 0.61 - 0.77, significantly outperforming traditional linear baselines (R2 = 0.32). This workflow provides both a light-weight generalizable methodology and a prioritized list of physical features for accelerated catalyst screening - and these features can subsequently be integrated into microkinetic and reaction engineering models to create digital twins of complex reactor systems and to enable predictive optimization in autonomous R&D laboratories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：机器学习框架、SHAP特征重要性分析、树集成模型、预测）；研究对象：铁基催化体系，具体为用于甲烷部分氧化（POM）的Fe-沸石和氧化物负载催化剂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热力学晶格稳定性和几何因素是驱动电子带隙（氧化还原反应活性的关键代理指标）的主要因素，而非体相化学计量比。非线性模型（R²=0.61-0.77）显著优于传统线性模型（R²=0.32）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热力学晶格稳定性和几何因素是驱动电子带隙（氧化还原反应活性的关键代理指标）的主要因素，而非体相化学计量比。非线性模型（R²=0.61-0.77）显著优于传统线性模型（R²=0.32）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用可解释机器学习框架，结合基于SHAP（可解释人工智能）的特征重要性分析与树集成模型（随机森林和贝叶斯优化的CatBoost），用于预测电子结构微观描述符并解析结构-性能关系。

papers.title: Impact of the non-canonical approach to the exact solution of the ideal one-dimensional electron gas confined with an anisotropic quantum wire of oscillator-shaped profile
papers.abstract: We study an exactly solvable model that can be interpreted as an ideal one-dimensional electron gas confined with an anisotropic quantum wire potential of oscillator-shaped profile. The homogeneous nature of the quantum wire is broken by the introduction of the effective electron mass, which changes with radial distance. We solve the problem described both within the canonical and the non-canonical approach. Analytical expressions of the wavefunctions of the stationary states for both cases in terms of the Laguerre polynomials are obtained, as well as the discrete energy spectrum related to these wavefunctions. Additionally, an exact solution to the angular position part of the position-dependent mass Schrödinger equation within the non-canonical approach leads to the angular-part wavefunctions of the even and odd states expressed through the Gegenbauer polynomials. Possible limit relations and special cases are studied too.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“exactly solvable model”、“analytical expressions”、“Schrödinger equation”。；研究对象：理想一维电子气，被限制在具有振荡器形状轮廓的各向异性量子线势阱中，且有效电子质量随径向距离变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正则和非正则两种方法下，均获得了该位置依赖质量薛定谔方程的精确解，包括用拉盖尔多项式表示的波函数和离散能谱；非正则方法还得到了用盖根鲍尔多项式表示的角部分波函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正则和非正则两种方法下，均获得了该位置依赖质量薛定谔方程的精确解，包括用拉盖尔多项式表示的波函数和离散能谱；非正则方法还得到了用盖根鲍尔多项式表示的角部分波函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析求解：分别采用正则方法和非正则方法求解位置依赖质量的薛定谔方程，得到波函数和能谱的解析表达式，并研究了极限关系和特例。

papers.title: Path Dependence in Alchemical Calculations of Water Chemical Potential in Aqueous Electrolytes
papers.abstract: Accurate calculation of free energies and their derivatives is central to assessing the thermodynamic stability of molecular and particulate systems across length scales. Yet such quantities can be difficult to compute reliably in strongly interacting systems, such as solutions of ionic species in polar solvents. One important example is the chemical potential of water in aqueous electrolytes, which can be estimated through staged particle insertion by gradually coupling an inserted molecule to its environment. Although the resulting insertion free energy should be independent of the alchemical pathway, the order and manner in which van der Waals and electrostatic interactions are activated can strongly affect convergence and, in some cases, yield inconsistent estimates. Here, we examine this issue by calculating water's chemical potential in aqueous KCl solutions using eight alchemical insertion pathways that differ in the extent and order of van der Waals and Coulombic coupling. We find that concurrently activating these interactions, particularly in fully coupled and partially end-coupled protocols, can produce chemically implausible insertion free energies. These anomalies arise from intermediate states in which the inserted water molecule develops strong electrostatic interactions with a chloride ion before sufficient short-range repulsion has been established. In contrast, pathways that activate short-range van der Waals interactions before electrostatics yield more consistent and chemically plausible estimates. These findings demonstrate that practical alchemical calculations in polar and ionic environments can be highly sensitive to pathway design, underscoring the importance of decoupling short-range and electrostatic interactions in staged insertion alchemical protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“alchemical calculations”（炼金术计算）、“staged particle insertion”（分步粒子插入）、“coupling”（耦合）等计算模拟方法，并比较了不同计算路径的结果。；研究对象：水在电解质溶液（具体为KCl水溶液）中的化学势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在通过炼金术方法计算水化学势时，同时激活范德华和静电相互作用（特别是全耦合和部分端耦合协议）会产生化学上不合理的插入自由能，而先激活短程范德华相互作用再激活静电相互作用的路径则能得到更一致且合理的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在通过炼金术方法计算水化学势时，同时激活范德华和静电相互作用（特别是全耦合和部分端耦合协议）会产生化学上不合理的插入自由能，而先激活短程范德华相互作用再激活静电相互作用的路径则能得到更一致且合理的结果。；创新点：系统性地揭示了在极性/离子环境中进行炼金术计算时，路径设计（特别是范德华与静电相互作用的解耦顺序）对计算结果收敛性和物理合理性的关键影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 炼金术自由能计算。具体采用了八种不同的炼金术插入路径，这些路径在激活范德华相互作用和库仑相互作用的程度与顺序上有所区别，用于计算水分子在KCl水溶液中的插入自由能。

papers.title: Theory for TERS of 2D materials including out-of-plane Raman response
papers.abstract: Tip-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (TERS) can be used to make nanoscale spatial measurements of 2D materials, such as graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). The TERS theory introduced in [Phys. Rev. X 4, 031054 (2014)], however, was tailored for graphene, whose out-of-plane Raman response is neglected. In the present work, we include the out-of-plane response in the TERS theory. In doing so, we provide an exact analytical expression for the field propagation between the tip and the sample, and show that the contribution to the TERS signal that scatters first at the sample, then at the tip (sample-tip, or TS) is important only when the out-of-plane response is significant. We extensively study the variation of TERS experimental measurements when varying physical parameters of the system, like the tip radius, the out-of-plane response, the TERS coherence length, and others. It becomes evident that the TERS enhancement is very sensitive to the out-of-plane Raman response of the phonon mode, while normalized tip-approach measurements are more sensitive to the coherence length, and we show that the medium refractive index leads to an effective tip enhancement factor $f_e$. Our results lead to the conclusion that, in general, a strong TERS enhancement is a necessary condition for investigating the physics discussed here, which here means surveying the difference in TERS signals between different Raman modes. We use our model to analyze some graphene TERS experiments, showing that they are consistent with a negligible out-of-plane Raman response and a non-zero TERS coherence length in the fitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“theory”、“exact analytical expression”、“model”等关键词，属于理论推导与建模分析。；研究对象：二维材料（如石墨烯和过渡金属硫族化合物）的针尖增强拉曼光谱（TERS），特别关注面外拉曼响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当二维材料的面外拉曼响应显著时，先经样品散射再经针尖散射的“样品-针尖（TS）”信号贡献变得重要；TERS增强因子对声子模式的面外拉曼响应非常敏感，而归一化针尖逼近测量对TERS相干长度更敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当二维材料的面外拉曼响应显著时，先经样品散射再经针尖散射的“样品-针尖（TS）”信号贡献变得重要；TERS增强因子对声子模式的面外拉曼响应非常敏感，而归一化针尖逼近测量对TERS相干长度更敏感。；创新点：将面外拉曼响应纳入TERS理论框架，弥补了此前仅针对石墨烯（忽略面外响应）的TERS理论的不足，并揭示了面外响应在TERS信号中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于电磁场传播的解析推导，给出了针尖与样品之间场传播的精确解析表达式，并系统研究了针尖半径、面外响应、TERS相干长度、介质折射率等物理参数对TERS信号的影响。

papers.title: Machine learning the non-radiative decay modes in photochemical processes
papers.abstract: Non-radiative decay in photoexcited molecular systems is driven by nuclear motion toward conical intersections (CIs), where electronic states become degenerate and nonadiabatic transitions occur. Identifying the nuclear degrees of freedom responsible for CI access from nonadiabatic molecular dynamics (NAD) simulations remains challenging because the underlying motions are high-dimensional and collective. Here, we introduce an unsupervised, information-theoretic framework based on Differentiable Information Imbalance (DII) to identify the nuclear coordinates governing CI access directly from trajectory surface hopping (TSH) simulations. By quantifying correlations between structural descriptors and electronic observables, including energy gaps and oscillator strengths, the method ranks nuclear degrees of freedom by predictive relevance. A multi-step protocol then extracts low-dimensional, physically interpretable modes associated with non-radiative decay. We apply the framework to the methaniminium cation, furan, L-glutamine, L-pyroglutamine-ammonium, and a photoactive molecular motor. Across all systems, the method recovers known mechanistic coordinates while revealing the relative importance of competing modes when multiple structural distortions contribute to CI access. The analysis also reveals a systematic distinction between observables: energy gaps are typically governed by a small number of localized coordinates, whereas oscillator strengths depend on more collective and distributed structural rearrangements. Overall, the DII-based framework combines predictive power with direct interpretability, providing a general and scalable route for extracting mechanistic insight from high-dimensional NAD data and constructing reduced-dimensional models of excited-state dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“unsupervised, information-theoretic framework”、“Differentiable Information Imbalance (DII)”、“trajectory surface hopping (TSH) simulations”。；研究对象：光激发分子体系中的非辐射衰变过程，具体研究对象包括：甲亚胺阳离子、呋喃、L-谷氨酰胺、L-焦谷氨酰胺-铵盐以及一个光驱动分子马达。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于可微信息不平衡（DII）的无监督信息论框架，能够直接从非绝热分子动力学模拟数据中识别出控制分子体系到达圆锥交叉点（CI）的关键核坐标，从而揭示非辐射衰变的主要模式。该方法发现，能量间隙通常由少数局域坐标主导，而振子强度则依赖于更集体、更分散的结构重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于可微信息不平衡（DII）的无监督信息论框架，能够直接从非绝热分子动力学模拟数据中识别出控制分子体系到达圆锥交叉点（CI）的关键核坐标，从而揭示非辐射衰变的主要模式。该方法发现，能量间隙通常由少数局域坐标主导，而振子强度则依赖于更集体、更分散的结构重排。；创新点：提出了一种兼具预测能力和直接可解释性的通用、可扩展方法，用于从高维非绝热分子动力学数据中提取机制性见解，并构建激发态动力学的降维模型。该方法能够系统地区分不同电子可观测量（能量间隙与振子强度）对结构变化的敏感性差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于可微信息不平衡（DII）的无监督机器学习框架，结合轨迹面跳跃（TSH）模拟。该方法通过量化结构描述符与电子可观测量（如能量间隙、振子强度）之间的相关性，对核自由度进行预测相关性排序，并通过多步协议提取低维、物理可解释的非辐射衰变模式。

papers.title: On Distinguishing Capability Elicitation from Capability Creation in Post-Training: A Free-Energy Perspective
papers.abstract: Debates about large language model post-training often treat supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as imitation and reinforcement learning (RL) as discovery. But this distinction is too coarse. What matters is whether a training procedure increases the probability of behaviors the pretrained model could already produce, or whether it changes what the model can practically reach. We argue that post-training research should distinguish between capability elicitation and capability creation. We make this distinction operational by introducing the notion of accessible support: the set of behaviors that a model can practically produce under finite budgets. Post-training that reweights behaviors within this support is capability elicitation; whereas changing the support itself corresponds to capability creation. We develop this argument through a free-energy view of post-training. SFT and RL can both be seen as reweighting a pretrained reference distribution, only with different external signals. Demonstration signals define low-energy behavior for SFT, and reward signals define low-energy behavior for RL. When the update remains close to the base model, the main effect is local reweighting, not capability creation. Within this framework, the central question is no longer whether post-training is framed as SFT or RL, but whether it reweights behaviors already within reach, or instead expands the model's reachable behavioral space through search, interaction, tool use, or the incorporation of new information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：free-energy perspective、theoretical framework、distinction operational。；研究对象：大语言模型（LLM）的后训练（post-training）过程，具体关注监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）在模型行为空间上的本质区别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 后训练应区分为“能力激发”（capability elicitation）与“能力创造”（capability creation）：前者仅对预训练模型已能产生的行为进行重新加权，后者则改变模型实际可达到的行为空间（accessible support）。SFT和RL本质上都是对预训练参考分布的重新加权，区别仅在于外部信号（演示信号 vs. 奖励信号）不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：后训练应区分为“能力激发”（capability elicitation）与“能力创造”（capability creation）：前者仅对预训练模型已能产生的行为进行重新加权，后者则改变模型实际可达到的行为空间（accessible support）。SFT和RL本质上都是对预训练参考分布的重新加权，区别仅在于外部信号（演示信号 vs. 奖励信号）不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统“SFT=模仿、RL=发现”二分法的具体对比细节，但明确提出了一个可操作化的区分标准（基于可达支持是否改变），并统一了SFT和RL的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 引入“可达支持”（accessible support）概念，从自由能（free-energy）视角将后训练建模为对预训练参考分布的重新加权过程。通过分析更新是否接近基模型，区分局部重新加权（能力激发）与扩展可达行为空间（能力创造）。

papers.title: Mesoscopic Regimes of Temporal Entanglement in Ergodic Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We study temporal correlations in interacting quantum systems through the influence functional of a half-infinite quantum Ising chain. Using Rényi entropies and temporal mutual information, we confirm that integrable dynamics is captured by the quasiparticle picture. In contrast, generic ergodic Hamiltonian dynamics exhibits pronounced deviations from random-circuit universality, and its generalization including a symmetry accounting for energy conservation. Instead, we find a long mesoscopic regime suggestive of a slow spectral reorganization of the influence functional. Our results reveal a rich temporal structure in generic Hamiltonian dynamics and point to limitations of existing random-circuit paradigms at experimentally and numerically relevant timescales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过影响泛函研究”、“使用Rényi熵和时间互信息”等理论分析工具，并讨论“准粒子图像”、“随机电路普适性”等理论概念，未提及任何实验或数值计算的具体细节。；研究对象：论文研究的是遍历性量子系统中的时间关联结构，具体体系为半无限量子伊辛链。物理现象为相互作用量子系统中的时间纠缠（temporal entanglement）及其在不同动力学机制下的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在遍历性哈密顿动力学中，时间关联结构存在一个长的介观区域，暗示影响泛函存在缓慢的谱重组过程，这与随机电路模型的普适性行为存在显著偏离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在遍历性哈密顿动力学中，时间关联结构存在一个长的介观区域，暗示影响泛函存在缓慢的谱重组过程，这与随机电路模型的普适性行为存在显著偏离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：揭示了在实验和数值可及的时间尺度上，通用哈密顿动力学的时间纠缠结构比随机电路模型所预测的更为丰富和复杂，并指出了现有随机电路范式的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为影响泛函（influence functional）方法。具体分析手段包括：计算Rényi熵（Rényi entropies）和时间互信息（temporal mutual information），并与可积动力学中的准粒子图像（quasiparticle picture）以及随机电路模型（random-circuit universality）进行对比。

papers.title: Quantum trajectory simulation of two-dimensional non-equilibrium steady states with a trapped ion quantum processor
papers.abstract: Digital quantum computers offer a promising route for studying complex many-body systems that are otherwise inaccessible by their classical counterparts. Capabilities including mid-circuit measurements and feedback allow for simulating the dynamics of interacting open quantum systems. Using the Quantinuum System Model H1 trapped-ion quantum computer, we experimentally realise quantum trajectories for a two-dimensional system of (interacting) particles-hard-core bosons or fermions-undergoing stochastic driving at a source and drain at opposite corners of a square lattice. We study the non-equilibrium steady state with persistent current resulting from the this in/out flow of particles. The particle statistics, presence of interactions, and introduction of a magnetic field produce measurable effects on the steady state. Our findings highlight the rich physics in this corner driven two-dimensional setup and showcases both the power and current limitations of quantum computers as a platform to study it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimentally realise、quantum computer、trapped-ion quantum processor。；研究对象：二维方形晶格中硬核玻色子或费米子体系，在源极和漏极（位于晶格对角）随机驱动下的非平衡稳态（non-equilibrium steady state）及持续电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维角驱动开放量子系统中，粒子统计性质、相互作用以及外加磁场对非平衡稳态产生可测量的影响，展示了该体系中丰富的物理现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维角驱动开放量子系统中，粒子统计性质、相互作用以及外加磁场对非平衡稳态产生可测量的影响，展示了该体系中丰富的物理现象。；创新点：首次在离子阱量子处理器上实验实现了二维开放量子系统（含相互作用粒子）的量子轨迹模拟，并研究了角驱动下的非平衡稳态及持续电流。摘要未突出说明与经典模拟或先前量子模拟的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 使用Quantinuum System Model H1离子阱量子计算机，通过数字量子计算中的中电路测量（mid-circuit measurements）和反馈（feedback）实现量子轨迹（quantum trajectories）模拟。

papers.title: Indirect Detection of Lactate Through Voltammetry Using Glassy Carbon Microelectrodes
papers.abstract: Glassy carbon (GC) microelectrodes are increasingly being used for voltametric detection of electroactive neurotransmitters such as dopamine and serotonin. However, non-electroactive molecules including lactate, glutamate, and gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) cannot be directly detected using conventional voltammetry without surface functionalization. In this study, lactate oxidase was immobilized within a chitosan matrix on lithographically patterned GC microelectrodes to enable indirect detection of lactate via enzymatic generation of hydrogen peroxide, an electroactive byproduct. The resulting hydrogen peroxide was detected using fast-scan cyclic voltammetry (FSCV), enabling indirect in vitro detection of lactate at concentrations as low as 10 nM. The functionalized GC microelectrodes were integrated into a four channel array on a 1.6 cm flexible neural probe with potential for in vivo applications. Surface morphology and bonding interactions were characterized using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. FTIR analysis confirmed successful chitosan deposition through characteristic O-H, N-H, amide, and C-O stretching bands. Hydrogen peroxide detection was concentration-dependent, while lactate detection exhibited early saturation consistent with enzyme-limited kinetics. These results demonstrate a mechanically robust GC microelectrode platform for nanomolar-level indirect lactate sensing and provide insight into the reaction-diffusion coupling governing enzyme-based electrochemical detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（如酶固定化、电化学检测、形貌表征），并使用了实验仪器（SEM、FTIR、FSCV）。；研究对象：基于玻璃碳微电极的生物传感器，用于间接检测非电活性分子乳酸。具体体系为：通过壳聚糖基质将乳酸氧化酶固定在光刻图案化的玻璃碳微电极上，利用酶促反应产生的过氧化氢进行间接检测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功构建了一种机械性能稳定的玻璃碳微电极平台，能够通过酶促反应间接检测乳酸，检测限低至纳摩尔级别（10 nM）。实验发现乳酸检测存在早期饱和现象，这受限于酶动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功构建了一种机械性能稳定的玻璃碳微电极平台，能够通过酶促反应间接检测乳酸，检测限低至纳摩尔级别（10 nM）。实验发现乳酸检测存在早期饱和现象，这受限于酶动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）将玻璃碳微电极与酶修饰相结合，实现了对非电活性分子（乳酸）的间接伏安检测，拓展了玻璃碳电极的应用范围；2）实现了在柔性神经探针上集成四通道阵列，为潜在的体内应用提供了可能；3）实现了纳摩尔级别的超低检测限。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验方法包括：1）光刻技术制备图案化玻璃碳微电极；2）将乳酸氧化酶固定在壳聚糖基质中修饰电极；3）使用快速扫描循环伏安法（FSCV）检测酶促反应产物过氧化氢；4）使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）表征电极表面形貌和化学键合。

papers.title: Can LLMs Predict Polymer Physics Just by Reading Synthesis and Processing Prose?
papers.abstract: Can large language models predict physical and mechanical polymer properties simply by reading unstructured scientific prose? Polymer performance is rarely determined by chemical structure alone; identical nominal polymers can exhibit drastically different behaviors depending on their synthesis route, processing history, morphology, and testing conditions. Yet, state-of-the-art polymer property models typically rely on structure-only representations -- such as SMILES or molecular graphs -- which strip away this vital experimental context. In this work, we introduce \textbf{PolyLM}, a natural-language-only, process- and condition-aware framework that predicts materials performance directly from full-text literature. By circumventing structural inputs entirely, PolyLM preserves the nuanced, unstructured descriptions of synthesis and processing reported by domain scientists. To train this framework, we curated an unprecedented, literature-scale dataset encompassing 185,000 scientific papers and over 276,400 unique polymer samples across 22 physical, mechanical, and thermal properties. We fine-tuned a massive 9-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and task-level uncertainty weighting. Evaluated on 68,283 held-out observations, the model achieves remarkably high predictive accuracy, establishing new state-of-the-art benchmarks for complex properties. Across the 22 diverse targets, the model achieves a median $R^2$ of 0.74, with predictions for key thermal, mechanical, and physicochemical properties frequently surpassing an $R^2$ of 0.80. These results unequivocally demonstrate that natural language is a powerful, highly scalable interface for realistic materials performance prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算与数据驱动研究）。判断依据：使用大规模语言模型（LLM）进行预测，涉及大规模数据集构建、模型微调（LoRA）和性能评估，属于计算与数据科学方法。；研究对象：聚合物材料的物理、力学和热学性能。具体涉及22种物理、力学和热学性质，如热性能、力学性能、物理化学性质等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过阅读自然语言描述（如合成路线、加工历史、测试条件等非结构化文本），大型语言模型PolyLM能够高精度预测聚合物材料的性能，在22种性质上达到中位数R²为0.74，关键热、力学和物理化学性质的R²常超过0.80，证明了自然语言可作为材料性能预测的强大且可扩展的接口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过阅读自然语言描述（如合成路线、加工历史、测试条件等非结构化文本），大型语言模型PolyLM能够高精度预测聚合物材料的性能，在22种性质上达到中位数R²为0.74，关键热、力学和物理化学性质的R²常超过0.80，证明了自然语言可作为材料性能预测的强大且可扩展的接口。；创新点：完全绕过传统的结构输入（如SMILES或分子图），仅依赖自然语言文本（合成与加工描述）进行聚合物性能预测，保留了实验上下文信息，实现了对复杂性能的高精度预测。
papers.method_zh: 构建了包含18.5万篇科学论文和超过27.64万个独特聚合物样本的大规模文献数据集；使用低秩自适应（LoRA）技术和任务级不确定性加权，微调了一个90亿参数的大语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B）；在68,283个保留样本上进行评估。

papers.title: Geometry-free prediction of inertial lift forces in microfluidic devices using deep learning
papers.abstract: Inertial microfluidic devices (IMDs) offer low-cost, high-throughput alternative techniques for many traditional particle- (or cell-) manipulation tasks, but simulating them requires being able to predict particle migration, and thus particle lift forces, under a variety of possible channel geometries. Recent work has demonstrated that machine learning models can be used to drastically speed up these numerical simulations, but doing so required training individual models for every unique channel cross-section type (e.g., rectangular, triangular) -- shifting the burden from the simulation step to the training step. In this paper, we develop a novel approach for predicting particle lift forces that contains no explicit geometric parameters. We train a neural network model using a new parameter set and show that while it performs comparably to existing models on channel geometries in the training set, it is able to generalize to unseen channel geometries far more effectively. We show that the lift force model developed herein can be easily transferred to particle tracing simulation software, where it is capable of predicting particle migration patterns consistent with the literature across a variety of channel designs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：deep learning、neural network model、numerical simulations、predicting particle lift forces）；研究对象：微流控装置中颗粒（或细胞）在惯性力作用下的迁移行为，具体为颗粒所受的惯性升力（inertial lift forces）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种不含显式几何参数的神经网络模型，能够有效预测不同通道截面形状下的颗粒升力，且对训练集中未出现的通道几何形状具有更强的泛化能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种不含显式几何参数的神经网络模型，能够有效预测不同通道截面形状下的颗粒升力，且对训练集中未出现的通道几何形状具有更强的泛化能力。；创新点：现有机器学习模型需针对每种通道截面类型（如矩形、三角形）单独训练，而本工作开发的方法不包含显式几何参数，从而实现了对未见通道几何形状的有效泛化，将训练负担从逐几何类型训练转移到单一模型训练。
papers.method_zh: 采用深度学习中的神经网络模型，使用新的参数集进行训练，并将训练好的升力模型集成到粒子追踪模拟软件中，用于预测颗粒迁移模式。

papers.title: Crystal Fractional Graph Neural Network for Energy Prediction of High-Entropy Alloys
papers.abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) have attracted growing attention for their exceptional mechanical and thermal properties arising from complex atomic configurations. In this paper, we propose crystal fractional graph neural network for predicting the energy of high-entropy alloys by explicitly integrating both local atomic environments and global compositional information. The model consists of three components: a crystal graph neural network, which employs graph attention network layers to learn local interactions among 16 on-site atoms within the crystal lattice; fractional neural network, a fully connected network that embeds the global fraction of constituent elements; and feature fusion neural network, which fuses the outputs of the two submodels to predict the total crystal energy. We train the model on a dataset of 1,049 crystal structures and validate it on 198 quaternary structures, optimizing all hyperparameters via Optuna. Our results show that our model achieves an RMSE comparable to first-principles calculations and maintains high accuracy even for low-energy configurations. However, the model exhibits limitations in handling large crystal cells, which we aim to address in future work to extend its applicability to more complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：graph neural network、first-principles calculations、RMSE。；研究对象：高熵合金（High-entropy alloys, HEAs）的晶体能量预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的晶体分数图神经网络模型在预测高熵合金能量时，其均方根误差（RMSE）可与第一性原理计算相当，且对低能构型仍保持高精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的晶体分数图神经网络模型在预测高熵合金能量时，其均方根误差（RMSE）可与第一性原理计算相当，且对低能构型仍保持高精度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 晶体分数图神经网络（Crystal Fractional Graph Neural Network），包含三个子网络：晶体图神经网络（使用图注意力网络层学习晶格内16个原位原子的局域相互作用）、分数神经网络（全连接网络嵌入组成元素的全局分数）、特征融合神经网络（融合两个子网络输出以预测总晶体能量）。模型在1049个晶体结构上训练，在198个四元结构上验证，超参数通过Optuna优化。
