Our measurements with superconducting Nb routing lines reveal that the routing increases the in-plane thermal conductance of the system, but the substrate remains the dominant heat path. These results highlight the critical role of the substrate choice within quantum systems and underscore the importance of function partitioning through 3D integration approaches for more efficient thermal management in quantum architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental thermal study、measurements、test vehicle）；研究对象：量子集成系统中衬底材料（高阻硅、低阻硅、硼硅玻璃、蓝宝石）的亚开尔文热导率，以及片上布线（超导铌布线）对系统热导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阻硅在300 mK下热导率最高（5×10⁻² W/m·K），而低阻硅、硼硅玻璃和蓝宝石热导率较低（分别为8×10⁻⁴、2×10⁻³、2×10⁻³ W/m·K）；片上布线会增加系统面内热导，但衬底仍是主要热传导路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阻硅在300 mK下热导率最高（5×10⁻² W/m·K），而低阻硅、硼硅玻璃和蓝宝石热导率较低（分别为8×10⁻⁴、2×10⁻³、2×10⁻³ W/m·K）；片上布线会增加系统面内热导，但衬底仍是主要热传导路径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了四种衬底材料在亚开尔文温区的热导率；采用基于有限元非平衡格林函数（finite-element non-equilibrium Green's function）方法评估弹道电导，提取声子平均自由程；使用专用测试结构（dedicated test vehicle）测量超导铌布线对系统热导的影响。

papers.title: Transformation-mediated twinning governs plasticity in body-centered cubic nanocrystals under extreme loading
papers.abstract: Plasticity in body-centered cubic (BCC) nanocrystals is often associated with twin nucleation phenomena under extreme loading conditions. Here, we reveal unconventional twinning pathways that operate at the intersection of crystal plasticity and structural phase transitions. We show that the classical shear-driven twinning mode becomes progressively suppressed with increasing pressure, giving rise to transformation-mediated twinning pathways involving transient HCP or FCC phases. In BCC Fe, Ta, and Nb nanocrystals of moderate elastic stiffness, plasticity is consistently initiated by an elastic instability that triggers a dual-shuffle process mediated by stable or metastable hexagonal closed-packed (HCP) phases. This pathway operates independently of the characteristic {112} twin boundary planes and is driven by compression, challenging the conceptual paradigm for metal plasticity in which plastic deformation arises from shear stresses resolved on specific planes. By contrast, in the archetypal elastically stiffer BCC Mo and W nanocrystals, plastic deformation proceeds via two alternative twinning pathways associated with shear-driven elastic instabilities mediated by highly-distorted face-centered cubic (FCC) phases. Comprehensive analyses of the energy landscapes to the competing nanoscale twinning modes provide mechanistic insight into their activation, establishing a unified framework for transformation-mediated twinning in BCC nanocrystals across a broad range of loading conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：揭示（reveal）、分析（analyses）、能量景观（energy landscapes）、统一框架（unified framework），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：体心立方（BCC）纳米晶体在极端加载条件下的塑性变形机制，具体涉及BCC Fe、Ta、Nb、Mo和W纳米晶体中的孪晶形核与结构相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BCC纳米晶体中，经典剪切驱动孪晶模式随压力增加被抑制，转而出现由瞬态HCP或FCC相介导的转变介导孪晶路径；弹性刚度适中的BCC金属（Fe、Ta、Nb）通过压缩驱动的双移位过程经HCP相发生塑性变形，而弹性刚度较大的BCC金属（Mo、W）则通过剪切驱动弹性失稳经高度畸变的FCC相发生塑性变形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BCC纳米晶体中，经典剪切驱动孪晶模式随压力增加被抑制，转而出现由瞬态HCP或FCC相介导的转变介导孪晶路径；弹性刚度适中的BCC金属（Fe、Ta、Nb）通过压缩驱动的双移位过程经HCP相发生塑性变形，而弹性刚度较大的BCC金属（Mo、W）则通过剪切驱动弹性失稳经高度畸变的FCC相发生塑性变形。；创新点：揭示了与经典{112}孪晶界平面无关的、由压缩驱动的双移位孪晶路径，挑战了传统金属塑性中塑性变形源于特定晶面剪切应力的概念范式，并建立了涵盖不同弹性刚度BCC纳米晶体的转变介导孪晶统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 通过能量景观分析（energy landscape analyses）对竞争性纳米尺度孪晶模式的激活进行机制性研究，建立了统一的理论框架。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如DFT、分子动力学等）。

papers.title: Dominant Role of Sulphur divacancy in Charge Trapping Dynamics in MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: Intrinsic defects govern carrier trapping and recombination in two-dimensional semiconductors, yet the microscopic origin of defect-dependent capture dynamics remains unclear. Here, we compute carrier capture coefficients of vacancy defects, treating monolayer MoS$_2$ as a prototype, from first principles. We find that the single Sulphur vacancy forms a shallow defect with a small capture coefficient of $\sim 10^{-16}\ \mathrm{cm}^3/\mathrm{s}$, whereas the Sulphur divacancy exhibits a capture coefficient larger by seven orders of magnitude, $\sim 10^{-9}\ \mathrm{cm}^3/\mathrm{s}$, despite being only moderately deeper in energy. This enhancement originates from strong lattice relaxation enabling efficient multiphonon capture. Consequently, single vacancies contribute weakly to trapping, while Sulphur divacancies dominate nonradiative recombination and reduce quantum yield. In contrast, molybdenum vacancies and Sulphur antisites, although deep, show much smaller capture coefficients, indicating a limited role in carrier trapping in n-type devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first principles、compute、capture coefficients）；研究对象：单层MoS₂中的空位缺陷（硫单空位、硫双空位、钼空位、硫反位）及其对载流子捕获与复合动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硫双空位尽管能级仅中等深度，但其载流子捕获系数比硫单空位大七个数量级（~10⁻⁹ cm³/s vs ~10⁻¹⁶ cm³/s），主导非辐射复合并降低量子产率；而钼空位和硫反位虽为深能级缺陷，但捕获系数很小，在n型器件中对载流子捕获作用有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硫双空位尽管能级仅中等深度，但其载流子捕获系数比硫单空位大七个数量级（~10⁻⁹ cm³/s vs ~10⁻¹⁶ cm³/s），主导非辐射复合并降低量子产率；而钼空位和硫反位虽为深能级缺陷，但捕获系数很小，在n型器件中对载流子捕获作用有限。；创新点：揭示了硫双空位因强晶格弛豫实现高效多声子捕获，从而在能量上仅中等深度却具有极大捕获系数的微观机制，挑战了传统上仅依赖缺陷能级深度判断捕获能力的观点。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如DFT、GW、多声子捕获理论等），计算了不同空位缺陷的载流子捕获系数。

papers.title: Floquet-induced suppression of thermalization in a quasiperiodic Ising chain
papers.abstract: Many-body localized (MBL) systems are known to thermalize in periodically driven systems. In this work, we demonstrate that under proper driving protocol, this thermalization this thermalization can be resisted such that the MBL phase turns into a non-ergodic extended phase, known as the many-body critical (MBC) phase. Considering a kicked quasiperiodic Ising chain, we show that while at high-frequency driving the ergodic, MBL, and the MBC phases coexist, at moderate driving frequencies the MBL phase is completely suppressed and the MBC phase proliferates in the parameter space. Using quasienergy statistics, Floquet eigenstates, autocorrelation dynamics, and entanglement growth, we characterize the emergent phases and identify non-monotonic signatures revealing richness of the nonergodic phases. Our results establish Floquet driving as a powerful route to stabilizing nonergodic extended many-body phases beyond the conventional Floquet-MBL paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论分析、数值计算（准能级统计、Floquet本征态、自关联动力学、纠缠增长）。；研究对象：准周期伊辛链中的多体局域化（MBL）系统，在周期驱动（Floquet）下的热化抑制与非遍历扩展相（多体临界相，MBC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在适当的周期驱动协议下，准周期伊辛链中的多体局域化相可以被完全抑制，并在参数空间中扩展出非遍历的多体临界相，从而超越传统的Floquet-MBL范式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在适当的周期驱动协议下，准周期伊辛链中的多体局域化相可以被完全抑制，并在参数空间中扩展出非遍历的多体临界相，从而超越传统的Floquet-MBL范式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算。具体包括：准能级统计、Floquet本征态分析、自关联函数动力学、纠缠熵增长等表征手段。

papers.title: Probing critical phases in quasiperiodic systems via subsystem information capacity
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate the entanglement dynamics of quasiperiodic systems across their extended, critical, and localized phases, aiming to identify dynamical signatures that can clearly distinguish the critical phase from the other two. Focusing on the extended Harper model, we complement the half-chain entanglement entropy with the spatially resolved subsystem information capacity (SIC) and demonstrate that the critical phase exhibits a pronounced spatial heterogeneity that is absent in the extended and localized phases. In the steady state, the SIC reveals a stepwise ramp as a function of subsystem size, reflecting an underlying fragmentation of the chain into weakly connected subregions. Dynamically, information initially localized within such a subregion can undergo coherent long-lived oscillations, dubbed subregion echoes, whose period scales with the subregion length, in quantitative agreement with a quasiparticle picture of confined quasiparticle reflections. We trace this internal fragmentation to the incommensurately distributed zeros (IDZs) in the off-diagonal hopping terms of the Hamiltonian. To establish the generality of the SIC as a diagnostic tool, we further apply it to a mobility-edge phase with coexisting extended and localized states and to a critical phase that does not originate from IDZ fragmentation, and show that the SIC can cleanly distinguish these scenarios through their distinct steady-state profiles, initial-site sensitivities and the presence of subregion echoes. Our results establish the SIC as a powerful real-space probe for diagnosing critical phases and for uncovering the bottlenecked connectivity that underlies their multifractal structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：entanglement dynamics（纠缠动力学），quasiparticle picture（准粒子图像），数值模拟分析。；研究对象：准周期系统中的临界相（critical phase），具体以扩展哈珀模型（extended Harper model）为研究对象，并推广至具有迁移率边（mobility edge）的体系及非IDZ起源的临界相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 子系统信息容量（SIC）能够清晰区分准周期系统的扩展相、临界相和局域相：临界相表现出显著的空间异质性，其稳态SIC随子系统大小呈阶梯状上升，并存在“子区域回波”（subregion echoes）这一动力学特征，反映了链内部弱连接子区域的碎片化结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：子系统信息容量（SIC）能够清晰区分准周期系统的扩展相、临界相和局域相：临界相表现出显著的空间异质性，其稳态SIC随子系统大小呈阶梯状上升，并存在“子区域回波”（subregion echoes）这一动力学特征，反映了链内部弱连接子区域的碎片化结构。；创新点：首次提出将子系统信息容量（SIC）作为诊断准周期系统临界相的有效实空间探针，揭示了临界相中由IDZ导致的瓶颈式连接性（bottlenecked connectivity）及其与多分形结构的关联，并展示了SIC在区分不同临界相起源（如IDZ碎片化与非IDZ碎片化）方面的能力。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算半链纠缠熵和空间分辨的子系统信息容量（SIC），分析准周期系统在不同相（扩展、临界、局域）下的纠缠动力学；利用准粒子图像解释子区域回波的周期与子区域长度的标度关系；通过分析哈密顿量非对角跃迁项中的非公度分布零点（IDZs）解释内部碎片化机制。

papers.title: Topological spin freezing in frustrated quantum materials
papers.abstract: Competing interactions, non-trivial electronic band topology, quantum fluctuations, and the interplay between emergent degrees of freedom in frustrated quantum materials can give rise to a wide range of exotic phenomena. Glassy dynamics, originally studied in amorphous materials and biological systems, has recently attracted considerable interest in quantum condensed matter, particularly in relation to the collective behavior of spins, quasiparticle excitations, and topological spin textures. Here, we investigate the emergence of unconventional glassy spin dynamics in a broad class of frustrated quantum materials, where spin freezing exhibit distinct signatures in both thermodynamic and microscopic measurements. Using a comprehensive set of experimental probes, including thermodynamic, NMR, ($μ$SR), and neutron scattering, we identify characteristic signatures of topological spin-glass behavior and these complementary techniques reveal unconventional spin dynamics, short-range spin correlations, emergent low-energy excitations, and glassy behavior of topological origins, distinguishing these states from conventional spin glasses and disordered magnets. Furthermore, we discuss the role of hydrodynamic spin modes in governing glassy dynamics and the emergence of spin-jam states in frustrated lattices, providing a unified framework for understanding unconventional spin freezing of topological origin and bridging experimental observations with theoretical models. This review aims to advance our understanding of collective many-body phenomena arising from competing interactions, topological defects, collective excitations, quantum entanglement, and symmetry constraints. Such insights may facilitate the discovery and design of novel quantum materials and help address fundamental questions in contemporary condensed matter physics, with potential implications for future quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/混合类型（关键词：review, experimental probes, theoretical models, unified framework）；研究对象：受挫量子材料中拓扑起源的自旋冻结现象，包括拓扑自旋玻璃、自旋堵塞态（spin-jam states）等非常规玻璃态自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多种受挫量子材料中，自旋冻结表现出拓扑起源的非常规特征，与传统的自旋玻璃和无序磁体不同，其动力学由拓扑自旋纹理、短程自旋关联和低能激发主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多种受挫量子材料中，自旋冻结表现出拓扑起源的非常规特征，与传统的自旋玻璃和无序磁体不同，其动力学由拓扑自旋纹理、短程自旋关联和低能激发主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但指出该综述通过多种互补实验技术识别了拓扑自旋玻璃的特征信号，并提出了一个统一的理论框架来理解拓扑起源的非常规自旋冻结，桥接了实验与理论模型。）
papers.method_zh: 综合使用热力学测量、核磁共振（NMR）、μ子自旋旋转（μSR）和中子散射等实验手段，并结合流体动力学自旋模式等理论框架。

papers.title: Quantum oscillations and nonsaturating magnetoresistivity in nodal-line semimetals
papers.abstract: Understanding the magnetotransport behaviors in topological systems remains alluring, as a lot of intrinsic information could be extracted, e.g., the band structures, Berry phase, Fermi surface, carrier density, and so on. Motivated by the recent magnetotransport developments in nodal-line semimetal, EuGa4, in this paper, we will study the magnetotransport properties of the system, focusing on the quantum oscillations and nonsaturating magnetoresistivity (MR). Firstly, we analyze the chemical potential and magnetoconductivity oscillations with the magnetic field and reveal that there exist two distinct oscillation frequencies, which are caused by the characteristic torus Fermi surface and can be regarded as an important experimental signature of nodal-line semimetals. Then we calculate the MR and find that although the MR is nonsaturating with the magnetic field in the low-energy region, the MR ratio is much smaller than that reported in the experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：analyze、calculate、theoretical study。；研究对象：节线半金属（nodal-line semimetals）中的磁输运行为，具体以EuGa₄为模型体系，聚焦量子振荡和非饱和磁电阻（MR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了节线半金属中存在两种由环面费米面（torus Fermi surface）引起的不同振荡频率，可作为节线半金属的重要实验特征；同时发现低能区磁电阻虽不饱和，但其比值远小于实验报道值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了节线半金属中存在两种由环面费米面（torus Fermi surface）引起的不同振荡频率，可作为节线半金属的重要实验特征；同时发现低能区磁电阻虽不饱和，但其比值远小于实验报道值。；创新点：首次将量子振荡中的双频率特征与节线半金属的环面费米面结构直接关联，提出该双频率可作为节线半金属的实验判据。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析化学势和磁导率随磁场的变化，计算磁电阻（MR）随磁场的变化关系。

papers.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction as a coherence diagnostic for chirality-induced spin selectivity
papers.abstract: Whether chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) reflects coherent SU(2) spin rotation or incoherent spin-dependent filtering is a central unresolved question in molecular spintronics, with implications ranging from asymmetric chemistry to quantum information. We show that these two scenarios are distinguishable by a sharp symmetry criterion on the superexchange interaction mediated by a chiral molecular bridge. Coherent CISS, implemented as a unitary spin rotation of the tunneling electron, generates a giant Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction with ratio |D|/JH up to 3, which is two orders of magnitude beyond intrinsic Rashba spin-orbit coupling in Si/SiGe. Incoherent CISS, represented by any Hermitian (non-unitary but spin-diagonal) tunneling matrix, produces D = 0 identically; we prove this as a structural theorem, reinforced by a Lindblad argument that dissipative spin filtering cannot modify virtual-tunneling-mediated superexchange. The DM interaction thus serves as a coherence order parameter, nonzero only when quantum amplitudes for opposite-spin transmission maintain a fixed relative phase. We derive closed-form angular, enantiomeric, and sensitivity signatures and show that the critical coherent rotation angle lies two orders of magnitude below current transport-inferred values and is accessible to existing 10 kHz exchange spectroscopy in gate-defined quantum dots. Five candidate molecules are predicted to exceed this threshold by one to two orders of magnitude even in a conservative interface-amplification scenario. The proposed measurement converts a long-standing transport controversy into a binary spin-qubit experiment with quantum-amplitude resolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：We show、We prove、We derive、structural theorem、Lindblad argument。；研究对象：手性分子体系中的手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应，具体关注其物理机制是相干SU(2)自旋旋转还是非相干自旋依赖过滤。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用可作为区分相干与非相干CISS的序参量：相干CISS产生巨大的DM相互作用（|D|/JH可达3），而非相干CISS则严格为零。该DM相互作用可作为自旋量子比特实验中的可观测信号，将输运争议转化为量子振幅分辨的测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用可作为区分相干与非相干CISS的序参量：相干CISS产生巨大的DM相互作用（|D|/JH可达3），而非相干CISS则严格为零。该DM相互作用可作为自旋量子比特实验中的可观测信号，将输运争议转化为量子振幅分辨的测量。；创新点：首次提出将DM相互作用作为CISS相干性的序参量，并证明其可作为区分相干与非相干CISS的严格对称性判据；预测临界相干旋转角比当前输运实验推断值低两个数量级，且可通过现有10 kHz交换谱学在门控量子点中测量。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于超交换相互作用的对称性判据，推导了手性分子桥介导的相干与非相干隧穿矩阵的数学形式；使用Lindblad主方程论证耗散自旋过滤无法修改虚隧穿介导的超交换；给出了DM相互作用的角依赖、对映体依赖和灵敏度特征的闭合形式解析解。

papers.title: Massive Mitigation of Transport AC Losses in Superconducting Hybrid CORC-TSTC Cables
papers.abstract: High-current superconducting cables are emerging as key enablers for next-generation power transmission systems; however, their deployment is often limited by transport AC losses. Hybrid superconducting cables combining Conductor-on-Round-Core (CORC) and Twisted Stacked-Tape Conductor (TSTC) architectures have recently been proposed as a promising route toward cables with high current capacity and compact form factors. However, their electrodynamic response under transport current operation remains poorly understood, particularly regarding how current injection conditions govern internal current redistribution. Here, we employ a fully-3D electromagnetic model, previously validated against magnetisation experiments in equivalent cables, to investigate the influence of current injection strategy on the electrodynamics of hybrid CORC-TSTC cables under self-field conditions. By comparing configurations in which the total current is either injected through a common connection between the CORC and TSTC conductors (non-insulated feeding) or supplied independently to each conductor (insulated feeding), we show that electrical coupling in non-insulated designs leads to strong current redistribution, pronounced waveform distortion and elevated AC losses once the CORC layers approach magnetic saturation. In contrast, independent current feeding suppresses inter-conductor current exchange, stabilises the current waveforms, and exhibits an outstanding reduction in transport AC losses of up to 90% at practical operating currents, compared with conventional feeding schemes. These findings reveal the central role of the current injection strategy in governing the internal electrodynamics and energy dissipation of hybrid superconducting cables, and identify the electrical decoupling of the constituent conductors at the feeding point as a simple and scalable route toward ultra-efficient power cables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“采用全三维电磁模型”（fully-3D electromagnetic model），且该模型已通过磁化实验验证，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：混合型高温超导电缆（hybrid CORC-TSTC cables）在自场条件下的交流输运损耗（transport AC losses）及电流注入策略对内部电流重分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在混合CORC-TSTC超导电缆中，采用独立电流馈电（绝缘馈电）方式可抑制导体间的电流交换，稳定电流波形，并在实际工作电流下将交流输运损耗降低高达90%，相比传统非绝缘馈电方案具有显著优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在混合CORC-TSTC超导电缆中，采用独立电流馈电（绝缘馈电）方式可抑制导体间的电流交换，稳定电流波形，并在实际工作电流下将交流输运损耗降低高达90%，相比传统非绝缘馈电方案具有显著优势。；创新点：首次系统揭示了电流注入策略（特别是馈电点处导体间的电耦合/去耦）对混合型超导电缆内部电动力学和能量耗散的决定性作用，并提出了通过馈电点处导体电去耦实现超高效电力电缆的简单可扩展方案。
papers.method_zh: 使用全三维电磁模型（fully-3D electromagnetic model），该模型先前已通过与等效电缆的磁化实验对比得到验证。研究对比了两种电流注入策略：非绝缘馈电（总电流通过CORC与TSTC导体的公共连接注入）与绝缘馈电（各导体独立供电）。

papers.title: Emergent conserved quantities via irreversibility
papers.abstract: Conserved quantities increasingly underpin the inference of physical models. Recently new conserved quantities have been found in this context, that currently lack an interpretation. Here, we show that irreversible reactions in CRNs and Markov Chains lead to emergent conservation laws and broken cycles. Linearly dependent currents - characterized by the "co-production index" - arise due to irreversible reactions. We derive a law relating conserved quantities, broken cycles, and co-production. This resolves a recent conundrum posed by a machine-discovered candidate for a non-integer conservation law. Our findings introduce heretofore overlooked extensions to a widely used index law for CRNs and Markov Chains that undercounts conservation laws. This furnishes new tools and immediate applications for the inference and analysis of models based on conservation laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive a law”“introduce heretofore overlooked extensions”等表述，属于理论推导与模型分析。；研究对象：化学反应网络（CRNs）和马尔可夫链中的守恒量、不可逆反应导致的涌现守恒律及破缺循环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不可逆反应会导致化学反应网络和马尔可夫链中出现涌现的守恒律和破缺循环，并由此推导出守恒量、破缺循环与“共生产指数”之间的关系，解决了此前机器学习发现非整数守恒律的谜题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不可逆反应会导致化学反应网络和马尔可夫链中出现涌现的守恒律和破缺循环，并由此推导出守恒量、破缺循环与“共生产指数”之间的关系，解决了此前机器学习发现非整数守恒律的谜题。；创新点：揭示了不可逆反应导致涌现守恒律的机制，并修正了此前低估守恒律数量的索引律，为基于守恒律的模型推断与分析提供了新工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与索引律分析。具体包括：利用“共生产指数”表征线性相关的电流，推导守恒量、破缺循环与共生产指数之间的定律，并扩展了广泛使用的CRN与马尔可夫链索引律。

papers.title: Lack of self-averaging of the critical internal energy in a weakly-disordered Baxter model
papers.abstract: We investigate the first two moments of the critical internal energy $E$ in a weakly disordered two-dimensional Baxter eight-vertex model as a function of the system size $L$, evaluated at the pseudo-critical point. Disorder is introduced via an equivalent representation of the pure eight-vertex model in terms of two ferromagnetic Ising models coupled by a four-spin interaction of strength $g_0$, where the Ising couplings consist of a uniform ferromagnetic part $J>0$ supplemented by weak Gaussian spatial disorder. In the critical regime, the model is formulated in terms of interacting Grassmann-Majorana spinor fields with quartic interactions and analyzed, for small positive $g_0$, using a combination of replica and renormalization-group methods. We also run extensive numerical simulations measuring the critical internal energy. Our results show that its relative variance increases with $L$ and approaches a finite constant as $L \to \infty$ for both $\pm g_0$. Hence, fluctuations remain relevant independently of the sign of $g_0$ (and thus of the specific-heat exponent), implying a lack of self-averaging of both the critical internal energy and the free energy. Consequently, reliable estimates of these quantities require averaging over many disorder realizations. In addition, we numerically confirm earlier predictions concerning the absence of self-averaging of the critical internal energy in the disordered Ising model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算与数值模拟混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用复制和重整化群方法”进行理论分析，并“运行了广泛的数值模拟”测量临界内能。；研究对象：弱无序二维Baxter八顶点模型在伪临界点处的临界内能统计行为，特别是其自平均性质（self-averaging）的缺失问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱无序Baxter模型中，临界内能的相对方差随系统尺寸L增大并趋于有限常数，表明临界内能和自由能均缺乏自平均性，因此需要大量无序样本的平均才能获得可靠估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱无序Baxter模型中，临界内能的相对方差随系统尺寸L增大并趋于有限常数，表明临界内能和自由能均缺乏自平均性，因此需要大量无序样本的平均才能获得可靠估计。；创新点：首次在弱无序Baxter模型中系统证明了临界内能缺乏自平均性，且该行为与比热指数符号（即g0正负）无关；同时数值验证了此前关于无序Ising模型临界内能缺乏自平均性的理论预言。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：将纯八顶点模型等价表示为两个铁磁Ising模型通过四自旋耦合（强度g0）相互作用，引入弱高斯空间无序，在临界区用Grassmann-Majorana旋量场和四费米子相互作用描述，结合复制方法和重整化群分析。数值方面：对正负g0均进行了大规模蒙特卡洛模拟，测量临界内能。

papers.title: Intrinsic Floquet Generation and $1/I$ Quantum Oscillations in a Sliding Charge-Density Wave
papers.abstract: The realization of intrinsic, tunable high-frequency quantum states without external radiation is a major goal in condensed matter physics and quantum device engineering. Here, we demonstrate that a uniformly sliding charge-density wave (CDW) acts as an intrinsic dc-to-ac converter, transforming spatial periodicity into temporal periodicity to realize a unique periodically driven quantum state. We show that the isolated sliding-CDW problem is exactly solvable in Floquet form, yielding split gap edges and a ladder of Floquet sidebands. Using this exact solution, we reveal that weak-probe tunneling spectroscopy naturally yields an inverse-current ($1/I$) oscillation as a fixed-bias cut of the sideband ladder. Matching the observed oscillation period to theory indicates that the macroscopic current must percolate through a highly localized coherent filament, with an effective channel number orders of magnitude smaller than the geometric chain count. Furthermore, using a segmented multiterminal model, we demonstrate that inelastic phase-slip dephasing near the contacts explains the strong suppression of oscillation visibility on outer voltage probes. Ultimately, our results provide a rigorous transport interpretation of the striking $1/I$ quantum oscillations recently observed in quasi-one-dimensional CDW insulators. More broadly, they highlight a universal spatial-to-temporal conversion mechanism where the insulating gap protects Floquet coherence, offering a novel paradigm for intrinsically driven quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、exactly solvable in Floquet form、reveal、provide a rigorous transport interpretation）；研究对象：滑动电荷密度波（sliding CDW）体系中的内禀Floquet态生成与量子振荡输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀滑动的电荷密度波可作为内禀直流-交流转换器，产生Floquet边带，其弱探针隧穿谱在固定偏压下呈现逆电流（1/I）量子振荡；该振荡周期表明宏观电流必须通过高度局域的相干细丝（filament）输运，有效通道数远小于几何链数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀滑动的电荷密度波可作为内禀直流-交流转换器，产生Floquet边带，其弱探针隧穿谱在固定偏压下呈现逆电流（1/I）量子振荡；该振荡周期表明宏观电流必须通过高度局域的相干细丝（filament）输运，有效通道数远小于几何链数。；创新点：首次从理论上严格解释了近期在准一维CDW绝缘体中观测到的1/I量子振荡，揭示了无外辐射条件下内禀周期驱动量子态的实现机制，并指出绝缘能隙保护Floquet相干性的普适时空转换机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用Floquet形式精确求解孤立滑动CDW问题，得到能隙分裂边带和Floquet边带阶梯；结合分段多端模型分析非弹性相滑移退相干对振荡可见度的影响。

papers.title: Unraveling the Origin of Ferrimagnetic Signatures in (Fe,Mn,Ga)2O3 Bixbyites: The Role of Structurally-Undetectable Spinel Impurities
papers.abstract: The cubic Fe2-xMnxO3 is an intriguing material that has recently been investigated for various applications, including lithium-ion battery anodes, catalysts, energy storage media, humidity sensors, and photocatalysts. Despite its wide range of promising applications, the magnetic properties of Fe2-xMnxO3 remain controversial, with different sources reporting conflicting information regarding the type of magnetic ordering, phase transition temperature, and magnetic moment of this compound. This work presents a study of the magnetic state of three Fe2-xMnxO3:Ga solid solutions with varying Mn:Fe:Ga ratios, along with one gallium-free Fe2-xMnxO3 reference sample. We performed a detailed analysis of the actual chemical composition and crystal structure of the synthesized samples using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX), powder X-ray diffraction (XRD), and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to evaluate compositional differences. The magnetic states of the three Fe2-xMnxO3:Ga samples and the gallium-free Fe2-xMnxO3 were investigated using magnetometry and Mossbauer spectroscopy. The low-temperature magnetic anomalies were found to be more consistent with spin-glass-like freezing than with conventional long-range antiferromagnetic ordering. Although variations in magnetic behavior were observed and found to depend on composition and the cooling rate during synthesis, our results demonstrate that these factors do not account for the drastically different magnetic properties reported for similar bixbyite-type oxides. Instead, the apparent room-temperature ferrimagnetism observed in one sample is most likely extrinsic and can be attributed to a trace spinel-type impurity phase, as supported by magnetizations and ESR measurements. Thus, the origin of these discrepancies lies primarily in the chemical purity of the samples and, to a significant extent, in the synthesis technique employed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用EDX、XRD、XAS、磁强计、穆斯堡尔谱、ESR等实验手段。；研究对象：立方相Fe₂₋ₓMnₓO₃（黑铁锰矿型氧化物）及其掺Ga固溶体的磁性起源问题，特别是低温磁异常和室温铁磁信号的来源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低温磁异常更符合自旋玻璃冻结行为，而非传统长程反铁磁有序；室温铁磁信号是外禀的，源于样品中痕量的尖晶石型杂质相，而非黑铁锰矿主相的本征磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低温磁异常更符合自旋玻璃冻结行为，而非传统长程反铁磁有序；室温铁磁信号是外禀的，源于样品中痕量的尖晶石型杂质相，而非黑铁锰矿主相的本征磁性。；创新点：揭示了文献中关于Fe₂₋ₓMnₓO₃磁性争议的根本原因——并非成分或冷却速率差异，而是合成过程中引入的痕量尖晶石杂质相导致了外禀的铁磁信号。
papers.method_zh: 能量色散X射线光谱（EDX）、粉末X射线衍射（XRD）、X射线吸收光谱（XAS）用于成分与结构分析；磁强计（磁化率测量）和穆斯堡尔谱用于磁性表征；电子自旋共振（ESR）用于支持杂质相归属。

papers.title: Fermi energy Weyl nodes in $\mathbf{AM}$Te$_4$ ($\mathbf{A}$=Ta, Nb, $\mathbf{M}$=Ir, Rh)
papers.abstract: Key aspects of the quantum oscillations and magnetoresistance in Weyl semimetals $AM$Te$_4$ ($A$=Nb,Ta, $M$=Rh, Ir) persist as open questions, obscuring the link between their topological electronic structure and practical implementations. Employing a generalised search procedure, we carry out a comprehensive scan of WPs accounting for all the subbands close to the Fermi energy, and show that this dramatically alters the WP landscape in these compounds. In particular, we predict these compounds to feature WPs within a few meV of the Fermi energy which significantly influence their properties. Remarkably, most of the considered compounds host WPs of more than one type, including NbRhTe$_4$ which hosts type-I, II and III Weyl points. Our comparative analysis of structure and fidelity of computational parameters/models not only provides a detailed mapping of the complex electronic structure in these compounds, but also clarifies quantum oscillations and magnetoresistance observations in this family, bridging the gap between theory and experiments and offering a framework for precise tunability of WPs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“generalised search procedure”、“comprehensive scan of WPs”、“computational parameters/models”等关键词，表明主要采用计算扫描和理论建模方法。；研究对象：Weyl半金属家族AMTe₄（A=Ta, Nb, M=Ir, Rh），具体包括NbRhTe₄等化合物，以及其拓扑电子结构、量子振荡和磁电阻现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该家族化合物在费米能附近几meV范围内存在Weyl节点，且多数化合物（如NbRhTe₄）同时拥有类型I、II和III的Weyl节点，显著影响其物理性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该家族化合物在费米能附近几meV范围内存在Weyl节点，且多数化合物（如NbRhTe₄）同时拥有类型I、II和III的Weyl节点，显著影响其物理性质。；创新点：通过全面考虑费米能附近所有子带，大幅改变了此前对这些化合物中Weyl节点分布的认识，并首次预测了多种类型Weyl节点共存（如NbRhTe₄中的I、II、III型），为解释量子振荡和磁电阻实验提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义搜索程序，对所有靠近费米能的子带进行系统扫描，以全面识别Weyl节点；同时进行结构保真度和计算参数/模型的比较分析。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Projected and Unprojected Schemes for Micromagnetic Simulations
papers.abstract: In micromagnetic simulations, the constant magnitude of the magnetization can be derived from the continuity equation. Since the time evolution of the magnetization in the continuity equation is perpendicular to the plane determined by the magnetization and the effective field, taking the inner product of both sides of the model with the magnetization shows that the evolution rate of the magnitude of the magnetization is zero, thus keeping the magnitude constant. From this perspective, the equation itself can maintain the constraint of constant magnetization magnitude. We discretized the continuity equation and compared two first-order semi-implicit strategies in time: one is the implicit Gauss-Seidel method, and the other is the semi-implicit Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF) method. We considered the comparison between these two schemes with and without the projection step. The results of micromagnetic simulations show that when the dissipation coefficient is large, the implicit Gauss-Seidel method without the projection step has significant differences from the method with the projection step in both the achieved steady state and domain wall motion. When an appropriate dissipation coefficient is selected, the difference between the two narrows, and both the steady state and domain wall motion can be simulated. For the other method, BDF1, whether the dissipation coefficient is large or small, the results with and without the projection step are quite consistent, and it can effectively simulate the domain wall motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）、“discretized”（离散化）、“first-order semi-implicit strategies”（一阶半隐式策略）。；研究对象：微磁模拟中磁化强度矢量的时间演化，具体关注磁化强度大小恒定的约束条件，以及不同数值方案（投影与非投影）对模拟结果的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当耗散系数较大时，无投影步的隐式高斯-赛德尔方法与有投影步的方法在稳态和畴壁运动上存在显著差异；而BDF1方法无论耗散系数大小，有无投影步的结果均高度一致，能有效模拟畴壁运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当耗散系数较大时，无投影步的隐式高斯-赛德尔方法与有投影步的方法在稳态和畴壁运动上存在显著差异；而BDF1方法无论耗散系数大小，有无投影步的结果均高度一致，能有效模拟畴壁运动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种一阶半隐式时间离散策略：隐式高斯-赛德尔方法和半隐式后向微分公式（BDF1）方法，分别在有/无投影步的情况下进行微磁模拟对比。

papers.title: Emergent spin quantum Hall edge states at the boundary of two-dimensional electron gas proximitized by an $s$-wave superconductor
papers.abstract: Hybrid two-dimensional electron gas-superconductor (2DEG-S) structures in a quantized magnetic field offer a promising platform for realizing new topological phases. While recent experiments reveal chiral Andreev edge states, their charge conductance is not integer quantized and is disorder sensitive, raising the question of whether topological protection survives. We argue that it does, but manifests in the spin transport channel. The 2DEG-S system belongs to symmetry class C of the Altland-Zirnbauer classification, which supports an even-integer quantized transverse spin conductivity - the spin quantum Hall effect, so far unobserved experimentally. We demonstrate that 2DEG-S hybrids host topologically protected edge states carrying a spin current with an even-integer quantized spin conductance robust against disorder. Finally, we propose an experimental setup to probe this protection via electrical measurements, establishing a concrete route to detect the class C origin of the chiral Andreev edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要使用理论论证（“We argue that...”、“We demonstrate that...”）和提出实验方案（“propose an experimental setup”），未提及具体实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：二维电子气与s波超导体混合结构（2DEG-S hybrid）在量子化磁场中的边界态，具体为手征安德烈夫边缘态的自旋输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系属于Altland-Zirnbauer分类中的C类，支持拓扑保护的边缘态，其自旋电导呈偶数整数量子化，且对无序具有鲁棒性，即表现为自旋量子霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系属于Altland-Zirnbauer分类中的C类，支持拓扑保护的边缘态，其自旋电导呈偶数整数量子化，且对无序具有鲁棒性，即表现为自旋量子霍尔效应。；创新点：指出此前实验中手征安德烈夫边缘态的电荷电导非整数量子化且对无序敏感的问题，并非拓扑保护失效，而是拓扑保护体现在自旋输运通道中；首次提出在2DEG-S体系中实现自旋量子霍尔效应，并给出通过电学测量探测该拓扑保护的实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分类（Altland-Zirnbauer分类）的理论分析，论证体系属于C类，并推导出自旋霍尔电导的偶数整数量子化性质。

papers.title: Enhancement of $J$$_c$ by Proton Irradiation in HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_8$$_+$$_δ$ Single Crystals
papers.abstract: Critical current density is the key parameter for the practical application of superconductivity. In this study, 3 MeV proton irradiation experiments were conducted on HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_8$$_+$$_δ$ single crystals to introduce pinning centers. The critical current density is found to be strongly enhanced after the irradiation with its maximum at a dose of 1$\times$10$^{16}$/cm$^2$, where the self-field critical current density at 2 K is enhanced from 5.5 MA/cm$^2$ to 26 MA/cm$^2$. At 77 K, the self-field critical current density for all irradiated crystals is over 0.1 MA/cm$^2$. The power-law dependence of the critical current density on the magnetic field is observed after irradiation, with a large power-law exponent $α$ close to 1. A monotonic magnetic field dependence of the normalized magnetic relaxation rate is observed, which could be attributed to the low irreversibility field caused by the large anisotropy in Hg1223 single crystals. Through the analysis of the pinning force density of the crystal before and after irradiation, a clear mechanism change has been observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“proton irradiation experiments”、“single crystals”、“measurements”。；研究对象：HgBa₂Ca₂Cu₃O₈₊δ（Hg1223）单晶的高温超导体，具体研究其临界电流密度在质子辐照后的增强行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 3 MeV质子辐照可显著增强Hg1223单晶的临界电流密度，在剂量为1×10¹⁶/cm²时达到最佳效果，2 K自场下临界电流密度从5.5 MA/cm²提升至26 MA/cm²；辐照后临界电流密度与磁场呈幂律依赖关系，且幂指数α接近1。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：3 MeV质子辐照可显著增强Hg1223单晶的临界电流密度，在剂量为1×10¹⁶/cm²时达到最佳效果，2 K自场下临界电流密度从5.5 MA/cm²提升至26 MA/cm²；辐照后临界电流密度与磁场呈幂律依赖关系，且幂指数α接近1。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用3 MeV质子辐照实验引入钉扎中心；通过测量辐照前后单晶的临界电流密度、磁弛豫率及钉扎力密度，分析其磁场依赖性和机制变化。

papers.title: Thermodynamic incompleteness in non-Markovian Majorana transport I: Island dynamics and missing transport statistics
papers.abstract: We show that the complete knowledge of the non-Markovian island-state dynamics of a floating Majorana island does not, in general, determine the thermodynamic transport statistics measured in the leads. We demonstrate this statement in a Coulomb-blockaded island with $M$ Majorana zero modes coupled to structured reservoirs. In the cotunneling regime, a Schrieffer-Wolff transformation gives reservoir-assisted transitions generated by Majorana bilinears. After the reservoirs are traced out, the island state determines the memory kernel associated with each bilinear, and this is enough to predict all island-state observables within the cotunneling approximation. It is not enough to determine which lead or detector channel supplied the electron, absorbed the electron, or carried the corresponding energy exchange. This is a genuine loss of thermodynamic information, not an error in the island equation. We formulate the result as a thermodynamic completeness criterion: an island memory equation determines a transport observable only when that observable is constant over all assignments of reservoir channels that give the same island memory kernel. The criterion gives a measurable prediction. Two structured-reservoir Majorana devices can have identical island-state tomography and relaxation, but different charge noise measured separately in the leads, heat noise, and mixed charge-energy correlations. The geometry of the projection from reservoir records to island kernels and the topology of the network of tunnel contacts identify which transport information is absent from island-state dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we show”“we demonstrate”“we formulate”等理论推导表述，涉及Schrieffer-Wolff变换、记忆核、投影几何等理论框架，无实验或计算细节。；研究对象：非马尔可夫输运中漂浮Majorana岛的岛态动力学与热力学输运统计之间的关系，具体为库仑阻塞岛中耦合到结构化库的M个Majorana零模体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非马尔可夫Majorana输运中，即使完全知道岛态动力学（包括记忆核），也无法唯一确定在电极中测量的热力学输运统计量（如电荷噪声、热噪声、电荷-能量关联）。这是一种热力学信息的内在缺失，而非岛态方程本身的误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非马尔可夫Majorana输运中，即使完全知道岛态动力学（包括记忆核），也无法唯一确定在电极中测量的热力学输运统计量（如电荷噪声、热噪声、电荷-能量关联）。这是一种热力学信息的内在缺失，而非岛态方程本身的误差。；创新点：首次明确指出非马尔可夫岛态动力学与热力学输运统计之间的信息缺失关系，并给出可实验检验的判据：两个具有相同岛态层析和弛豫的结构化库Majorana器件，可在电极中表现出不同的电荷噪声、热噪声及混合电荷-能量关联。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：采用Schrieffer-Wolff变换处理共隧穿区，得到由Majorana双线性算符生成的库辅助跃迁；通过迹除库自由度得到岛态记忆核；提出“热力学完备性判据”——只有当输运观测量在所有产生相同岛记忆核的库通道分配下为常数时，该观测量才可由岛记忆方程确定。

papers.title: Polarizable atomic multipoles for learning long-range electrostatics
papers.abstract: Long-range electrostatics and polarization remain central obstacles to extending machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to ionic, polar, and interfacial systems. Here, we introduce a semi-local framework for learning electrostatics from energies and forces using polarizable atomic multipoles. Local equivariant descriptors predict environment-dependent latent monopoles, dipoles, and quadrupoles, while residual non-local charge transfer and polarization are captured by non-self-consistent linear response in induced charges and dipoles. Across four diverse benchmarks and four short-range MLIP architectures, the multipole hierarchy and response terms systematically improve potential energy surface accuracy, with the largest gains in systems where long-range effects are essential. More importantly, the learned latent variables recover physically meaningful electrical responses: accurate Born effective charge tensors, emergent polarizabilities, infrared spectra in close agreement with experiments, and semi-quantitative Raman spectra for bulk water and hybrid MAPbI$_3$ perovskite. This systematically improvable, physically transparent framework enables MLIPs trained on standard energy and force labels to predict polarization-sensitive observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、local equivariant descriptors、linear response。；研究对象：机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）中长程静电与极化效应的建模，具体应用于离子、极性和界面体系（如体相水、杂化钙钛矿MAPbI₃）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入可极化原子多极矩（单极、偶极、四极）及非自洽线性响应项，能够系统性地提升MLIPs对势能面的精度，并学习到物理上有意义的电学响应（如Born有效电荷、极化率、红外与拉曼光谱）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入可极化原子多极矩（单极、偶极、四极）及非自洽线性响应项，能够系统性地提升MLIPs对势能面的精度，并学习到物理上有意义的电学响应（如Born有效电荷、极化率、红外与拉曼光谱）。；创新点：提出了一种系统可改进、物理透明的半局域多极矩框架，使仅用能量和力标签训练的MLIPs能够预测极化敏感可观测量（如红外/拉曼光谱），而无需额外训练数据。
papers.method_zh: 采用半局域框架：利用局域等变描述符预测依赖于环境的潜单极、偶极和四极矩，再通过诱导电荷与偶极的非自洽线性响应捕捉非局域电荷转移与极化效应。该方法可嵌入四种短程MLIP架构中。

papers.title: Nonlinear Hall quantum oscillations to probe topological Brown-Zak fermions in graphene moiré systems
papers.abstract: Due to the deep connection with the quantum geometry of electronic Bloch wavefunctions, the second-order nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) has been an attractive topic since its proposal. However, studies on NLHE under a magnetic field have been lacking. Given that quantum oscillations in the linear response regime have been proven to be useful tools in investigating electronic systems, searching for quantum oscillations in NLHE is of great interest and is expected to provide new avenues to unveil rich quantum geometric properties of novel quasiparticles. Here, we propose a new type of NLHE quantum oscillations and experimentally probe it in graphene moiré systems. It stems from the alternation of the dominant NLHE mechanisms with recurring Bloch states under magnetic field, which enables sensitive detection of Brown-Zak fermions, giving an onset field as low as 0.5 T. Most importantly, when the commensurability condition is satisfied, the nonlinear transport of Brown-Zak fermions is mainly governed by quantum geometric contributions. Our findings not only establish a new type of quantum oscillations, but also demonstrate the first experimental detection of the topological nature of Brown-Zak fermions, shedding light on the exploration of novel topological quasiparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally probe、our findings、demonstrate the first experimental detection）；研究对象：石墨烯莫尔体系中的非线性霍尔效应量子振荡，以及拓扑Brown-Zak费米子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并实验观测到一种新型非线性霍尔效应量子振荡，该振荡源于磁场下布洛赫态重现导致的非线性霍尔效应主导机制交替，可灵敏探测Brown-Zak费米子，并在公度条件下首次实验证实其拓扑性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并实验观测到一种新型非线性霍尔效应量子振荡，该振荡源于磁场下布洛赫态重现导致的非线性霍尔效应主导机制交替，可灵敏探测Brown-Zak费米子，并在公度条件下首次实验证实其拓扑性质。；创新点：首次在非线性霍尔效应中观测到量子振荡，并利用该振荡首次实验探测到Brown-Zak费米子的拓扑本质。
papers.method_zh: 理论提出与实验测量相结合：通过分析磁场下非线性霍尔效应的量子振荡机制，并在石墨烯莫尔体系中开展输运实验探测。

papers.title: A Scalable Translationally Invariant Variational Theory of Ab Initio Polarons
papers.abstract: We introduce a scalable, translationally invariant variational theory for ab initio polarons that remains applicable across coupling regimes without resorting to supercells. Our approach combines a momentum-projected Toyozawa-type wavefunction with a low-rank factorization of the electron-phonon kernel, enabling near-linear scaling with the number of $\mathbf{k}$-points while capturing both delocalized and self-trapped carriers. Benchmarks for the Fröhlich model, LiF, and anatase and rutile TiO$_2$ yield accurate polaron binding energies, thermodynamic-limit band structures, and transparent real-space measures of polaron extent. For LiF, comparison with first-principles diagrammatic Monte Carlo (DiagMC) reveals close agreement for the weak-coupling electron-polaron ground state and band structure. However, in the hole-polaron of LiF, which is in the strong-coupling regime, we found a significant bias in DiagMC results. These results establish momentum-projected variational wavefunctions as a systematically improvable route to thermodynamic limit studies of polarons in real materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：variational theory、wavefunction、low-rank factorization）；研究对象：ab initio极化子（polarons），具体材料包括LiF、锐钛矿和金红石TiO₂，以及Fröhlich模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可扩展、平移不变的变分理论，能够准确计算极化子结合能、热力学极限能带结构和实空间极化子范围，并发现对于LiF中的强耦合空穴极化子，第一性原理图解蒙特卡洛（DiagMC）结果存在显著偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可扩展、平移不变的变分理论，能够准确计算极化子结合能、热力学极限能带结构和实空间极化子范围，并发现对于LiF中的强耦合空穴极化子，第一性原理图解蒙特卡洛（DiagMC）结果存在显著偏差。；创新点：该方法在保持平移不变性的同时，可跨越耦合区间（从弱耦合到强耦合）适用，并首次实现了对真实材料中极化子的热力学极限研究，且具有系统可改进性。
papers.method_zh: 动量投影的Toyozawa型波函数结合电子-声子核的低秩分解，实现近线性标度计算，无需超胞。

papers.title: Si/SiGe multi-channel superlattice structure epitaxial growth with segmented temperature control for Next-Generation Logic Devices
papers.abstract: Stacking multiple SiSiGe channels in advanced logic devices faces severe thermal budget accumulation, which degrades interfaces via Ge-Si interdiffusion and strain relaxation.This strategy lowers the Ge diffusion coefficient to 5.6-7% of its value at 650C (Arrhenius estimate), suppressing interdiffusion and preserving pseudomorphic strain. The 4 + 4 channel stack exhibits clear XRD satellite peaks, fully coherent strain state (reciprocal space mapping), sharp interfaces (1.5-2.6 nm transition width) and low RMS roughness (0.08 nm). Quantitative analysis from bottom to top reveals that prolonged high-temperature exposure broadens bottom interfaces and dilutes Ge concentration (from 20% to 18.5%), while the top stack maintains design targets. This work provides a process-physics understanding of thermal budget effects in multi-channel superlattices and establishes a high-quality material foundation for advanced logic devices beyond 2 nm node.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：epitaxial growth（外延生长）、XRD（X射线衍射）、reciprocal space mapping（倒易空间映射）。；研究对象：Si/SiGe多通道超晶格结构，具体为用于2纳米以下先进逻辑器件的多层SiGe沟道堆叠材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分段温度控制策略，将Ge扩散系数降低至650°C时的5.6-7%，有效抑制了Ge-Si互扩散和应变弛豫，成功制备出具有清晰界面（过渡宽度1.5-2.6 nm）和低表面粗糙度（0.08 nm）的4+4通道超晶格堆叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分段温度控制策略，将Ge扩散系数降低至650°C时的5.6-7%，有效抑制了Ge-Si互扩散和应变弛豫，成功制备出具有清晰界面（过渡宽度1.5-2.6 nm）和低表面粗糙度（0.08 nm）的4+4通道超晶格堆叠。；创新点：提出了针对多通道超晶格热预算积累问题的分段温度控制策略，并系统定量分析了从底部到顶部通道的Ge浓度梯度（从20%降至18.5%）和界面展宽效应，建立了热预算效应的工艺-物理理解。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）生长Si/SiGe多通道超晶格，结合分段温度控制工艺；使用X射线衍射（XRD）卫星峰分析、倒易空间映射（RSM）表征应变状态，以及界面过渡宽度和表面粗糙度的定量分析。

papers.title: Inter-harmonic ratio structure and saturation of Bernstein modes in graphene
papers.abstract: Bernstein modes (BM) in graphene are finite-wavevector magnetoplasmons excited by contact near fields, whereas ordinary cyclotron resonance (CR) probes $q\approx0$. We derive the BM peak absorption in the quasiclassical ballistic regime and show that it factorizes into a launch spectrum, Bernstein-mode splitting, turning-point enhancement, and residual dielectric-response factor. At fixed excitation frequency, BM overtones ($n\ge2$) are sampled, to leading order, at the same momentum $q\simeqω/v_F$. Smooth launch and screening factors therefore cancel in inter-harmonic peak ratios, yielding $I_n/I_m\simeq m/n$, modified by linewidth corrections and one residual response ratio for each harmonic pair. In smooth-launcher synthetic tests, noisy full-$q$ spectra recover the residual ratio within errors: moderate launcher/dielectric misspecification within this benchmark family shifts it by only $\sim\!1$--$2\%$, whereas linewidth assumptions shift it by $\sim\!10$--$30\%$. The same factorization connects low-power amplitudes to nonlinear saturation. If BM harmonics share the same cooling region and bolometric readout, the low-power slope times onset intensity is harmonic independent, while BM and CR power sweeps obey distinct normalized saturation curves with linewidth scalings $Γ^{-1/2}$ and $Γ^{-1}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“derive”（推导）、“factorizes”（因子化）、“synthetic tests”（合成测试）等关键词，主要进行解析推导和数值模拟，未提及实验数据或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：石墨烯中的伯恩斯坦模式（Bernstein modes, BM），即有限波矢的磁等离激元，以及其与普通回旋共振（CR）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准经典弹道输运区，伯恩斯坦模式峰值吸收可因子化为发射谱、模式分裂、转折点增强和残余介电响应因子的乘积；谐波间峰值比简化为 \( I_n/I_m \simeq m/n \)，且该因子化框架可连接低功率振幅与非线性饱和行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准经典弹道输运区，伯恩斯坦模式峰值吸收可因子化为发射谱、模式分裂、转折点增强和残余介电响应因子的乘积；谐波间峰值比简化为 \( I_n/I_m \simeq m/n \)，且该因子化框架可连接低功率振幅与非线性饱和行为。；创新点：揭示了伯恩斯坦模式谐波间峰值比的简单解析形式（\( m/n \)），并建立了低功率振幅与非线性饱和之间的统一因子化关系，同时指出伯恩斯坦模式与普通回旋共振的饱和曲线具有不同的线宽标度律（\( \Gamma^{-1/2} \) 与 \( \Gamma^{-1} \)）。
papers.method_zh: 采用准经典弹道输运框架进行解析推导，并通过平滑发射器合成测试（synthetic tests）进行数值验证，分析发射器/介电参数误设及线宽假设对残余响应比的影响。

papers.title: Physics-Grounded Understanding of Thermal Boundary Conductance between Ga$_2$O$_3$ and SiC from a Feedforward Neural Network Potential
papers.abstract: Ga$_2$O$_3$/SiC heterointegration is attractive for ultra-wide-bandgap power electronics, but interfacial thermal boundary conductance (TBC) remains a major heat-removal bottleneck. Direct experimental access to intrinsic atomistic interfacial transport remains limited, particularly for ideally synthesized materials with defect-free interfacial contact. First-principles simulations are too expensive at relevant length and time scales, while empirical Molecular Dynamics (MD) potentials often lack transferability across oxide and carbide bonding environments. We develop a unified feedforward neural network potential and validate it against density-functional data, bulk phonon dispersions, and anisotropic thermal-conductivity trends in both $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and SiC. Nonequilibrium simulations show that TBC decreases with transport length, increases with temperature, and is consistently higher for Ga$_2$O$_3$$(\bar{2}01)$/SiC(0001) than for Ga$_2$O$_3$(100)/SiC(0001). These trends are explained by attenuation of long-mean-free-path carriers, enhanced incoherent and anharmonic interfacial exchange within broadly unchanged spectral channels, and stronger bonding and vibrational coupling at the $(\bar{2}01)$ interface. The results show how a single transferable feedforward neural network potential can enable large-scale transport prediction and physics-grounded mechanistic understanding of thermal boundary conductance. Code for NEP training and simulation workflows is available at the project repository https://github.com/knowhow07/TBC_Ga2O3_SiC.git
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a unified feedforward neural network potential”、“Nonequilibrium simulations”、“first-principles simulations”等计算与模拟方法。；研究对象：Ga₂O₃/SiC异质结的界面热边界电导（TBC）及其微观物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热边界电导随输运长度增加而降低、随温度升高而增加，且Ga₂O₃(¯201)/SiC(0001)界面的TBC始终高于Ga₂O₃(100)/SiC(0001)界面。这些趋势可由长平均自由程载流子的衰减、非相干与非谐界面交换增强，以及(¯201)界面更强的键合与振动耦合来解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热边界电导随输运长度增加而降低、随温度升高而增加，且Ga₂O₃(¯201)/SiC(0001)界面的TBC始终高于Ga₂O₃(100)/SiC(0001)界面。这些趋势可由长平均自由程载流子的衰减、非相干与非谐界面交换增强，以及(¯201)界面更强的键合与振动耦合来解释。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 开发并验证了一个统一的**前馈神经网络势（feedforward neural network potential）**，结合密度泛函数据、体相声子色散和各向异性热导率趋势进行验证，并采用**非平衡分子动力学（Nonequilibrium Molecular Dynamics）**模拟计算界面热边界电导。

papers.title: Tuning charge-transport properties and magnetic order in metallic EuTiO$_{3-δ}$
papers.abstract: The stoichiometric antiferromagnetic insulator EuTiO$_3$ is proximate to a ferroelectric phase. Whereas cation substitution has been used as a tuning parameter to introduce charge carriers and manipulate the magnetism, the effects of oxygen-vacancy doping have been less explored. Here we report a detailed study of the charge transport and magnetic properties of metallic, oxygen-vacancy-doped EuTiO$_{3-δ}$. Using CaH$_2$ as an oxygen getter to achieve a higher carrier concentration than previously reported, we find that the phase diagram of the oxygen-vacancy-doped system is distinct from that obtained via cation doping. In particular, we uncover a change from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic order in the metallic state, with a maximum Curie temperature of TC $\approx$ 11 K at the highest carrier concentration of n $\approx$ 10$^{21}$ cm$^{-3}$. These findings are supported by density functional theory calculations, which indicate a significant change in the nearest-neighbor magnetic exchange constant with increasing electron doping. We also present x-ray diffuse scattering and complementary first-principles results that reveal that, similar to the prominent incipient ferroelectric perovskite SrTiO$_3$, the data for EuTiO$_3$ are consistent with thermal diffuse scattering and with the absence of quasi-elastic contributions. Finally, we report specific heat measurements that confirm the magnetic transition temperatures deduced from magnetization measurements and corroborate the lattice dynamics picture inferred from the diffuse scattering data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了“charge transport and magnetic properties”的实验研究，并提及“density functional theory calculations”和“first-principles results”作为理论支持。；研究对象：氧空位掺杂的金属性钛酸铕（EuTiO₃₋δ）的电荷输运性质与磁有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过氧空位掺杂实现高载流子浓度（n ≈ 10²¹ cm⁻³），在金属态中观察到从反铁磁到铁磁有序的转变，最高居里温度TC ≈ 11 K。该掺杂体系的相图与阳离子掺杂体系显著不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过氧空位掺杂实现高载流子浓度（n ≈ 10²¹ cm⁻³），在金属态中观察到从反铁磁到铁磁有序的转变，最高居里温度TC ≈ 11 K。该掺杂体系的相图与阳离子掺杂体系显著不同。；创新点：首次系统研究了氧空位掺杂对EuTiO₃磁性和输运性质的影响，发现其相图与阳离子掺杂体系不同，并揭示了电子掺杂对最近邻磁交换常数的显著改变。
papers.method_zh: 使用CaH₂作为氧吸气剂实现高载流子浓度掺杂；进行了电荷输运测量、磁化强度测量、X射线漫散射实验、比热测量；并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和第一性原理计算分析磁交换常数与晶格动力学。

papers.title: Strain-Dependent Ionic Transport in Li3YCl6 Solid Electrolytes
papers.abstract: Solid-state batteries require electrolytes that sustain high ionic conductivity under the mechanical environment of a functioning cell. Lattice strain, arising from stack pressure, thermal cycling, or lattice mismatch at interfaces, can either enhance or suppress Li+ transport in solid electrolytes, yet how it couples to the underlying diffusion mechanism remains poorly understood. Using Li3YCl6 halide superionic conductor, we address this with large-scale molecular dynamics simulations driven by an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) machine learning interatomic potential trained on first-principles data. The ACE model faithfully reproduces experimental and \textit{ab initio} structural, mechanical, and transport properties of Li3YCl6. We find that Li+ diffusion in Li3YCl6 follows a two-regime Arrhenius behavior, crossing over at a critical temperature $T_c$ from one-dimensional hopping at low temperature to three-dimensional cooperative diffusion at high temperature. Strain substantially modulates diffusivity: tensile strain enhances it while compressive strain suppresses it, yet leaves $T_c$ invariant, indicating that strain tunes diffusion efficiency without reshaping the underlying transport framework. In each regime, the mechanistic origin differs: altered activation barriers dominate at low temperature, while modified pre-exponential factors become critical at high temperature. These results establish lattice strain as a design lever for ionic conductivity in Li3YCl6 solid-state electrolytes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：large-scale molecular dynamics simulations、Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) machine learning interatomic potential、first-principles data。；研究对象：Li3YCl6卤化物超离子导体中的锂离子输运行为，以及晶格应变对其离子电导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li3YCl6中锂离子扩散呈现双区Arrhenius行为，在临界温度Tc处从低温一维跳跃转变为高温三维协同扩散；拉伸应变增强扩散，压缩应变抑制扩散，但Tc保持不变，表明应变仅调节扩散效率而不改变输运框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li3YCl6中锂离子扩散呈现双区Arrhenius行为，在临界温度Tc处从低温一维跳跃转变为高温三维协同扩散；拉伸应变增强扩散，压缩应变抑制扩散，但Tc保持不变，表明应变仅调节扩散效率而不改变输运框架。；创新点：揭示了应变对Li3YCl6中锂离子扩散的调控机制，并指出在低温与高温两个扩散区中，应变影响的物理起源不同（低温以激活能变化为主，高温以前指数因子变化为主）。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理数据训练的原子团簇展开（ACE）机器学习原子间势，进行大规模分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Galois Solvability of Finite-Size Bethe Solutions in the Heisenberg Chain
papers.abstract: The spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnetic chain is the canonical example of an integrable quantum many-body model. Despite its exact solvability, explicit finite-size solutions are typically only accessible via numerical evaluation of the Bethe ansatz equations. Here, we analyse the algebraic structure of the exact, symbolic ground states for chains up to ten sites using the coordinate Bethe ansatz. We show that both the ground state wavefunction and the Bethe-roots rapidly develop algebraic complexity with respect to system size, but at different rates. The Bethe-roots appear to become Galois unsolvable for chains of eight or more sites, whereas the ground state wavefunction coefficients and energy appear to become unsolvable for ten or more sites. This demonstrates a lack of explicit analytic tractability in a quantum integrable model due to algebraic complexity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bethe ansatz、algebraic structure、Galois unsolvability。；研究对象：自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁链（spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnetic chain）的有限尺寸基态解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限尺寸海森堡链中，Bethe根（Bethe-roots）在8个格点以上变得伽罗瓦不可解（Galois unsolvable），而基态波函数系数和能量在10个格点以上变得不可解，表明该可积量子多体模型因代数复杂性而缺乏显式解析可处理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限尺寸海森堡链中，Bethe根（Bethe-roots）在8个格点以上变得伽罗瓦不可解（Galois unsolvable），而基态波函数系数和能量在10个格点以上变得不可解，表明该可积量子多体模型因代数复杂性而缺乏显式解析可处理性。；创新点：首次揭示了可积量子多体模型（海森堡链）中有限尺寸基态解的伽罗瓦不可解性，并指出Bethe根与波函数系数/能量在代数复杂性上存在不同的增长速率。
papers.method_zh: 采用坐标Bethe ansatz（coordinate Bethe ansatz）对最多10个格点的链进行精确符号基态分析，通过代数结构分析研究Bethe根和波函数系数的可解性。

papers.title: Collective quantum state at the atomic limit
papers.abstract: Collective quantum states are often associated with extended systems, where spatially extensive degrees of freedom enable emergent many-body behavior; whether such strongly correlated states survive at atomic dimensions remains a fundamental question. Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids provide a paradigmatic example of one-dimensional collective quantum matter characterized by spin-charge separation. Using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, we directly visualize quantized collective modes in atomically confined mirror twin boundary segments of monolayer WSe2. Distinct standing-wave branches associated with fractionalized spin and charge excitations persist in segments as short as one nanometer, establishing the atomic-scale confinement limit of Luttinger-liquid behavior. These ultrashort segments form a new class of many-body quantum dots whose discrete spectra arise from confined collective bosonic modes rather than single-particle electron states. When assembled into ordered chains, inter-dot coupling reshapes electron-like fundamental states while collective spin/charge excitations remain largely intact, revealing distinct coupling responses of emergent many-body modes. Our results demonstrate that collective quantum matter can persist and exhibit fundamentally distinct coupling behavior at atomic length scales, establishing a novel platform for engineering strongly correlated quantum phases from atomically confined building blocks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy（低温扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学）。；研究对象：单层WSe₂中原子尺度受限的镜像孪晶边界（mirror twin boundary segments）及其中的集体量子态，具体为Tomonaga-Luttinger液体行为在原子极限下的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅1纳米长的原子受限镜像孪晶边界段中，仍可观测到与自旋-电荷分离对应的量子化集体模式驻波，证明Luttinger液体行为可存活至原子尺度极限；这些超短段形成一种新型多体量子点，其离散谱源于受限的集体玻色子模式而非单粒子电子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅1纳米长的原子受限镜像孪晶边界段中，仍可观测到与自旋-电荷分离对应的量子化集体模式驻波，证明Luttinger液体行为可存活至原子尺度极限；这些超短段形成一种新型多体量子点，其离散谱源于受限的集体玻色子模式而非单粒子电子态。；创新点：首次在原子尺度（1纳米）的受限体系中直接观测到Luttinger液体的集体量子态，并发现其与单粒子态截然不同的耦合行为（当组装成有序链时，集体自旋/电荷激发几乎不受影响，而类电子基态被重塑），从而建立了从原子尺度受限构建块工程化强关联量子相的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS）直接成像与谱学测量。

papers.title: Multifrequency Floquet Engineering of Magnon Polaritons
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering of cavity magnon-polaritons by periodically modulating the magnon frequency has recently attracted much interest as a way to manipulate the energy spectrum of magnon-photon hybrid systems. However, modulating the frequency of magnons by a time-varying bias magnetic field can be challenging. We demonstrate cavity magnon-polariton Floquet engineering by modulating the microwave cavity frequency, allowing large modulation depth and bandwidth. We apply commensurate two-frequency Floquet modulations with the higher frequency at twice and three times the lower frequency, and demonstrate that the resulting spectrum depends on the relative amplitude and phase of the two drive tones. In comparison with single-frequency Floquet modulations, the spectrum has qualitatively different features; in particular, new anticrossings appear between previously uncoupled sidebands. Our platform offers an alternative way to manipulate Floquet quasi-energy levels in hybrid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”（展示）、“platform”（平台）等关键词，并描述了具体的实验调制和观测结果。；研究对象：腔磁子-极化激元（cavity magnon-polaritons）的Floquet工程，具体是通过调制微波腔频率来操控磁子-光子混合系统的准能级。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加两频率成整数比（2:1和3:1）的协同Floquet调制，发现能谱依赖于两个驱动信号的相对振幅和相位，并出现了单频率调制下不存在的新的反交叉现象（即原本未耦合的边带之间发生耦合）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加两频率成整数比（2:1和3:1）的协同Floquet调制，发现能谱依赖于两个驱动信号的相对振幅和相位，并出现了单频率调制下不存在的新的反交叉现象（即原本未耦合的边带之间发生耦合）。；创新点：首次通过调制微波腔频率（而非磁子频率）来实现腔磁子-极化激元的Floquet工程，并引入了多频率（双频率）协同调制，揭示了相对振幅和相位对能谱的调控作用，以及新出现的边带间反交叉现象。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用对微波腔频率进行周期性调制（而非调制磁子频率）的方法，实现了大调制深度和带宽；并施加了两种频率成整数比（高频率为低频率的2倍和3倍）的协同Floquet调制。

papers.title: Tunable Interlayer Charge-transfer States in MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ Moiré Superlattices
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices formed by transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterobilayers provide a versatile platform for studying strongly correlated electronic, excitonic, and topological phenomena in solids. In particular, angle-aligned MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ heterobilayers, which have a Type-I band alignment at zero vertical electric field, host rich correlated spin and charge physics. Here, combining large-scale first-principles calculations and optical reflection spectroscopy, we report a thorough study of the emergent moiré excitonic states and interlayer charge-transfer states in angle-aligned electron-doped MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ moiré superlattices. The moiré excitonic states serve as sensitive optical probes to the localization profile of doped electrons. We observe a series of interlayer charge-transfer transitions from n/n$_0$ = 1 to 4 (where n$_0$ denotes the moiré density) when the vertical electric field switches the heterostructure band alignment from Type-I to Type-II. By tuning the vertical electric field, we can precisely control the interlayer electron localization, realizing a Fermi-Hubbard model with a tunable charge-transfer band on an effective honeycomb lattice. Furthermore, Monte Carlo simulation of the doping dependence of the electric-field susceptibility predicts that multiple correlated charge-ordered states appear at both integer and fractional fillings. Our results provide a holistic understanding of the emergent optical excitations and the correlated charge-transfer states in electron-doped MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ moiré superlattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（第一性原理计算 + 光学反射谱实验）。判断依据：关键词“large-scale first-principles calculations”和“optical reflection spectroscopy”。；研究对象：MoSe₂/WS₂ 莫尔超晶格中的层间电荷转移态与莫尔激子态，具体为电子掺杂、转角对齐的 MoSe₂/WS₂ 异质双层体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过垂直电场调控，可精确控制 MoSe₂/WS₂ 莫尔超晶格从 Type-I 到 Type-II 的能带对齐转变，并观测到从 n/n₀ = 1 到 4 的一系列层间电荷转移跃迁，从而在有效蜂窝晶格上实现具有可调电荷转移带的费米-哈伯德模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过垂直电场调控，可精确控制 MoSe₂/WS₂ 莫尔超晶格从 Type-I 到 Type-II 的能带对齐转变，并观测到从 n/n₀ = 1 到 4 的一系列层间电荷转移跃迁，从而在有效蜂窝晶格上实现具有可调电荷转移带的费米-哈伯德模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 大规模第一性原理计算（large-scale first-principles calculations）；2. 光学反射谱（optical reflection spectroscopy）；3. 蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation）用于研究掺杂依赖的电场响应。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and emergent thermomechanical response of a quantum ring with nonminimal spin--orbit coupling
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic and emergent thermomechanical properties of fermions confined to a one-dimensional quantum ring with effective spin--orbit interactions induced by nonminimal couplings to antisymmetric tensor fields. Using the exact spectrum obtained in the companion work, we develop canonical and grand-canonical descriptions and show that the coupling parameter~$ξ$ deforms the angular-momentum branches, reorganizing the low-energy spectrum and leaving clear signatures in the internal energy, entropy, heat capacity, and spin--orbit response functions. We also formulate an effective thermomechanical description by treating the ring circumference as a quasi-static thermodynamic variable. This leads to a pressure-like quantity and associated response coefficients, directly linked to the microscopic spectrum. In the grand-canonical ensemble, Fermi statistics strongly enhance the response, producing coupling-dependent instabilities and sign changes reminiscent of mesoscopic de~Haas--van Alphen oscillations. Finally, we introduce a phenomenological interacting extension based on an exponential resummation of the free energy, showing that collective effects can sharpen the thermomechanical response and induce anomalous thermal contraction. Our results connect spectral deformation, finite-size thermodynamics, and emergent mechanical behavior in spin--orbit-active quantum rings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“我们研究”“我们发展”“我们引入”等理论推导和模型构建表述，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：一维量子环中的费米子，该体系具有由非最小耦合到反对称张量场诱导的有效自旋-轨道相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合参数ξ会形变角动量分支，重组低能谱，并在内能、熵、热容和自旋-轨道响应函数中留下清晰特征；在巨正则系综中，费米统计显著增强响应，产生类似介观de Haas–van Alphen振荡的耦合依赖不稳定性与符号变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合参数ξ会形变角动量分支，重组低能谱，并在内能、熵、热容和自旋-轨道响应函数中留下清晰特征；在巨正则系综中，费米统计显著增强响应，产生类似介观de Haas–van Alphen振荡的耦合依赖不稳定性与符号变化。；创新点：首次将非最小自旋-轨道耦合引入量子环的热力学与热力学响应研究，揭示了能谱形变、有限尺寸热力学与自旋-轨道活性量子环中涌现力学行为之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于伴生工作中获得的精确能谱，发展正则系综和巨正则系综的热力学描述；将环周长视为准静态热力学变量，构建有效热力学描述并引入压力类量及关联响应系数；通过自由能的指数重求和引入唯象的相互作用扩展。

papers.title: Field-Induced Local Excitations Causing Zero-Magnetization Plateaus in Antiferromagnets of Antiferromagnetic Spin Dimers Under Magnetic Field
papers.abstract: Certain antiferromagnets composed of antiferromagnetic spin dimers exhibit a zero-magnetization plateau despite that the single-ion anisotropy of their magnetic ions is negligible. The cause for this observation was investigated by analyzing how a magnetic field affects the energy spectrum of an antiferromagnetic chain composed of antiferromagnetic spin dimers made up of two spin-half ions and by carrying out specific heat measurements for potassium copper chloride as a function magnetic field at 2 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论加实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既包含理论分析（分析磁场如何影响反铁磁自旋二聚体链的能谱），也包含实验测量（对氯化铜钾进行比热测量）。；研究对象：由反铁磁自旋二聚体（两个自旋1/2离子构成）组成的反铁磁体，具体材料为氯化铜钾（potassium copper chloride），物理现象为零磁化平台（zero-magnetization plateau）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单离子各向异性可忽略的情况下，反铁磁自旋二聚体构成的某些反铁磁体仍会出现零磁化平台，其成因与磁场诱导的局域激发有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单离子各向异性可忽略的情况下，反铁磁自旋二聚体构成的某些反铁磁体仍会出现零磁化平台，其成因与磁场诱导的局域激发有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：分析磁场对反铁磁自旋二聚体链（由两个自旋1/2离子构成）能谱的影响。实验方面：在2 K温度下，对氯化铜钾进行随磁场变化的比热测量。

papers.title: Exact theory of plasmon reflection and transmission in partially gated two-dimensional system
papers.abstract: We develop an exact theory of plasmon scattering at the boundary between gated and ungated regions of a two-dimensional electron system (2DES). Using the Wiener-Hopf technique, we derive analytical expressions for the complex reflection and transmission coefficients of plasmons incident from both sides of the interface. The theory fully accounts for evanescent fields at the gate edge and radiative losses into free-space electromagnetic waves. In the non-retarded limit and for small gate-2DES separation, the reflected plasmon dominates the total electric field, while radiative losses are negligible when plasmon scattering. The amplitudes and phases of the reflection and transmission coefficients for plasmons incident from both sides have a complex dependence from 2DES-gate separation and conductivity of 2DES. Our results provide a rigorous foundation for modeling tunable plasmonic crystals based on 2DES for terahertz detection and modulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“exact theory”、“Wiener-Hopf technique”、“analytical expressions”。；研究对象：部分栅极覆盖的二维电子系统（2DES）中，有栅区域与无栅区域边界处的等离激元（plasmon）散射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了等离激元在栅极边界处反射与透射系数的精确解析表达式，并发现非延迟极限下且栅极-2DES间距较小时，反射等离激元主导总电场，而辐射损耗可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了等离激元在栅极边界处反射与透射系数的精确解析表达式，并发现非延迟极限下且栅极-2DES间距较小时，反射等离激元主导总电场，而辐射损耗可忽略。；创新点：首次建立了部分栅极二维电子系统中等离激元散射的精确理论，完整描述了反射/透射系数对栅极间距和2DES电导率的复杂依赖关系，为基于2DES的可调谐等离激元晶体建模提供了严格基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用Wiener-Hopf技术进行解析推导，严格考虑了栅极边缘的倏逝场以及向自由空间电磁波的辐射损耗。

papers.title: Breakdown of Emergent Chiral Order and Defect Chaos in Nonreciprocal Flocks
papers.abstract: We show that chiral order in two-dimensional nonreciprocal flocking mixtures is generically unstable. Combining large-scale agent-based simulations with a coarse-grained continuum description, we demonstrate that rotating chiral states emerging from antisymmetric couplings are destroyed by the proliferation of topological defects. The resulting dynamics is spatiotemporally chaotic and characterized by a finite correlation length that diverges as nonreciprocity vanishes. On length scales below this cutoff, density and orientational order fluctuations remain scale-free, but the associated scaling exhibits nonuniversal exponents. We attribute this atypical behavior to the coupling between density and order, which causes topological defects to act as persistent sources of nonlinear fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合类型。关键词：agent-based simulations（基于主体的模拟）、coarse-grained continuum description（粗粒化连续描述）。；研究对象：非互易性（nonreciprocal）二维混合群体（flocking mixtures）中的手性有序（chiral order）及其拓扑缺陷动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维非互易群体中的手性有序态普遍不稳定，会被拓扑缺陷的增殖所破坏，导致时空混沌动力学，且密度与取向涨落呈现非普适标度指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维非互易群体中的手性有序态普遍不稳定，会被拓扑缺陷的增殖所破坏，导致时空混沌动力学，且密度与取向涨落呈现非普适标度指数。；创新点：揭示了非互易耦合下旋转手性态因拓扑缺陷增殖而崩溃的普遍机制，并发现密度-取向耦合导致缺陷成为持续非线性涨落源，从而产生非普适标度指数。
papers.method_zh: 结合大规模基于主体的模拟（agent-based simulations）与粗粒化连续场理论描述，分析手性有序态的稳定性、缺陷动力学及关联长度标度行为。

papers.title: Resonance Proliferation Across Localization Transitions
papers.abstract: Models of many-body localization (MBL) exhibit slow numerical drifts towards delocalization with increasing system size, for which no satisfactory theory exists. Numerics indicates that these drifts are driven by the proliferation of many-body resonances at intermediate disorder strengths. We develop a statistical method to predict the distribution of resonance oscillation frequencies which captures how the formation of resonances at larger frequency scales subsequently affects the formation of resonances at lower frequencies. Working within the statistical Jacobi approximation (SJA), we derive a flow equation for a power-law exponent $θ(w)$ characterizing the density of resonances at frequency scale $w$. A localized phase is described by a line of fixed points with $θ(w)>0$, while an instability of the flow signals resonance proliferation and the onset of thermalization. The predicted $θ(w)$ matches numerics on the Anderson model on random regular graphs and the Lévy-Rosenzweig-Porter random matrix ensemble, both of which host resonance-driven delocalization transitions. We further connect the flow to eigenstate properties such as the participation ratio and to dynamical observables such as the return probability. The predicted $θ(w)$ also matches what is numerically measured in real-space models of MBL at intermediate disorder strengths, representing a significant step towards explaining the finite-size drifts observed in MBL.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：statistical method, flow equation, fixed points, instability of the flow）；研究对象：多体局域化（MBL）中的共振增殖与退局域化相变，具体包括随机正则图上的安德森模型、Lévy-Rosenzweig-Porter随机矩阵系综以及实空间MBL模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中间无序强度下，多体共振在更大频率尺度上的形成会级联地影响更低频率尺度上的共振形成，导致共振增殖并触发热化；局域相由一条固定点线描述，其共振密度幂律指数θ(w)>0，而流动的不稳定性标志着共振增殖和热化开始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中间无序强度下，多体共振在更大频率尺度上的形成会级联地影响更低频率尺度上的共振形成，导致共振增殖并触发热化；局域相由一条固定点线描述，其共振密度幂律指数θ(w)>0，而流动的不稳定性标志着共振增殖和热化开始。；创新点：首次提出一个统计方法，通过流动方程定量预测不同频率尺度下共振密度的演化，并成功将理论预测与MBL实空间模型在中间无序强度下的数值测量结果匹配，为解释MBL中随系统尺寸增大而出现的缓慢退局域化漂移提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于统计雅可比近似（SJA）推导出共振密度幂律指数θ(w)的流动方程，并通过数值模拟（随机正则图安德森模型、Lévy-Rosenzweig-Porter系综）验证理论预测，同时将θ(w)与参与比、返回概率等本征态和动力学可观测量建立联系。

papers.title: Superconductivity mediated by nematic fluctuations -- the dispersion of collective modes
papers.abstract: We analyze the spectrum of collective modes in a superconductor in which pairing is mediated by long-range nematic fluctuations. Previous experimental and theoretical studies have found that the superconducting gap in such a system is highly anisotropic and, at any finite $T<T_c$, vanishes on four arcs of the Fermi surface, even when the pairing symmetry is $s$ wave ($s^{+-}$ between hole and electron pockets). We derive the expression for the pair susceptibility $χ(\mathbf{q},Ω)$ at finite momentum $\mathbf{q}$ and frequency $Ω$ deep in the superconducting phase. We analyze the spectral function, $\operatorname{Im}χ(\mathbf{q},Ω)$, and its pole structure in the transverse (phase) and longitudinal (amplitude) channels, and compare the results with those of a conventional $s$-wave superconductor. We find that the analytic structure of the pair susceptibility in both channels is qualitatively distinct from that in a BCS superconductor. This gives rise to a highly unconventional dispersion of phase and amplitude collective modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We derive the expression for...”、“We analyze the spectral function...”，属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：由向列涨落（nematic fluctuations）介导的超导体中的集体模（collective modes）的色散关系。具体体系为具有长程向列涨落、配对对称性为s波（s^{+-}）的超导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在由向列涨落介导的超导体中，对易磁化率（pair susceptibility）在相位（phase）和振幅（amplitude）通道的解析结构与BCS超导体有本质区别，导致相位和振幅集体模具有非常规的色散关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在由向列涨落介导的超导体中，对易磁化率（pair susceptibility）在相位（phase）和振幅（amplitude）通道的解析结构与BCS超导体有本质区别，导致相位和振幅集体模具有非常规的色散关系。；创新点：揭示了由向列涨落介导的超导体中集体模的色散关系与BCS超导体存在定性差异，即对易磁化率的解析结构完全不同，从而产生非常规的相位和振幅模色散。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析。具体包括：推导超导相中有限动量q和频率Ω下的对易磁化率χ(q,Ω)表达式；分析其谱函数Im χ(q,Ω)在横向（相位）和纵向（振幅）通道的极点结构；并与常规s波超导体结果进行对比。

papers.title: A transition in the hole probability at finite temperature for free fermions in $d$ dimensions
papers.abstract: In a free Fermi gas at temperature $T$ much higher than the Fermi temperature one expects that the fluctuations of the number of particles in a given region has Poissonian/classical statistics. On the other hand at low temperature the Pauli exclusion principle leads to non trivial counting statistics. It is of great interest from a theoretical and experimental point of view to characterize the crossover between these two limits. Here we focus on the hole probability $P(R,T)$, i.e. the probability that a region of size $R$ is devoid of particles, in dimension $d$, and on the case of a spherical region of large radius $R$. We show that at low temperature it takes the scaling form $P(R,T)\sim \exp\big[-(k_F R)^{d+1}Φ_d(u=2R\,T/k_F)\big],$ where $k_F$ is the Fermi momentum. By mapping the problem to an effective Coulomb gas, we compute exactly the scaling function $Φ_d(u)$ in any dimension. Remarkably, it exhibits a transition of order $\tfrac{3}{2}(d+1)$ at the universal critical value $u_c=2/π$, signaling a sharp change in the mechanism of rare fluctuations, associated with the emergence of a macroscopic gap in the optimal density of the associated Coulomb gas. Our analytical predictions are supported by precise numerical evaluations of the corresponding Fredholm determinants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“mapping to an effective Coulomb gas”“compute exactly the scaling function”“analytical predictions”等理论推导和解析计算关键词，并辅以数值验证（Fredholm determinants）。；研究对象：自由费米气体中球形区域内的“空穴概率”（hole probability），即给定区域中完全没有粒子的概率，研究其在有限温度下从低温到高温的统计行为转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空穴概率在低温下具有标度形式 \( P(R,T) \sim \exp[-(k_F R)^{d+1} \Phi_d(u)] \)，其中标度函数 \( \Phi_d(u) \) 在临界值 \( u_c = 2/\pi \) 处发生一个阶数为 \( \frac{3}{2}(d+1) \) 的相变，标志着稀有涨落机制的突然改变，对应有效库仑气最优密度中出现宏观能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空穴概率在低温下具有标度形式 \( P(R,T) \sim \exp[-(k_F R)^{d+1} \Phi_d(u)] \)，其中标度函数 \( \Phi_d(u) \) 在临界值 \( u_c = 2/\pi \) 处发生一个阶数为 \( \frac{3}{2}(d+1) \) 的相变，标志着稀有涨落机制的突然改变，对应有效库仑气最优密度中出现宏观能隙。；创新点：首次精确刻画了自由费米气体中空穴概率从低温（Pauli阻塞主导）到高温（泊松统计）的交叉行为，并发现该标度函数在任意维度下均存在一个普适的、高阶的相变点。
papers.method_zh: 通过将问题映射到有效库仑气模型，解析计算任意维度下的标度函数 \( \Phi_d(u) \)，并利用Fredholm行列式的精确数值计算验证解析结果。

papers.title: Band Unfolding via the Quadratic Pseudospectrum
papers.abstract: Band theory provides the foundation for understanding electronic structure in crystalline materials, but its reliance on exact translational symmetry limits its applicability to systems with defects, disorder, incommensurate modulations, or large unit cells. Here, we introduce a band unfolding framework that directly generalizes traditional band theory to systems where exact periodicity is absent, and which remains well-defined for both aperiodic and finite systems. To do so, we employ a pseudospectral approach to identify approximate joint eigenvectors of a system's Hamiltonian and translation operators, thereby yielding an unfolded band structure whose features are directly connected to the manifestation of approximate extended states simultaneously localized in energy and crystalline momentum. To reveal bulk-only spectral phenomena in finite systems, we further show that this pseudospectral framework naturally accommodates additional operators that suppress contributions from boundary-localized states, enabling the systematic isolation of intrinsic bulk behavior. We benchmark the scheme on several representative systems in one and two dimensions, including a Fibonacci chain, where our approach is able to both reveal a dispersive envelope while preserving the underlying hierarchy of spectral gaps. Looking forward, this pseudospectral approach may yield a broad framework for predicting momentum-resolved material responses in aperiodic, disordered, and finite systems where conventional band-theoretic methods are not applicable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：pseudospectral approach、band unfolding framework、generalizes traditional band theory。；研究对象：无严格周期性的系统，包括存在缺陷、无序、非公度调制、大原胞、准周期（如Fibonacci链）以及有限尺寸的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于二次伪谱的能带展开框架，能够将传统能带理论推广到缺乏精确周期性的系统中，从而在非周期和有限体系中获得与近似扩展态对应的展开能带结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于二次伪谱的能带展开框架，能够将传统能带理论推广到缺乏精确周期性的系统中，从而在非周期和有限体系中获得与近似扩展态对应的展开能带结构。；创新点：该框架直接推广了传统能带理论，使其在非周期、无序和有限体系中仍然有明确定义，并能揭示如Fibonacci链中色散包络与谱隙层级结构等传统方法无法获得的物理信息。
papers.method_zh: 采用伪谱方法（pseudospectral approach）识别系统哈密顿量与平移算符的近似联合本征矢，并进一步引入额外算符抑制边界局域态贡献，以分离有限体系中的体态谱特征。

papers.title: MLM: Multi-Layer Moire -- A Python Package for Generating Commensurate Supercells of Twisted Multilayer Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: Moire superlattices formed by stacking atomically thin two-dimensional materials with a relative twist angle have emerged as a versatile platform for engineering quantum electronic, optical, and ferroic properties. Computational modelling of such systems with periodic boundary conditions requires the identification of commensurate supercells in which the moire periodicity is reproduced exactly, or within a prescribed tolerance. While several codes exist for bilayer systems, extension to three or more layers with independently chosen twist angles remains a significant challenge. Here we present MLM (Multi-Layer Moire), an open-source Python package that constructs periodic, PBC-compatible moire supercells for an arbitrary number of twisted layers with any Bravais lattice type. The package employs a solve-and-round algorithm that reduces the coincidence-site search to an $O(N^2)$ linear-algebra problem per twist angle, compared to the O(N^4) brute-force enumeration required by conventional approaches. We demonstrate the package on bilayer graphene, bilayer and trilayer MoS$_2$, bilayer SrTiO$_3$, and a PbTiO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ oxide heterostructure, producing simulation-ready structure files for both VASP and LAMMPS. The fractional-coordinate atom-selection algorithm scales to supercells containing millions of atoms and is robust across all twist angles including very small angles below 1 degree.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Python package, computational modelling, algorithm。；研究对象：多层二维材料（如石墨烯、MoS₂、SrTiO₃、PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃氧化物异质结）的扭转莫尔超晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一个名为MLM（Multi-Layer Moire）的开源Python包，能够高效地为任意层数、任意布拉维格子的扭转二维材料构建与周期性边界条件兼容的莫尔超胞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一个名为MLM（Multi-Layer Moire）的开源Python包，能够高效地为任意层数、任意布拉维格子的扭转二维材料构建与周期性边界条件兼容的莫尔超胞。；创新点：将莫尔超胞的构建从双层系统推广到任意层数（三层及以上），且每层可独立选择扭转角，解决了现有代码的主要局限。其分数坐标原子选择算法可扩展至包含数百万个原子的超胞，并能在包括小于1度的极小扭转角下稳健工作。
papers.method_zh: 采用“求解并舍入”（solve-and-round）算法，将寻找重合位点的问题简化为每个扭转角下的O(N²)线性代数问题，相比传统O(N⁴)的暴力枚举方法效率更高。该包可生成适用于VASP和LAMMPS的结构文件。

papers.title: Frustrated Fields: Statistical Field Theory for Frustrated Brownian Particles on 2D Manifolds
papers.abstract: We develop a statistical field theory that describes the large-N limit of a system of Brownian particles with quenched random pairwise interactions on a compact two-dimensional Riemannian manifold.
